### M-ON-08 · Permissions review
- **Screen ID:** M-ON-08 (step 8)
- **Route:** `app/(onboarding)/permissions.tsx`
- **Entry points:** M-ON-07 CTA or skip.
- **Primary purpose:** The step-8 review (C-01): granted scopes in plain Turkish, per-account Data Source Controls enforced server-side (SREQ-68), and the device calendar permission state.
- **Data dependencies:** `connected_accounts` (capabilities_granted, granted_scopes, data_source_toggles, updated_at), OS calendar permission, `bootstrap.preferences.retention_policy`.
- **API dependencies:** `PATCH /integrations/:accountId/data-sources {data_sources:{<toggle>:boolean}, expected_updated_at}` (API-INT-05; the keys are the DB `data_source_toggles` keys); PostgREST `PATCH profiles {onboarding_step:'permissions'}`.
- **State dependencies:** `['integrations','accounts']`.
- **Source design reference:** P/07 › 7.3 (grouped list + switches, "AI'ın Eriştiği Veriler"); S/src/screens/settings/DataSourceControl.tsx (per-account axis). StepHeader "ADIM 1 / 4 · İZİNLER". Copy (new):
  - Title "Neye eriştiğimi gör." · sub "Bunları daha sonra Gizlilik Merkezi'nden de değiştirebilirsin."
  - Section "BAĞLI HESAPLAR": per account, a kicker with the account e-mail and switch rows:
    - Mail: "Mailleri analiz et" (`mail_read`, on) · (new) "Ekleri analiz et" (`attachments_analyze`, on) · "Son tarihleri tespit et" (`deadline_detect`, on) · "Yanıt taslağı hazırla" (`draft_replies`, on).
    - Calendar: "Etkinlikleri oku" (`calendar_read`, on) · "Uygun zaman öner" (`schedule_suggest`, on) · "Onayınla etkinlik oluştur" (`calendar_write_with_approval`, on).
  - Informational rows (non-interactive): "Mail gönderme · yalnızca onayınla, ilk gönderimde izin istenir" and "Takvime yazma · yalnızca onayınla, ilk seferde izin istenir".
  - Section "CİHAZ İZİNLERİ": "Takvim" with status "İzin verildi" / "İzin verilmedi · Ayarları Aç" / "Sorulmadı · İzin Ver".
  - AssuranceBox: "Sen onaylamadan mail göndermeyiz." · "Takviminde değişiklik yapmadan önce senden onay isteriz." · "Mail içeriklerin yapay zekâ modellerini eğitmek için kullanılmaz." (SREQ-78) · "Mail içeriğinin tamamı saklanmaz; yalnızca özetler, kısa alıntılar ve analiz sonuçları saklama süren boyunca tutulur." (R-15).
  - CTA "Devam".
- **Primary CTA:** "Devam" → `personalization`.
- **Secondary actions:**
  - Switch toggles: optimistic PATCH; turning off `mail_read` asks for confirmation (new) "Mail analizi kapatılırsa bu hesaptan yeni öncelik çıkmaz." with "Kapat" / "Vazgeç".
  - "Ayarları Aç" / "İzin Ver" (OS).
  - Back.
- **Loading:** Rows from cache; a switch shows a 14 px spinner while its PATCH is in flight.
- **Empty:** No connected accounts (all skipped) → section "BAĞLI HESAPLAR" shows (new) "Henüz bağlı hesap yok." and the CTA still continues.
- **Error:** PATCH failure → revert the switch + error toast "Kaydedilemedi. Tekrar dene." (new).
- **Offline:** Switch PATCHes are queued (internal preference).
- **Permission edge case:** OS calendar revoked → status row + "Ayarları Aç".
- **Approval requirement:** None (server-enforced configuration, not an external side effect).
- **Analytics events:** `onboarding_step_viewed {step:'permissions'}`, `data_source_toggled {toggle, value}` (`toggle` is the enum of `data_source_toggles` keys).
- **Accessibility notes:** Switches are labelled with their row text and state; the informational rows are plain text.
- **Deep links:** None.
- **Tests:** `PermissionsReview.test.tsx` (toggle → API-INT-05 payload with the DB keys, confirmation on `mail_read` off). A server-side Deno test lives in API_CONTRACTS.

- **Screen ID:** M-ON-10 (step 10)
- **Route:** `app/(onboarding)/briefing-schedule.tsx`
- **Entry points:** M-ON-09 CTA.

- **API dependencies:** PostgREST `PATCH user_preferences`; `PATCH profiles {onboarding_step:'briefing_schedule'}`.
- **State dependencies:** `['me','bootstrap']`.
- **Source design reference:** P/02 › 2.9.
  - SettingRow r18; TimeChip 36 h r12 17/600; Switch 50×30. StepHeader "ADIM 3 / 4".

Sonradan değiştirebilirsin." · "Sabah brifingi" — "Günün tamamı · sesli sürüm" — "08:00" · "Öğle nabzı" — "Yalnızca değişenler" — "13:00" · "Akşam kapanışı" — "Yarına kalanlar" — "19:00" · "Hafta sonu" — "Sadece sabah, 10:00 · Kişisel öncelikli" · CTA "Devam".

  - The AI hint ("Takvimine göre: genelde 08:15'te telefonu açıyorsun…") is **replaced** (D-07) by (new) "İlk toplantın genelde {HH:MM}{'de}; {HH:MM} iyi bir seçim." It is shown only when ≥3 weekday first-event samples exist in synced calendars. The suggestion is the median first start − 60 min, rounded to 15 min and clamped 06:00–10:00. Otherwise the hint is hidden.

  - Locked row tap → M-GL-13 (`midday` / `evening`).
  - Back.

- **Error:** Save failure → queued.

### M-ON-11 · VIP
- **Screen ID:** M-ON-11 (step 11)
- **Route:** `app/(onboarding)/vip.tsx`
- **Entry points:** M-ON-10 CTA. Skipped automatically when `skippedAllSources` is true or no mail account is connected.
- **Primary purpose:** Mark the people whose messages always rise to the top. VIP feeds the priority engine deterministically (M§30–31).
- **Data dependencies:**
  - `contacts`, derived from synced headers of the initial sync that started at connection (ADR-07).
  - RPC-13 `vip_suggestions()` (Pro only; the client shows the first 8) ranks by from/to counts in the synced window and excludes the user's own addresses, `List-Unsubscribe`/`Precedence: bulk`/no-reply senders and domains matched by low-priority rules.
  - `vip_people`; entitlements.
- **API dependencies:** RPC-13 `vip_suggestions()` (Pro only); PostgREST `insert vip_people [{contact_id, relationship:'other', origin:'onboarding'}]` (owner insert under RLS; `trg_vip_people_plan_limit` enforces `vip_max`; VIP effects apply only when `private.is_pro`, per DATABASE_AND_RLS_PLAN `vip_people`); `PATCH profiles {onboarding_step:'vip'}`.
- **State dependencies:** `['contacts','vip-suggestions']`, `['me','entitlements']`.
- **Source design reference:** S/src/screens/onboarding/OnboardingFlow.tsx `VIPScreen` (IA), restyled to P/06 › 6.6 (GroupedListCard; avatar 38 with deterministic palette; `star` FILL `#5B5CE2` trailing when selected; header pill "Kişi Ekle" 36 h `#5B5CE2`). StepHeader "ADIM 4 / 4" with trailing "Atla".
  - Copy (SECONDARY verbatim): "Kimlerden gelen şeyleri asla kaçırmak istemezsin?" · "VIP kişilerin mesajları her zaman öne çıkar." · "Atla" · "Devam ({n})".
  - Row meta (new): "{n} mail · son {72 saat}" (the real window from sync). SECONDARY's hard-coded names are never used.
- **Primary CTA:** "Devam ({n})" → insert the selected people → `analysis`.
- **Secondary actions:** Row toggle; "Kişi Ekle" → M-ON-11A; "Atla" → `analysis`; back.
- **Loading:** Skeleton rows (5) while the RPC runs. If initial sync is still running, the RPC is polled every 5 s for up to 30 s.
- **Empty:** No suggestions → (new) "Henüz öneri yok." / "Mailin analiz edildikçe en çok yazıştığın kişileri öneririm. İstersen şimdi e-postayla ekleyebilirsin." · actions "Kişi Ekle" / "Atla".
- **Error:** RPC failure → the empty state plus a "Tekrar Dene" text action.
- **Offline:** List from cache if any; "Devam" inserts are queued (internal preference writes). On replay, a `vip_max` rejection from `trg_vip_people_plan_limit` is shown as the toast (new) "VIP listesi dolu." and the extra rows are dropped.
- **Permission edge case:** **Free users (D-28):** RPC-13 is not called, because it is Pro only and locked content is never sent to the client (M-GL-13). The step shows the inline 7.6 gate card (`vip`) above three neutral bars. The primary CTA becomes "Atla ve devam et" (new) → `analysis`. The gate CTA → paywall → on success the RPC runs and the list becomes selectable in place.
- **Approval requirement:** None (internal preference; M§33 types don't apply).
- **Analytics events:** `onboarding_step_viewed {step:'vip'}`, `vip_selected {count, from_suggestions:number, manual:number}`, `onboarding_skipped {step:'vip'}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** Rows are checkboxes ("{name}, {n} mail, VIP değil"). The star icon is decorative (the state is in the label).
- **Deep links:** None.
- **Tests:** `VipStep.test.tsx` (Free gate without an RPC call; selection insert payload `{contact_id, relationship:'other', origin:'onboarding'}`; empty/poll). pgTAP (DATABASE plan): an owner insert succeeds, a foreign `user_id` is rejected, and an insert beyond `vip_max` is rejected by `trg_vip_people_plan_limit`.

### M-ON-12 · First Analysis
- **Screen ID:** M-ON-12 (step 12)
- **Route:** `app/(onboarding)/analysis.tsx`
- **Entry points:** M-ON-11 CTA or skip; M-ON-10 when VIP is auto-skipped. Never reached when `skippedAllSources`.
- **Primary purpose:** Real progress of the first analysis (M§34): the **last 72 h of mail** plus **today → +48 h of calendar** (audit issue 10). It shows mail, important, calendar and follow-up counts (REQ-ONB-03).
  - **Checklist rows (only connected sources are shown):**

    | Key | Pending | Active | Done |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `mails_fetched` | (new) "Mailler okunuyor" | "{n} mail bulundu" (counting up) | "{n} mail bulundu" |
    | `candidates` | (new) "Önemli konular aranıyor" | same | "{n} potansiyel önemli konu" |
    | `events` | (new) "Takvim okunuyor" | same | "{n} yaklaşan etkinlik" (SREQ-55) |
    | `followups` | (new) "Takipler aranıyor" | "{n} takip tespit ediliyor…" | (new) "{n} takip bulundu" |
    | `ranking` | "Öncelikler sıralanıyor" | same | (new) "Öncelikler sıralandı" |

  - Each row turning done fires a light haptic; counts animate to the real value (360 ms, none under reduce-motion). There are no timers (SECONDARY's 1 s steps are rejected).
- **Data dependencies:** `jobs` row (type `first_analysis`, status, `progress` jsonb `{steps:[{key,status,count}], counts:{mail,important,events,followups}}`; `jobs` is a system table, read only through API-ONB-02), `connected_accounts` (for the subtitle).
- **API dependencies:**
  - `POST /onboarding/first-analysis` with `Idempotency-Key: first_analysis:{user_id}:{attempt}` → `{job_id, status}`. It returns the existing job if one is queued or running, or completed within 24 h.
  - `GET /onboarding/first-analysis/:jobId` → `{status, steps, counts, findings?, total?, briefing_id?, error_code?}`.
  - `PATCH profiles {onboarding_step:'analysis'}`.
- **State dependencies:** `['onboarding','first-analysis', jobId]` (refetchInterval 1500 ms while `queued|running|retrying`); `useOnboardingStore.analysisJobId`.
- **Source design reference:** P/02 › 2.10.
  - `gradient/night`; PulsingRing 132 (outer 3 px `rgba(255,255,255,.15)` + white arc 1.4 s; inner inset 14 reversed 2.2 s; center `star_shine` 44 FILL); title 26/32; sub 14.
  - ProgressChecklist: done `check_circle` FILL `analysis/check #A9F0C1` †; active 22 px spinner .9 s; pending ring, opacity .4.
  - Copy: "Dijital hayatın analiz ediliyor…" · subtitle "Son 72 saat · {Gmail ve Google Takvim}" (the connected source names joined with " ve ").
  - Footer rewritten (D-07, R-15): while running "Genelde 20–40 saniye sürer. Mail içeriğinin tamamı saklanmaz."; at completion (the 600 ms before auto-advance) the R-15 canonical footer "Son 72 saat analiz edildi. Mail içeriğinin tamamı saklanmaz."
  - Design rule: no progress bar ("İlerleme çubuğu yok").
- **Primary CTA:** None while running. At completion it auto-advances to `ready` after 600 ms.
- **Secondary actions:** Slow state (running > 60 s, config `first_analysis.slow_threshold_s` †) shows (new) "Biraz uzun sürüyor; hazır olunca haber vereyim." with text button (new) "Bugün'e geç". That continues to `notifications` → completion; the job keeps running and Today shows `first_analysis_running` (M-TD-01).
- **Loading:** This screen is the loading state.
- **Empty:** Zero mails and zero events at completion → auto-advance to Aha zero variant.
- **Error:**
  - `failed` / `dead_letter` / timeout (600 s †) → the checklist freezes; ErrorCard on the gradient: (new) "İlk analiz tamamlanamadı." / "Bağlantın sağlam; birkaç saniye sonra tekrar deneyebiliriz." · "Tekrar Dene" (new attempt key) · "Şimdilik geç" (→ `notifications`; Today shows live data as sync proceeds).
  - Partial (calendar step `failed`, mail done): the row shows `error` icon + (new) "Takvim okunamadı · daha sonra yeniden denenecek" and the job completes.
- **Offline:** Polling pauses; (new) "Bağlantı bekleniyor…" appears under the ring. It resumes on reconnect. The job runs server-side regardless.
- **Permission edge case:** A token revoked mid-job → that source's steps fail → partial handling.
- **Approval requirement:** None (read-only analysis).
- **Analytics events:** `first_analysis_started {sources:number}`, `first_analysis_completed {duration_s, mail_bucket:'0'|'1-50'|'51-200'|'201+', important_count, event_count, followup_count}`, `first_analysis_slow_continue`, `first_analysis_failed {error_code}`, `first_analysis_retry`.
- **Accessibility notes:**
  - The ring is `accessibilityRole="progressbar"` with label "Analiz sürüyor".
  - Each row completion is announced ("127 mail bulundu").
  - Reduce-motion replaces the ring with a static icon and 120 ms opacity changes.
  - Light status bar.
- **Deep links:** None.
- **Tests:**
  - `FirstAnalysisScreen.test.tsx`: step rendering from the progress payload; slow state at 60 s (fake timers only in tests); partial row; failure retry key increments.
  - Deno test: the `first_analysis` job is idempotent.
  - Maestro: `mf_onboarding_first_run.yaml`, `mf_onboarding_zero_findings.yaml`.

### M-ON-14 · Notification permission
- **Screen ID:** M-ON-14 (step 14)
- **Route:** `app/(onboarding)/notifications.tsx`. Skipped automatically if `getPermissionsAsync().status==='granted'`; the token is then registered silently.
- **Entry points:** M-ON-13 CTA; M-ON-12 slow-continue; the analysis failure "Şimdilik geç"; the zero-source path after M-ON-10.
- **Primary purpose:** Explain the notification philosophy **after** value has been shown ("değer görülmeden izin istenmez"), then show the OS prompt.
  - **Android 13+:** channels already exist (M-GL-01), so the `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` prompt appears on `requestPermissionsAsync()`.
  - **Android ≤12:** permission is implicit, so the screen is skipped per the rule above.
  - **iOS:** `requestPermissionsAsync({ios:{allowAlert:true, allowBadge:true, allowSound:true}})`. Provisional authorization is not used.
- **Data dependencies:** `notification_preferences.os_permission`, `os_permission_updated_at` and `prompt_deferred_count`; `push_tokens`; `app_installations.push_enabled`.
- **API dependencies:** `Notifications.getExpoPushTokenAsync({projectId})` → `POST /devices/register {…, push:{permission, expo_push_token}}` (API-DEV-01); PostgREST `PATCH notification_preferences {os_permission, os_permission_updated_at}`; `PATCH profiles {onboarding_step:'notifications'}`. **External credential required:** EAS project ID, APNs key and FCM v1 service account uploaded to EAS. Without them the token call fails; this is logged and the flow proceeds.
- **State dependencies:** `useInstallStore`.
- **Source design reference:** P/02 › 2.12.
  - Three NotificationPreview cards (r20, `rgba(255,255,255,.7)` + blur 20, app tile 38 r11).
  - Copy: "14:10 · Toplantına 20 dakika kaldı. Mehmet için 3 konu hazır." (for Free users the Pro fragment is dropped: "14:10 · Toplantına 20 dakika kaldı.") · "08:00 · Bugün cevaplaman gereken önemli bir mail var." · "11:30 · Kargon bugün geliyor. 14:00–18:00 arası." · title **rewritten (R-14)** "Sadece önemli olduğunda haber veririz." · body "Pazarlama bildirimi yok, "bak bana" bildirimi yok." (the design's frequency number is removed; the non-critical daily cap is `notification_preferences.daily_cap`, default 5) · CTA "Bildirimleri Aç" · "Daha sonra" (EN: "Not now").
- **Primary CTA:** "Bildirimleri Aç" → OS prompt → granted: register the token → `android-notifications` (Android) or M-ON-15 (iOS).
- **Secondary actions:** "Daha sonra" → PostgREST `PATCH notification_preferences {prompt_deferred_count: 1}` (queued if offline) and `useInstallStore.notificationPromptDeferredAt = now` → next step. There is exactly one re-ask, on the first briefing (D-29), shown while `prompt_deferred_count = 1`.
- **Loading:** CTA spinner during the prompt and registration.
- **Empty:** None.
- **Error:**
  - Denied → CTA becomes (new) "Ayarları Aç" (`Linking.openSettings()`) with sub (new) "Bildirimler kapalı. İstersen Ayarlar'dan açabilirsin."; secondary (new) "Devam" continues.
  - Token failure → continue; retried at the next launch.
- **Offline:** The OS permission can be granted; registration is queued and retried.
- **Permission edge case:** `canAskAgain=false` → the Settings variant immediately. Android 13 without channels would show no prompt; this is prevented by M-GL-01 and covered by a test.
- **Approval requirement:** None.
- **Analytics events:** `notification_prompt_viewed`, `notification_permission_result {status:'granted'|'denied'|'blocked'}`, `notification_prompt_deferred`.
- **Accessibility notes:** The preview cards are one element labelled (new) "Örnek bildirimler"; the CTA order matches.
- **Deep links:** None.
- **Tests:** `NotificationStep.test.tsx` (skip when granted, deferral write, Settings variant). Maestro `mf_notification_permission_android13.yaml` (`permissions: {notifications: unset}`, taps the system "Allow").

- **Screen ID:** M-ON-14S

- **State dependencies:** `useInstallStore`.

- **Primary CTA:** "Bildirimleri Aç".
- **Secondary actions:** "Daha sonra" (the deferral is recorded for this installation only, in `useInstallStore.notificationPromptDeferredAt`; the account-level `prompt_deferred_count` does not change).
- **Loading:** Spinner.
- **Empty:** None.
- **Error:** As M-ON-14.
- **Offline:** As M-ON-14.
- **Permission edge case:** As M-ON-14.
- **Approval requirement:** None.
- **Analytics events:** `notification_prompt_viewed {context:'device'}`, `notification_permission_result {…, context:'device'}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** Standard sheet.
- **Deep links:** None.

### M-ON-14A · Android notification access ("Telefon Bildirimleri", optional)
- **Screen ID:** M-ON-14A (design 2.13; Android only)
- **Route:** `app/(onboarding)/android-notifications.tsx`. It is never registered on iOS; the guard returns `+not-found` if reached (M§36, REQ-ANDNI-06).
- **Entry points:** M-ON-14 completion on Android.
- **Primary purpose:** Prominent disclosure before enabling the Kotlin `NotificationListenerService` (local module `notification-intelligence`, ADR-12).
  - Extraction is on-device and structured-signals-only; raw notification text is never uploaded or persisted, so the design's claims are true (C-12).
  - Modes (D-27): a SegmentedControl with (new) "Seçili uygulamalar" | "Tüm uygulamalar" (M§36, C-11). In "Seçili uygulamalar" (default) the category rows below are package presets that fill `ni_allowed_packages` (as in M-ANI-01). In "Tüm uygulamalar" the rows are hidden and every app except the locked denylist is read. The locked denylist applies in both modes.
- **Data dependencies:** native module state (`isGranted()`, enabled, mode, allowed packages), mirrored to `app_installations.ni_listener_granted`, `ni_mode` (`'selected'|'all'`) and `ni_allowed_packages`; the preset → package catalogue from bootstrap config (below); entitlements.
- **API dependencies:** native module `openSettings()` (DETAIL intent on API 30+, else `ACTION_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SETTINGS` via `expo-intent-launcher` †), `isGranted()`, `setMode('selected'|'all')`, `setAllowedPackages(string[])`; then `POST /devices/register {…, android_ni:{available:true, listener_granted, enabled, mode, allowed_packages}}` (API-DEV-01, the only write path for these columns).
- **State dependencies:** Local form; `['me','entitlements']`.
- **Source design reference:** P/02 › 2.13.
  - Kicker "SADECE ANDROID"; section "UYGULAMALAR"; ToggleListCard; AssuranceBox; switch off `#D9D6D0` †.
  - Copy verbatim: "Telefon bildirimlerini de anlayayım mı?" · "Kargo, banka ve uygulama bildirimlerinden kişisel sinyaller çıkarırım. Mesaj içerikleri asla saklanmaz." · rows "Kargo uygulamaları" — "Trendyol, Hepsiburada, Yurtiçi" (on) · "Banka" — "Ödeme ve son tarih bildirimleri" (on) · "Havayolu" — "THY, Pegasus · kapı ve rötar" (on) · "Rezervasyon" — "Yemek, otel, etkinlik" (off) · "Mesajlaşma" — "WhatsApp, Telegram · önerilmez" (off) · "Bildirim erişimi cihazda işlenir. Sohbet uygulamaları varsayılan olarak kapalıdır ve önerilmez." · CTA "Bildirim Erişimini Aç" · "Android Ayarlar → Bildirim erişimi ekranı açılır." · "Atla".
  - Added (new): a locked row `lock` "Güvenlik uygulamaları her zaman hariç" — "Doğrulayıcılar, şifre yöneticileri, e-Devlet"; AssuranceBox line (R-15 canonical) "Bildirim içerikleri cihazında işlenir; yalnızca çıkarılan bilgiler (ör. kargo durumu, tutar, tarih) hesabına kaydedilir. Doğrulama kodları ve güvenlik uygulamaları her zaman hariç tutulur."
  - The example brand names map to package lists in app config `android_ni.package_catalog` † (served in `GET /me/bootstrap` `config`, edited in backoffice Settings; it is not a feature-flag key, R-10).
- **Primary CTA:** "Bildirim Erişimini Aç" → persist the settings → `openSettings()`. On AppState `active`, `isGranted()`:
  - Granted → toast (new) "Telefon bildirimleri açık" → M-ON-15.
  - Not granted → inline (new) "Bildirim erişimi verilmedi." / "İstersen daha sonra Ayarlar › Telefon Bildirimleri'nden açabilirsin." The CTA becomes "Tekrar Dene".
- **Secondary actions:**
  - "Atla" → M-ON-15.
  - Category switches; mode segment.
  - The locked row → a sheet listing the exclusion categories (read-only).
  - Expandable "Sorun mu yaşıyorsun?" (new) → text "Uygulama bilgisi → ⋮ → Kısıtlı ayarlara izin ver" (Android 13+ restricted settings for sideloaded builds).
  - Back.
- **Loading:** None.
- **Empty:** None.
- **Error:** The settings intent fails to resolve → fall back to `ACTION_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SETTINGS`; if that fails too, toast (new) "Ayarlar açılamadı."
- **Offline:** Works. The `POST /devices/register` mirror is retried on reconnect; the module state on the device is authoritative for extraction.
- **Permission edge case:**
  - **Free users (§0.6):** the CTA row is replaced by the inline gate (`android_ni`) and "Atla".
  - Access granted but later revoked → the Settings part shows the real state.
  - **Manual external step:** Play Console permissions declaration and Data safety form for notification access.
- **Approval requirement:** None (explicit opt-in; no external write).
- **Analytics events:** `android_ni_prompt_viewed`, `android_ni_result {granted:boolean, mode}`, `onboarding_skipped {step:'android_notifications'}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** The segment is a radio group; switches are labelled; the locked row reads "Her zaman hariç, değiştirilemez".
- **Deep links:** None.
- **Tests:**
  - `AndroidNiStep.test.tsx`: iOS not registered; Free gate; `/devices/register` `android_ni` payload (`mode:'selected'` with the preset packages; `mode:'all'` with an empty list).
  - Kotlin unit tests (module): denylist and OTP detector.
  - Maestro `mf_android_ni_optin.yaml` (Android only; grants via `adb shell cmd notification allow_listener`).

### M-ON-15 · Onboarding completion handoff
- **Screen ID:** M-ON-15 (step 15)
- **Route:** No UI. A transition performed by `completeOnboarding()` in `apps/mobile/src/features/onboarding/complete.ts`.
- **Entry points:** M-ON-14 (iOS) / M-ON-14A (Android) completion or skip; the zero-source path.
- **Primary purpose:** Finish onboarding and land on Today with the first briefing on top (D-05).
  1. `PATCH profiles {onboarding_step:'done', onboarding_completed_at: now()}`.
  2. A DB trigger enqueues `referral_evaluate` when a referral exists †.
  3. `router.replace('/(tabs)/today')`.
  4. If `briefing_id` exists, `router.push('/briefing/{id}')`.
- **Data dependencies:** `profiles`; the first `briefings` row.
- **API dependencies:** PostgREST `PATCH profiles`.
- **State dependencies:** Invalidates `['me','bootstrap']` and `['today', localDate]`; resets `useOnboardingStore`.
- **Source design reference:** P/02 intro text ("… → Bugün").
- **Primary CTA:** None.
- **Secondary actions:** None.
- **Loading:** None.
- **Empty:** None.
- **Error:** PATCH failure → queued; the guard treats the local completion flag as authoritative until the server confirms.
- **Offline:** As above.
- **Permission edge case:** None.
- **Approval requirement:** None.
- **Analytics events:** `onboarding_completed {mail_connected:boolean, calendar_connected:boolean, skipped_count:number, duration_s}` (M§42 "onboarding completion"; SECURITY §4.9 prop names).
- **Accessibility notes:** Focus lands on the briefing header (or the Today H1).
- **Deep links:** A stored pending link replays after completion (M-GL-02 step 4).
- **Tests:** `complete-onboarding.test.ts`. Maestro `mf_onboarding_first_run.yaml` (asserts briefing on top and Back → Today).

## 4. Today

### M-TD-01 · Today ("Bugün")
- **Screen ID:** M-TD-01
- **Route:** `app/(tabs)/today/index.tsx` (tab root; ScrollView with `RefreshControl`; ≤ ~25 rows, so no virtualization is needed).
- **Entry points:** Default route after onboarding or sign-in; the "Bugün" tab; "Bugün'e Dön" buttons; the widget `dijitalasistan://today`; M-ON-15; the notification router fallback.
- **Primary purpose:** Answer "Bugün gerçekten neyi bilmeliyim?" (M§2, M§8) as a calm editorial page, not a dashboard.
  - Section order (D-24):
    1. RootHeader (M-GL-04).
    2. AccountAlertCard: at most one, the highest severity in this order: `needs_reauth` → `admin_consent_required` → device-calendar permission revoked → sync lag > 30 min → AI unavailable.
    3. Hero (Annex M-TD-01-A), inline Pro gate (M-GL-13 card), or connect card.
    4. Weekly card, from Sunday `weekly_time` until Monday 23:59.
    4a. AnnouncementBanner (R-25, D-33): at most one, the first of `bootstrap.announcements[]` ordered by `ends_at`.
    5. "ÖNCELİKLERİN" with "{N} konu" and up to `today.max_priorities` (5) † PriorityCards; footer inline actions "Akış'ta tümünü gör" (when N > 5) and "Ekle" (D-23).
    6. "PROGRAMIN" with "{k} etkinlik": remaining events of today (start ≥ now − 15 min, max 4, TimelineRow).
    7. "TAKVİM ZEKÂSI": ≤1 conflict/schedule-suggestion card (dashed border = proposed, P/01).
    8. "DİJİTAL HAYATIN": ≤3 life events today/tomorrow not already in priorities (GroupedListCard) + "Tümü".
  - Evening mode renames section 5 to "YARINA KALANLAR" (P/03 3.2).
- **Data dependencies:** RPC-04 `today_overview(p_local_date)` (API_CONTRACTS §15; its jsonb carries the keys below) returns:
  - `hero` `{mode, briefing_id?, kind?, ready_at?, scheduled_for?, count, context:{important_mail, events, followups, deadlines} | {completed, followups, tomorrow_first:{title,start_at}}, audio:{status, duration_s?, mode?}, gate?:{feature, count}}`
  - `account_alerts[]` `{account_id, provider, code, last_success_at}`
  - `priorities[]` (insight fields: id, kind, urgency, badge_key, display_at, title, subtitle?, source_type, source_id, source_provider, source_timestamp, source_label, person_contact_id?, life_event_type?, has_tracking_url, has_checkin_url, rank, status, snoozed_until), `priorities_total`
  - `program[]` `{event_id, start_at, end_at, title, attendee_count, has_prep, location_kind}`
  - `intelligence[]`, `life[]`, `weekly?` `{briefing_id, mails_analyzed, time_saved_min}`, `first_analysis?` `{job_id, counts}`, `mails_analyzed_today`, `demo_mode`
  - Tables behind it: `insights`, `briefings`, `briefing_items`, `calendar_events`, `life_events`, `commitments`, `connected_accounts`, `sync_states`, `approval_actions`, `user_preferences`.
  - Membership and ranking come from the domain `selectTodayPriorities` (priority-engine `rank`, precedence explicit_rule → learned_preference → deterministic_signal → ai_classification).
  - Announcements: `GET /me/bootstrap` `announcements[]` `{id, title, body, cta_route, ends_at}` (active, targeted server-side by audience, platform and app version, not dismissed; R-25).
- **API dependencies:**
  - RPC-04 `today_overview`; head count `approval_actions`; RPC-01 `set_insight_status`; RPC `apply_insight_feedback` / `revert_insight_feedback` (R-24); RPC-14 `dismiss_announcement(p_announcement_id)`.
  - `POST /approvals` (calendar_create from "Takvime Ekle"/reservation); `POST /followups/:threadId/draft`; `POST /plan/proposals`.
  - Pull-to-refresh: `POST /integrations/:accountId/sync` for each healthy account (server-rate-limited 1/60 s/account; a 429 counts as fresh).
- **State dependencies:** `['today', localDate]`, `['approvals','pending-count']`, `['me','bootstrap']`, `useSheetStore`, `useToastStore`, `usePlayerStore` (a "Dinle" autostart), `useNetStore`.
- **Source design reference:**
  - P/03 › 3.1 (light morning) and 3.2 (dark evening).
    - Hero: light `radial-gradient(140% 100% at 100% 0%,#E4E4FA 0%,#FFFFFF 58%)`; dark `…rgba(133,134,242,.28) 0%,#1F1E1B 60%` + 6% ring; r28, padding 22 22 20.
    - Kicker 12/600 +6% `#5B5CE2` (dark `#A9AAF5`) with `star_shine` 16 FILL; sentence 26/32 with the number in brand colour.
    - Primary 48 r14; tonal "Dinle" 48 `#EDEDFC`/`#4547C9` (dark `rgba(133,134,242,.16)`/`#C3C4F8` †) with `play_arrow` 20 FILL.
    - PriorityCard: r20, padding 14 16 10; top row badge + time + `check_circle`/`more_horiz` 22 `#B8B4AA` (dark `#5E5B54` †); title 17/23; sub 14/20; source row 12 with icon 16; ≤2 text actions 14/600.
  - P/07 › 7.6 gate card. P/08 empty, error, loading, offline and swipe specs.
  - P/Dijital Asistan.dc.html `isToday` (behaviour intent).
  - S/src/screens/today/TodayScreen.tsx: PROGRAMIN list, DİJİTAL HAYATIN carousel IA, restyled as a GroupedListCard.
  - Section kickers: "ÖNCELİKLERİN" + "{N} konu" (verbatim); "PROGRAMIN" (M§9 label); "TAKVİM ZEKÂSI" (P/05 label); "DİJİTAL HAYATIN" (S); "YARINA KALANLAR" (P/03 3.2).
  - Footer actions (new): "Akış'ta tümünü gör" · "Ekle". Weekly card copy (new): kicker "HAFTALIK ÖZET HAZIR" · title "Bu hafta {n} mail analiz edildi." · meta "Tahmini {2 sa 48 dk} kazandın".
  - AnnouncementBanner (new, PRIMARY card language, P/01 InfoCard): `info` soft surface `#E7F0FD` (dark `rgba(59,130,230,.16)`), r20, padding 14 16; icon `campaign` 20 `#2262BE`; title 15/600; body 14/20, clamped to 3 lines with a "Devamı" text action that expands it; optional text CTA 14/600 `#2262BE` when `cta_route` is set; close IconButton `close` 20 with a 44 pt hit target. The text arrives already localised (`title_tr`/`title_en` resolved server-side).
- **Primary CTA:** The hero primary per mode (Annex A), e.g. "Brifingimi Gör" → `briefing/{id}` (REQ-TODAY-05).
- **Secondary actions:**
  - Hero "Dinle · {m} dk" → `briefing/{id}/listen?autoplay=1` (REQ-TODAY-06; Pro gate).
  - Header: search → `search`; approval chip → `approvals/index`; avatar → `settings/index`.
  - Card actions per Annex M-TD-01-B.
  - Card body tap → the source route (Annex B last column).
  - `check_circle` → complete: `set_insight_status(done)`. The icon fills green in 160 ms, the card scales .96 and fades in 300 ms, the list reflows in 300 ms, success haptic, then toast "Tamamlandı · Bir sonraki konu yukarı taşındı" + "Geri al" → `set_insight_status(open)`. Linked commitments are cascaded by the RPC.
  - `more_horiz` → M-TD-02.
  - Swipe right → complete (as above). Swipe left → "Ertele" (M-TD-04) / "Önemli değil" (`apply_insight_feedback(not_important)` + dismiss + toast "Öğrendim · Bu tür konuları daha aşağıda göstereceğim." + "Geri al").
  - PROGRAMIN row → `meeting/{eventId}/prep` (Pro, meeting with attendees) or `event/{id}`.
  - TAKVİM ZEKÂSI → "Seçenekleri Gör" → `plan/conflict/{insightId}` / "Planla" → `POST /plan/proposals` → `plan/proposal/{id}`.
  - DİJİTAL HAYATIN row → `life/{id}`; "Tümü" → `flow?filter=kisisel`.
  - Weekly card → `weekly/{id}`.
  - AnnouncementBanner: "Kapat" → RPC-14 `dismiss_announcement(p_announcement_id)` (optimistic hide; idempotent `on conflict do nothing`); CTA → `router.push(cta_route)` after the M-GL-07 allow-list check. A route that fails the check hides the CTA.
  - Account alert actions: "Yeniden Bağlan" → `POST /integrations/:provider/start {capabilities, account_id, return_to:'error_card', device_nonce_hash}` (re-consent, API-INT-01) through an auth session, finished by `POST /integrations/oauth/complete` (D-31); "Sonra" → snooze the card until the next session; "İzin Ver" → `Linking.openSettings()` (device calendar) or re-consent (cloud); "Neden gerekli?" → M-TD-03-style explainer; "Şimdi Dene" → `POST /integrations/:accountId/sync`; "Tamam" → dismiss; "Tekrar Dene" → refetch; "Brifinge Dön" → `briefing/{id}`.
  - Pull-to-refresh → sync + refetch → a 2 px indigo top line (400 ms) → "Güncel · {HH:MM}" for 1.5 s.
- **Loading:**
  - P/08 › loading/today: the header renders instantly from the bootstrap cache.
  - Hero skeleton bars 85%×22 r8, 55%×22 r8, 40%×12 r6; button blocks flex×48 r14 `#EFEDE7` + 110×48 `#F5F4F0`; two priority skeleton cards.
  - Shimmer 1.6 s linear; cards fill with a 60 ms stagger.
  - Dark skeleton: surface `#1F1E1B`, highlight `rgba(255,255,255,.08)`.
  - The kicker "BRİFİNG HAZIRLANIYOR…" + 14 px spinner appears only in hero mode `generating`.
- **Empty:**
  - N = 0 → P/08 › empty/today: "Her şey kontrol altında." / "Bugün dikkat gerektiren yeni bir konu yok. {n} maili senin için okudum." (the second sentence only when n > 0) + (new) " Sıradaki brifing {HH:MM}{'de}." (only if a later briefing is scheduled and entitled today) / CTA "Akışa göz at" → Flow tab. The hero sentence becomes (new) "Bugün bilmen gereken yeni bir şey yok."
  - Night after carry-over: (new) "Bugünlük bu kadar." / "Taşıdığın {n} konu sabah brifinginde seni bekliyor."
  - No sources: hero `no_sources` (S/EmptyStates "Mailini bağla." / "Gmail veya Outlook bağlayarak önemli konuları burada görebilirsin." / "Hesap Bağla" → `settings/accounts`).
  - Partial data: mail-only hides PROGRAMIN and TAKVİM ZEKÂSI; calendar-only drops mail groups from the context line.
  - No active announcement → no banner and no reserved space.
- **Error:**
  - `today_overview` fails with a cache → keep the cache + toast (new) "Güncellenemedi. Tekrar denenecek."
  - Fails without a cache → ErrorCard (new) "Bugün yüklenemedi." / "Sunucuya ulaşamadım. Birazdan tekrar deneyeceğim." / "Tekrar Dene".
  - P/08 error cards verbatim: "Gmail bağlantısı yenilenmeli." / "Google oturumu süresi doldu. Yeniden bağlanana kadar yeni mailler analiz edilmez." / "Yeniden Bağlan" · "Sonra". "Senkronizasyon gecikti." / "Son başarılı analiz {09:40}. Yeniden deniyoruz; gösterilenler {12} dakika eski olabilir." / "Şimdi Dene" · "Tamam". "Takvim izni verilmedi." / "Toplantı hazırlığı ve çakışma uyarıları takvim erişimi gerektirir. Diğer her şey çalışıyor." / "İzin Ver" · "Neden gerekli?". "Asistan şu an yanıt veremiyor." / "Brifingin ve önceliklerin hazır; yalnızca yeni soru ve taslaklar birkaç dakika bekleyebilir." / "Tekrar Dene" · "Brifinge Dön".
  - Provider names are substituted: Outlook → "Microsoft oturumu…".
  - Action failures show an error toast and the card reverts.
- **Offline (P/08 › Çevrimdışı Bugün):**
  - M-GL-09 banner; content at opacity .75.
  - Hero kicker `history` "BRİFİNG · {07:58} · ÇEVRİMDIŞI".
  - "Dinle" is enabled when the audio file is cached; otherwise it is a disabled chip "İndirilmedi" (`download_for_offline`).
  - Network-only card actions are disabled with the card hint "Yanıt taslağı bağlantı gelince hazırlanır." (verbatim; per-action variants (new) "Takvim önerisi bağlantı gelince hazırlanır.").
  - Complete, snooze and feedback are queued (§0.5).
  - The announcement banner renders from the cached bootstrap; "Kapat" is queued (RPC-14 is idempotent).
- **Permission edge case:**
  - Device calendar permission revoked → alert card.
  - Notifications denied → nothing on Today (Settings owns it), except M-ON-14S on a new device.
  - Free → gates per §0.6.
- **Approval requirement:** Today never executes external side effects. "Takvime Ekle", reservation "Takvime Ekle" and "Planla" **propose** approvals (`calendar_create`) via `api`. The approval sheet `approvals/{id}` opens in place (SREQ-43) and the toast "Onay Merkezi'ne eklendi" + "Görüntüle" confirms the persisted pending row. Draft actions lead to `email_send` approvals in the Reply part. Reminders use the confirm-in-sheet model (C-08).
- **Analytics events:** `today_viewed {hero_mode, priorities_count, has_alert}`, `today_hero_cta {mode, cta:'primary'|'listen'|'secondary'}`, `priority_opened {kind}`, `priority_action {kind, action}`, `priority_complete {kind, via:'button'|'swipe'|'a11y'}`, `priority_undo {action}`, `priority_snoozed {preset}`, `priority_feedback {kind, feedback}`, `today_section_tapped {section}`, `today_refreshed {accounts}`, `account_alert_action {code, action}`, `weekly_card_opened`, `announcement_viewed {has_cta:boolean}`, `announcement_dismissed`, `announcement_cta_tapped` (no announcement id or text is sent; SECURITY §4.9 string props are enums).
- **Accessibility notes:**
  - The H1 and section kickers are headers.
  - Hero: one element whose label reads the sentence and context, followed by separate buttons.
  - Each PriorityCard is one accessible element labelled "{badge}, {time}. {title}. {subtitle}. Kaynak: {source}." with `accessibilityActions`: activate (open source), `complete` "Tamamlandı", `snooze` "Ertele", `not_important` "Önemli değil", `more` "Diğer seçenekler", plus the card's own actions ("Yanıtla", …). The 36 pt icons get `hitSlop` to 44.
  - Completion is announced ("Tamamlandı, geri almak için…").
  - Informational 12 px text (time, source, meta) uses `ink/tertiary-strong` †.
  - Reduce-motion: no scale/slide, opacity 120 ms; the count-up animation is disabled.
  - Dynamic Type: cards grow, and the header cluster compacts (D-22).
  - Dark: all tokens per P/03 3.2 (no hard-coded white).
  - AnnouncementBanner: one group read as "Duyuru: {title}. {body}"; the close button is labelled (new) "Duyuruyu kapat"; after dismissal focus moves to the next section kicker.
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://today`; `https://<web>/app/today`.
- **Tests:**
  - Domain: `hero-mode.test.ts` (Annex A matrix incl. DST days), `select-priorities.test.ts`, `today-counts.test.ts`, `insight-actions.test.ts` (Annex B incl. URL presence and entitlement).
  - Components: `TodayScreen.test.tsx` (each hero mode and state from fixtures), `PriorityCard.test.tsx` (actions, a11y actions, swipe thresholds), `AnnouncementBanner.test.tsx` (renders a targeted announcement; "Kapat" hides it and calls RPC-14 once; the CTA is hidden for a route outside the allow-list).
  - Maestro: `mf_today_complete_undo.yaml`, `mf_today_correction.yaml`, `mf_today_swipe_snooze.yaml`, `mf_today_takvime_ekle_approval.yaml`, `mf_today_offline.yaml`, `mf_today_dark.yaml`, `mf_pro_gate_midday.yaml`, `mf_today_oauth_expired.yaml` (scenario `oauth_expired`), `mf_today_announcement.yaml` (scenario `announcement_active`: banner visible → "Kapat" → still gone after relaunch).

| # | Mode | Condition | Kicker | Sentence | Context | Primary / secondary |

| 4 | `evening_confirmed` | evening window and `evening_ready_at` set | (new) "YARINA HAZIRSIN" | (new) "Sabah brifingin {08:00'de} hazır olacak." | (new) "{n} konu yarına taşındı" + " · Bildirimler sabaha kadar sessizde" (if chosen) | "Kapanışı Gör" |

| 8 | `midday_gate` | midday window, Free, deterministic delta > 0, not dismissed | `lock` "ÖĞLE NABZI · PRO" | "Sabahından beri {n} gelişme oldu." | "Öğle nabzı Pro'da. Sabah brifingin her zaman ücretsiz." | "{7} gün ücretsiz dene"/"Pro'yu Gör" / "Şimdi değil" |

In the midday window with midday skipped, replaced by "Sabahından beri önemli bir değişiklik yok." | "Brifingimi Gör" / "Dinle · {m} dk" ("Dinle" when no audio yet; Free: `lock`) |

Windows: midday = [midday_time, evening_time); evening = [evening_time, 04:00 next day). On weekend days with `weekend_morning_only` on, morning = `weekend_morning_time` and the midday/evening windows are off.

### M-TD-02 · Correction "···" sheet
- **Screen ID:** M-TD-02
- **Route:** sheet(host) `insight_correction` `{insightId}`
- **Entry points:** The PriorityCard `more_horiz`; the accessibility action "Diğer seçenekler"; long-press on a card.
- **Primary purpose:** Let the user correct the AI's importance decision and teach the system (M§3.9–10, M§31–32, M§59). The reason is shown up front for explainability (M§131).
- **Data dependencies:** `insights` (title, person_contact_id, why_important, decision_tier, source_*), `vip_people` (whether the person is already VIP), `user_preferences.learn_from_interactions`, entitlements.
- **API dependencies:**
  - RPC `apply_insight_feedback(p_insight_id, p_kind:'not_important'|'show_more'|'make_vip'|'stop_tracking', p_client_mutation_id)` (R-24; contract in API_CONTRACTS §15). Atomically: upserts `ai_feedback {target_type:'insight', target_id, rating:(show_more ? 1 : -1), reason_code:p_kind}` (codes from the extended `ai_feedback.reason_code` check); creates or updates `learned_preferences` (when learning is on); inserts `vip_people {relationship:'other', origin:'suggestion'}` (make_vip; raises `ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED:vip` unless `private.is_pro`); sets the insight status (`dismissed` for not_important/stop_tracking); enqueues `insight_refresh` (idempotency `insight_refresh:{user}:{minute}`). Returns `{feedback_id, learned_preference_id?, vip_id?}`.
  - Undo: RPC `revert_insight_feedback(p_feedback_id)` (R-24): deletes that `ai_feedback` row, reverts the `learned_preferences` change and the `vip_people` insert it made, and restores the insight status.
- **State dependencies:** `['insights', id, 'why']`, `['today', localDate]` (optimistic), `useToastStore`.
- **Source design reference:** P/Dijital Asistan.dc.html `sheetDefs.correct`. Copy verbatim:
  - "Bunu nasıl değerlendireyim?" / "Seçimin gelecekteki öncelikleri etkiler"
  - Options → toasts:
    - `remove_circle` "Önemli değil" → "Öğrendim · Bu tür konuları daha aşağıda göstereceğim."
    - `trending_up` "Bunu daha sık göster" → "Öğrendim · Bu konuyu daha yüksek öncelikle izleyeceğim."
    - `star` "Bu kişiyi VIP yap" (the label adds the name: (new) "{Ad} kişisini VIP yap") → "Öğrendim · {Ad} artık VIP."
    - `visibility_off` "Bunu takip etme" → "Öğrendim · Bu konuyu artık takip etmeyeceğim."
  - Toast icon `psychology`.
  - Additions (new): a reason line under the subtitle "Neden: {reason kısa}" (tap → M-TD-03); footer text actions "Kaynağı aç" and "Kural oluştur".
- **Primary CTA:** The option rows (each commits immediately and closes).
- **Secondary actions:**
  - Reason line → M-TD-03.
  - "Kaynağı aç" → the source route.
  - "Kural oluştur" → `settings/priority-rules/new?fromInsight={id}` (C-20; `priority-rules/[id]` with id `new`).
  - Every resulting toast carries "Geri al" → revert.
- **Loading:** The chosen row shows a spinner while the RPC runs; the sheet closes on success.
- **Empty:** The VIP row is hidden when no person resolves; it shows (new) "VIP'den çıkar" when the person is already VIP.
- **Error:** RPC failure → the sheet stays open, inline error (new) "Kaydedilemedi. Tekrar dene." `ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED:vip` on make_vip → M-GL-13 `vip`.
- **Offline:** Queued; optimistic removal from Today; offline toast.
- **Permission edge case:** Free → the VIP row shows `lock` → gate. Learning off → toast (new) "Kaydettim · Öğrenme kapalı olduğu için sıralama değişmeyecek." (the card is still dismissed for not_important/stop_tracking).
- **Approval requirement:** None (internal preferences; no external side effect).
- **Analytics events:** `priority_feedback {kind, feedback, learning_on}`, `priority_feedback_undone {feedback}`, `rule_create_from_insight`.
- **Accessibility notes:** The options are a list of buttons; the reason line is a link; the toast is announced.
- **Deep links:** None.
- **Tests:** `CorrectionSheet.test.tsx` (VIP row visibility, Free lock, toasts per option, undo calls revert). pgTAP for the RPC ownership and Pro check. Maestro `mf_today_correction.yaml`.

### M-TD-03 · "Neden önemli?" sheet
- **Screen ID:** M-TD-03
- **Route:** sheet(host) `insight_why` `{insightId}`
- **Entry points:** The M-TD-02 reason line; the account alert "Neden gerekli?" (variant `permission_reason`); briefing rows (long-press).
- **Primary purpose:** Explainability (M§131, M§97, SREQ-04): the reason, the decision tier, confidence language, verified evidence and the real source ("Bu nereden çıktı?").
- **Data dependencies:** `insights` (reason, decision_tier, rule_id → `priority_rules.name`, learned preference description, confidence, `evidence` jsonb quotes ≤300 chars, source_type/id/provider/timestamp).
- **API dependencies:** PostgREST select (§0.4 key).
- **State dependencies:** `['insights', id, 'why']`.
- **Source design reference:** S/src/components/cards/InsightCard.tsx "Neden önemli?" sheet (IA), restyled to the P/01 sheet. Evidence box: surface-2 r14, 14/20. Copy:
  - Title "Neden önemli?"; reason sentence, e.g. "Bu mailde bugün saat 17:00'ye kadar cevap istendiği için önemli olarak işaretlendi." (generated, grounded).
  - Tier row (new): explicit_rule "Senin kuralın: {kural adı}" · learned_preference "Öğrendiğim tercih: {açıklama}" · deterministic_signal "Sinyal: {VIP kişi | Son tarih ifadesi | Doğrudan sana yazılmış}" · ai_classification "Yapay zekâ değerlendirmesi".
  - Confidence: when < 0.70 (P/06 rule) (new) "Emin değilim; kaynağı kontrol etmeni öneririm."
  - Source row: provider icon + "Gmail · Ahmet Yılmaz · 08:42" + "Kaynağı aç".
  - Footer: "Önemli değil" (SECONDARY) · "Kural oluştur".
- **Primary CTA:** "Kaynağı aç" → the source route.
- **Secondary actions:** The tier row → `settings/priority-rules/{rule_id}` or `settings/personalization`; "Önemli değil" → as M-TD-02; "Kural oluştur".
- **Loading:** Skeleton lines.
- **Empty:** No evidence stored → the evidence box is omitted (never fabricated).
- **Error:** Load failure → inline error with "Tekrar Dene".
- **Offline:** Readable when cached (the query is not persisted, so a first open offline shows (new) "Çevrimdışıyken açıklama yüklenemedi.").
- **Permission edge case:** For `permission_reason` the explainer copy is P/02 2.7c's four reasons.
- **Approval requirement:** None.
- **Analytics events:** `why_important_opened {decision_tier, confidence_bucket:'<0.7'|'>=0.7'}`, `why_source_opened {source_type}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** Evidence quotes are marked as quotations ("Alıntı:"); the tier is conveyed in text.
- **Deep links:** None.
- **Tests:** `WhySheet.test.tsx` (tier copy mapping, confidence threshold, no evidence box when empty).

### M-TD-04 · Snooze ("Ertele") sheet
- **Screen ID:** M-TD-04
- **Route:** sheet(host) `snooze` `{entity:'insight'|'commitment', id}`. Shared with the Flow/Takip swipe (same component `SnoozeSheet`).
- **Entry points:** Left-swipe "Ertele"; the TAAHHÜT "Ertele"; the accessibility action "Ertele".
- **Primary purpose:** Re-surface an item later without creating a notification. For an insight it sets `snoozed_until`; for a commitment it changes the due date.
- **Data dependencies:** `user_preferences` (evening_time, morning_time), the item's due time.
- **API dependencies:** Insight: RPC-01 `set_insight_status(id,'snoozed', p_snoozed_until)`. Commitment: RPC-06 `set_commitment_status(p_commitment_id, 'snoozed', p_due_at)`.
- **State dependencies:** `['today', localDate]` (optimistic removal).
- **Source design reference:** P/08 swipe "Ertele" (`schedule`); P/04 › 4.11 sheet anatomy (option rows with meta times). Copy (new):
  - Insight: title "Ne zaman tekrar göstereyim?" · rows "Bu akşam · {19:00}" (hidden when now ≥ evening − 30 min) · "Yarın sabah · {08:00}" · "Kendin seç".
  - Commitment: title "Yeni tarih ne olsun?" · rows "Yarın" · "Haftaya" · "Kendin seç".
  - Toast (new) "Ertelendi · {Yarın 08:00}" + "Geri al".
- **Primary CTA:** A preset row (commits).
- **Secondary actions:** "Kendin seç" → the native date-time picker (iOS sheet spinner; Android dialogs). Validation: must be in the future, else (new) "Geçmiş bir zaman seçilemez."
- **Loading:** Row spinner.
- **Empty:** None.
- **Error:** Failure → the card is restored + error toast.
- **Offline:** Queued.
- **Permission edge case:** None (no notification is involved).
- **Approval requirement:** None (internal state; commitment dates are our own records, not provider data).
- **Analytics events:** `priority_snoozed {entity, preset:'tonight'|'tomorrow_morning'|'tomorrow'|'next_week'|'custom'}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** Each row label includes the absolute time.
- **Deep links:** None.
- **Tests:** `SnoozeSheet.test.tsx` (preset time computation in the user's timezone, hide "Bu akşam" late). Maestro `mf_today_swipe_snooze.yaml`.

## 5. Briefings

### M-BR-01 · Morning Briefing
- **Screen ID:** M-BR-01
- **Route:** `app/briefing/[id].tsx`, rendering `MorningBriefingView` when `kind==='morning'`. Stack; light status bar; GradientHeader dawn.
- **Entry points:** Today hero "Brifingimi Gör"; the morning push; widgets (iOS Large "brifing", Android 4×2); M-ON-15; M-BR-07; the Assistant "Brifingimi oku" (other part; goes to listen).
- **Primary purpose:** A full-screen narrative briefing with six fixed sections (M§9), each row linked to its source (M§131).
  - **Sections in fixed order, empty ones hidden, labels per D-09:** "BUGÜNÜN ÖNCELİKLERİ", "PROGRAMIN", "SENDEN BEKLENENLER", "SENİN BEKLEDİKLERİN", "SON TARİHLER", "KİŞİSEL GELİŞMELER".
  - **Rows:** icon tile 30 r10 + title 15/20 500 + meta 12 + chevron.
  - **Live overlay (D-12):** a linked item that is done shows `check_circle` success, a line-through title and meta (new) "Tamamlandı".
  - **Low-confidence rows** (< 0.70) get the meta prefix (new) "Emin değilim · ". Ungrounded amounts or dates are never shown (M§83). Where the source is ambiguous, "Kaynakta kesinleşmiyor." is used (plan §8).
- **Data dependencies:**
  - `briefings` `{id, kind, local_date, status, headline, narrative, provenance{mail_count, calendar_count, lookback_hours, generated_at}, generated_at, audio_status, audio_engine, audio_duration_s, opened_at}` (DATABASE_AND_RLS_PLAN column names).
  - `briefing_items` † `{section (briefing_section †), position, icon_kind, title, meta, entity_type, entity_id, provenance…}` + the live status of linked `insights`/`commitments`.
  - `notification_preferences.os_permission` and `prompt_deferred_count` (for the re-ask banner).
- **API dependencies:** PostgREST selects; RPC-07 `mark_briefing_opened(p_briefing_id)`; PostgREST insert `ai_feedback {target_type:'briefing', target_id, rating:1|-1, reason_code:'helpful'|'inaccurate'}` (the server fills `feature`, `model` and `prompt_version_id` by trigger; API_CONTRACTS §15); `POST /briefings/:id/retry` (API-BRF-04, failed state); re-ask result → `POST /devices/register {…, push:{permission, expo_push_token}}` + `PATCH notification_preferences {os_permission, prompt_deferred_count}`.
- **State dependencies:** `['briefings', id]`, `usePlayerStore` (mini-player docking), `useInstallStore`.
- **Source design reference:** P/03 › 3.3 and 3.3D (dark).
  - GradientHeader dawn: padding 0 20 60; back circle `rgba(255,255,255,.16)`. **The right `ios_share` circle is removed (D-11).**
  - Kicker "SABAH BRİFİNGİ · {23 EYLÜL}"; H 32/38 "{Günaydın}, {Yunus}" (D-08); sub 16/22 = `headline` (data-derived tone; the fixed "Bugün oldukça sakin bir günün var." is not used unless true, SREQ-05).
  - Overlapping sheet −28 r28, padding 26 20 120, gap 22.
  - Lora 18/29 narrative; GroupedListCard r18 per section.
  - ProvenanceFooter `verified` 16 + "{46} mail, {1} takvim, {3} gün geçmiş analiz edildi · {07:58}".
  - StickyBottomCTA ink 52 r16 (dark: primary `#8586F2` / `#0F0F2A`) `headphones` "Brifingi Dinle · {2} dk".
  - Additions (new): feedback row "Bu brifing faydalı mıydı?" with `thumb_up`/`thumb_down` → toast "Teşekkürler · geri bildirimin kaydedildi."; re-ask banner (brand-soft InfoCard) "Brifingin hazır olduğunda haber vereyim mi?" / "Bildirimleri Aç" / "Hayır, teşekkürler".
- **Primary CTA:** "Brifingi Dinle · {m} dk" → `briefing/{id}/listen?autoplay=1`. Free users see a `lock` → M-GL-13 `voice_briefing`.
- **Secondary actions:**
  - Back → the previous screen (Today).
  - Row tap → source: email `mail/{id}`; event `event/{id}` (Pro meeting → `meeting/{id}/prep`); person-waiting rows `mail/{id}`; commitments `commitments/{id}`; life `life/{id}`.
  - Row long-press → M-TD-03.
  - Feedback thumbs.
  - Re-ask banner actions: OS prompt, or "Hayır, teşekkürler" → `PATCH notification_preferences {prompt_deferred_count: 2}` (the banner never shows again; `notifications.reprompt_max=1`).
- **Loading:** The header renders from cache; Lora shimmer lines (3) + section skeletons (1.6 s shimmer). The P/08 "Brifing açılışı" motion (hero 240 ms fade + 8 px, sections 60 ms stagger, ≤600 ms total) runs on first open only.
- **Empty:**
  - All sections empty → the narrative stays + (new) "Bugün sakin bir gün." / "Dikkat gerektiren yeni bir konu yok. Yeni bir şey olursa haber veririm."
  - Status `generating` (opened from Today while generating) → (new) "Brifingin hazırlanıyor…" with shimmer; `['briefings', id]` is polled every 5 s until the status leaves `generating` (R-19).
- **Error:**
  - `failed` → ErrorCard (new) "Brifing hazırlanamadı." / "Önceliklerin Bugün ekranında güncel." / "Tekrar Dene" (`POST /briefings/:id/retry`, API-BRF-04) · "Bugün'e Dön".
  - Not found or deleted by retention → (new) "Bu brifing artık yok." / "Saklama süren dolduğu için silinmiş olabilir." / "Bugün'e Dön".
- **Offline:** The cached briefing renders; the banner shows. The listen CTA is enabled only if the audio file is cached. Feedback and the opened mark are queued.
- **Permission edge case:** The notification re-ask is shown once (D-29). Free → audio gate.
- **Approval requirement:** None (read-only).
- **Analytics events:** `briefing_opened {kind:'morning', via:'today'|'push'|'widget'|'history'|'onboarding'}` (M§42 "briefing open"; a backoffice metric input under this exact name), `briefing_item_opened {section, entity_type}`, `briefing_feedback {rating:'up'|'down'}`, `briefing_read_to_end {kind}`, `notification_reprompt_result {status}`.
- **Accessibility notes:**
  - The header title is a header. The narrative uses `maxFontSizeMultiplier` 1.6 (Lora).
  - Each section is a list with its kicker as the list label. Rows read "{title}, {meta}, {Tamamlandı?}".
  - The footer is plain text. The sticky CTA does not cover content (bottom padding 120 + inset).
  - Dark per 3.3D (sticky fade `rgba(20,19,17,0)→#141311`).
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://briefing/{id}`.
- **Tests:** `MorningBriefingView.test.tsx` (section order and labels exactly per M§9, empty-section hiding, live overlay, Free gate, feedback insert, re-ask banner once). Maestro `mf_briefing_read_listen.yaml`.

### M-BR-02 · Audio briefing player
- **Screen ID:** M-BR-02
- **Route:** `app/briefing/[id]/listen.tsx` (`presentation:'fullScreenModal'`; a custom swipe-down on the header dismisses it; `?autoplay=1`).
- **Entry points:** The M-BR-01 sticky CTA; Today "Dinle"; M-BR-04 "Dinle · 1 dk"; M-GL-14 expand; the widget/lock-screen tap; the Assistant "Brifingimi oku" handoff.
- **Primary purpose:** Real playback with play, pause, seek, ±15 s, speed, chapters, lock-screen controls, and a native-TTS fallback (M§9, M§25, REQ-BRIEF-03/04/05, C-30).
  - **Chapters:** "Genel bakış" + one per non-empty section with the M§9/M§11 labels (D-09).
  - **Premium (file) mode** (`engine='premium_tts'`):
    1. `POST /briefings/:id/audio {prefer:'premium'}` (API-BRF-01) → `{mode:'premium', url (signed, 300 s), url_expires_at, duration_s, chapters:[{index,title,start_s,duration_s}]}`.
    2. The file downloads to `FileSystem.cacheDirectory/briefing-audio/{id}/{version}.mp3` (kept for the retention window or until evicted at 100 MB total; a new briefing version is a new file).
    3. `setAudioModeAsync({playsInSilentMode:true, shouldPlayInBackground:true, interruptionMode:'doNotMix'})`; the player loads the local file.
    4. `player.setActiveForLockScreen(true, {title:'{Sabah Brifingi}', artist:'Dijital Asistan', artwork: app icon}, {showSeekForward:true, showSeekBackward:true})`; `updateLockScreenMetadata` on chapter change.
    5. iOS `UIBackgroundModes: audio`. Android background media per the expo-audio config (plugin options verified at implementation).
  - **Native-TTS mode** (`engine='native_tts'`; premium TTS not configured or failed): `{mode:'native', language, chapters:[{index,title,text,est_duration_s}], notice_key}` (API-BRF-01).
    - Each chapter is split into sentences; `Speech.speak(sentence, {language:'tr-TR'|'en-US', rate, onDone})` is queued.
    - Position and duration are estimated (≈14.5 chars/s at 1.0×).
    - ±15 s jumps by estimated sentences; the scrubber snaps to sentence boundaries; chapters jump to their first sentence.
    - Pause: iOS `Speech.pause()`; Android `Speech.stop()` + resume from the current sentence index.
    - No lock-screen session (D-19).
    - Notice chip (new) "Cihaz sesiyle okunuyor".
- **Data dependencies:** `briefings.audio_status`, `audio_engine`, `audio_storage_path`, `audio_duration_s`, `audio_chapters` (DB names), the chapters; per-briefing resume position in MMKV.
- **API dependencies:** `POST /briefings/:id/audio` (idempotent). The server returns a cached asset from Storage `briefing-audio/{user_id}/{briefing_id}/{version}.mp3` (cached per briefing version), renders synchronously (≤45 s, API-BRF-01), or returns `mode:'native'`. It returns HTTP 402 `ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED` for Free users. **External credential required (optional):** a premium TTS provider key; without it the native mode is the honest default.
- **State dependencies:** `['briefings', id, 'audio']`, `usePlayerStore`, `AudioPlayerHost`.
- **Source design reference:** P/03 › 3.4.
  - `gradient/night`; header `keyboard_arrow_down` (alias of `expand_more`) 36 circle `rgba(255,255,255,.14)` + "SESLİ BRİFİNG" + SpeedChip 32 h.
  - Title 26/32 "{Sabah Brifingi}"; meta "{5 Eylül} · {2 dk 14 sn} · {chapter}".
  - Waveform 34 bars (decorative, animated `dabar` only while playing, static under reduce-motion). Progress 4 px; times 12.
  - Controls: replay-15 (`replay` 30 + "15"), play/pause 76 `#fff` / `#25266A` 40 FILL, forward-15 (mirrored).
  - Chapter rows 14/500 (inactive .55, active `graphic_eq`).
  - Copy verbatim: "SESLİ BRİFİNG" · "1.0x" / "1.25x" / "1.5x" · chapter titles per D-09.
- **Primary CTA:** Play/pause.
- **Secondary actions:**
  - ±15 s → `seekTo(clamp(pos±15))`.
  - Scrubber drag → `seekTo`.
  - Speed chip cycles 1.0 → 1.25 → 1.5 → 1.0 (`setPlaybackRate(rate,'high')` / TTS `rate`).
  - Chapter row → `seekTo(start_s)`.
  - Collapse → M-GL-14 (playback continues).
  - Ended state: (new) "Brifing bitti." with "Baştan Dinle" / "Brifinge Dön".
  - Failed file: (new) "Ses hazırlanamadı. Cihaz sesiyle okuyabilirim." → "Cihaz Sesiyle Dinle" (`POST /briefings/:id/audio {prefer:'native'}`; switches to TTS mode).
- **Loading:** (new) "Ses hazırlanıyor…" with a spinner in the play button while `/audio` renders or the file downloads (a progress fraction is shown as text "%{n}").
- **Empty:** No chapters (an empty briefing) → only the "Genel bakış" chapter.
- **Error:** Signed URL expired → silent re-fetch. Download failure → retry once, then the TTS offer. An interruption (call) or a headphone unplug pauses playback (and it does not auto-resume after unplug).
- **Offline:** A cached file plays. Otherwise (new) "Ses indirilmedi · çevrimdışısın." and the TTS option (TTS works offline if the text is cached with the briefing).
- **Permission edge case:** None (playback needs no permission). Free → the route guard opens M-GL-13 `voice_briefing` and closes.
- **Approval requirement:** None.
- **Analytics events:** `briefing_audio_played {kind, mode:'premium_tts'|'native_tts', completion_bucket:0|25|50|75|100}` (one per listening session, sent when playback ends or the player or mini-player closes; a backoffice metric input under this exact name), `briefing_audio_pause`, `briefing_audio_seek {method:'skip'|'scrub'|'chapter'}`, `briefing_audio_speed_changed {rate}`, `briefing_audio_fallback {reason}`.
- **Accessibility notes:**
  - Play/pause is labelled "Oynat"/"Duraklat".
  - Skip buttons are labelled "15 saniye geri" / "15 saniye ileri" (the design's "15" glyph is not read alone).
  - The scrubber is `accessibilityRole="adjustable"` with increment/decrement = ±15 s and value "{elapsed} / {total}".
  - The speed chip reads "Hız, 1,25 kat".
  - Chapters are buttons with "Bölüm {n}, {title}, {duration}, şu an çalıyor?".
  - The waveform is hidden from assistive tech. A transcript (the chapter texts) is available via an accessibility action (new) "Metni göster" that opens M-BR-01 scrolled to the section.
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://briefing/{id}/listen`.
- **Tests:**
  - `AudioPlayerScreen.test.tsx` (mocked expo-audio: skip clamping, rate cycle, chapter seek, ended state).
  - `tts-queue.test.ts` (sentence splitting, estimated positions, Android pause emulation).
  - Maestro `mf_briefing_read_listen.yaml` (file mode with a fixture audio asset in demo; asserts play → pause → +15 → chapter 3 → speed 1.25).

### M-BR-03 · Midday Pulse
- **Screen ID:** M-BR-03
- **Route:** `app/briefing/[id].tsx` → `MiddayPulseView` when `kind==='midday'` (stack; ModalHeader close).
- **Entry points:** The midday push (only sent when delivered); Today hero "Nabzı Gör"; M-BR-07 (including `skipped` rows).
- **Primary purpose:** A delta-only update since the morning (M§10). No-delta days open the no-delta state (D-14).
  - **Delta item kinds** (domain `midday-delta.ts` †): new urgent/today insights since `morning.generated_at`; calendar changes today (a new invite conflict, a time change or cancellation, a reschedule request found in mail); a reply received on an awaited thread; a deadline moved or added; a shipment status change; an approval that failed or expired.
  - Each delta item renders as a DeltaCard.
- **Data dependencies:** `briefings` (kind midday, `delta_count` †, status, `skipped_reason`), `briefing_items` (section `midday_delta` / `rest_of_day` †), today's `calendar_events` (the "GÜNÜN GERİ KALANI" rows, all remaining events: audit issue 26), `meeting_preps` (prep-ready status).
- **API dependencies:**
  - PostgREST selects; RPC-07 `mark_briefing_opened`.
  - "{16:30} Öner" → `POST /plan/conflicts/:insightId/resolve {option:{type:'propose_slot', start, end}}` → the server creates `email_send` (+ `calendar_update` if the user owns the event) approvals → `approvals/{id}` sheet.
  - "Seçenekleri Gör" → `plan/conflict/{insightId}` (uses `POST /plan/conflicts/:insightId/options`).
  - "Takip Mesajı Hazırla" → `POST /followups/:threadId/draft`.
  - "Toplantıda Sor" → `POST /meetings/:eventId/notes {kind:'talking_point', text, source_insight_id}`; undo = PostgREST delete of that `meeting_notes` row.
- **State dependencies:** `['briefings', id]`, `['today', localDate]`.
- **Source design reference:** P/03 › 3.5.
  - bg `#F5F4F0`; ModalHeader close + "ÖĞLE NABZI"; hero kicker `star_shine` "SABAHTAN BERİ"; H 28/34 "Sabahından beri **{2}** önemli gelişme oldu."
  - DeltaCard r20 padding 16: badge (e.g. "TAKVİM" info), title, sub, source row, ButtonPair S (primary 40 r12 + tonal) or inline actions.
  - "GÜNÜN GERİ KALANI" TimelineList: time 44 w 13/600; status "Hazır" (`#4547C9`), "{4} sa kaldı" (`#9A6300`, computed live), "{4} kişi".
  - Bottom ink CTA "Tamam".
  - Copy verbatim for the design case: "Mehmet toplantıyı 16:00'ya almak istiyor." / "16:00 Ürün gözden geçirme ile çakışır. 16:30 senin için boş." / "16:30 Öner" / "Seçenekleri Gör" / "Gönderdiğin teklife henüz cevap gelmedi." / "Takip Mesajı Hazırla" / "Toplantıda Sor".
  - Footer (S/MiddayPulse.tsx, new styling) "Sonraki brifing saat {19:00}'da" (only if the evening is enabled and entitled).
  - No-delta state: "Her şey planlandığı gibi." (P/03 3.5 note) + (C-21) "Sabahından beri önemli bir değişiklik yok."
- **Primary CTA:** "Tamam" → dismiss + mark opened.
- **Secondary actions:** The DeltaCard actions (above); timeline rows → `meeting/{id}/prep` ("Hazır") / `event/{id}` / the deadline source; close.
- **Loading:** Skeleton cards.
- **Empty:** `status==='skipped'` or `delta_count===0` → the no-delta state (one line + "GÜNÜN GERİ KALANI" + "Tamam").
- **Error:** Load failure → ErrorCard + "Tekrar Dene". A stale delta (e.g. the meeting was already rescheduled) is marked by the live overlay (new) "Güncellendi" and its actions are hidden.
- **Offline:** Cached content; actions that need the network are disabled with hints.
- **Permission edge case:** Free → the route guard shows M-GL-13 `midday` (Free users never receive midday pushes). Meeting Prep and Follow-Up actions are gated as §0.6.
- **Approval requirement:** "16:30 Öner" and the conflict options produce `email_send` / `calendar_update` approvals (M§33). "Toplantıda Sor" is internal (no approval).
- **Analytics events:** `briefing_opened {kind:'midday', via}`, `midday_action {action:'propose_slot'|'see_options'|'followup_draft'|'ask_in_meeting'}`, `midday_no_delta_viewed`.
- **Accessibility notes:** The hero sentence is a header; each DeltaCard is a group with its actions; the time-left status is text, not colour alone.
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://briefing/{id}`.
- **Tests:** `MiddayPulseView.test.tsx` (delta and no-delta, footer conditional, stale overlay). `midday-delta.test.ts` (domain). Maestro `mf_midday_deliver.yaml`, `mf_midday_skip.yaml`.

### M-BR-04 · Evening Close
- **Screen ID:** M-BR-04
- **Route:** `app/briefing/[id].tsx` → `EveningCloseView` when `kind==='evening'` (stack; GradientHeader dusk; light status bar).
- **Entry points:** The evening push; Today hero "Kapanışı Gör"; M-BR-07.
- **Primary purpose:** Close the day with the M§11 sections and the "Yarına Hazırım" → confirmation → carry-over action (REQ-BRIEF-11). The domain `evening-carry-over.ts` † defines:
  - **Tamamlananlar:** insights completed today; `email_send`/`calendar_*` approvals executed today ("… gönderildi"); meetings that ended today and were not declined ("gerçekleşti" semantics); shipments delivered per source.
  - **Yarına Kalanlar:** open insights due ≤ today or urgency today; open `user_owes` commitments due ≤ tomorrow; payments due ≤ 3 days.
  - **Takip:** open `they_owe` follow-ups with days waiting.
  - **Yarının ilk etkinliği:** the first non-all-day event tomorrow.
- **Data dependencies:** `briefings` (kind evening, `evening_ready_at`, `counts`), `briefing_items` (sections `completed`, `carry_over`, `follow_up`, `tomorrow_first` †) with the live status overlay.
- **API dependencies:** PostgREST selects; RPC-07 `mark_briefing_opened`; open-row radio → RPC-01 `set_insight_status(done)` or RPC-06 `set_commitment_status(p_commitment_id,'done')`; `POST /briefings/:id/evening-ready` (via M-BR-04C).
- **State dependencies:** `['briefings', id]`, `['today', localDate]`.
- **Source design reference:** P/03 › 3.6.
  - Dusk header (padding 0 20 56); kicker "AKŞAM KAPANIŞI · {5 EYLÜL}"; H 30/36 "Bugünden yarına {3} konu kaldı." (number not accented on the gradient, as designed); sub "{4} konuyu kapattın. Yarın {09:00}'da başlıyorsun." (no event tomorrow: (new) "Yarın takviminde etkinlik yok.").
  - ChecklistRows: done `check_circle` FILL `#2FA062` + line-through; open `radio_button_unchecked` `#C9C5BC`; follow-up `schedule_send`.
  - Kickers (D-10): "TAMAMLANANLAR · {n}" · "YARINA KALANLAR · {n}" · "TAKİP · {n}" · "YARININ İLK ETKİNLİĞİ".
  - NextEventCard ink r20: time tile 48 r14 "{09}/{00}"; title 16/600; meta "{60 dk} · {Ofis}". The design's "07:50'de çıkman yeterli" is **not rendered** (D-07).
  - Sticky primary CTA `bedtime` "Yarına Hazırım", shadow `0 8px 24px rgba(91,92,226,.28)`.
  - Dark variant uses the DARK tokens; the dusk gradient is the same in both modes.
- **Primary CTA:** "Yarına Hazırım" → M-BR-04C.
- **Secondary actions:**
  - Open-row radio → complete (optimistic + "Geri al").
  - Done row → source.
  - Carry-over row → source or `commitments/{id}`.
  - Follow-up row → `mail/{id}`.
  - NextEventCard → `event/{id}`; its `alarm` icon → `reminders/new?sourceType=event&sourceId={id}&preset=before_1h`.
  - "Dinle · {1} dk" (header text action, from 3.2) → M-BR-02.
  - Back.
- **Loading:** Skeleton checklist.
- **Empty:**
  - Zero carry-over → H (new) "Bugün her şeyi kapattın." and "YARINA KALANLAR" hidden; the CTA still confirms the quiet-until-morning option.
  - Nothing completed → "TAMAMLANANLAR" hidden.
- **Error:** Load failure → ErrorCard + "Tekrar Dene".
- **Offline:** Cached; radio completion is queued; "Yarına Hazırım" is queued (idempotent; §0.5).
- **Permission edge case:** Free → the route guard opens M-GL-13 `evening`.
- **Approval requirement:** None. The carry-over only changes internal records (insight snooze, commitment due dates). Provider tasks and events are never modified here (there is no task_update action type; M§33).
- **Analytics events:** `briefing_opened {kind:'evening', via}`, `evening_item_completed {entity_type}`, `evening_ready_opened`.
- **Accessibility notes:** Checklist rows are checkboxes with state. The NextEventCard reads "Yarının ilk etkinliği, {09:00}, {Haftalık ekip}, {60 dakika}". Once confirmed, the CTA is replaced by a non-interactive status row (new) "Yarına hazırsın · {21:14}" that does not look pressable (SREQ-85).
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://briefing/{id}`.
- **Tests:** `EveningCloseView.test.tsx` (section labels exact, leave-by line absent, zero states, confirmed status row). `evening-carry-over.test.ts` (domain). Maestro `mf_evening_carry_over.yaml`.

### M-BR-04C · "Yarına Hazırım" confirmation + success
- **Screen ID:** M-BR-04C
- **Route:** sheet(host) `evening_ready` `{briefingId}`
- **Entry points:** The M-BR-04 CTA.
- **Primary purpose:** The M§11 confirmation step and the persisted carry-over action.
- **Data dependencies:** Carry-over candidates (from the briefing), `morning_time` (or the weekend time tomorrow), entitlements.
- **API dependencies:** `POST /briefings/:id/evening-ready` with `Idempotency-Key: evening_ready:{briefing_id}` and body `{carry_over:[{entity_type:'insight'|'commitment', entity_id}], quiet_until_morning:boolean}` → `{carried_count, morning_at, quiet_until?}`. Server effects (transactional):
  - Insights → `status='snoozed'`, `snoozed_until = morning_at`, `carried_over_from = local_date` †.
  - Commitments due ≤ today → `due_at` = tomorrow at the same local time.
  - `notification_preferences.snooze_until = morning_at` † when quiet is chosen. `critical_email` and `meeting` still pass the decision engine.
  - `briefings.evening_ready_at = now()`.
  - Tomorrow's morning generator pulls `carried_over_from = yesterday` items into "BUGÜNÜN ÖNCELİKLERİ".
- **State dependencies:** `['briefings', id]`, `['today', localDate]`, `['me','bootstrap']`.
- **Source design reference:** P/08 MOTION "Başarı" (a green ring 500 ms + icon 450 ms / 100 ms delay, success haptic); S/src/screens/today/EveningClose.tsx per-item "Yarına taşı" (IA only; its dead CTA is not copied). Copy (new):
  - Kicker "AKŞAM KAPANIŞI" · title "Yarına taşıyalım mı?" · sub "Seçtiğin konular yarının sabah brifingine eklenir."
  - Section "YARINA TAŞINACAKLAR · {n}" (switch rows, default on).
  - Switch "Sabaha kadar bildirimleri sessize al" (meta "Kritik mailler ve toplantı hatırlatmaları gelmeye devam eder", default on).
  - Echo line "Sabah brifingin {08:00'de} hazır olacak."
  - Primary "Yarına Hazırım" · secondary "Vazgeç".
  - Success: title "Yarına hazırsın." · body "{n} konu yarının brifingine taşındı. İyi akşamlar." · CTA "Bugün'e Dön".
- **Primary CTA:** "Yarına Hazırım" → POST → success state in the same sheet.
- **Secondary actions:** Item switches; the quiet switch; "Vazgeç"; success "Bugün'e Dön" → `router.replace('/(tabs)/today')` (Today hero → `evening_confirmed`).
- **Loading:** CTA spinner; the rows are locked.
- **Empty:** Zero carry-over → the section is hidden; the sheet confirms only the quiet option (title (new) "Günü kapatalım mı?").
- **Error:** POST failure → inline (new) "Kaydedilemedi. Tekrar dene." Repeating the POST is safe (idempotent).
- **Offline:** Queued mutation; the sheet shows (new) "Bağlantı gelince uygulanacak." and closes. Today reflects the optimistic state.
- **Permission edge case:** Notifications denied → the quiet switch is hidden (nothing to silence).
- **Approval requirement:** The explicit user confirmation in this sheet (M§11 "→ confirmation"). There is no `approval_actions` row because no external side effect occurs.
- **Analytics events:** `evening_ready_confirmed {carried_count, excluded_count, quiet:boolean}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** The success state is announced ("Yarına hazırsın"). Reduce-motion: no ring animation.
- **Deep links:** None.
- **Tests:** `EveningReadySheet.test.tsx` (payload excludes toggled-off items, idempotency key, quiet hidden when notifications are denied). A Deno test for the route (API_CONTRACTS). Maestro `mf_evening_carry_over.yaml`.

### M-BR-05 · Weekly Review
- **Screen ID:** M-BR-05
- **Route:** `app/weekly/[id].tsx` (stack; ModalHeader close; bg `editorial/paper #FBFAF7`; dark bg `#141311` with the dark card tokens †).

- **Accessibility notes:** Stats read as sentences; Lora numbers use `fontVariant:['tabular-nums']`; the HighlightCard reads "Kazandığın zaman, tahmini, {2 saat 48 dakika}".
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://weekly/{id}`.
- **Tests:** `WeeklyReview.test.tsx` (zero rows omitted, deadline phrasing variants, Pro prep clause, people section present). `time-saved.test.ts` (formula v1 reproduces 168 min for 652/14/6). Maestro `mf_weekly_share.yaml`.

### M-BR-06 · Weekly share (privacy-safe card)
- **Screen ID:** M-BR-06
- **Route:** `app/weekly/[id]/share.tsx` (modal; ModalHeader close).
- **Entry points:** The M-BR-05 CTA.
- **Primary purpose:** Preview and share a privacy-safe image through the native share sheet (M§12, REQ-BRIEF-13/14). The card contains aggregates only: no names, people, subjects or content.
- **Data dependencies:** `GET /weekly/:id/share-card` → `{period_label, mails_analyzed, important_count, meetings, followups, time_saved_min, tagline}`. The server builds it from `weekly_stats` and it has no PII by construction. `GET /referrals/me` (the optional invite link).
- **API dependencies:** Those two routes; local rendering with `react-native-view-shot` † `captureRef(ref,{format:'png', quality:1, width:1080, height:1350|1920})`; `expo-sharing` `shareAsync(fileUri,{mimeType:'image/png', UTI:'public.png', dialogTitle})`.
- **State dependencies:** `['weekly', id, 'share-card']`, `['referrals','me']`.
- **Source design reference:** P/03 › 3.8 ("Dijital Haftam" 1080×1350, dawn gradient, padding 96).
  - Logo row (tile 84 r26 + "Dijital Asistan" 34/600); kicker 30/600 "DİJİTAL HAFTAM · {21–27 EYLÜL}"; Lora 96/104 "{684} maili okumadım.\nÖnemli {32}'sini gördüm."; stats Lora 80/84 "{21}" toplantı · "{8}" takip · "{2 sa 48 dk}" kazandım; tagline "Bugün bilmen gerekenleri, sen sormadan söyler."
  - The 9:16 story variant (1080×1920) uses the same template (designer note).
  - The headline auto-shrinks (`adjustsFontSizeToFit`, min scale .7) for long numbers like "1.284".
  - Copy (new) for the sheet: title "Dijital Haftamı Paylaş" · segmented "Gönderi · 4:5" / "Hikâye · 9:16" · switch "Davet bağlantımı ekle" (appends the text `https://<web>/r/{code}` to the share message; the image is unchanged) · privacy note "Paylaşım kartında isim, kişi veya konu yer almaz; yalnızca toplamlar." · CTA "Paylaş".
- **Primary CTA:** "Paylaş" → capture → `shareAsync`.
- **Secondary actions:** Format segment; invite switch; close.
- **Loading:** A card skeleton while `/share-card` loads. During capture the CTA shows a spinner. Fonts are already loaded at boot, so capture never uses fallback fonts.
- **Empty:** None (the weekly row already exists).
- **Error:** Capture or share failure → toast (new) "Paylaşım hazırlanamadı. Tekrar dene." If the user dismisses the share sheet, nothing is shown.
- **Offline:** A cached share-card payload lets the image render and share (OS share works offline). Without a cache, the CTA is disabled.
- **Permission edge case:** None (`expo-sharing` needs no permission; no photo-library write).
- **Approval requirement:** None (the user shares their own aggregates through the OS).
- **Analytics events:** `weekly_share_format_changed {format:'4:5'|'9:16'}`, `weekly_share_completed {format, with_invite:boolean}` (fired when `shareAsync` resolves; no target app is recorded).
- **Accessibility notes:** The preview image has a label with the full aggregate sentence; the segment is a radio group; the privacy note is read before the CTA.
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://weekly/{id}/share`.
- **Tests:**
  - `ShareCard.test.tsx`: renders only aggregate props; a snapshot shows no contact names; long-number shrink.
  - Deno test: `/weekly/:id/share-card` returns no PII fields.
  - Maestro `mf_weekly_share.yaml` (asserts the system share sheet appears).

### M-BR-07 · Briefing history
- **Screen ID:** M-BR-07
- **Route:** `app/briefings/index.tsx` (stack; SubHeader kicker (new) "BRİFİNGLER").
- **Entry points:** M-BR-05 "Bu haftanın brifingleri"; Settings › Brifingler "Geçmiş brifingler" (Settings part); `dijitalasistan://briefings`.
- **Primary purpose:** Reach past briefings, including skipped middays. This closes the IA gap flagged in the design-hub audit.
- **Data dependencies:** `briefings` (id, kind, local_date, status, headline, delta_count, ready_at), limited to the retention window; cursor pagination of 30.
- **API dependencies:** PostgREST select with `order=local_date.desc,kind.asc`.
- **State dependencies:** `['briefings','list',{cursor}]`.
- **Source design reference:** P/03 › 3.3 GroupedListCard. Group kickers "BUGÜN" / "DÜN" / "{22 EYLÜL SALI}".
  - Row icons: `wb_twilight` morning, `wb_sunny` midday, `bedtime` evening, `star_shine` weekly.
  - Titles (new): "Sabah brifingi" · "Öğle nabzı" · "Akşam kapanışı" · "Haftalık özet".
  - Meta = `headline`, or (new) "Değişiklik yoktu" for a skipped midday, plus the time.
  - List rendered with FlashList 2.
- **Primary CTA:** A row → `briefing/{id}` or `weekly/{id}`.
- **Secondary actions:** Pull-to-refresh; infinite scroll.
- **Loading:** Skeleton rows.
- **Empty:** (new) "Henüz brifing yok." / "İlk sabah brifingin {08:00'de} hazır olacak."
- **Error:** ErrorCard + "Tekrar Dene".
- **Offline:** The first cached page; pagination is disabled.
- **Permission edge case:** Free users see only morning and weekly rows (no Pro rows exist for them).
- **Approval requirement:** None.
- **Analytics events:** `briefing_history_opened`, `briefing_opened {kind, via:'history'}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** Group kickers are headers; rows read "{title}, {date}, {meta}".
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://briefings`.
- **Tests:** `BriefingHistory.test.tsx` (grouping by local date in the user's timezone, skipped midday meta).
