## Flows

Each flow is written as the end-to-end chain UI → state → API → backend → DB → provider/AI → approval → side effect → confirmation → refreshed state (M§98). "—" means the link does not apply to that step.

### F-01 · First-run onboarding → Today
Example: iOS, new user, Apple sign-in, Gmail + Google Calendar, Free plan.

| # | UI | State | API | Backend / job | DB | Provider / AI | Approval / side effect | Confirmation → refreshed state |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Cold start, native splash | `installation_id` missing → generate, keychain purge; `authStatus=signed_out` | — | — | — | — | — | M-GL-02 → `welcome?page=0` |
| 2 | M-ON-01…04 pager, "Hesap Oluştur" | `introIndex` persisted | `POST /analytics/events` (batched) | — | `analytics_events` | — | — | M-ON-05 (signup) |
| 3 | "Apple ile devam et" | `authMode=signup` | Supabase `signInWithIdToken(apple, nonce)` | Auth; new-user trigger | `auth.users`, `profiles`, `user_preferences` (tz Europe/Istanbul), `notification_preferences` (title_only) | Apple ID token verified by Supabase | — | Session stored (LargeSecureStore) |
| 4 | (background) | — | `POST /auth/apple/exchange`; `POST /devices/register` (applies the device timezone when `timezone_mode='auto'`); `GET /me/bootstrap`; `PATCH profiles {locale, terms_*, onboarding_step:'connect_mail'}` | `api` exchanges the code at Apple `/auth/token`, encrypts the refresh token (ADR-06) | `app_installations`; `profiles` | Apple token endpoint | — | `Purchases.logIn`; route → M-ON-06 |
| 5 | Gmail "Bağla" → M-ON-06G → "Google ile Bağlan" | `pendingOAuth={google, mail_read}`; `device_nonce` in SecureStore `da.oauth.pending` | `POST /integrations/google/start {…, device_nonce_hash}` → `openAuthSessionAsync(auth_url)` | `api` creates a single-use `oauth_states` row (10 min) with `device_nonce_hash` (R-07) | `oauth_states` | Google consent (`gmail.readonly`) | — | Browser |
| 6 | (redirect) | — | Google → `oauth /google/callback` | Validate and consume the state, PKCE exchange, parse granted scopes, AES-GCM encrypt the token set and hold it on the state row. The account is **not** finalised here (R-07); a one-time `completion_code` is issued (its hash stored) | `oauth_states` (`used_at`, `completion_code_hash`) | Google token endpoint | — | Redirect `dijitalasistan://integrations/callback?provider=google&result=pending_confirmation&completion_code=…` |
| 7 | Row spinner → "Bağlandı", toast "Gmail bağlandı" | read `da.oauth.pending`; then invalidate `['integrations','accounts']` | `POST /integrations/oauth/complete {completion_code, device_nonce}` (user JWT) | `api` requires `oauth_states.user_id = auth.uid()` and `sha256(device_nonce) = device_nonce_hash`, upserts the account (`syncing`), stores the credentials, enqueues `initial_sync` (`initial_sync:{account}`) and audits. `worker` then runs `initial_sync` (72 h metadata; triage survivors fetched transiently) and Gmail `watch` | `oauth_states.completed_at`, `oauth_credentials`, `connected_accounts` (syncing → healthy), `sync_states`, `jobs`, `audit_logs`, `email_threads`, `email_messages` (headers + ≤200-char snippet), `contacts` | Gmail API, Pub/Sub watch | — | Meta "İlk analiz bekliyor" |
| 8 | M-ON-07 "Google Takvim" → M-ON-07E → CTA | `pendingOAuth={google, calendar_read}` | `POST /integrations/:accountId/upgrade {capability:'calendar_read', device_nonce_hash}` → callback → `POST /integrations/oauth/complete` | Incremental consent callback (not final); the completion adds the capability and enqueues `calendar_sync` | `connected_accounts.capabilities_granted`, `calendars` | Google consent + Calendar API | — | M-ON-07P opens automatically |
| 9 | M-ON-07P "Kaydet" | — | `PATCH /integrations/:accountId/data-sources {calendars, expected_updated_at}` | Selection applied to sync (`max_calendars`) | `calendars.selected` | — | — | "1 takvim · Kişisel" (Free, D-30) |
| 10 | M-ON-08 → M-ON-09 → M-ON-10 | optimistic bootstrap patches | `PATCH data-sources` toggles; `PATCH user_preferences {interest_categories, *_time, weekend_morning_*}`; `PATCH profiles.onboarding_step` | Scheduler reads times on its next tick | `connected_accounts.data_source_toggles`, `user_preferences` | — | — | Next step |
| 11 | M-ON-11 (Free) | gate visible | none (RPC-13 is Pro only; neutral bars) | — | — | — | — | "Atla ve devam et" → M-ON-12 |
| 12 | M-ON-12 checklist | `analysisJobId` | `POST /onboarding/first-analysis` (Idempotency-Key), then `GET …/:jobId` every 1.5 s | `api` inserts the `first_analysis` job + pokes `worker`. Phases: wait for 72 h sync → deterministic filters → batched classification → reasoning for survivors → zod validation → grounding → insights (dedupe) → ranking → enqueue `briefing` (kind morning, origin onboarding †). `jobs.progress` updated per phase. | `insights` (+ provenance), `ai_requests`, `jobs.progress`, `briefings`, `briefing_items` | Claude Haiku 4.5 / Sonnet 5 via `ai_model_config` (fixture provider in demo) | — | Rows tick with real counts; auto-advance |
| 13 | M-ON-13 "Brifingimi Gör" | — | cached job result | — | — | — | — | M-ON-14 |
| 14 | M-ON-14 "Bildirimleri Aç" | — | OS prompt → `getExpoPushTokenAsync` → `POST /devices/register {…, push:{permission:'granted', expo_push_token}}`; `PATCH notification_preferences {os_permission}` | `api` upserts the token | `push_tokens`, `app_installations.push_enabled`, `notification_preferences.os_permission` | APNs via Expo | — | Next |
| 15 | M-ON-15 | reset onboarding store | `PATCH profiles {onboarding_step:'done', onboarding_completed_at}` | Trigger enqueues `referral_evaluate` if a referral exists † | `profiles`, `jobs` | — | — | `replace('/(tabs)/today')` + `push('/briefing/{id}')` |
| 16 | M-BR-01 visible; Back → M-TD-01 | `['today',date]` fetched | RPC-04 `today_overview`; RPC-07 `mark_briefing_opened` | — | `briefings.opened_at` | — | — | Hero `first_day`, N = Aha N |

**Branches**
- **Zero sources** (step 5/8 skipped): D-03. Steps 11–13 are skipped; Today opens in hero `no_sources`.
- **Calendar denied:** M-ON-07D, then continue.
- **Partial Google grant:** "Eksik izin" → `upgrade`.
- **Slow analysis:** "Bugün'e geç" → steps 14–15; Today hero `first_analysis_running` until the job completes (Today polls RPC-04 every 5 s in this mode, R-19).
- **Analysis failure:** retry with a new attempt key, or "Şimdilik geç".
- **Android:** channels exist at boot so the prompt shows; M-ON-14A is inserted between steps 14 and 15.
- **Demo:** steps 5/8 use `POST /integrations/demo/start`. Its `auth_url` (`oauth/demo/authorize`, OAUTH-03) redirects straight back with `result=pending_confirmation`, and the completion call is the same as for real providers.

| 5 | Route | pending link replay (if any) | — | — | — | — | — | `replace('/(tabs)/today')` |

- `bootstrap.config.upgrade_required` → M-GL-12.

For users whose local now ≥ `morning_time − briefing.generation_lead_minutes` † and with no `briefings(user, morning, local_date)`: insert the row (scheduled), enqueue `briefing` (`briefing:{user}:morning:{local_date}`). DST-safe via `AT TIME ZONE`. | `briefings`, `jobs` | — | — | — |

Pro + premium TTS configured → enqueue `briefing_audio` †. | `briefing_items`, `ai_requests`; `briefings.status=ready` | Sonnet 5 (fixture in demo) | — | Hero → `morning_ready` |

(generic mode: "Dijital Asistan" / "Yeni bir güncellemen var.") | `notifications` (sent), `push_tickets`; `briefings.status=delivered`; after 15 min `push_receipts` | Expo Push → APNs/FCM | — | Push on the device |
| 5 | Tap the push | M-GL-08 routes | PATCH `notifications.opened_at` (matched by `entity_id` + `category`, M-GL-08) | — | — | — | — | M-BR-01 |

| 7 | "Brifingi Dinle · 2 dk" | `usePlayerStore.loading` | `POST /briefings/:id/audio` → signed URL (300 s) | Entitlement check (Pro); returns the cached asset | — | — | — | Download → local file → autoplay; lock-screen session active |
| 8 | ±15, speed 1.25, chapter 03, collapse | player state | — | — | resume position in MMKV | — | — | M-GL-14 docked; playback continues in the background |

**Branches**
- No premium TTS → step 7 returns `mode:'native'` → D-19 degraded controls with the "Cihaz sesiyle okunuyor" chip.
- Free user → M-GL-13 `voice_briefing`.
- Briefing `failed` after retries → hero `morning_failed`; `POST /briefings/:id/retry` (API-BRF-04) re-enqueues with a new attempt key `briefing_retry:{briefing_id}:{n}`.
- Offline at tap → the cached briefing; audio only if the file is cached.

### F-04 · Midday: skip vs deliver

| # | Branch | Backend | DB | Notification | Client result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Both | `scheduler_tick` at local `midday_time` for **Pro** users with midday enabled, on days in `briefing_weekdays` (weekend days only when `weekend_morning_only` is off) → enqueue `briefing` (`briefing:{user}:midday:{date}`) | `briefings` (scheduled), `jobs` | — | — |
| 2 | Both | `worker` computes the domain `computeMiddayDelta(morning.generated_at, now)` over insights, calendar changes, replies, deadlines, shipments and approvals | — | — | — |
| 3a | **Skip** (delta = 0) | `briefings.status='skipped'`, `skipped_reason='no_meaningful_delta'` (R-05); no LLM call | `briefings` | none (backoffice metric M§54) | Today morning hero context "Sabahından beri önemli bir değişiklik yok."; opening from history → "Her şey planlandığı gibi." |
| 3b | **Deliver** (delta ≥ 1) | Deterministic T0 composition of the delta items (R-05) → items (`midday_delta`, `rest_of_day`) → ready. An optional one-sentence T1 polish runs only behind flag `ai.feature.briefing_polish`; never T2 | `briefing_items`, `ai_requests`, `briefings.delta_count` † | Decision engine → Expo push (interruption `passive`) title "Öğle nabzı" / body "Sabahından beri {n} önemli gelişme oldu." → delivered | Today hero `midday_ready`; tap → M-BR-03 |
| 4 | Deliver, action "16:30 Öner" | `api` `/plan/conflicts/:insightId/resolve` → validate → exact change → `approval_actions` (email_send ± calendar_update, pending) | `approval_actions`, `approval_events` | — | `approvals/{id}` sheet → Onayla → execution in the Approval part (provider idempotency: Message-ID / event id) → chip count refresh |
| 5 | Free users | No job. RPC-04 `today_overview` computes the deterministic delta count | — | none | Hero `midday_gate` (count > 0 and not dismissed) → "Şimdi değil" writes `user_preferences.dismissed_gates.midday` (7 d) |

An optional one-sentence T1 polish runs behind `ai.feature.briefing_polish`; never T2 | — | Push at `evening_time` (passive): "Akşam kapanışı" / "Bugünden yarına {n} konu kaldı." (suppressed when both counts are 0) |

**Branches**
- Offline at step 4 → the queued mutation replays with the same key (no duplicate carry-over).
- Zero carry-over → quiet-only confirmation.

## Proposed additions to the canonical registry

**Mobile routes**

| Item | Justification |
|---|---|
| `app/update-required.tsx` (M-GL-12) | Accepted into the registry. Blocking gate for unsupported builds (API contract safety). |
| `app/briefings/index.tsx` (M-BR-07) | Accepted into the registry. Reach past and skipped briefings; weekly "Bu haftanın brifingleri". |
| `app/index.tsx` resolver, `app/+native-intent.tsx`, `integrations/callback`, `auth/callback` | Accepted into the registry. Framework entry files and link targets required by M-GL-02 / M-GL-07. |
| `app/demo/setup` | Accepted into the registry (defined in Part 5). Listed here because M-GL-07 owns the allow-list; demo builds only. |
| `(auth)/sign-in?mode=signup\|signin`; `(auth)/email-otp?step=email\|code` | Params on the existing routes. |

**API routes and contracts (`api`)**

| Item | Justification |
|---|---|
| `POST /briefings/:id/retry` | Accepted as API-BRF-04: re-enqueue a failed briefing from Today or the briefing screen (honest failure recovery). |
| `POST /integrations/:provider/start` accepts `provider=demo` and `{capabilities, return_to, login_hint, device_nonce_hash}`; callback query `provider, result, completion_code, error_code, admin_consent_url`; completion `POST /integrations/oauth/complete {completion_code, device_nonce}` → `{result, account_id, granted[], resume?}` | R-07 client-bound completion. # Screen & Flow Map — Part 2: Flow, Mail, Reply, Follow-up, Commitments, Life, Capture, Reminders, Approvals

> **Status:** Plan Mode draft, 2026-09-23. Execution step 0 saves this file as part 2 of `docs/SCREEN_AND_FLOW_MAP.md`.
>
> **Binding sources, in order:**
> 1. The master plan (`/root/.claude/plans/root-claude-uploads-46bfff87-a0f2-5945-magical-fern.md`). It supplies the ADRs, canonical enums, tables, the §5b `api` route catalogue and the §9 route tree.
> 2. The master prompt (cited as **M§n**). It decides functional behaviour.
> 3. PRIMARY design canvases (`04 Akis ve Mail`, `06 Asistan Hafiza Kisiler` 6.8, `08 Durumlar Widgetlar Etkilesimler`, hub `Dijital Asistan.dc.html`, `07` 7.6). They decide visuals.
> 4. SECONDARY prototype. Use it for coverage and IA only; never copy its fakes.
> 5. The audits:
>    - design-flow-mail, design-hub, design-plan-assistant (6.4/6.8), design-account-states-marketing (08) and design-secondary-code;
>    - secondary-docs (REQ-*, SREQ-*, C-*);
>    - integrations (send scopes).
>
> **Scope of this part:**
> - Flow tab, Mail Intelligence, Email Detail and AI Reply.
> - Waiting ("Senden Beklenenler") and Follow-ups ("Senin Cevap Beklediklerin").
> - Commitments, the Life Intelligence detail sheet and the Smart Reminder sheet.
> - Universal Capture, including share intake.
> - Approval Center plus the inline approval sheet.
> - The "Bu nereden çıktı?" sheet and the correction sheet.
>
> Screens owned by other parts are referenced by **route**, not ID: `(tabs)/today`, `plan/proposal/[id]`, `meeting/[eventId]/prep`, `event/[id]`, `person/[id]`, `search`, `settings/*`, `paywall`.

---

## 0. Conventions used in this part

### 0.1 Block format
Each screen, sheet and modal gets one block with the 20 M§145 fields, in this order:

Screen ID · Route · Entry points · Primary purpose · Data dependencies · API dependencies · State dependencies · Source design reference · Primary CTA · Secondary actions · Loading · Empty · Error · Offline · Permission edge case · Approval requirement · Analytics events · Accessibility notes · Deep links · Tests.

"Permission edge case" covers four kinds of permission: OS permissions, OAuth scopes (capabilities), Pro entitlement (M§44) and the per-account Data Source Controls (SREQ-68).

### 0.2 Routes and presentation (Expo Router, per plan §9)

| Route file (under `apps/mobile/app/`) | Presentation | Tab bar | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `(tabs)/flow/index.tsx` | tab root | visible | Per-tab stack preserved. Re-tapping the tab pops to root and scrolls to top. |
| `mail/index.tsx` | stack push | hidden | Mail Intelligence |
| `mail/category/[category].tsx` | stack push | hidden | Accepted registry route (see last section) |
| `mail/[id].tsx` | stack push | hidden | `id` = `email_messages.id` (uuid) |
| `mail/[id]/reply.tsx` | `modal` (iOS pageSheet, Android full screen) | — | `gestureEnabled:false` while submitting or executing |
| `waiting.tsx`, `followups.tsx` | stack push | hidden | — |
| `commitments/index.tsx`, `commitments/[id].tsx` | stack push | hidden | — |
| `life/[id].tsx` | `transparentModal` + `packages/ui` `Sheet` | — | Deep-linkable sheet |
| `reminders/new.tsx` | `transparentModal` + `Sheet` | — | Global reminder sheet |
| `capture/index.tsx` (= `capture`) | `modal` | — | Composer and share intake |
| `capture/[id].tsx` | stack push inside the capture modal stack | — | Analyzing / results / success are rendered by `captures.status` |
| `approvals/index.tsx` | stack push | hidden | `?view=history` renders history in the same file |
| `approvals/[id].tsx` | stack push | hidden | Push-notification target |
| Global sheet host (`_layout.tsx` `SheetHost`) | `Sheet` portal, no URL | — | `ApprovalSheet` (M-APPR-04), `ExplainSheet` (M-SRC-01), `CorrectionSheet` (M-CORR-01), `MailActionsSheet` (M-MAIL-04), `LinkConfirmSheet` (M-MAIL-05), `ScopeUpgradeSheet` (M-REPLY-02) |

**Sheet primitive.** Every sheet uses one `Sheet` primitive (`packages/ui`) built on Reanimated 4.5.1 and gesture-handler ~2.32 to match the PRIMARY spec:

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Scrim | `rgba(27,25,23,.35)` |
| Surface | radius 28 top, padding 10/20/44 |
| Grabber | 36×5 `#E0DED7` |
| Timing | open 300 ms, close 240 ms, dim 250 ms |
| Haptic | light haptic on open |
| Dismiss | drag with velocity snap; Android hardware back closes the sheet first |
| Accessibility | `accessibilityViewIsModal`, focus trap |

Native `formSheet` is not used, so both platforms stay visually identical.

### 0.3 Shared UI kit components used here (`packages/ui`, all theme-aware)
Components follow the audit specs:

- Navigation and headers: `LargeTitleHeader`, `NavHeader`, `PillButton`, `FilterChipRow`, `MetaLine`, `SegmentedControl`.
- Cards: `AttentionCard` (swipeable), `MailSummaryCard`, `PersonActionCard`, `WaitingCard`, `CommitmentCard`, `LifeCard`, `ApprovalCard`, `AICard`.
- Swipe: `SwipeableRow` (built on `ReanimatedSwipeable` from gesture-handler 2.32).
- Badges and markers: `StatusBadge` (tones `critical|warning|neutral|success|info`), `SourceLine` (always tappable → M-SRC-01), `SuggestedSurface` (dashed = "proposed / not yet real").
- Lists and layout: `SectionKicker`, `GroupedList`/`CategoryRow`, `StackedBar`, `HeroStat`, `Avatar`, `SenderHeader`, `ActionTileGrid`, `Accordion`, `OptionRow`, `FileRow`, `ExtractedItemRow`, `ApprovalRow`, `StickyCTABar`.
- Reply: `DraftEditorCard`, `RecipientChip`, `AssistChip`.
- Buttons and notes: `TonalButton`, `PrimaryButton`, `SecondaryButton`, `AssuranceNote`, `HintRow`, `PrivacyNote`.
- Capture: `CaptureSourceTiles`, `CaptureTextField`, `UrlField`, `MediaPreview`, `LinkPreviewCard`, `AnalysisProgressCard`, `EntityHighlightText`.
- States and feedback: `SuccessState`, `Toast`/`UndoToast`, `EmptyState`, `ErrorCard`, `OfflineBanner`, `Skeleton`, `ProGateCard`.

### 0.4 Write-policy matrix (M§3.6–8, M§33, M§94, M§115; plan §5b)

| Action | Mechanism | Approval | Offline | Idempotency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insight status: done / dismiss / snooze (Flow, Waiting, Follow-ups, Life) | PostgREST RPC `set_insight_status` | No (internal); undo toast 5 s | **Queued** (persisted paused mutation, replayed in order) | Setting a status is idempotent |
| Commitment done / snooze / edit | RPC-06 `set_commitment_status`; field corrections through RPC-17 `submit_ai_correction` | No (internal); undo toast | Queued | Idempotent |
| Priority feedback (Önemli değil, Daha sık göster, Takip etme) | Insight targets: RPC `apply_insight_feedback(p_insight_id, p_kind, p_client_mutation_id)`. The server writes `ai_feedback{rating, reason_code}` and, only if "Etkileşimlerimden öğren" is on, derives the `learned_preferences` row (`private.upsert_learned_preference`). Mail rows without an insight: PostgREST `ai_feedback` insert `{target_type:'email_thread', target_id, rating, reason_code}`. The client never writes `learned_preferences`. | No; undo (`revert_insight_feedback(p_feedback_id)` / delete of the `ai_feedback` row) | Queued | `p_client_mutation_id` / client uuid PK |
| VIP add | PostgREST `vip_people` insert (Pro) | No; undo | Queued | Unique `(user_id, contact_id)` |
| In-app reminder (non-smart preset) | `POST /reminders` (API-REM-02, `channel:'local'`) with a client `client_reminder_id` (stored as `reminders.idempotency_key`) + device-local notification | Confirm step inside the sheet (M§29, C-08) | **Queued**: the local notification is scheduled immediately and the POST is replayed | `reminders (user_id, idempotency_key)` |
| "Uygun zamanda" resolution | `POST /reminders/resolve-time` | — | **Blocked** (server needed) | — |
| Reminder to Apple Reminders / Google Tasks / To Do | `POST /approvals` `reminder_create` | Yes | Blocked | Approval key |
| Reply send | `POST /reply-drafts/:id/submit` → `POST /approvals/:id/approve` | Yes (`email_send`) | Blocked | Approval key + Gmail `Message-ID` / Graph marker |
| Calendar create/update | `POST /approvals` → approve | Yes | Blocked | Approval key + deterministic event id / `transactionId` |
| Task create, any destination incl. in-app | `POST /approvals` `task_create` → approve (the sheet is the approval UI) | Yes (M§115 when external; in-app too, for one audited path) | Blocked | Approval key |
| Commitment from ambiguous source | `commitment_create` approval | Yes (M§18) | Blocked | Approval key |
| Capture actions | `POST /captures/:id/actions` → N approvals → approve each | Yes (batch sheet) | Blocked | Per-approval key |
| "Hafızaya kaydet", "Akış'a ekle", link to person (capture) | `POST /captures/:id/actions` (internal kinds) | No | Blocked (server needed) | `(capture_id, extraction_id, action)` |

Approvals are **blocked offline, never queued**. They trigger external side effects, and replaying stale intent after reconnect is unsafe (M§94 "Duplicate write oluşmamalı").

### 0.5 Approval UX contract (M§33, plan §5 state machine)

**Status → UI**

| `approval_status` | Badge (tone) | Card actions | Copy |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pending` | BEKLİYOR (warning) | Onayla · Düzenle · Reddet | — |
| `approved` (transient) | ONAYLANDI (success) | none (spinner) | "Onaylandı" |
| `executing` | İŞLENİYOR (neutral + spinner) | none | email: "Gönderiliyor…"; others: "İşleniyor…" |
| `executed` | TAMAMLANDI (success) | "Sonucu gör" (deep link to result) | Per type, see below |
| `failed` | BAŞARISIZ (critical) | "Tekrar dene" (only if `last_error_code` is retryable in the `packages/domain` approval error map) · "Düzenle" (re-propose as a new approval, see below) | Error-code copy, see below |
| `rejected` | REDDEDİLDİ (neutral, card opacity .45) | — | "Reddedildi" |
| `expired` | SÜRESİ DOLDU (neutral) | "Yeniden öner" (only if the source is still valid) | "Süresi doldu · {time} geçti" |

**Type labels and icons**

| Action type | Label | Icon |
|---|---|---|
| `email_send` | MAİL GÖNDER | `send` |
| `calendar_create` | ETKİNLİK EKLE | `event` |
| `calendar_update` | ETKİNLİK TAŞI (time change only) / ETKİNLİK GÜNCELLE | `event_repeat` |
| `task_create` | GÖREV OLUŞTUR | `add_task` |
| `reminder_create` | HATIRLATICI OLUŞTUR | `notifications` |
| `commitment_create` | TAAHHÜT KAYDET | `handshake` |

**Card fields** (the union required by M§33, which fixes design issue #13):

| Field | Example |
|---|---|
| **Ne** (what) | the title |
| **Neden** (why) | grounded reason, or "Senin isteğinle · {origin screen}" |
| **Kaynak** (source) | tappable → M-SRC-01 |
| **Değişim** (exact change) | one-line summary; "Ayrıntı" → M-APPR-03 |
| **Hedef** (destination/account) | e.g. "Google Takvim · yu***@gmail.com" |
| **Yan etki** (side effect) | "1 mail gönderilecek · geri alınamaz", "2 katılımcıya davet gider", "Takvimine yazılmaz" |
| Expiry | "Süre: bugün 16:00" when `approval_expires_at` is < 24 h away |

**Executed copy** (shown only after `executed`, never earlier; M§98):

| Type | Copy |
|---|---|
| `email_send` | "Yanıtın gönderildi." |
| `calendar_create` | "Takvimine eklendi." |
| `calendar_update` | "Etkinlik güncellendi." |
| `task_create` | "Görev oluşturuldu · {Hedef}" |
| `reminder_create` | "Hatırlatıcı kuruldu · {zaman}" |
| `commitment_create` | "Taahhüt kaydedildi." |

**Capability gate.** Before an approve call the client checks `connected_accounts.capabilities_granted` for `mail_send`, `calendar_write` or `tasks_write`. The server enforces the same check again: `POST /approvals/:id/approve` returns 424 `PROVIDER_SCOPE_MISSING` with `details.upgrade` (`ScopeUpgrade`, API §7). Both paths open M-REPLY-02 (the generic scope-upgrade sheet), then retry approve with the same key.

**Idempotency**
- The approve button is disabled while the mutation is pending.
- `POST /approvals/:id/approve {idempotency_key, payload_version, approved_via}` (API-APR-03) is safe to replay: the HTTP `Idempotency-Key` returns the stored response (API §2.11), and the same approval key and version return the current state without a second job.
- `approved_via` records the surface that was tapped (R-03; every value is a tap): `approval_center` (M-APPR-01/03), `inline_sheet` (M-APPR-04 single), `capture_batch` (M-APPR-04 batch from M-CAP-06), `in_place` (the reply screen's "Göndermeyi Onayla" and the M-COMMIT-01 proposal card), `voice_card` (Part 3). A spoken "onayla" never approves.
- If the payload was edited, a stale key or version returns 409 `APPROVAL_STATE_CONFLICT`. The client refetches and shows "Bu onay güncellendi; son hâlini incele."
- Retry of a `failed` approval = approve again with the **same** key (`failed → executing`).
- Provider-level duplicate guards follow plan §7.

**Undo before approve (R-06).** In M-APPR-04 (single and capture batch) the tap on "Onayla" starts a client-side 5 s delay with the toast "Onaylandı · {N} işlem" + "Geri al". `POST /approvals/:id/approve` is sent only when the delay ends. "Geri al" sends nothing and every approval stays `pending`. If the app is backgrounded or closed during the delay, nothing is sent and the approvals wait in the Approval Center as `pending`. There is no server-side undo status or transition.

**Failed approvals** (the plan §5 state machine exactly; R-06: no `failed → rejected`, no `failed → expired`):
- "Tekrar dene" = approve again with the same key (`failed → executing`). It is offered only when `last_error_code` is retryable in the `packages/domain` approval error map.
- "Düzenle" opens the typed editor (M-APPR-05) or the reply editor in **re-propose mode**: the edited payload becomes a **new** pending approval (`POST /approvals`, or a new `POST /reply-drafts/:id/submit` for `email_send`). The failed approval stays `failed`.
- A failed card stays in TAMAMLANAMADI for 24 h after `failed_at`. After that it lives only in history (M-APPR-02), where "Tekrar dene" stays available for retryable codes.

**Result tracking.** No Realtime. After approve, poll `approval_actions?id=eq.{id}&select=id,status,result,last_error_code,attempt_count,updated_at`:
- every 1 s for 5 s, then every 2 s until 20 s, then every 5 s until 60 s;
- stop on a terminal status;
- after 60 s show "İşlem sürüyor. Bitince bildireceğim." The worker sends a push in the `approval` category on the terminal state.

**Failure copy (`last_error_code` → UI; codes from the API §2.6 `ErrorCode` catalogue)**

| `last_error_code` | Title | Body / CTA |
|---|---|---|
| `PROVIDER_REAUTH_REQUIRED` | "{Gmail\|Outlook} bağlantısı yenilenmeli." | "Yeniden Bağlan" (`POST /integrations/:provider/start`), then "Tekrar dene" |
| `PROVIDER_SCOPE_MISSING` | "Gönderim izni gerekli." / "Takvime yazma izni gerekli." / "Görev yazma izni gerekli." | "İzin Ver" (M-REPLY-02) |
| `PROVIDER_ADMIN_CONSENT_REQUIRED` | "Kurumunun yöneticisi bu uygulamaya onay vermeli." | "Metni kopyala" · "Outlook'ta aç" |
| `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` / `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT` | "{Sağlayıcı}'a ulaşılamadı." | "Tekrar dene" |
| `PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED` | "Sağlayıcı şu an yoğun." | "Tekrar dene" (shown after the job's automatic backoff is exhausted) |
| `PROVIDER_REJECTED` / `VALIDATION_FAILED` | "Bilgilerden biri geçersiz: {alan}." | "Düzenle" (re-propose) |
| `APPROVAL_STALE` | "Etkinlik bu arada değişmiş." | "Yeniden öner" · "Düzenle" (re-propose) |
| `SOURCE_GONE` | "Kaynak artık bulunamıyor." | "Düzenle" (re-propose) |
| `DEVICE_WRITE_FAILED` (`details.reason='permission_denied'`) | "Takvim izni verilmedi." / "Anımsatıcılar izni verilmedi." | "İzin Ver" (`Linking.openSettings()`), then "Tekrar dene" |
| `DEVICE_RESULT_MISSING` | "İşlem bu cihazda tamamlanamadı." | "Tekrar dene" (the device checks its marker before writing again) |

Reply attachments over `REPLY_ATTACHMENT_LIMIT_BYTES` never reach an approval. `PATCH /reply-drafts/:id` and `POST /reply-drafts/:id/submit` reject them with 413 `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (`details.reason='attachment_limit_exceeded'`), shown in M-REPLY-01.

### 0.6 Pro gating in this part (M§44; server-enforced in `api`/`worker`, client gating only for UX)

| Feature | Free | Pro |
|---|---|---|
| Flow (all filters except Takip content), Mail Intelligence, Email Detail, AI Reply (daily AI budget), Waiting, Life cards/sheet, Smart Reminders (incl. "Uygun zamanda"), Approval Center | ✓ | ✓ |
| Follow-ups list and follow-up cards | `ProGateCard` with a deterministic count | ✓ |
| Commitments (list, detail, cards) | `ProGateCard`, no count (no LLM run for Free) | ✓ |
| Universal Capture and share intake | `ProGateCard` | ✓ |
| VIP ("Bu kişiyi VIP yap") | opens `paywall?source=vip` | ✓ |
| Meeting card "Hazırlan" | action becomes "Etkinliği Aç" → `event/[id]` | "Hazırlan" → `meeting/[eventId]/prep` |

**`ProGateCard`** (PRIMARY 07/7.6):
- Kicker: `lock` + "{ÖZELLİK} · PRO".
- Body: a real value statement.
- Primary button: "7 gün ücretsiz dene" **only if** the RevenueCat offering has an eligible intro offer (C-09); otherwise "Pro'yu Gör". Either opens `paywall?source={feature}`.
- Secondary: "Şimdi değil" suppresses the gate for 7 days, stored in `user_preferences.dismissed_gates`.
- Blurred real content is never shipped; the card shows neutral skeleton bars only.

### 0.7 Offline and cache policy (M§94, ADR-04, plan §9)

**Persistence** (TanStack Query persister over AES-256 MMKV):
- Only queries tagged `meta.persist:true`: `['flow',filter]`, `['mail-intel',date,account]`, `['mail-category',…]`, `['email',id]` (derived fields only), `['thread',id]`, `['waiting']`, `['followups']`, `['commitments',dir]`, `['commitment',id]`, `['life-event',id]`, `['approvals','pending']`, `['approvals','history',f]`, `['approval',id]`, `['reply-draft',id]` (user-reviewed draft text).
- **Never persisted:** `['email-original',id]` (raw body, memory only, `gcTime` 5 min) and `['capture-file',…]`.

**Network state.** `@react-native-community/netinfo` 12.0.1 wired to TanStack `onlineManager`.

**Offline behaviour**
- `OfflineBanner` (ink pill): "Çevrimdışısın. Son analiz {HH:mm}'{suffix} gösteriliyor." with "Yenile". The suffix comes from the `trSuffix` helper (see §0.12).
- Content below renders at opacity .75.
- Queued writes show a small `schedule` glyph on the affected card until acknowledged.
- Blocked writes show toast "Çevrimdışısın · Bu işlem için bağlantı gerekli." with a coral icon and emit `offline_blocked_action{action}`.

**Reconnect**
- Replay queued mutations FIFO.
- Invalidate every persisted key.
- Flash "Güncel · {HH:mm}" for 1.5 s (08 MOTION "Senkron").

### 0.8 Canonical state copy (PRIMARY 08, verbatim; i18n keys under `states.*`)

**Errors**

| Key | Title | Body | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|
| `error.oauthExpired` | "Gmail bağlantısı yenilenmeli." (Outlook: "Outlook bağlantısı yenilenmeli.") | "Google oturumu süresi doldu. Yeniden bağlanana kadar yeni mailler analiz edilmez." (Microsoft: "Microsoft oturumu süresi doldu. …") | "Yeniden Bağlan" · "Sonra" |
| `error.syncDelayed` | "Senkronizasyon gecikti." | "Son başarılı analiz {time}. Yeniden deniyoruz; gösterilenler {n} dakika eski olabilir." | "Şimdi Dene" · "Tamam" |
| `error.permissionDenied` | "Takvim izni verilmedi." | "Toplantı hazırlığı ve çakışma uyarıları takvim erişimi gerektirir. Diğer her şey çalışıyor." | "İzin Ver" · "Neden gerekli?" |
| `error.aiUnavailable` | "Asistan şu an yanıt veremiyor." | "Brifingin ve önceliklerin hazır; yalnızca yeni soru ve taslaklar birkaç dakika bekleyebilir." | "Tekrar Dene" · "Brifinge Dön" |
| `error.aiBudget` (new) | "Bugünkü AI kullanım sınırına ulaştın." | "Sınır yarın yenilenir. Pro ile sınır genişler." | "Pro'yu Gör" · "Kendim yazayım" (reply only) |
| `error.noInternet` (SECONDARY gap-fill) | "İnternet bağlantısı yok." | "Çevrimiçi olduğunda her şey otomatik olarak güncellenir." | "Tekrar Dene" |
| `error.generic` | "Bir sorun oluştu." | "Tekrar denemek ister misin?" | "Tekrar Dene" |

**Empties**

|---|---|---|---|
| `empty.followups` | "Bekleyen takip yok." | "Gönderdiğin her maile yanıt geldi. Yeni bir gecikme olursa buraya düşer." | per screen |
| `empty.approvals` | "Onay bekleyen işlem yok." | "Bir mail göndermek veya takvimi değiştirmek istediğimde önce burada görürsün." | "Geçmişi gör" |
| `empty.noAccount` | "Mailini bağla." | "Gmail veya Outlook bağlayarak önemli konuları burada görebilirsin." | "Hesap Bağla" → `settings/accounts` |

### 0.9 Analytics (ADR-13, M§42)

- Events go to first-party `analytics_events` through `POST /analytics/events` (batched).
- Props are content-free: enums, booleans and small integers only. No IDs, subjects, names or text.
- Every event carries `screen` (Screen ID), `platform` and `is_pro`.
- The full list of new event names for the allow-list is in the last section.

### 0.10 Accessibility (M§92, ADR-03)

**Targets and roles**
- Hit targets are ≥44 pt (iOS) / 48 dp (Android). `hitSlop` applies to 34 h chips and 36 h circles.
- Chips use `accessibilityRole="button"` with `accessibilityState.selected`. Filter chip rows use `tablist`/`tab` semantics.
- Every swipe has an `accessibilityActions` equivalent and a visible "···" button (M§13 / SREQ-82).

**Text**
- Dynamic Type via `allowFontScaling`. `maxFontSizeMultiplier` is 1.4 for body/title and 1.2 for badges and kickers.
- At multipliers above 1.3, card rows wrap: the badge moves under the source.

**Colour and contrast**
- Colour never carries meaning alone; badges always carry text.
- `ink/tertiary #9B978E` is used only for ≥12 px meta. Informational text uses `ink/tertiary-strong` (DESIGN_AUDIT deviation).
- On the right-swipe track (`#2FA062`), the white 11 px label is paired with a 26 px icon, and the action is announced.
- `radio_button_unchecked #C9C5BC` fails 3:1. Unselected states also expose `accessibilityState.checked=false`, and the ring uses the darker token `#969490` (DESIGN_AUDIT).

**Announcements and motion**
- Toasts announce through `AccessibilityInfo.announceForAccessibility`. Undo toasts expose the "Geri al" action.
- Focus: when a sheet opens, focus moves to its title; when it closes, focus returns to the invoking control.
- Reduce Motion: all durations become 0 except a 120 ms opacity transition; the shimmer becomes a static `#EFEDE7` block.

### 0.11 Deep links and notification routing
Scheme `dijitalasistan://`; universal links `https://<web-domain>/app/...`. Every deep link runs:
1. the auth guard (unauthenticated → store the intent → sign-in → resume);
2. the entitlement guard (gate card, never a crash);
3. the missing-entity fallback: "Bu içerik artık yok." with "Akış'a Dön".

| Push `notification_category` | Opens |
|---|---|
| `critical_email` | `mail/{messageId}` |
| `deadline` | source (`mail/{id}` / `event/{id}` / `capture/{id}`) |
| `follow_up` | `followups?focus={insightId}` |
| `life_intel` | `life/{lifeEventId}` |
| `approval` (pending or execution result) | `approvals/{approvalId}` |
| Device-local reminder | `reminders` target (`mail/{id}`, `commitments/{id}`, `life/{id}`, …) via `data.deeplink` |

### 0.12 Resolved inconsistencies applied throughout (design-flow-mail "Open issues")

1. **Demo fixtures.**
   - Ahmet Yılmaz (Kuzey Lojistik) = the urgent "Re: Eylül teklifi – revize" request.
   - Mehmet Yılmaz (Yılmaz Endüstri) = the 14:30 meeting, the follow-up and the contract.
   - Selin Kaya = contract clause 4.
   - Dates are relative to now; weekdays are computed, never hard-coded.
2. **Mail categories are mutually exclusive** (one `mail_category` per message).
   - Every Mail Intelligence number comes from the single RPC-08 `mail_intelligence` call.
   - "dikkat" = `important` + `awaiting_my_reply` + `has_deadline`.
3. **Mail Intelligence routing (the SECONDARY wiring was swapped).**
   - "Senden cevap bekleyen" (`awaiting_my_reply`) → `waiting`.
   - "Senin cevap beklediğin" (`awaiting_their_reply`) → `followups`.
4. **Follow-up wait badge:** neutral under 3 days, amber from 3 days, coral from 7 days, everywhere.
5. **Copy fixes.**
   - "Deadline 17:00" → "Son tarih 17:00".
   - Card action "Yanıtla" → "Yanıt Hazırla" wherever it opens a draft.
   - Waiting bucket "YAKINDA" → "DAHA SONRA" (SREQ-11; the quality gate bans "yakında").
   - Reminder preset "Özel zaman" → "Kendin seç" (V-09, M§29).
6. **Claims removed unless grounded (M§83):**
   - "Okundu, yanıt yok";
   - "Son 30 günde 2 kez izlendi";
   - "2 bilet";
   - "19:10'da çıkman gerekebilir" / "06:45'te evden çıkman gerekebilir" (no routing credential; KNOWN_PLATFORM_LIMITATIONS);
   - "Belge cihazında özetlenir" → replaced by true server-processing copy (M§40);
   - "yanıtını aldı" → "Yanıtın gönderildi.".
7. **Turkish suffixes on dynamic values** ("09:40'tan", "77'sini", "Ahmet'e", "Ayşe'ye") come from `packages/i18n/tr-suffix.ts`. It exports `trSuffix(word, case)` (vowel harmony + buffer consonants) and `trNumberSuffix(n, case)` (spoken final number word), with unit tests. Strings are never concatenated by hand.

## 1. Flow

### M-FLOW-01 · Akış (Flow tab)

- **Screen ID** — M-FLOW-01
- **Route** — `app/(tabs)/flow/index.tsx`. Search param `filter ∈ all|important|mail|calendar|followup|personal` (default: last filter stored in MMKV `flow.lastFilter`, else `all`).
- **Entry points**
  - Tab "Akış".
  - Today "Tümü" links: life section → `filter=personal`; priorities → `all`.
  - Empty-state CTA "Akışa göz at" on Today.
  - Deep link `dijitalasistan://flow?filter=`.
  - Widget rows (Part 1).
  - Android "Kişisel" push fallback when the life event is gone.
- **Primary purpose** — A smart attention feed over all sources, not an inbox clone (M§13). One card template (source · badge · title · AI summary · action), sorted urgency → time.
- **Data dependencies**
  - RPC-05 `flow_feed(p_filter, p_cursor, p_limit)` (`security invoker`) over `insights` where `flow_card_type is not null`, `status='open'` (snoozed rows reappear when the scheduler reopens them at `snoozed_until`), and the retention `expires_at` has not passed.
  - Row fields used: `id, kind (insight_kind), card_type (= insights.flow_card_type), urgency, is_important, title, summary (= insights.body), badge_code, source_type, source_id, source_provider, source_timestamp, confidence, decision_tier, reason_code, rule_id, primary_action {type, label_key, target} (= insights.actions[0]), entity_type + entity_id, display_at, sort_bucket, sort_at`.
  - Response `meta` of the same call: `{total, important, last_analysis_at, accounts:[{id, provider, status, last_success_at}]}` (header counts; there is no separate meta RPC).
  - RPC-08 `mail_intelligence(p_local_date: today, p_category: null, …)` for the digest row.
  - `me/bootstrap` for entitlements and the pending-approvals count.
  - **Filter mapping (canonical; applied server-side by RPC-05 `p_filter`; `card_type` = `insights.flow_card_type`):**

    | Filter | Rows |
    |---|---|
    | Tümü | all |
    | Önemli | `is_important` |
    | Mail | `card_type in (email, deadline)` and `source_type in (email_message, email_thread)` |
    | Takvim | `card_type = meeting`, or `card_type = deadline` with `source_type in (calendar_event, capture)` |
    | Takip | `card_type in (follow_up, commitment)` |
    | Kişisel | `card_type in (shipment, flight, reservation, payment, subscription, security)` |

  - **Sort** (`sort_bucket` asc, then `sort_at`): urgent → today by earliest due/start first; normal → low by newest first.
- **API dependencies**
  - Feed: RPC-05 `rpc('flow_feed', {p_filter, p_cursor, p_limit:30})`; opaque keyset cursor over `(sort_bucket, sort_at, id)`; header counts from the response `meta`.
  - RPC-08 `mail_intelligence`; RPC-01 `set_insight_status(p_insight_id, p_status, p_snoozed_until, p_reason)`; RPC-06 `set_commitment_status`; `apply_insight_feedback` / `revert_insight_feedback` (feedback and its undo). Learned preferences are derived server-side and never written by the client.
  - Pull-to-refresh: `POST /integrations/:accountId/sync` for each `healthy|partial` account (server rate limit 1/60 s per account; 429 is treated as success-without-new-sync).
  - `POST /approvals` (`calendar_create` from "Takvime Ekle").
  - `POST /followups/:threadId/draft`.
  - `POST /plan/proposals` (commitment "Planla").
  - `POST /analytics/events`.
- **State dependencies**
  - TanStack keys `['flow',filter]` (persist, staleTime 60 s, refetch on focus and every 5 min while focused) (the header counts come from the same response's `meta`).
  - Zustand: `useFlowFilterStore` (MMKV-persisted per viewer), `useSheetStore`, `useToastStore`, `useNetworkStore`.
  - Optimistic cache updates for swipe/status mutations, with rollback on error.
  - "Yeni {n} konu ↑" pill when a refetch returns rows newer than the first visible `display_at`.
- **Source design reference**
  - PRIMARY 04/4.1 "Akış · Tümü" (light) and 4.2 "Akış · Kişisel filtresi · Dark".
  - Hub `isAkis` (FEED, FILTERS); 08 "KAYDIRMA AKSİYONLARI", MOTION rows 4/7/8, BOŞ/HATA DURUMLARI.
  - SECONDARY `FlowScreen.tsx`: avatar and "Mail Özeti" entry adopted; its dead buttons and "Takip = deadline" bug rejected.
  - **Layout, top → bottom:**
    1. Header row: "Akış" 28/34; right group = "Ekle" pill (`add_a_photo`) + 32 px avatar (Profile, M§8).
    2. `FilterChipRow` (Tümü · Önemli · Mail · Takvim · Takip · Kişisel).
    3. `MetaLine` "{n} konu · {m} önemli · Son analiz {HH:mm}".
    4. When filter ∈ {all, mail}: digest row (`GroupedList` single row) with kicker "MAİL ZEKÂSI", label "Bugün {total} mail · {attention} dikkat gerektiriyor" and chevron.
    5. `AttentionCard` list (gap 12, padding 0 20 16). Each card has a trailing "···" 44 pt button in row 1.
- **Primary CTA** — The per-card primary action: a text button, 14/600 `#4547C9`. Mapping (table below):

  | card_type | Icon | Badge (tone) | Source line | Primary action → behaviour | Card tap | Swipe-right "Tamamlandı" semantics |
  |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
  | email | `mail` | ACİL (critical) if `urgent`; BUGÜN (neutral) if `today`; none otherwise | "Gmail · {sender}" / "Outlook · {sender}" | `awaiting_my_reply` → "Yanıt Hazırla" → `mail/[id]/reply`; deadline-only → "Takvime Ekle" → `POST /approvals` → M-APPR-04; else "Aç" → `mail/[id]` | `mail/[id]` | insight `done` (reason `no_reply_needed`); the provider mailbox is untouched |
  | meeting | `event` | BUGÜN if today else TOPLANTI (neutral) | "Google Takvim" / "Outlook Takvim" / "Apple Takvim" / "Cihaz Takvimi" | Pro "Hazırlan" → `meeting/[eventId]/prep`; Free "Etkinliği Aç" → `event/[id]` | same as action | insight `done` (event untouched) |
  | deadline | source icon (`mail`/`event`/`description`) | SON TARİH (warning) | source label | "Takvime Ekle" (if no calendar event already linked) else "Hatırlat" → `reminders/new?anchorAt=` | source detail | insight `done` (acknowledged) |
  | follow_up | `schedule_send` | TAKİP (neutral) | "Gmail · {person}" | "Takip Mesajı Hazırla" → `POST /followups/:threadId/draft` → reply modal (`mode=follow_up`) | `followups?focus={id}` | insight `done` (reason `closed`) |
  | commitment | `handshake` | TAAHHÜT (neutral) | "Taahhüt · {Mail\|Toplantı notu\|Belge}" | "Planla" → `POST /plan/proposals {commitment_id}` → `plan/proposal/[id]` | `commitments/[id]` | commitment `done` + insight `done` |
  | shipment | `package_2` | KARGO | "Kargo · {merchant}" | "Takibi Gör" if a grounded, allowlisted `tracking_url` exists (`expo-web-browser`); else "İncele" → `life/[id]` | `life/[id]` | life event + insight `done` |
  | flight | `flight` | UÇUŞ | "{airline}" | "Check-in" if grounded `checkin_url` and check-in-open is stated in the source; else "İncele" | `life/[id]` | `done` |
  | reservation | `restaurant` (`hotel` for lodging) | REZERVASYON | "Rezervasyon · {venue}" | "Teyit Et" if grounded `confirm_url` (web browser) or phone (`tel:`); else "İncele" | `life/[id]` | `done` |
  | payment | `receipt_long` | ÖDEME | "{payee}" | "Hatırlat" → `reminders/new` anchored to the grounded due date | `life/[id]` | `done` = "Ödendi" |
  | subscription | `autorenew` | ABONELİK | "{service}" | "İncele" → `life/[id]` | `life/[id]` | `done` |
  | security | `shield` | GÜVENLİK (critical) | "{provider}" | "Kontrol Et" → `life/[id]` (source-only actions) | `life/[id]` | `done` = "Bendim" |

- **Secondary actions**
  - "Ekle" → `capture` modal. Free users see the Capture Pro gate inside the modal.
  - Avatar → `settings/index`.
  - Filter chip → updates `filter`, the URL param and MMKV; scrolls to top; emits `flow_filter_select`.
  - Digest row → `mail/index`.
  - Card body → the tap target above. `SourceLine` → M-SRC-01. Long-press or "···" → action sheet with "Tamamlandı" / "Ertele" / "Önemli değil" / "Bu nereden çıktı?" / "Düzelt…" (M-CORR-01).
  - **Swipe right** "Tamamlandı" (full swipe ≥60% auto-applies; 35% reveals):
    - optimistic removal, success haptic;
    - `UndoToast` "Tamamlandı · Geri al" (5 s); undo restores the previous status through the same RPC.
  - **Swipe left** (reveal only, no auto-apply):
    - "Ertele" → `reminders/new?mode=snooze&targetType=insight&targetId=`.
    - "Önemli değil" → `apply_insight_feedback(p_insight_id, p_kind:'not_important', p_client_mutation_id)`: the server sets `dismissed`, writes `ai_feedback{rating:-1, reason_code:'not_important'}` and, only if learning is on, derives the learned preference (`private.upsert_learned_preference`). Toast "Öğrendim · Bu tür konuları daha aşağıda göstereceğim." / "Geri al" (`revert_insight_feedback(p_feedback_id)`).
    - Security cards: "Önemli değil" calls only `set_insight_status(dismissed)`, never `apply_insight_feedback`, so it **never** writes a learning signal. Security alerts are never down-ranked by learning.
  - **Pull-to-refresh:**
    - a 2 px indigo line at the top plus `RefreshControl tintColor #5B5CE2`;
    - triggers the sync calls, refetches, then shows "Güncel · {HH:mm}" for 1.5 s.
  - Infinite scroll: next page at 70% scroll.
- **Loading**
  - Header, chips and meta skeleton render instantly.
  - Three `Skeleton` cards at real `AttentionCard` dimensions (tile 28, 30%×12, 92%×16, 60%×14), shimmer 1.6 s, filled with a 60 ms stagger.
  - Card-level AI missing: title = subject/entity title, summary "Özet hazırlanamadı", `SourceLine` still shown.
- **Empty** (per filter; M§93):
  - no mail or calendar connected: `empty.noAccount`;
  - Tümü: "Her şey kontrol altında." / "Şu an dikkat gerektiren bir konu yok. Yeni bir gelişme olursa burada görürsün." / "Mail Zekâsı'nı Aç";
  - Önemli: "Önemli bir konu yok." / "Önemli işaretlenen her şey burada toplanır." / "Öncelik Kuralları" → `settings/priority-rules`;
  - Mail: "Dikkat gerektiren mail yok." / "Bugün {analyzed} maili senin için okudum." / "Mail Zekâsı'nı Aç";
  - Takvim: calendar not connected → "Takvim bağlı değil." / "Toplantıların ve son tarihlerin burada görünsün diye takvimini bağla." / "Takvimi Bağla" → `settings/accounts`; connected → "Bugün takvimin oldukça sakin." / "Yaklaşan toplantı veya son tarih yok." / "Plan'ı Aç" → Plan tab;
  - Takip: `empty.followups`; CTA "Taahhütlerini gör" → `commitments`;
  - Kişisel: "Kişisel sinyal yok." / iOS "Kargo, uçuş, rezervasyon, ödeme, abonelik ve güvenlik bilgilerini mail ve belgelerinden çıkarırım." (Android with Notification Intelligence on: "…mail, belge ve bildirimlerinden çıkarırım."); no CTA.
- **Error**
  - Feed query error: `error.generic` with "Tekrar Dene", keeping the cached list.
  - Account `needs_reauth`: `ErrorCard` `error.oauthExpired` pinned above the list, one per failing account ("Sonra" hides it until the next session).
  - `last_success_at` older than 15 min: `error.syncDelayed`.
  - AI provider circuit open (`GET /me/bootstrap` `service_status.unavailable_features` lists an AI feature, or a call returns `AI_UNAVAILABLE`): `error.aiUnavailable`, while cards still render from deterministic fields.
  - Partial data (one account failing): the healthy account's cards render; the error card names the failing provider.
  - Action failure: toast "İşlem tamamlanamadı · Tekrar dene" and optimistic rollback.
- **Offline**
  - Cached feed, `OfflineBanner`, filters work on cached data.
  - Swipe done / dismiss / snooze without the smart preset are **queued**.
  - "Takvime Ekle", "Takip Mesajı Hazırla", "Planla", "Hazırlan" (needs network) and "Ekle" analysis are **blocked** with a toast.
  - External handoffs ("Takibi Gör", "Check-in", "Teyit Et") are allowed: the browser handles connectivity.
- **Permission edge case**
  - No notification permission: no effect here.
  - Pro: the Takip filter for Free shows `ProGateCard`: "TAKİP · PRO" / "{n} gönderdiğin mail yanıtsız." (deterministic count of `awaiting_their_reply` threads older than 2 days) / "Takip ve taahhütler Pro'da. Sabah brifingin her zaman ücretsiz." Commitment cards are never produced for Free.
  - Meeting action for Free: see the table.
  - Data Source Controls: an account whose "Mailleri oku" is off contributes no cards, and the meta line appends "· {n} hesap duraklatıldı".
- **Approval requirement**
  - "Takvime Ekle" creates a `calendar_create` approval → M-APPR-04.
  - "Planla" → the Plan proposal flow (approval there).
  - Swipe and status actions are internal and need no approval.
- **Analytics events** — `flow_view{filter}`, `flow_filter_select{filter}`, `flow_card_open{card_type}`, `flow_card_action{card_type, action}`, `flow_swipe{direction, action, card_type}`, `insight_status_change{from, to, via:swipe|button|a11y}`, `insight_feedback{kind}`, `flow_refresh{result}`, `pro_gate_viewed{feature:'followups'}`, `offline_blocked_action{action}`.
- **Accessibility notes**
  - Card `accessibilityLabel` = "{badge}, {source}, {time}. {title}. {summary}"; `accessibilityHint` = "Ayrıntılar için iki kez dokun".
  - `accessibilityActions`: `activate`, `primary` (label = action label), `complete` "Tamamlandı", `snooze` "Ertele", `dismiss` "Önemli değil", `why` "Bu nereden çıktı?".
  - Chip row is `tablist`; the digest row is a `button`.
  - The "Yeni {n} konu" pill announces politely.
- **Deep links** — `dijitalasistan://flow`, `dijitalasistan://flow?filter=important|mail|calendar|followup|personal`.
- **Tests**
  - RNTL `apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/flow/__tests__/flow.test.tsx`: each filter predicate against a fixture; per-filter empty states; meta counts; card action routing table (all 11 card types); undo restores status; the security "Önemli değil" path calls only `set_insight_status` (never `apply_insight_feedback`); offline queue vs block; Free Takip gate.
  - Vitest `packages/domain/flow/sort.test.ts`: bucket/sort order, is_important derivation.
  - pgTAP `supabase/tests/flow_feed.test.sql`: RLS isolation of RPC-05 `flow_feed` rows and `meta`, snoozed exclusion, the six filter predicates.
  - Maestro `apps/mobile/e2e/flow-filters-swipe.yaml` (demo mode): filter switching, swipe right plus undo, swipe left "Önemli değil", a11y action "Ertele" opens the reminder sheet.

## 2. Mail Intelligence

### M-MAIL-01 · Mail Zekâsı

- **Screen ID** — M-MAIL-01
- **Route** — `app/mail/index.tsx`; params `date` (local ISO date, default today in `user_preferences.timezone`) and `account` (connected_account id or `all`).
- **Entry points**
  - Flow digest row.
  - Today "Mail" link (Part 1).
  - Morning briefing "Senden Beklenenler / Senin Beklediklerin" section headers (Part 1).
  - Flow empty-state CTAs.
  - Deep link.
- **Primary purpose** — Mail understanding instead of an inbox: the "83 → 6" story, six fixed categories (M§14), AI summary first, and separable classification signals (source, confidence, reason, deterministic rules).
- **Data dependencies**
  - RPC-08 `mail_intelligence(p_local_date, p_category: null, p_cursor: null, p_limit: 5, p_account_id)` returns:
    - `total_received`, `analyzed`, `pending_analysis`;
    - `by_category {important, awaiting_my_reply, awaiting_their_reply, has_deadline, informational, low_priority}`;
    - `attention = important + awaiting_my_reply + has_deadline`;
    - `top_important[≤5]`: `id, sender_name, sender_initials, avatar_palette, received_at, ai_one_liner, badge_code, deadline_at, primary_action`.
  - `connected_accounts` (provider, status, label).
  - Entitlements.
- **API dependencies**
  - RPC-08 `mail_intelligence`; `connected_accounts?select=id,provider,status,account_label,capabilities_granted`.
  - `POST /integrations/:accountId/sync` (pull-to-refresh).
  - `POST /approvals` ("Takvime Ekle" on a card).
- **State dependencies** — `['mail-intel',date,account]` (persist, stale 60 s); `['accounts']`.
- **Source design reference**
  - PRIMARY 04/4.3 "Mail Zekâsı · Gelen kutusu yerine anlama".
  - SECONDARY `MailIntelligence.tsx`: the category drill-down idea is adopted as M-MAIL-02; its inverted wiring and hard-coded counts are rejected.
  - **Layout:**
    1. `NavHeader`: back · kicker "MAİL ZEKÂSI · BUGÜN" · search circle.
    2. When >1 account: account `FilterChipRow` ("Tüm hesaplar" · "{label}" …).
    3. `HeroStat`: "{total}" + "mail geldi"; headline "**{attention}** tanesi dikkat gerektiriyor."; sub "{analyzed}'{suffix} senin için okudum; {low}'{suffix} düşük öncelikli, {info}'{suffix} bilgilendirme." (suffixes via `trNumberSuffix`).
    4. `StackedBar` with three segments (attention `#5B5CE2` / informational + awaiting_their_reply `#C9C7F3` / low `#E9E7E1`), plus a 4th hatched neutral segment while `pending_analysis > 0`.
    5. Category `GroupedList` with 6 rows (icon, label, count, chevron). Rows in the attention set use hot styling (`#EDEDFC` tile, count `#5B5CE2`). Zero counts still show and still open.
    6. Kicker "ÖNEMLİ · {n}" + `MailSummaryCard`s for `important` only.
- **Primary CTA** — Category row → routing:

  | Row label (TR) | `mail_category` | Destination |
  |---|---|---|
  | Önemli (`priority_high`) | important | `mail/category/important` |
  | Senden cevap bekleyen (`person`) | awaiting_my_reply | `waiting` |
  | Senin cevap beklediğin (`schedule_send`) | awaiting_their_reply | `followups` |
  | Son tarih içeren (`flag`) | has_deadline | `mail/category/has_deadline` |
  | Bilgilendirme (`info`) | informational | `mail/category/informational` |
  | Düşük öncelik (`low_priority`) | low_priority | `mail/category/low_priority` |

- **Secondary actions**
  - Back.
  - Search → `search?types=email`.
  - Account chip → re-query.
  - `MailSummaryCard` tap → `mail/[id]`.
  - Card action: "Yanıt Hazırla" → `mail/[id]/reply`; "Takvime Ekle" → `POST /approvals` → M-APPR-04; "Aç" → detail.
  - Card "···" → M-CORR-01 (priority mode).
  - Pull-to-refresh as in Flow.
  - The bar is not interactive (`accessible=false`, summarised in the hero label).
- **Loading** — Hero digits and bar skeleton; 6 category rows with count skeletons; 2 card skeletons. While `pending_analysis > 0`: chip "{analyzed}/{total} analiz edildi" next to the kicker, with the 4th bar segment.
- **Empty** — `total_received = 0`: hero "0 mail geldi" + headline "Bugün henüz mail yok." + sub "Yeni mail geldiğinde önemli olanları burada ayırırım."; categories show 0; the Önemli section is hidden. No account connected: `empty.noAccount`.
- **Error** — Digest error: `error.generic`, keeping the cached digest. Account `needs_reauth`: `error.oauthExpired` card above the hero. Delayed sync: `error.syncDelayed`.
- **Offline** — Cached digest with banner; pull-to-refresh disabled (toast); card actions that need the network are blocked.
- **Permission edge case**
  - Free: the "Senin cevap beklediğin" row stays visible with its count; tapping it opens `followups` (Pro gate).
  - Free: the account chip row only ever shows 1 account (Free allows 1 mail account).
  - Data Source Control "Mailleri oku" off for an account: that account's chip shows "Duraklatıldı" and its numbers are excluded.
- **Approval requirement** — "Takvime Ekle" → `calendar_create` approval. Nothing else.
- **Analytics events** — `mail_intel_view{accounts_count, has_pending_analysis}`, `mail_category_open{category}`, `mail_card_action{action}`.
- **Accessibility notes**
  - Hero label: "Bugün {total} mail geldi, {attention} tanesi dikkat gerektiriyor."
  - Category rows: `button` with label "{label}, {count} mail".
  - The bar is hidden from the reader.
  - Numbers use `tr-TR` formatting.
- **Deep links** — `dijitalasistan://mail`, `dijitalasistan://mail?account={id}`.
- **Tests**
  - pgTAP `mail_intelligence.test.sql`: counts sum to `total_received`, user timezone day boundary (Europe/Istanbul, DST-free, plus a synthetic DST tz), RLS.
  - Vitest `trNumberSuffix` (1..1,000,000 sample table).
  - RNTL: row routing (asserts that `awaiting_my_reply` → `waiting` and `awaiting_their_reply` → `followups`); zero-count rows open; partial-analysis chip.
  - Maestro `mail-intel-routing.yaml`.

### M-MAIL-02 · Mail kategorisi listesi (category drill-down)

- **Screen ID** — M-MAIL-02
- **Route** — `app/mail/category/[category].tsx` (accepted registry route); `category ∈ important|has_deadline|informational|low_priority`; params `date`, `account`.
- **Entry points** — M-MAIL-01 category rows; deep link.
- **Primary purpose** — List every mail of one category for the day (and earlier days, paginated) as AI one-liners, never raw bodies.
- **Data dependencies**
  - RPC-08 row fields over `email_messages`: `id, connected_account_id, from_name, from_email, received_at, subject, classification, classification_tier, classification_reason, classification_confidence, ai_status, is_read`, plus the proposed `badge_code`, `ai_one_liner` (first sentence of `ai_summary`) and `deadline_at`.
  - Ordered by `received_at desc`.
  - Grouped into day sections "Bugün" / "Dün" / "{d MMMM}".
- **API dependencies**
  - RPC-08 `mail_intelligence(p_local_date, p_category:{c}, p_cursor, p_limit:30, p_account_id)`; opaque cursor over `received_at desc`.
  - PostgREST `ai_feedback` insert `{target_type:'email_thread', target_id, rating, reason_code}` (corrections; the learned preference is derived server-side, never written by the client).
  - `POST /approvals` ("Takvime Ekle").
- **State dependencies** — `['mail-category',category,account]` (persist, infinite query).
- **Source design reference** — PRIMARY 04/4.3 `MailSummaryCard` pattern (no primary artboard exists; built from primary components per M§4). SECONDARY `MailIntelligence.tsx` "ÖNE ÇIKANLAR" list IA.
  - **Layout:** `NavHeader` (back · kicker "{KATEGORİ}") · H1 category label · sub "{n} mail · son 7 gün" · day `SectionKicker`s · `MailSummaryCard`s (avatar 28, sender, badge, time, one-liner, action).
- **Primary CTA** — Card tap → `mail/[id]`.
- **Secondary actions**
  - Card action by category: important → "Yanıt Hazırla" if a reply is expected, else none; has_deadline → "Takvime Ekle"; informational and low_priority → none.
  - "···" → M-CORR-01, which on `low_priority` / `informational` rows includes "Bu önemliydi" (`show_more`) so misclassifications can be corrected (M§3.9).
- **Loading** — 5 `MailSummaryCard` skeletons.
- **Empty** — Copy per category:
  - important: "Önemli mail yok.";
  - has_deadline: "Son tarih içeren mail yok.";
  - informational: "Bilgilendirme maili yok.";
  - low_priority: "Düşük öncelikli mail yok.";
  - sub: "Yeni mail geldiğinde burada ayırırım."
- **Error** — `error.generic` + retry; `error.oauthExpired` when the account needs reauth.
- **Offline** — Cached pages plus banner; pagination beyond the cache shows "Çevrimdışı · daha fazlası için bağlantı gerekli".
- **Permission edge case** — Paused accounts are excluded, with a footer note "{hesap} duraklatıldı".
- **Approval requirement** — "Takvime Ekle" only.
- **Analytics events** — `mail_category_list_view{category}`, `mail_card_open{category}`, `insight_feedback{kind}`.
- **Accessibility notes** — Section headers are `header` role. Card label: "{sender}, {badge?}, {time}. {one-liner}".
- **Deep links** — `dijitalasistan://mail/category/{category}`.
- **Tests** — RNTL grouping by local day; low-priority correction path writes `ai_feedback{rating:1, reason_code:'show_more'}`. pgTAP RLS on `email_messages` column list (no body columns exist).

## 3. Email Detail

### M-MAIL-03 · Mail Detayı

- **Screen ID** — M-MAIL-03
- **Route** — `app/mail/[id].tsx` (`id` = `email_messages.id`); optional `highlight` (evidence id to scroll to and highlight, used by "Kaynağı Gör").
- **Entry points**
  - Flow email/deadline cards.
  - M-MAIL-01/02 cards.
  - Waiting and Follow-up card taps.
  - Commitment "Kaynağı Gör".
  - M-SRC-01 "Uygulamada aç".
  - Search results, Person page, Meeting prep "Son mailler", Assistant source cards (other parts).
  - Push `critical_email` / `deadline`.
- **Primary purpose** — AI summary first, per M§15: Sender, Subject, Date, AI Summary, Key Points, Source, Original Mail. Actions: Yanıt Hazırla, Görev Oluştur, Takvime Ekle, Hatırlat, Orijinal Maili Aç. Each action is wired to a real provider or domain flow.
- **Data dependencies**
  - `email_messages` columns (DB §4.3): `from_name, from_email, to_emails, cc_emails, received_at, subject, provider, connected_account_id, thread_id, web_link, ai_summary, key_points jsonb[{text, kind: deadline|amount|ask|attachment|other, evidence_ref}], classification (mail_category), classification_tier, classification_reason, classification_rule_id, classification_confidence, has_attachments, attachment_meta jsonb[{name, mime, size}]`; accepted `ai_status (pending_t0|t0_final|skipped_source_control|skipped_budget|skipped_flag|queued_realtime|queued_batch|classified|failed)` and `injection_suspected`; proposed `deadline_at`, `badge_code`, `evidence jsonb`. `email_threads.provider_thread_id` serves the provider handoff. "Sana / Sana ve {n} kişiye" is derived client-side from `to_emails`/`cc_emails` and the connected aliases.
  - Thread siblings: `email_messages?thread_id=eq.{t}&select=id,from_name,received_at,ai_one_liner,subject`.
  - `contacts` (`id`, `vip` via `vip_people`).
  - Linked `insights` (status), existing `reply_drafts` (status `draft`) and pending `approval_actions` for this source (to show "Onay bekliyor" instead of creating duplicates).
  - `connected_accounts` (status, capabilities_granted).
- **API dependencies**
  - PostgREST reads as above.
  - `GET /mail/:messageId/original` (on demand; sanitized text; not stored or logged).
  - `POST /mail/:messageId/reply-drafts`.
  - `POST /approvals` (`task_create`, `calendar_create`).
  - `set_insight_status`; `vip_people` insert; `apply_insight_feedback` / `revert_insight_feedback` (through M-CORR-01).
- **State dependencies**
  - `['email',id]` (persist; derived fields only), `['thread',threadId]`, `['email-original',id]` (memory only).
  - `useSheetStore` (reminder sheet via route, approval sheet, explain sheet).
  - Accordion open state is local.
- **Source design reference**
  - PRIMARY 04/4.4 "Mail Detayı · AI özeti önce"; hub `isMail`; 08 MOTION row 10 (accordion 280 ms, chevron 200 ms).
  - SECONDARY `EmailDetail.tsx`: "Orijinal Maili Aç" handoff and the task sheet IA adopted; fake successes rejected.
  - **Layout:**
    1. `NavHeader`: back · right group [`StatusBadge` (ACİL/SON TARİH) tappable → M-SRC-01, `more_horiz` → M-MAIL-04].
    2. `SenderHeader`: avatar 44, name + VIP star, meta "{Bugün 08:42} · {Gmail} · {Sana|Sana ve {n} kişiye}".
    3. Subject 22/28.
    4. `AICard`: "AI ÖZETİ", summary 17/24, "ÖNEMLİ NOKTALAR" bullets.
    5. "ÖNERİLEN AKSİYONLAR" `ActionTileGrid` 2×2: "Yanıt Hazırla" primary · "Görev Oluştur" · "Takvime Ekle" · "Hatırlat".
    6. When `has_attachments`: "EKLER" list (filename, size; tap → M-MAIL-04 "Eki Ekle'ye gönder" when Pro, or provider handoff).
    7. "Konu dizisi · {n} mail" `Accordion`: sibling rows with sender, time and AI one-liner, or the subject when not analyzed. Never raw snippets.
    8. "Orijinal Mail" `Accordion`, collapsed by default.
    9. `SourceLine` `verified`: "Kaynak: {Gmail} · {masked from} · {Gelen Kutusu} · Konu dizisi {n} mail" → M-SRC-01.
- **Primary CTA** — "Yanıt Hazırla" → `mail/[id]/reply?tone={default_reply_tone}`. If a draft with `status='draft'` exists, the tile label becomes "Taslağa Devam Et" and opens with `draftId`.
- **Secondary actions**
  - **"Görev Oluştur"** → `POST /approvals {action_type:'task_create', source:{type:'email_message', id}, payload:{}}`.
    - The server proposes: title (AI, grounded in the ask), `due` from `deadline_at` (date-only when the destination is Google Tasks), destination = `user_preferences.default_task_destination` (else `in_app`), and notes containing the in-app deep link.
    - Result opens M-APPR-04; "Düzenle" opens M-APPR-05 (task editor with destination picker).
  - **"Takvime Ekle"**:
    - with a grounded `deadline_at` or event datetime → `POST /approvals {calendar_create, source, payload:{}}`. The server proposes title, start = the grounded time, 30 min duration (deadline: a 30 min block ending at the deadline; event: stated duration or 60 min), the default writable calendar and a 30 min reminder. Result → M-APPR-04.
    - without a grounded time → M-APPR-05 calendar editor in "new proposal" mode (title prefilled, date required) → "Devam" → `POST /approvals` → M-APPR-04.
    - If a pending approval already exists for the same source and type, the server returns it (dedupe) and the sheet opens on it.
  - **"Hatırlat"** → `reminders/new?targetType=email_message&targetId={id}&anchorAt={deadline_at?}&title={subject}`.
  - "Orijinal Mail" accordion expand:
    - calls `GET /mail/:messageId/original`;
    - renders sanitized plain text (default) with no remote images;
    - links are shown underlined; tapping one opens M-MAIL-05;
    - "Metni seç" long-press copy is allowed.
  - `SourceLine` / badge → M-SRC-01.
  - `more_horiz` → M-MAIL-04.
  - Sender row → `person/[contactId]`.
  - Thread row → `mail/[siblingId]`.
- **Loading**
  - The header renders from cache first; the `AICard` shimmers until it is ready.
  - While `ai_status` is `pending_t0`, `queued_realtime` or `queued_batch`: the card shows "Analiz ediliyor…" with a spinner kicker, and actions stay enabled (they do not depend on the summary except "Takvime Ekle" pre-fill).
  - Original accordion: an inline spinner row "Orijinal mail getiriliyor…".
- **Empty**
  - No key points: the section is hidden.
  - `ai_status='t0_final'` with `classification_tier='explicit_rule'` (e.g. a muted sender): the `AICard` is replaced by `HintRow` "Bu mail {kural} kuralın nedeniyle analiz edilmedi." with "Analiz et" → `POST /integrations/:accountId/sync {message_ids:[id], force_analysis:true}` (body extension, see the proposal list).
  - `ai_status='skipped_budget'`: `HintRow` "Bugünkü AI kullanım sınırına ulaşıldığı için bu mail özetlenmedi."; Free users also get "Pro'yu Gör" → `paywall?source=ai_budget`. "Analiz et" returns when the budget resets.
  - `ai_status='skipped_source_control'`: `HintRow` "Bu hesap için AI analizi kapalı." with "Ayarlar" → `settings/privacy/data-sources`.
  - `ai_status='skipped_flag'`: `error.aiUnavailable` inline; the stored fields still render.
- **Error**
  - `ai_status='failed'`: `AICard` "Özet şu an hazırlanamadı." + "Tekrar dene" (same force-analysis call), and the original accordion auto-expands.
  - `injection_suspected=true` (prompt-injection guard fired, M§114): `HintRow` "Bu mail yapay zekâya yönelik talimatlar içeriyor; güvenliğin için özet ve öneriler sınırlandırıldı." Tiles "Takvime Ekle" and "Görev Oluştur" stay available but are not pre-filled.
  - Original fetch failures:

    | Status | Copy | Action |
    |---|---|---|
    | 410 `SOURCE_GONE` | "Bu mail {sağlayıcı}'da artık bulunamıyor (silinmiş veya taşınmış olabilir)." | — |
    | 424 `PROVIDER_REAUTH_REQUIRED` | `error.oauthExpired` | "Yeniden Bağlan" |
    | 5xx | "Orijinal mail alınamadı." | "Tekrar dene" |

  - Entity not found locally: "Bu içerik artık yok." with "Akış'a Dön".
- **Offline**
  - Cached derived fields render.
  - The original accordion is disabled: "Orijinal mail için bağlantı gerekli."
  - All four action tiles are blocked (toast) except "Hatırlat" with non-smart presets (queued).
  - The provider handoff in M-MAIL-04 still opens (browser/app).
- **Permission edge case**
  - Data Source Control "Mailleri oku" off: the screen still shows stored derived fields; "Orijinal Mail" returns 403 `DATA_SOURCE_DISABLED` → "Bu hesap için mail okuma kapalı. Ayarlar'dan açabilirsin." + "Ayarlar" → `settings/privacy/data-sources`.
  - "Ekleri analiz et" off: the EKLER list is shown, but sending an attachment to capture is hidden.
  - Pro: VIP star action (in M-MAIL-04) and attachment → Capture are gated.
- **Approval requirement** — "Görev Oluştur" (`task_create`) and "Takvime Ekle" (`calendar_create`) create approvals. "Yanıt Hazırla" leads to `email_send` approval in M-REPLY-01. "Hatırlat" uses the confirm step inside M-REM-01 (in-app) or an approval (external destination).
- **Analytics events** — `email_detail_view{category, ai_status, has_draft}`, `email_action{action: reply|task|calendar|remind}`, `email_original_expand{result}`, `email_thread_open`, `source_sheet_open{origin:'email_detail'}`.
- **Accessibility notes**
  - `SenderHeader` reads "{name}, VIP, {meta}".
  - The AI card is a `summary` region ("AI özeti: …").
  - Action tiles are buttons with their labels.
  - Accordions expose `accessibilityState.expanded`.
  - Links in the original text are `link` role and announce "dış bağlantı".
  - The badge is a button with label "{ACİL}, neden önemli olduğunu göster".
- **Deep links** — `dijitalasistan://mail/{id}`, `dijitalasistan://mail/{id}?highlight={evidenceRef}`.
- **Tests**
  - RNTL: each tile triggers the right API / route; approval dedupe opens the existing sheet; rule-skipped (`t0_final` + `explicit_rule`) / `skipped_budget` / `skipped_source_control` / `failed` / `injection_suspected` states; the original accordion never writes to the MMKV persister (the persister's `shouldDehydrateQuery` rejects the `email-original` key).
  - Deno `supabase/functions/api/tests/mail_original_test.ts`: sanitizer strips scripts, remote images and tracking pixels; the response is never logged (log spy); RLS ownership check; 404 mapping.
  - Maestro `email-detail-actions.yaml`.

### M-MAIL-04 · Mail işlemleri (overflow sheet)

- **Screen ID** — M-MAIL-04
- **Route** — Global `SheetHost` (`MailActionsSheet`), no URL.
- **Entry points** — M-MAIL-03 `more_horiz`; long-press on a M-MAIL-02 card.
- **Primary purpose** — Secondary mail actions, including M§15 "Orijinal Maili Aç" as a real provider handoff (SREQ-15).
- **Data dependencies** — The message's `provider`, `web_link` (Graph `webLink`), `provider_thread_id`, account email, sender contact id, VIP state, `is_important`.
- **API dependencies**
  - `vip_people` insert/delete (PostgREST).
  - `set_insight_status` / `ai_feedback` (through M-CORR-01).
  - Handoff URLs:
    - Outlook: `web_link`.
    - Gmail: `https://mail.google.com/mail/?authuser={accountEmail}#all/{providerThreadId}` (unofficial pattern; if it cannot open, fall back to `https://mail.google.com/mail/?authuser={accountEmail}`), opened with `Linking.openURL` so the Gmail/Outlook app or browser handles it.
- **State dependencies** — `useSheetStore`.
- **Source design reference** — PRIMARY 04/4.4 `more_horiz` (contents undefined in the design; defined here per the audit proposal). SECONDARY `EmailDetail.tsx` "Orijinal Maili Aç" sheet IA (its fake close-only button is rejected). Standard `Sheet` + `OptionRow`s.
- **Primary CTA** — "{Gmail'de|Outlook'ta} Aç" (`open_in_new`).
- **Secondary actions**
  - "Bu nereden çıktı?" → M-SRC-01.
  - "Önemli değil" / "Bu önemliydi" → M-CORR-01 priority mode, preselected.
  - "Göndereni VIP yap" / "VIP'den çıkar" (Pro; Free → `paywall?source=vip`).
  - "Kural oluştur" → `settings/priority-rules/new?sender={email}&kind=sender_important`.
  - "Göndereni gör" → `person/[contactId]`.
  - "Kapat" dismisses.
- **Loading** — n/a (static options).
- **Empty** — n/a.
- **Error** — `Linking.canOpenURL` false → toast "Bağlantı açılamadı." VIP write error → rollback + toast.
- **Offline** — The handoff is allowed; VIP change is queued.
- **Permission edge case** — VIP is Pro. Missing `web_link` for Outlook → hide the handoff row, never show a dead row.
- **Approval requirement** — None (handoff or internal).
- **Analytics events** — `email_provider_handoff{provider}`, `vip_toggle{on}`, `rule_create_start{origin:'mail'}`.
- **Accessibility notes** — Rows are buttons. The handoff row hint: "{Gmail} uygulamasında veya tarayıcıda açılır."
- **Deep links** — None.
- **Tests** — RNTL: URL built per provider; the row is hidden when there is no link; VIP gate for Free.

### M-MAIL-05 · Dış bağlantı onayı (link confirmation sheet)

- **Screen ID** — M-MAIL-05
- **Route** — Global `SheetHost` (`LinkConfirmSheet`).
- **Entry points** — Tapping a link inside "Orijinal Mail" (M-MAIL-03), inside capture results (M-CAP-06) or in the life sheet source preview.
- **Primary purpose** — Phishing-safe external navigation: show the real destination domain before leaving the app (M§114, SSRF/phishing posture).
- **Data dependencies** — The parsed URL (scheme, host, punycode-decoded host), the displayed anchor text, and a mismatch flag (anchor domain ≠ href domain).
- **API dependencies** — None (client-side parsing in `packages/domain/url-safety`).
- **State dependencies** — Local.
- **Source design reference** — PRIMARY 08 alert/sheet rules ("Modal yalnızca geri alınamaz işlemler için" → a sheet is used). Title 19/600, body 13, `PrimaryButton` + text "Vazgeç".
- **Primary CTA** — "Bağlantıyı Aç" → `expo-web-browser.openBrowserAsync(url)` for http(s). Other schemes (`mailto:`, `tel:`) go to `Linking.openURL`. Only `https`, `http`, `mailto` and `tel` are allowed; any other scheme shows "Bu bağlantı türü açılamaz."
- **Secondary actions** — "Bağlantıyı kopyala"; "Vazgeç".
- **Loading** — n/a.
- **Empty** — n/a.
- **Error** — Unsupported scheme → the primary CTA is hidden and the copy above is shown.
- **Offline** — Allowed (the browser shows its own offline page).
- **Permission edge case** — None.
- **Approval requirement** — None.
- **Analytics events** — `external_link_open{context, mismatch:boolean}`.
- **Accessibility notes** — Announces the domain first: "Bağlantı {domain} alan adına gidiyor". When `mismatch` is true, a warning row (warning tone): "Görünen metin farklı bir adres gösteriyor."
- **Deep links** — None.
- **Tests** — Vitest `url-safety.test.ts`: punycode/IDN display, anchor mismatch, scheme allowlist.
