## 4. AI Reply

### M-REPLY-01 · AI Yanıt Taslağı

- **Screen ID** — M-REPLY-01
- **Route** — `app/mail/[id]/reply.tsx` (modal); params:
  - `tone ∈ short|professional|friendly|detailed`;
  - `mode ∈ reply|follow_up`;
  - `draftId`;
  - `approvalId` (approval edit mode, from M-APPR-05);
  - `origin` (screen to return to).
- **Entry points**
  - M-MAIL-03 "Yanıt Hazırla" / "Taslağa Devam Et".
  - Flow email card "Yanıt Hazırla"; Flow follow-up card and M-FUP-01 "Takip Mesajı Hazırla" (`mode=follow_up`).
  - M-WAIT-01 "Yanıt Hazırla".
  - Approval Center "Düzenle" on `email_send`.
  - Today priority "Yanıtla" (Part 1); Assistant/Voice "Düzenle" (Part 3).
  - Push `follow_up` → draft.
- **Primary purpose** — Generate → Edit → Approval → Send (M§16, REQ-REPLY-01..03) in four tones. Silent send is impossible: the only send path is an `email_send` approval that the user explicitly approves.
- **Data dependencies**
  - `reply_drafts` row (DB §4.4): `id, message_id, thread_id, connected_account_id, kind ('reply'|'follow_up'), tone ('short'|'professional'|'friendly'|'detailed'), status ('draft'|'submitted'|'sent'|'discarded'|'failed'), body, to_emails[], cc_emails[], subject, version int, prompt_version_id`, plus the proposed `reply_all bool`, `attachments[{source: email_attachment|device_upload, attachment_ref, filename, mime, size}]`, `variants_cached jsonb{tone → body}`, `edited_by_user bool` and `send_preview {from, to, cc, subject, threading:true, account_label, attachments_count, payload_hash}`. `generating` is a client phase, never a stored status.
  - `connected_accounts.capabilities_granted` (has `mail_send`?) and `status`.
  - `email_messages` header subset (sender, subject, received_at).
  - Recipient contacts (avatars).
  - AI budget remaining (`GET /me/bootstrap` `usage`, API-BOOT-01).
- **API dependencies**
  - `POST /mail/:messageId/reply-drafts {tone}` (API-MAIL-02) → 201 `{draft}` with `status='draft'`. Generation is synchronous within the request time limit (API §2.10); the client shows the `generating` phase while the request is in flight.
  - `POST /followups/:threadId/draft` (follow-up entry; returns `{draft, message_id}`).
  - `POST /reply-drafts/:id/regenerate {tone?, instructions?, expected_version}` (API-MAIL-03). "Kısalt" sends `instructions` = the catalog string `reply.assist.shortenInstruction` ("Daha kısa yaz."). A cached tone variant (same tone within 10 min, thread unchanged) returns with no AI cost.
  - `PATCH /reply-drafts/:id {body_text?, to?, cc?, subject?, reply_all?, attachments?, status?:'discarded', expected_version}` (API-MAIL-04; `reply_all`, `attachments` and `status:'discarded'` are the extensions proposed in the last section) → 409 `STATE_CONFLICT` on a stale version.
  - `POST /reply-drafts/:id/submit {expected_version}` (API-MAIL-05) → 201 `{draft, approval}` (pending `email_send`, with `payload_hash`, `payload_version` and `idempotency_key`).
  - `POST /approvals/:id/approve {idempotency_key, payload_version, approved_via:'in_place'}` (API-APR-03).
  - `PATCH /approvals/:id` (approval-edit mode).
  - `POST /integrations/:accountId/upgrade {capability:'mail_send'}` (via M-REPLY-02).
  - Attachments from device: `POST /reply-drafts/:id/attachments/upload-url` (contract in the last section, item 9) mints a signed upload URL in the private `captures` bucket at `{user_id}/replies/{draft_id}/{file}`; `POST /captures/upload-url` is **not** used.
- **State dependencies**
  - `['reply-draft',id]` (persist; user-reviewed text); local editor state with a debounced autosave (800 ms) through PATCH.
  - `mutationState` for submit/approve; `['approval',id]` polling.
  - Screen phase machine (client): `generating → ready → editing → submitting → approving → executing → executed | failed`.
- **Source design reference**
  - PRIMARY 04/4.5 "AI Yanıt Taslağı · Onay gerektirir"; hub `isReply` + `notSent`/`sent` (REPLY_AHMET, REPLY_MEHMET tone texts as demo fixtures); 06/6.4 approval language; 08 MOTION rows 2 and 12.
  - SECONDARY `AIDraftReply.tsx`: the editable textarea and recipient summary are adopted; its double "Son Onay" sheet, fake send and fake "Gmail açılıyor" are rejected.
  - **Layout:**
    1. `NavHeader`: close/back · kicker "YANIT TASLAĞI" | "TAKİP MESAJI" · `more_horiz` (was a 36 spacer; minimal addition).
    2. "Kime" row with `RecipientChip`(s) + "Re: {subject}" 12 px.
    3. Tone `SegmentedControl`: Kısa · Profesyonel · Samimi · Detaylı.
    4. `DraftEditorCard`: kicker "AI TASLAĞI · {TON}" + "Düzenlenebilir"; editable body 15/23; `AssistChip`s "Kısalt" (`short_text`) and attachment suggestions "{dosya} ekle" (`attach_file`), shown only for real files: sender's thread attachments that the user sent before, or recent captures; otherwise "Dosya ekle" opens the document picker.
    5. **"Gönderim özeti"** block (new, minimal; M§33 exact change inline):

       | Row | Content |
       |---|---|
       | Gönderen | {account email masked} · {Gmail\|Outlook} |
       | Kime | {…} |
       | Bilgi (Cc) | only if any |
       | Konu | Re: … |
       | Ekler | "Yok" or n files |
       | Yan etki | "1 mail gönderilecek · geri alınamaz" |

    6. `AssuranceNote` `verified_user`: "Sen onaylamadan hiçbir mail gönderilmez."
    7. CTA row: `PrimaryButton` "Göndermeyi Onayla" (flex 1) + `SecondaryButton` "Düzenle".
- **Primary CTA** — **"Göndermeyi Onayla"**. The tap is the user's explicit approval of the on-screen Gönderim özeti. Chain:
  1. Flush any pending PATCH.
  2. Capability gate: if `mail_send` is missing, open M-REPLY-02 and stop.
  3. `POST /reply-drafts/:id/submit {expected_version}` → approval `{id, idempotency_key, payload_version, payload_hash, status:'pending'}`.
  4. If `approval.payload_hash === send_preview.payload_hash`, the same tap continues with `POST /approvals/:id/approve {idempotency_key, payload_version, approved_via:'in_place'}`: the user approved exactly what the Gönderim özeti showed. If the hashes differ (the server normalised recipients or subject), open M-APPR-04 on this approval to show the difference; nothing is approved without a second tap there.
  5. Phase `executing`: the button shows a spinner and "Gönderiliyor…"; the modal disables swipe-dismiss; poll the approval (§0.5).
  6. `executed` → `SuccessState`:
     - 96 ring `#E4F5EA` + `check_circle`, title "Gönderildi";
     - body "Alıcı: {ad}. Yanıt gelirse Akış'ta göreceksin.";
     - ink button "{Origin}'{suffix} Dön" (e.g. "Maile Dön", "Akış'a Dön", "Bugün'e Dön"), which dismisses to the origin;
     - success haptic.
  7. `failed` → inline `ErrorCard` with the §0.5 copy; "Tekrar dene" re-approves with the same key.
- **Secondary actions**
  - Tone segment → if `edited_by_user`, open M-REPLY-04; else `POST /reply-drafts/:id/regenerate {tone}` with a shimmer on the card (no progress bar).
  - "Kısalt" → regenerate with `instruction:'shorten'`; a toast "Kısaltıldı · Geri al" restores the previous body (local history, 1 level).
  - Attachment chip:
    - suggestion → PATCH `attachments` (source `email_attachment`);
    - "Dosya ekle" → `expo-document-picker` (the `captures` bucket allow-list: JPEG/PNG/HEIC/HEIF/WebP images, PDF, plain text; ≤20 MB per file) → `POST /reply-drafts/:id/attachments/upload-url` → signed upload → PATCH `attachments`;
    - the total per draft is capped by `REPLY_ATTACHMENT_LIMIT_BYTES` in `packages/domain` (Gmail 25 MB, Outlook 3 MB; KPL-44). Outlook sends attachments inline as `fileAttachment` items in the `message` of the Graph `reply` request, so its 3 MB total applies and the row shows "Outlook yanıtlarında eklerin toplamı en fazla 3 MB olabilir." (`limits.mail.attachment_limit_outlook`). A file that would exceed the cap is refused before upload: "Ekler {25 MB|3 MB} sınırını aşıyor."
  - "Düzenle" → enters full edit mode: the tone bar collapses, the subject field and editable recipients appear (tap → M-REPLY-03), the body gets focus, and the keyboard is managed by `react-native-keyboard-controller`.
  - `more_horiz`:
    - "Metni kopyala" (`Clipboard.setStringAsync` via `expo-clipboard`, proposed) → toast "Taslak kopyalandı";
    - "{Gmail'de|Outlook'ta} konuyu aç" (handoff as in M-MAIL-04);
    - "Taslağı sil" → PATCH `status:'discarded'` → dismiss.
  - Close/back with unsaved or unsubmitted edits → M-REPLY-05.
  - **Approval-edit mode** (`approvalId` present):
    - pending approval: the CTA stays "Göndermeyi Onayla" and first calls `PATCH /approvals/:id {expected_payload_version, payload_patch}` (new version + key), then approves with the new key (`approved_via:'in_place'`);
    - failed approval (re-propose mode, §0.5): the draft is edited and submitted again (`POST /reply-drafts/:id/submit`), which creates a new pending approval; the failed one stays in history;
    - secondary "Kaydet" performs the PATCH only (stays pending) and returns to Approval Center.
- **Loading**
  - Phase `generating`: `DraftEditorCard` shimmer (1.6 s) with kicker spinner "AI TASLAĞI HAZIRLANIYOR…"; tone control and CTA disabled; recipients/subject render from the message immediately.
  - Regenerate: shimmer over the body only.
  - Submitting: button spinner.
- **Empty** — n/a. If generation returns no usable text (validator rejects the output): the editor is empty with a hint "Taslak oluşturulamadı; kendin yazabilirsin." The user can type and send via the same approval path.
- **Error**
  - Generation failure: `error.aiUnavailable` inline, with "Tekrar Dene" and "Kendim yazayım" (blank editor).
  - AI budget (429 `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`): `error.aiBudget` ("Pro'yu Gör" → `paywall?source=ai_budget`; "Kendim yazayım").
  - PATCH 409 `STATE_CONFLICT`: "Taslak başka bir cihazda güncellendi." + "Son hâli yükle".
  - Attachments over the cap (413 `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`, `details.reason='attachment_limit_exceeded'`): "Ekler {25 MB|3 MB} sınırını aşıyor." + "Düzenle".
  - Send failures: §0.5 mapping, including `admin_consent_required` (Microsoft work accounts) → "Metni kopyala" + "Outlook'ta aç".
  - Account `needs_reauth`: the CTA is replaced by "Yeniden Bağlan".
- **Offline**
  - Editing is allowed: local autosave to the persisted draft, PATCH queued with `expected_version`.
  - Tone/regenerate/Kısalt are blocked.
  - "Göndermeyi Onayla" is **blocked**: disabled, with note "Çevrimdışısın · Gönderim için bağlantı gerekli. Taslağın kaydedildi."
  - Never auto-send on reconnect.
- **Permission edge case**
  - Missing `mail_send` → M-REPLY-02 (progressive `gmail.send` / `Mail.Send`; ADR-07).
  - A `partial` grant where the user unticked send → "Gönderim izni verilmedi. Taslağın kaydedildi." with "Metni kopyala" / "{Gmail'de} aç".
  - Free: generation counts against the daily AI budget.
  - Document picker needs no OS permission.
  - **External credential required:** Google OAuth client with `gmail.send` on the consent screen (sensitive scope → brand verification is a **Manual external step**); Microsoft Entra app with `Mail.Send`; the Anthropic API key for generation. In demo mode the `demo` provider and `fixture` LLM cover the flow.
- **Approval requirement** — Yes: `email_send`. The on-screen Gönderim özeti + "Göndermeyi Onayla" is the approval UI; a hash mismatch falls back to M-APPR-04.
- **Analytics events** — `reply_draft_created{tone, result}` / `follow_up_draft_created{tone, result}` (by `mode`), `reply_tone_change{tone}`, `reply_assist{kind:'shorten'|'attach'}`, `reply_draft_edit`, `reply_submit{mode}`, `send_scope_upgrade_start{provider}`, `send_scope_upgrade_result{result}`, `approval_decided{action_type:'email_send', decision:'approved', via:'in_place'}`, `approval_execution_result{action_type, status, error_code?}`.
- **Accessibility notes**
  - The tone control is a `radiogroup`.
  - The editor has label "Yanıt metni, düzenlenebilir".
  - The Gönderim özeti is read as one group before the CTA.
  - The CTA hint: "Onayladığında mail gönderilir; geri alınamaz."
  - Phase changes are announced: "Gönderiliyor", "Gönderildi", "Gönderilemedi: {neden}".
  - Focus moves to the success title on success.
- **Deep links** — `dijitalasistan://mail/{id}/reply?tone=professional&mode=reply`, `dijitalasistan://mail/{id}/reply?draftId={draftId}`.
- **Tests**
  - RNTL `reply.test.tsx`: tone change with and without edits; the hash-match single-tap approve path (`approved_via='in_place'`); the mismatch path opens the approval sheet; the capability gate opens M-REPLY-02; offline block; success copy never says "aldı"; double-tap sends one approve (mutation dedupe).
  - Deno `reply_drafts_test.ts` (generation validator rejects invented URLs and invented attachments; tone cache hit costs 0 AI calls; submit creates exactly one pending approval per draft `version`; attachments over `REPLY_ATTACHMENT_LIMIT_BYTES` → 413 `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`; the upload URL path starts with the user's folder).
  - Deno `approval_execute_email_test.ts`:
    - Gmail MIME has `In-Reply-To`, `References`, `threadId`, `Message-ID <approval-{id}@mail.dijitalasistan.app>`;
    - on retry, `rfc822msgid:` finding a match → executed without resend;
    - Graph `reply` with `comment` only plus the extended-property marker;
    - the Sent Items check on retry.
  - pgTAP: `email_send` approval transitions.
  - Maestro `reply-approve-send.yaml` (demo).

### M-REPLY-02 · Gönderim / yazma izni (progressive scope upgrade sheet)

- **Screen ID** — M-REPLY-02
- **Route** — Global `SheetHost` (`ScopeUpgradeSheet`, generic for `mail_send | calendar_write | tasks_write`).
- **Entry points**
  - M-REPLY-01 CTA with `mail_send` missing.
  - Any approve returning 424 `PROVIDER_SCOPE_MISSING` (`details.upgrade`).
  - M-APPR-04 "Onayla" for calendar/task writes without the capability.
  - Failure CTA "İzin Ver".
- **Primary purpose** — Explain and obtain least-privilege write scopes only at the first approved write (ADR-07 progressive authorization).
- **Data dependencies** — Account (`provider`, masked email, `status`), requested capability.
- **API dependencies**
  - `POST /integrations/:accountId/upgrade {capability}` → `{auth_url}`.
  - `WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(auth_url, 'dijitalasistan://integrations/callback')`.
  - The `oauth` function callback → deep link `…/integrations/callback?result=success|partial|denied&account={id}`.
  - Refetch `connected_accounts`.
- **State dependencies** — `useSheetStore` holds a `pendingContinuation` (the approve/submit call to resume); `['accounts']`.
- **Source design reference** — PRIMARY 02 permission-explainer pattern (2.7/2.7b explainer sheets, restyled in the primary sheet spec). Copy is new, in PRIMARY tone.
- **Primary CTA** — "İzin Ver" → OAuth. On `success`, the continuation resumes automatically (M-REPLY-01 step 3, or approve with the same key) and the sheet closes.
- **Secondary actions** — "Vazgeç" → closes; the draft/approval stays as is (pending approvals remain in Approval Center). "Neden gerekli?" expands an inline explanation.
- **Loading** — While the browser session is open: CTA spinner "Bekleniyor…". After redirect: "İzin doğrulanıyor…" until the refetch completes.
- **Empty** — n/a.
- **Error**
  - `partial` / `denied`: "İzin verilmedi. {Mail gönderilmedi | Takvime yazılmadı}; taslağın/önerin kaydedildi."
  - `admin_consent_required`: "Kurumunun yöneticisi bu uygulamaya onay vermeli."
  - Browser dismissed: silent close.
- **Offline** — CTA disabled: "İzin için bağlantı gerekli."
- **Permission edge case** — Copy per capability:
  - `mail_send`: title "Gönderim izni gerekli"; body "Yanıtını {Gmail} üzerinden gönderebilmem için {Google}'dan 'senin adına e-posta gönderme' izni gerekiyor. Bu izin yalnızca onayladığın mailleri göndermek için kullanılır."
  - `calendar_write`: "Takvime yazma izni gerekli" / "…yalnızca onayladığın etkinlikleri eklemek veya güncellemek için kullanılır."
  - `tasks_write`: "Görev yazma izni gerekli" / "…yalnızca onayladığın görevleri oluşturmak için kullanılır."
  - Microsoft labels: "Outlook", "Microsoft".
- **Approval requirement** — None itself; it is a precondition for an approval.
- **Analytics events** — `scope_upgrade_view{capability, provider}`, `scope_upgrade_result{capability, result}`.
- **Accessibility notes** — Title focused on open; the CTA hint "Tarayıcıda {Google} izin ekranı açılır."
- **Deep links** — Handles the callback `dijitalasistan://integrations/callback` (shared with Part 4 accounts).
- **Tests** — RNTL: continuation resumes exactly once after success; the denied path never approves. Deno `integrations_upgrade_test.ts`: `include_granted_scopes=true`, `gmail.send` only; partial-grant parsing sets `status='partial'`.

### M-REPLY-03 · Alıcılar (recipient editor sheet)

- **Screen ID** — M-REPLY-03
- **Route** — Global `SheetHost`.
- **Entry points** — M-REPLY-01 recipient chip (edit mode); M-APPR-05 email editor.
- **Primary purpose** — Edit To/Cc and the reply-all toggle safely.
- **Data dependencies** — Draft `to[]`, `cc[]`, `reply_all`; the original message's participants; `contacts` for suggestions (from mail history only, never device contacts; SREQ-37).
- **API dependencies** — `PATCH /reply-drafts/:id {to, cc, reply_all, expected_version}`; PostgREST `contacts?select=id,display_name,primary_email&display_name=ilike.*{q}*` (limit 8).
- **State dependencies** — Local form (react-hook-form + zod `emailAddress`).
- **Source design reference** — Not designed in PRIMARY (audit: "Recipient editor … NOT DESIGNED"); built from `Sheet`, `RecipientChip`, `OptionRow`, switch row.
- **Primary CTA** — "Kaydet" → PATCH; recompute `send_preview`.
- **Secondary actions**
  - "Tümünü yanıtla" switch: adds the original To/Cc minus self; turning it off returns to sender + Reply-To.
  - Remove a chip (×).
  - Add by typing an address or picking a contact suggestion.
  - "Vazgeç".
- **Loading** — Suggestions spinner row.
- **Empty** — No suggestions: "Adres yaz".
- **Error** — Invalid address inline: "Geçerli bir e-posta adresi yaz." At least one To recipient is required.
- **Offline** — Allowed (PATCH queued).
- **Permission edge case** — None.
- **Approval requirement** — None (changes surface in the Gönderim özeti before approval).
- **Analytics events** — `reply_recipients_edit{added, removed, reply_all}` (counts only).
- **Accessibility notes** — Chips announce "{ad}, alıcı, kaldırmak için iki kez dokun". The switch row is fully tappable.
- **Deep links** — None.
- **Tests** — Vitest: reply-all computation excludes the user's own addresses (all connected aliases). RNTL validation.

### M-REPLY-04 · "Yeni tonla yeniden yazayım mı?" (tone overwrite dialog)

- **Screen ID** — M-REPLY-04
- **Route** — Global `SheetHost` (small `Sheet`).
- **Entry points** — M-REPLY-01 tone change when `edited_by_user`.
- **Primary purpose** — Prevent silent loss of user edits.
- **Data dependencies** — Current body, target tone.
- **API dependencies** — `POST /reply-drafts/:id/regenerate {tone}` on confirm.
- **State dependencies** — Local; previous body kept for undo.
- **Source design reference** — PRIMARY sheet spec; copy new.
- **Primary CTA** — "Yeniden Yaz" → regenerate; toast "Yeni ton uygulandı · Geri al" (undo restores the previous body and tone).
- **Secondary actions** — "Vazgeç" (the tone segment reverts).
- **Loading** — n/a (the parent shimmers).
- **Empty** — n/a.
- **Error** — The parent handles regenerate errors.
- **Offline** — The confirm CTA is disabled ("Bağlantı gerekli").
- **Permission edge case** — The AI budget error is shown by the parent.
- **Approval requirement** — None.
- **Analytics events** — `reply_tone_overwrite{confirmed}`.
- **Accessibility notes** — Title "Düzenlemelerin kaybolacak. {Ton} tonuyla yeniden yazayım mı?" is read first.
- **Deep links** — None.
- **Tests** — RNTL: confirm → regenerate once; cancel → no call.

## 5. Waiting and Follow-ups

### M-WAIT-01 · Senden Beklenenler

- **Screen ID** — M-WAIT-01
- **Route** — `app/waiting.tsx`; param `focus` (insight id to scroll to and highlight).
- **Entry points** — M-MAIL-01 "Senden cevap bekleyen"; Morning briefing "Senden Beklenenler" section (Part 1); Today priorities; push `critical_email`; deep link.
- **Primary purpose** — The people waiting on the user (M§17 type 2), grouped by urgency, with the fastest path to a reply.
- **Data dependencies**
  - `insights` where `kind='reply_needed'` and `status='open'`, joined to `email_threads` and `email_messages` (latest inbound) and `contacts`.
  - Fields:
    - `person` (display name, initials, palette);
    - `topic` (subject);
    - `expectation` (grounded AI ask; evidence required, else hidden);
    - `due_at` (grounded only);
    - `waiting_since` (inbound `received_at`);
    - `urgency`.
  - Groups:
    - **ACİL** (label `#C7432F`, dot `#E0553F`): `urgency=urgent`.
    - **BUGÜN** (`#9A6300` / `#E09A1C`): `urgency=today`.
    - **DAHA SONRA** (`#6B6860` / `#B8B4AA`): `normal | low`.
    - Empty groups are hidden.
  - Sort inside each group by `due_at` asc nulls last, then `waiting_since` asc.
- **API dependencies** — PostgREST `insights?kind=eq.reply_needed&status=eq.open&select=…,email_message:email_messages(…),contact:contacts(…)`; `set_insight_status`; `apply_insight_feedback` / `revert_insight_feedback`.
- **State dependencies** — `['waiting']` (persist).
- **Source design reference**
  - PRIMARY 04/4.7 "Senden Beklenenler · Acil / Bugün / Yakında" (bucket renamed per SREQ-11); 08 swipe spec.
  - SECONDARY `WaitingReply.tsx`: "Maili Aç" and the reminder affordance are adopted as swipe/overflow; the blue tone is rejected.
  - **Layout:** back · H1 "Senden Beklenenler" · sub "{n} kişi cevabını bekliyor." · `UrgencyGroup`s of `WaitingCard`s:
    - avatar 40;
    - name + waiting time ("2 sa", "18 sa", "1 gün" via date-fns `tr`);
    - topic 13;
    - expectation 14/20;
    - footer: deadline 12/600 in the group colour (only if grounded) · "Yanıt Hazırla" 13/600 `#4547C9`;
    - trailing "···".
- **Primary CTA** — "Yanıt Hazırla" → `mail/[latestInboundMessageId]/reply?mode=reply`.
- **Secondary actions**
  - Card tap → `mail/[id]` ("İlgili maili aç"; also offered in the "···" sheet).
  - Swipe right "Tamamlandı" → `set_insight_status(done, reason 'replied_elsewhere')`, undo toast.
  - Swipe left: "Ertele" → `reminders/new?mode=snooze&targetType=insight&targetId=`; "Önemli değil" → `apply_insight_feedback(not_important)` (dismiss + feedback; undo `revert_insight_feedback`).
  - "···" → action sheet: "İlgili maili aç" (`mail/[id]`), "Hatırlat" (`reminders/new?targetType=email_message&anchorAt={due_at}`), "Yanıt gerekmiyor" (= done, reason `no_reply_needed`), "Bu nereden çıktı?", "Düzelt…".
  - Auto-resolution: when sync sees the user's reply in the thread, the pipeline sets `done` with reason `replied`.
- **Loading** — 3 grouped skeleton cards.
- **Empty** — Icon `mark_email_read` on success tone; "Kimse senden yanıt beklemiyor." / "Cevap bekleyen biri olursa burada görürsün."; CTA "Mail Zekâsı'nı Aç".
- **Error** — `error.generic` + retry; account reauth card.
- **Offline** — Cached list; swipe/status queued; "Yanıt Hazırla" blocked.
- **Permission edge case** — Free feature (basic important email). Paused accounts are excluded.
- **Approval requirement** — None here; the reply path uses `email_send`.
- **Analytics events** — `waiting_view{count_bucket}`, `waiting_action{action: reply|open|remind|done|snooze|dismiss}`.
- **Accessibility notes** — Group headers use `header` role with the dot hidden. Card label: "{kişi}, {bekleme}, {konu}. {beklenen}. Son tarih {…}". a11y actions: reply / complete / snooze / dismiss / remind.
- **Deep links** — `dijitalasistan://waiting`, `dijitalasistan://waiting?focus={insightId}`.
- **Tests**
  - RNTL: grouping, empty groups hidden, expectation hidden when evidence is absent, deadline rendered only when `due_at` is grounded.
  - Deno pipeline test `reply_needed_resolution_test.ts`: an outbound reply resolves the insight.
  - Maestro `waiting-reply.yaml`.

### M-FUP-01 · Senin Cevap Beklediklerin (Follow-ups)

- **Screen ID** — M-FUP-01
- **Route** — `app/followups.tsx`; param `focus`.
- **Entry points** — M-MAIL-01 "Senin cevap beklediğin"; Flow follow-up card tap; Flow Takip filter; Morning briefing "Senin Beklediklerin"; Evening "Takip" (Part 1); push `follow_up`; deep link.
- **Primary purpose** — Sent mails with no reply (M§17 type 1), with the three M§17 actions: Takip mesajı hazırla, Yarın hatırlat, Kapat.
- **Data dependencies**
  - `insights` where `kind='follow_up'`, `status='open'`, joined to `email_threads` (last outbound `email_messages`) and `contacts`.
  - Fields:
    - `person`, `topic`;
    - `sent_at` (for the days pill: neutral <3 d, amber ≥3 d, coral ≥7 d);
    - `status_text` (grounded AI one-liner; no read-receipt claims);
    - `source_line` "{2 Eylül 10:05}'te gönderildi · {Gmail}";
    - `next_touchpoint` (deterministic: the next `calendar_events` row with this contact as attendee in the next 7 days → "Bugün 14:30 toplantıda konuşabilirsin.");
    - `typical_latency` (only if there are ≥3 historical reply samples → "Genelde 3–4 günde döner.");
    - `snooze_count` (→ "İki kez ertelendi" when ≥2).
  - Detection threshold for creating these insights: `user_preferences.follow_up_after_days` (default 2).
- **API dependencies** — PostgREST `insights?kind=eq.follow_up…`; `POST /followups/:threadId/draft`; `set_insight_status`; `apply_insight_feedback(p_kind:'stop_tracking')` / `revert_insight_feedback` (the contact-level learned preference is derived server-side).
- **State dependencies** — `['followups']` (persist).
- **Source design reference**
  - PRIMARY 04/4.6 "Akıllı Takip · Senin cevap beklediklerin"; 08 `empty/follow-up`; hub F4.
  - SECONDARY `SmartFollowUp.tsx` (full-sheet "Hatırlat" adopted as long-press).
  - **Layout:** back · H1 "Senin Cevap Beklediklerin" (see Deviations D-3) · sub "{n} gönderdiğin mail yanıtsız. En eskisi {d} gün." · `PersonActionCard`s:
    - avatar 40, name, topic, days pill;
    - status line, source row;
    - buttons "Takip Mesajı Hazırla" (soft indigo) · "Yarın Hatırlat" (neutral) · "Kapat" (ghost);
    - "···".
  - `HintRow` `psychology`: "Bir kişiyi “Takip etme” dersen, o kişiden bekleyen mailleri bir daha göstermem."
- **Primary CTA** — "Takip Mesajı Hazırla" → `POST /followups/:threadId/draft {tone:'short'}` → `mail/[lastOutboundMessageId]/reply?mode=follow_up&draftId=`. Default tone is "Kısa"; recipients are the original To.
- **Secondary actions**
  - **"Yarın Hatırlat"** → `reminders/new?targetType=insight&targetId={id}&preset=tomorrow_morning&title={topic}`: the sheet opens with "Yarın sabah · {08:00}" preselected and needs the confirm tap (C-28; M§29 confirm). Long-press opens the same sheet with no preselection.
  - **"Kapat"** → `set_insight_status(done, reason 'closed')`; the card fades 300 ms; toast "Kapatıldı · Geri al".
  - "···":
    - "Bu kişiyi takip etme" → `apply_insight_feedback(p_kind:'stop_tracking')`: the server writes `ai_feedback{rating:-1, reason_code:'stop_tracking'}`, dismisses the person's open follow-ups and, when learning is on, derives `learned_preferences(group_key:'people', target_type:'contact', target_ref:{contact_id}, effect:{priority:'low'})`; undo → `revert_insight_feedback`; toast "Öğrendim · {Ad} için takip önermeyeceğim. · Geri al";
    - "Ara" (only if the contact has a phone number stored from a signature/source) → `tel:`;
    - "Bu nereden çıktı?";
    - "Düzelt…".
  - Swipes as 08 (right Tamamlandı = close; left Ertele / Önemli değil).
  - Card tap → `mail/[lastOutboundMessageId]`.
- **Loading** — 3 `PersonActionCard` skeletons.
- **Empty** — `empty.followups` with CTA "Taahhütlerini gör" → `commitments` (the design's "Tamam" CTA was a dead action and is removed).
- **Error** — `error.generic`; reauth card.
- **Offline** — Cached; Kapat and swipe queued; "Yarın Hatırlat" queued (non-smart preset); "Takip Mesajı Hazırla" blocked.
- **Permission edge case** — **Pro** (Follow-Up, M§44). Free users get a full-screen `ProGateCard`: "TAKİP · PRO" / "{n} gönderdiğin mail yanıtsız." / "Yanıtsız kalan maillerini takip eder, tek dokunuşla takip mesajı hazırlarım." The count is deterministic; no LLM runs for Free.
- **Approval requirement** — The follow-up send uses the `email_send` approval (M-REPLY-01). Reminders use the M-REM-01 confirm step.
- **Analytics events** — `followup_view`, `follow_up_actioned{action: draft|remind_tomorrow|close|stop_tracking|call|snooze|dismiss}`, `pro_gate_viewed{feature:'followups'}`.
- **Accessibility notes** — Days pill label "{n} gündür yanıt yok". All three buttons are ≥44 pt. The hint row is plain text, not a button.
- **Deep links** — `dijitalasistan://followups`, `dijitalasistan://followups?focus={insightId}`.
- **Tests**
  - RNTL: badge thresholds; "Yarın Hatırlat" preselects `tomorrow_morning` and does not create anything until confirm; stop-tracking calls `apply_insight_feedback(stop_tracking)` once and the client writes no `learned_preferences` row; Free gate.
  - Vitest `packages/domain/followup/latency.test.ts` (min-sample rule).
  - Maestro `followup-draft.yaml`.

## 6. Commitments

### M-COMMIT-01 · Taahhütlerin (list)

- **Screen ID** — M-COMMIT-01
- **Route** — `app/commitments/index.tsx`; params `direction ∈ user_owes|they_owe` (default `user_owes`) and `focus`.
- **Entry points**
  - Flow commitment card; Flow Takip empty CTA.
  - Plan tab "Taahhütler" entry (SREQ-18, Part 3); Person page "Sözler" (Part 3).
  - Evening Close "Yarına Kalanlar" (Part 1); Post-meeting save result (Part 3).
  - Deep link.
- **Primary purpose** — Promises the user made (or received), detected from explicit statements (M§18). Ambiguous inferences need confirmation.
- **Data dependencies**
  - `commitments`: `id, direction, status (commitment_status), title (commitment_text), quote (evidence span ≤300), contact_id → contacts, due_at, due_text, source_type, source_id, source_provider, source_timestamp, confidence, snoozed_until, completed_at, completed_via ('manual'|'auto_sent_mail'), user_overrides`.
  - Pending ambiguous proposals: `approval_actions` where `action_type='commitment_create'`, `status='pending'`, `origin='commitment_detection'`.
  - Display status (derived):

    | Display | Rule | Tone |
    |---|---|---|
    | **GECİKMİŞ** | open, `due_at < now` | critical |
    | **BUGÜN** | open, due today in the user tz | warning |
    | **AÇIK** | open, otherwise | neutral |
    | **ERTELENDİ** | snoozed | neutral; meta "{Yarın 08:00}'e ertelendi" |
    | **TAMAMLANDI** | done | success |

- **API dependencies**
  - PostgREST `commitments?direction=eq.{d}&status=in.(open,snoozed)&order=due_at.asc.nullslast`, plus a separate done query limited to the last 30 days (`completed_at=gte.{now-30d}`).
  - `approval_actions?action_type=eq.commitment_create&status=eq.pending`.
  - RPC-06 `set_commitment_status`.
  - `POST /approvals/:id/approve` and `/reject` (confirmations).
  - `POST /followups/:threadId/draft` (they_owe with an email source).
- **State dependencies** — `['commitments',direction]`, `['commitment-proposals']` (persist).
- **Source design reference**
  - PRIMARY 04/4.8 "Taahhütler · Verdiğin sözler" (Lora italic quote; label/value rows).
  - SECONDARY `CommitmentTracker.tsx`: actions hidden for done items (adopted); its fake Ertele sheet rejected.
  - **Layout:**
    1. Back · H1 "Taahhütlerin" · sub "Mail ve notlarında verdiğin sözleri yakaladım. {open} açık, {overdue} gecikmiş." (for they_owe: "Sana verilen {n} söz açık.").
    2. `SegmentedControl` "Verdiğin" / "Sana verilen".
    3. Section "ONAY BEKLEYEN · {n}": ambiguous proposal cards in `SuggestedSurface` style (dashed; "Önerilen · henüz gerçek değil").
    4. Sections GECİKMİŞ / BUGÜN / AÇIK / ERTELENDİ (open cards).
    5. Collapsed "TAMAMLANANLAR · SON 30 GÜN".
  - `CommitmentCard`: badge + date, Lora italic quote in “ ”, rows Taahhüt / Kime / Kaynak / (Güven only when <0.8: "Emin değilim"), buttons.
- **Primary CTA** — Open card "Tamamlandı" → `set_commitment_status(done)`: success haptic, card moves to TAMAMLANANLAR, toast "Tamamlandı · Geri al".
- **Secondary actions**
  - "Ertele" → `reminders/new?mode=snooze&targetType=commitment&targetId={id}` (snooze mode; C-08 confirm).
  - "Kaynağı Gör" → the exact source: `mail/[id]?highlight={evidenceRef}` / `meeting/[eventId]/summary` / `capture/[id]`.
  - Card tap → `commitments/[id]`.
  - **Ambiguous proposal card** (M§18 confirmation):
    - kicker "ONAY BEKLİYOR" (warning), quote, "Bu bir söz mü?";
    - "Evet, takip et" → `POST /approvals/:id/approve {idempotency_key, payload_version, approved_via:'in_place'}` → the commitment is created → the card moves into the list;
    - "Hayır" → `POST /approvals/:id/reject` (stored `rejection_reason='user_reject'`; `commitment_detection` is an AI-suggested origin, so the server writes `ai_feedback{rating:-1, reason_code:'not_a_commitment'}`);
    - "Kaynağı Gör".
  - they_owe cards: "Takip Mesajı Hazırla" (email source) instead of "Ertele"; "Tamamlandı" = they delivered.
  - TAMAMLANDI cards show only "Geri al" within 24 h (reopen) and "Kaynağı Gör".
  - Swipes are not enabled here; buttons are visible (08 limits swipes to Akış, Bugün and Takip).
- **Loading** — 3 `CommitmentCard` skeletons (quote lines).
- **Empty**
  - user_owes: "Açık sözün yok." / "Mail ve toplantı notlarında “Cuma gönderirim” gibi bir söz verdiğinde burada takip ederim."
  - they_owe: "Sana verilen açık söz yok."
- **Error** — `error.generic`; approve/reject failures → toast + retry.
- **Offline** — Cached; Tamamlandı and Ertele (non-smart) queued; the confirm/reject of proposals is blocked (they are approvals).
- **Permission edge case** — **Pro** (Commitments, M§44). Free: `ProGateCard` "TAAHHÜTLER · PRO" / "Verdiğin sözleri yakalar, zamanı gelince hatırlatırım." (no count; detection does not run for Free).
- **Approval requirement** — Ambiguous proposals are `commitment_create` approvals. Complete, snooze and edit are internal.
- **Analytics events** — `commitment_view{direction}`, `commitment_action{action: done|snooze|source|followup_draft|reopen}`, `commitment_confirm{decision}`, `pro_gate_viewed{feature:'commitments'}`.
- **Accessibility notes** — The quote is read as "Alıntı: …". Status badges are text. The segmented control is a `tablist`. Proposal cards announce "Önerilen, henüz kaydedilmedi".
- **Deep links** — `dijitalasistan://commitments`, `dijitalasistan://commitments?direction=they_owe`, `…?focus={id}`.
- **Tests**
  - Vitest `packages/domain/commitments/detect.test.ts` (TR phrases "Cuma gönderirim.", "Yarın ararım.", "Haftaya dönerim." resolve deterministically against a fixed now/tz; ambiguous phrases → proposal).
  - pgTAP: the `set_commitment_status` transition guard.
  - RNTL: status derivation at day boundaries; proposal confirm/reject calls.
  - Maestro `commitment-complete-snooze.yaml`.

### M-COMMIT-02 · Taahhüt detayı

- **Screen ID** — M-COMMIT-02
- **Route** — `app/commitments/[id].tsx`.
- **Entry points** — M-COMMIT-01 card; Flow commitment card tap; Person page; reminder notification for a snoozed or due commitment; deep link.
- **Primary purpose** — Full provenance and control of one commitment (M§18 fields: commitment, person, due date, source, status, confidence).
- **Data dependencies** — The `commitments` row (+ `user_overrides`); `contacts`; source preview (for email: sender, subject, `received_at`, evidence quote; for a meeting note: event title/time; for a capture: filename/page ref); linked reminders (`reminders?target_type=eq.commitment&target_id=eq.{id}&status=eq.scheduled`); `approval_events` if it was created via approval.
- **API dependencies** — PostgREST reads; `set_commitment_status`; PostgREST PATCH on user-editable columns via M-COMMIT-03; `POST /reminders/:id/cancel`; `POST /plan/proposals {commitment_id}` ("Planla"); `POST /followups/:threadId/draft`.
- **State dependencies** — `['commitment',id]` (persist).
- **Source design reference** — PRIMARY 04/4.8 card anatomy expanded; `SourceLine`; PRIMARY 05 "Planla" pattern (Part 3).
  - **Layout:** `NavHeader` (back · kicker "TAAHHÜT" · `more_horiz`) · badge + date · Lora quote 18/29 (editorial) · rows Taahhüt / Kime (→ person) / Son tarih ("Kaynakta kesinleşmiyor." if ungrounded) / Kaynak / Güven ("%92 güven" or "Emin değilim") · "HATIRLATICILAR" list (if any) · actions row · `SourceLine`.
- **Primary CTA** — "Tamamlandı" (open) / "Yeniden aç" (done within 30 days).
- **Secondary actions**
  - "Ertele" (snooze sheet).
  - "Kaynağı Gör" (exact source).
  - "Planla" → `POST /plan/proposals` → `plan/proposal/[id]` (Pro advanced planning; approval there).
  - "Takip Mesajı Hazırla" (they_owe + email).
  - Reminder row "İptal" → `POST /reminders/:id/cancel` + cancel the local notification.
  - `more_horiz`: "Düzenle" → M-COMMIT-03; "Bu bir söz değil" → RPC-06 `set_commitment_status(cancelled)` + RPC-17 `submit_ai_correction(p_target_type:'commitment', p_target_id, p_kind:'not_commitment')` (writes `ai_feedback{rating:-1, reason_code:'not_a_commitment'}` server-side) + back; "Bu nereden çıktı?" → M-SRC-01; "Bilgi yanlış…" → M-CORR-01 fact mode.
- **Loading** — Skeleton quote + rows.
- **Empty** — n/a (missing entity → "Bu taahhüt artık yok." + "Taahhütlere Dön").
- **Error** — `error.generic`; source missing at provider → the source row shows "Kaynak artık erişilemiyor" (evidence quote still shown).
- **Offline** — Cached; status and edit queued; Planla and draft blocked.
- **Permission edge case** — Pro (as the list).
- **Approval requirement** — None for status/edit; "Planla" → a calendar approval in Plan.
- **Analytics events** — `commitment_detail_view{direction, status}`, `commitment_action{…}`.
- **Accessibility notes** — Rows are a definition list (label + value in one accessible element). The person row is a link.
- **Deep links** — `dijitalasistan://commitments/{id}`.
- **Tests** — RNTL: ungrounded due date shows "Kaynakta kesinleşmiyor."; "Bu bir söz değil" writes both calls; reminder cancel cancels the local notification (mock expo-notifications).

### M-COMMIT-03 · Taahhüdü düzenle (edit sheet)

- **Screen ID** — M-COMMIT-03
- **Route** — Global `SheetHost`.
- **Entry points** — M-COMMIT-02 "Düzenle"; M-CORR-01 fact mode "Tarih yanlış" on a commitment.

- **Secondary actions** — "Son tarihi kaldır"; "Vazgeç".
- **Loading** — CTA spinner.
- **Empty** — n/a.

- **Offline** — Queued.
- **Permission edge case** — Pro.
- **Approval requirement** — None (internal).
- **Analytics events** — `commitment_edit{fields_changed_count}`, `ai_correction{target:'commitment', kind}`.

## 7. Life Intelligence

### M-LIFE-01 · Yaşam detayı (life detail sheet)

- **Screen ID** — M-LIFE-01
- **Route** — `app/life/[id].tsx` (`transparentModal` sheet; `id` = `life_events.id`).
- **Entry points** — Flow Kişisel cards (tap or "İncele" / "Kontrol Et"); Today life section (Part 1); Search results for flight/payment/subscription (SREQ-41); push `life_intel`; deep link.
- **Primary purpose** — One reusable detail sheet for shipment, flight, reservation, payment, subscription and security (M§23; SREQ-25).
  - Every field is source-linked.
  - Amounts and deadlines appear only if grounded; otherwise "Kaynakta kesinleşmiyor."
  - Security alerts offer only the source.
- **Data dependencies**
  - `life_events`: `id, type (life_event_type), status (item_status), title, fields jsonb` (typed per type, each field `{value, evidence_ref}`), `evidence, source_type (email_message|capture|android_notification), source_id, source_provider, source_timestamp, confidence, dedupe_key, user_overrides`.
  - Linked insight.
  - Existing calendar event match (flight/reservation already in calendar?).
  - Carrier/airline domain allowlists (`packages/domain/life/allowlists.ts`).
- **API dependencies**
  - PostgREST `life_events?id=eq.{id}`.
  - `set_insight_status` (done/dismiss) + PostgREST update `life_events.status` (column grant).
  - `POST /approvals` (`calendar_create` for flight/reservation "Takvime Ekle").
  - `apply_insight_feedback(p_kind:'stop_tracking')` on the linked insight ("Bir Daha Gösterme"; the learned preference is derived server-side) and `revert_insight_feedback` (undo).
  - RPC-17 `submit_ai_correction` ("Bilgi yanlış…").
- **State dependencies** — `['life-event',id]` (persist).
- **Source design reference**
  - PRIMARY 04/4.9 `LifeCard` (44 tile, kicker, title 17/23, two text actions) expanded into the sheet; 04/4.2 dark tokens.
  - SECONDARY `LifeCard.tsx` + the Today detail sheet IA (its contradictory hard-coded extras are rejected).
  - **Layout:** grabber · 44 tile (security tile `#FCEDE9`/`#C7432F`, others neutral) · kicker (KARGO…) + time · title · typed field rows · actions · `SourceLine`.
- **Primary CTA** — Per type (table). Every URL action needs a grounded URL whose registrable domain is on the type allowlist **and** matches the DKIM-aligned sender domain. It opens with `expo-web-browser`. If there is no valid URL, that action is not rendered and "Kaynağı Aç" becomes primary.

  | Type | Fields (each only if grounded) | Primary | Secondary |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | shipment | merchant, carrier, tracking no, delivery window, item count | "Takibi Gör" (`tracking_url`) | "Hatırlat" (delivery day), "Teslim alındı" (= done), "Kaynağı Aç" |
  | flight | airline, flight no, route (typographic →), departure/arrival time, gate, PNR (masked "···· 4K"), check-in state as stated | "Check-in" (`checkin_url`, only if check-in is stated as open) | "Takvime Ekle" (hidden if already in calendar) → `calendar_create` approval, "Hatırlat", "Kaynağı Aç" |
  | reservation | venue, date/time, party size, confirm-by, address, phone | "Teyit Et" (`confirm_url` → browser, or phone → `tel:`) | "Yol Tarifi" (address → iOS `maps://?daddr=`, Android `geo:0,0?q=`), "Takvime Ekle", "Hatırlat", "Kaynağı Aç" |
  | payment | payee, amount + currency (`Intl` tr-TR TRY), due date, masked account ref, previous amount (only if a prior bill is sourced) | "Hatırlat" (anchor = due date) | "Ödendi" (done; never "Öde"), "Kaynağı Aç" |
  | subscription | service, amount/period, renews at | "Hatırlat" (before renewal) | "Bir Daha Gösterme" (`apply_insight_feedback(stop_tracking)`: dismiss + `ai_feedback{rating:-1, reason_code:'stop_tracking'}`; with learning on the server derives `learned_preferences(group_key:'topics', target_type:'sender', target_ref:{merchant sender domain}, effect:{priority:'low'})`), "Kaynağı Aç" |
  | security | provider, event, device, location, time | **"Kaynağı Aç"** (in-app `mail/[id]`) | "Bendim" (done), "Önemli değil" (dismiss; no learning). A guidance text line (not a link): "Sen değilsen şifreni hesabının güvenlik ayarlarından değiştir." Links embedded in the alert are **never** rendered as CTAs. |

- **Secondary actions** — See the table. Plus: `SourceLine` → M-SRC-01; `more_horiz` → "Bilgi yanlış…" (M-CORR-01 fact mode), "Bu nereden çıktı?". "Kaynağı Aç" by source type:
  - email → `mail/[id]`;
  - capture → `capture/[id]`;
  - android_notification → the structured signal view inside this sheet (app name, time, extracted fields; raw text never exists server-side).
- **Loading** — Sheet skeleton: tile + 3 rows.
- **Empty** — Ungrounded amount/deadline rows render the value "Kaynakta kesinleşmiyor." (C-15). No other empty state.
- **Error**
  - Missing entity: "Bu kayıt artık yok." + "Kapat".
  - Stale item (e.g. a flight already departed, a delivery window passed): kicker suffix "· GEÇTİ"; primary becomes "Kaynağı Aç"; the pipeline expires it (`status=expired`) via `insight_refresh`.
- **Offline** — Cached fields; external handoffs allowed; "Takvime Ekle" blocked; "Ödendi" / "Bendim" / "Teslim alındı" queued; "Hatırlat" follows M-REM-01 offline rules.
- **Permission edge case**
  - Free feature.
  - Security classification requires `Authentication-Results` DKIM/SPF pass for the claimed sender domain (pipeline rule); failing mails never become security cards.
  - iOS copy never claims notification sources.
- **Approval requirement** — "Takvime Ekle" → `calendar_create`. Everything else is internal or a handoff.
- **Analytics events** — `life_detail_view{type}`, `life_action{type, action}`, `external_handoff{kind: tracking|checkin|confirm|maps|tel}`.
- **Accessibility notes** — Field rows read "{etiket}: {değer}". Buttons ≥44 pt. The security guidance line is plain text. Handoff buttons have hint "Tarayıcıda açılır".
- **Deep links** — `dijitalasistan://life/{id}`.
- **Tests**
  - Vitest `packages/domain/life/allowlists.test.ts` (domain matching, DKIM alignment requirement).
  - RNTL per type: ungrounded amount → "Kaynakta kesinleşmiyor."; no URL → the action is not rendered; security renders no external link buttons.
  - Deno `life_extraction_grounding_test.ts`: amounts re-parsed from evidence (tr-TR "1.842 TL" → 1842.00).
  - Maestro `life-sheet.yaml`.

## 8. Smart Reminders

### M-REM-01 · Akıllı Hatırlatıcı (Smart Reminder sheet)

- **Screen ID** — M-REM-01
- **Route** — `app/reminders/new.tsx` (`transparentModal` sheet). Params:
  - `targetType ∈ email_message|insight|commitment|life_event|calendar_event|capture_item`, `targetId`;
  - `title`, `anchorAt` (ISO, optional; the item's own time/deadline);
  - `anchorDateOnly` (bool);
  - `preset` (preselect);
  - `mode ∈ remind|snooze`.
- **Entry points**
  - Remind mode: M-MAIL-03 "Hatırlat", Flow payment/deadline "Hatırlat", M-WAIT-01 overflow, M-FUP-01 "Yarın Hatırlat", M-LIFE-01 "Hatırlat", capture results rows, Today "Hatırlat" (Part 1), Meeting / Assistant actions (Part 3).
  - Snooze mode: Flow/Waiting/Follow-up swipe or menu "Ertele", Commitment "Ertele".
  - Deep link.
- **Primary purpose** — The product's single reminder component (SREQ-35). Six M§29 presets with absolute times, "Uygun zamanda" with its reason, "Kendin seç" native picker, and an explicit confirm step (M§29, C-08). External destinations go through approval.
- **Data dependencies**
  - `user_preferences`: `timezone`, `morning_time` (default 08:00), `evening_time` (default 19:00), `working_hours_start/end` (default 09:00–18:00), `default_reminder_destination`; `notification_preferences.quiet_hours_enabled`, `quiet_start`, `quiet_end` (default on, 22:30–07:30 in the user tz; R-13).
  - Notification permission (`expo-notifications getPermissionsAsync`).
  - Connected accounts with `tasks_read/write` (Google Tasks, To Do) and the iOS EventKit reminders permission.
  - Existing scheduled reminder for the same target (to offer "Mevcut: {time} · Değiştir").
- **API dependencies**
  - Client-side preset resolution: `packages/domain/reminders/resolvePreset(preset, {now, tz, anchorAt, anchorDateOnly, prefs})` → `{fire_at | disabled_reason}`.
  - `POST /reminders/resolve-time {preset:'smart', target, anchorAt}` → `{fire_at, reason_text}` ("Takvimine göre: 13 Eylül Cumartesi 10:00 · mesai içindeki ilk boşluk"). It uses calendar_events + device snapshots, working hours and quiet hours, before the anchor, with ≥15 min free.
  - `POST /reminders {client_reminder_id, title, preset, fire_at, anchor_at?, channel:'local', subject?:{type, id}, origin}` (API-REM-02; `client_reminder_id` is stored as `reminders.idempotency_key`) → 201 `{reminder}`. The server re-resolves the preset; a difference over 60 s returns 409 `STATE_CONFLICT {resolved_fire_at}` and the sheet refreshes the time instead of committing it.
  - `POST /reminders/:id/cancel` (undo / replace).
  - External destination: `POST /approvals {action_type:'reminder_create', payload:{title, fire_at, destination}}` → M-APPR-04.
  - Snooze: `set_insight_status(snoozed, snoozed_until)` or `set_commitment_status(snoozed, snoozed_until)`, plus an optional `POST /reminders`.
- **State dependencies**
  - Local selection state.
  - `expo-notifications.scheduleNotificationAsync({identifier: reminder.id, trigger:{type:'date', date: fire_at}})`. Content follows `notification_preferences.detail_level`: `full` → title + context; `title_only` → title; `generic` → "Hatırlatıcın var.". `data:{deeplink}`.
  - Other signed-in devices schedule the same reminder on their next bootstrap (idempotent by identifier) and cancel when its status becomes cancelled.
- **Source design reference**
  - PRIMARY 04/4.11 "Ne zaman hatırlatayım?" (OptionRow + AI row `#F7F7FE`); hub `sheetDefs.remind`; design-system "Reminder sheet".
  - SECONDARY `SmartReminderSheet.tsx`: the explicit CTA, "Kendin seç" wording and the smart explainer are adopted; the fake success is rejected.
  - **Layout:**
    1. Title "Ne zaman hatırlatayım?" (snooze: "Ne zamana erteleyeyim?"), sub = context title.
    2. Six `OptionRow`s (remind mode) with meta = absolute time, formatted relative to today ("16:30", "Bu akşam 19:00", "Yarın 08:00", "Cmt 13 Eyl 10:00").
    3. The "Uygun zamanda" AI row shows the reason line in `#4547C9` 12/600.
    4. Destination row "Nereye: {Dijital Asistan bildirimi}" ›.
    5. Snooze mode: switch row "Zamanı gelince bildir" (default on).
    6. `PrimaryButton` "{Hatırlatıcıyı Kur | Ertele} · {resolved time}" (disabled until a valid selection). External destination: "Onaya Gönder".
- **Primary CTA**
  - In-app: "Hatırlatıcıyı Kur · {time}":
    1. generate a client uuid `client_reminder_id` (stored as `reminders.idempotency_key`);
    2. schedule the local notification;
    3. `POST /reminders`;
    4. toast "Hatırlatıcı kuruldu · {time} · Geri al" (5 s; undo → `/reminders/:id/cancel` + cancel the local notification);
    5. close.
  - Snooze: "Ertele · {time}" → status RPC (+ reminder when the switch is on) → toast "Ertelendi · {time} · Geri al".
  - External: "Onaya Gönder" → `POST /approvals` → M-APPR-04.
- **Secondary actions**
  - Presets (remind mode, M§29 order, S-04):

    | Preset | Label | Resolution | Disabled when (meta) |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `before_30m` | "30 dakika önce" | `anchorAt − 30 min` | no anchor or date-only (meta "Saat yok"); resolved ≤ now + 1 min (meta "Geçti") |
    | `before_1h` | "1 saat önce" | `anchorAt − 60 min` | same |
    | `this_evening` | "Bu akşam" | today at `evening_time` | now ≥ `evening_time` − 5 min ("Geçti") |
    | `tomorrow_morning` | "Yarın sabah" | tomorrow at `morning_time` | never |
    | `smart` | "Uygun zamanda" | server | no calendar connected (meta "Takvim bağlı değil"); offline (meta "Bağlantı gerekli") |
    | `custom` | "Kendin seç" | → M-REM-02 | never |

  - Snooze mode shows `this_evening`, `tomorrow_morning`, `smart` and `custom` (only M§29 presets; a later day such as next Monday is picked with "Kendin seç").
  - A time falling inside quiet hours is shown with the meta suffix "· sessiz saatte" and allowed (user choice). `smart` never picks quiet hours.
  - Destination row → M-REM-03.
- **Loading** — The `smart` row shows a spinner meta "Takvimine bakıyorum…" until `resolve-time` returns (timeout 8 s → meta "Şu an hesaplanamadı · Tekrar dene").
- **Empty** — n/a.
- **Error**
  - `POST /reminders` failure after the local schedule: the local notification is kept, the POST is retried from the queue, and the toast is "Kaydedildi · Eşitleme bekliyor".
  - A 409 duplicate idempotency key is treated as success.
- **Offline** — Non-smart presets are **queued** (local notification scheduled immediately; POST replayed; idempotent). `smart` is disabled. External destinations are blocked.
- **Permission edge case**
  - Notification permission undetermined → the CTA first calls `requestPermissionsAsync()`.
  - Permission denied → inline warning row (warning tone) "Bildirim izni kapalı; hatırlatıcı kaydedilir ama bu cihazda bildirim gösterilemez." with "Ayarlar" (`Linking.openSettings()`); creation is still allowed.
  - Apple Reminders needs EventKit full reminders access (requested only when that destination is picked).
  - Google Tasks and To Do need `tasks_write` (progressive, via M-REPLY-02 at approve time).
- **Approval requirement** — In-app: the confirm step (CTA) is the confirmation. External destinations and AI-suggested reminders: `reminder_create` approval (C-08, M§115).
- **Analytics events** — `reminder_sheet_open{origin, mode}`, `reminder_created{preset, destination, mode, queued}`, `reminder_undo`, `reminder_smart_resolve{result}`.
- **Accessibility notes** — Rows are `radio` in a `radiogroup` with meta included in the label ("Bu akşam, 19:00"). Disabled rows announce the reason. The CTA label includes the resolved time. The AI row's reason is read after the label.
- **Deep links** — `dijitalasistan://reminders/new?targetType=email_message&targetId={id}&anchorAt={iso}&title={t}`.
- **Tests**
  - Vitest `packages/domain/reminders/resolvePreset.test.ts`: tz Europe/Istanbul and a DST zone, anchor date-only, past anchors, evening cutoff; the preset union is exactly the six M§29 values (no `next_week`).
  - Deno `reminders_resolve_time_test.ts`: free-slot finder respects working hours, quiet hours and the anchor; the reason text is present.
  - RNTL: nothing is created before the CTA; offline queue; permission-denied warning; undo cancels both local and server.
  - Maestro `reminder-presets.yaml`.

### M-REM-02 · Kendin seç (date-time picker page)

- **Screen ID** — M-REM-02
- **Route** — The second page inside the M-REM-01 sheet (`reminders/new?step=custom`).
- **Entry points** — M-REM-01 "Kendin seç".
- **Primary purpose** — Pick an exact reminder time with the native picker (SREQ-36).
- **Data dependencies** — `timezone`; quiet hours (for the warning); `anchorAt` (the default proposal is `anchorAt − 1h` if in the future, else tomorrow `morning_time`).
- **API dependencies** — None (hands the value back to M-REM-01).
- **State dependencies** — Local.
- **Source design reference** — SECONDARY "TARİH VE SAAT SEÇ" IA; PRIMARY sheet spec; `@react-native-community/datetimepicker` (iOS inline `display="inline"` date + `spinner` time; Android sequential dialogs).
- **Primary CTA** — "Bu zamanı seç" → returns to M-REM-01 with `custom` selected and the meta "{Per 11 Eyl 14:00}".
- **Secondary actions** — Back (keeps the previous selection).
- **Loading** — n/a.
- **Empty** — n/a.
- **Error** — Past time: CTA disabled + "Geçmiş bir zaman seçilemez." Beyond 1 year: "En fazla 1 yıl sonrası seçilebilir."
- **Offline** — Works (non-smart).
- **Permission edge case** — None.
- **Approval requirement** — Inherits M-REM-01.
- **Analytics events** — `reminder_custom_pick{lead_bucket: <1h|<1d|<1w|>1w}`.
- **Accessibility notes** — Native pickers are accessible. The chosen value is announced on return.
- **Deep links** — Covered by M-REM-01.
- **Tests** — RNTL with a mocked picker; validation.

### M-REM-03 · Hatırlatıcı hedefi (destination picker page)

- **Screen ID** — M-REM-03
- **Route** — The third page inside the M-REM-01 sheet (`step=destination`).
- **Entry points** — M-REM-01 "Nereye" row.
- **Primary purpose** — Choose where the reminder lives. External destinations become approvals.
- **Data dependencies** — Platform; connected accounts (Google Tasks lists via `tasks_read`, To Do lists); EventKit availability (iOS); `default_reminder_destination`.
- **API dependencies** — PostgREST `connected_accounts`; the device's EventKit reminder lists via `expo-calendar` (iOS only, after permission); `user_preferences` update ("Varsayılan yap").
- **State dependencies** — Local.
- **Source design reference** — SECONDARY Integrations rows (Google Tasks / Microsoft To Do / Apple Reminders) restyled as `OptionRow`s.
- **Primary CTA** — Select a row → back to M-REM-01. Options:
  - "Dijital Asistan bildirimi" (default; meta "Bu cihaz ve diğer cihazların");
  - iOS "Apple Anımsatıcılar" (meta "Cihazda saklanır");
  - "Google Görevler · {email}" (meta "Yalnızca tarih saklanır; saat bildirimini Google göstermez");
  - "Microsoft To Do · {email}".
- **Secondary actions** — "Varsayılan yap" switch (writes `user_preferences.default_reminder_destination`); "Hesap bağla" (if none) → `settings/accounts`.
- **Loading** — List skeleton while loading accounts/lists.
- **Empty** — Only the in-app destination: rows for the providers show "Bağlı değil" with a chevron to `settings/accounts`.
- **Error** — EventKit permission denied → the Apple row meta "İzin verilmedi · Ayarlar".
- **Offline** — External rows disabled ("Bağlantı gerekli").
- **Permission edge case** — iOS EventKit full reminders access (`NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription`), requested on first pick. Android shows no Apple row (C-35).
- **Approval requirement** — Selecting an external destination switches the M-REM-01 CTA to "Onaya Gönder".
- **Analytics events** — `reminder_destination_select{destination}`.
- **Accessibility notes** — `radiogroup`; meta is included in the label.
- **Deep links** — None.
- **Tests** — RNTL platform filtering; the default-preference write.
