## 1. Plan

### M-PLAN-01 · Plan · Gün (Day)

- **Screen ID:** M-PLAN-01
- **Route:** `apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/plan/index.tsx` with search params `view=day` (default), `date=YYYY-MM-DD` (default today in the user's tz), `focus=event:{uuid}|task:{uuid}|commitment:{uuid}|proposal:{approvalId}`. `focus` scrolls to the item and gives it a 1.2 s highlight.
- **Entry points:**
  - Tab bar "Plan" (`calendar_today`).
  - M-PLAN-02 day column or label tap.
  - Morning Briefing "Programın" row, which links to `plan?date=today` (Part 1).
  - Search task result, which links to `plan?date={due}&focus=task:{id}` (M-SRCH-01).
  - Assistant calendar card for a day (M-ASST-02).
  - Widget "Sıradaki" when it has no meeting (Part 1).
  - Deep link or universal link.
- **Primary purpose:** A calm one-column day timeline that merges calendar events from every connected calendar (Google, Microsoft, Apple/Android device), tasks, commitments, timed life events, deadlines, labelled free gaps and AI proposals. Above it sits a Calendar Intelligence card that proposes placing work into free time (M§19, M§20, REQ-PLAN-01..05, REQ-CAL-01..07).
- **Data dependencies:**
  - `plan_range(p_from, p_to)` RPC (API RPC-09, `security invoker`). The row shape follows RPC-09, extended by registry decision with `life_event` and `deadline` rows. It returns normalized rows `{item_type: event|task|commitment|life_event|deadline|proposal, id, start_at, end_at, all_day, title, subtitle, icon_key, location, conference_host, attendee_count, organizer_is_self, prep_status, status, account_id, calendar_label, provider, source_type, source_id, source_timestamp, da_approval_id, approval_status}`. Sources:
    - `calendar_events` joined to `calendars`
    - `tasks`
    - `commitments` (`direction='user_owes'`, `status='open'`)
    - `life_events` (typed, grounded start)
    - `insights` (kind `deadline` with a due time)
    - `approval_actions` (`calendar_create`/`calendar_update` in `pending|approved|executing|failed`)
  - `insights` with `status='open'` and kind in (`schedule_suggestion`,`conflict`), or kind `meeting` with `reason_code` in (`back_to_back`,`prep_needed`,`leave_by`), whose `payload.local_date` equals the selected date or whose window intersects it.
  - `meeting_preps.status` via `prep_status`.
  - `user_preferences` (`timezone`, `working_hours_start`, `working_hours_end`, `work_days`).
  - `connected_accounts.status` and `sync_states.last_success_at` per calendar account.
  - Entitlement from `GET /me/bootstrap`.
  - Gaps are **computed client-side** by `packages/domain/plan/timeline.ts`:
    - A gap is ≥60 min between busy items inside working hours.
    - Label "{n} saat boşluk" / "{n} dk boşluk".
    - Meta: "Öğle yemeği ve odaklanma için uygun" if it overlaps 12:00–14:00 and is ≥90 min; "Odaklanma için uygun" if ≥90 min; else none.
- **API dependencies:**
  - PostgREST: `rpc/plan_range` (RPC-09), `insights`, `meeting_preps`.
  - `POST /plan/proposals`: "Planla" with `{insight_id}`; "Başka zaman" with `{insight_id, action:'next_slot'}`; empty-state "Odak bloğu öner" with `{kind:'focus_block', date}`.
  - `set_insight_status` RPC ("Böyle Kalsın", undo).
  - `ai_feedback` insert.
  - `POST /integrations/:accountId/sync` (pull-to-refresh).
  - `POST /integrations/:accountId/upgrade` (scope missing).
  - `GET /me/bootstrap`.
- **State dependencies:**
  - `usePlanUiStore` (zustand, MMKV-persisted per device): `view`, `lastSelectedDate` (reset to today on cold start after 04:00 local).
  - `useQuery(['plan','timeline',weekFrom,weekTo])`, prefetching the adjacent weeks.
  - `useEntitlement()`, `useOnline()`, `useColorScheme` + `appearance` preference, `AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled`.
  - `useCalendarPermission()` for device calendars, re-checked on `AppState` `active`.
  - A per-minute clock tick for the "now" line.
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY `05` 5.1 "Plan · Gün" and 5.1D (dark); hub `isPlan`/`isDay`; SECONDARY `PlanScreen.tsx` (conflict banner, header avatar, "Taahhütler" entry, IA only).
  - **Layout:** padding `14 20 0`, gap 16.
    - **Header row:** "Plan" 28/34/600; SegmentedControl "Gün | Hafta" (track `#E9E7E1`); **added:** a 32-pt avatar button → `settings/index` (M§8) and, when the selected week ≠ the current week, a text pill "Bugün".
    - **DayStrip:** 7 cells, Monday first, 42×60, r14.
      - Today is inverted (`#1A1917` / `#fff`; dark `#F2F0EB` / `#141311`).
      - **Selected non-today cell:** `#EDEDFC` / `#4547C9` (defined here; missing in the design).
      - Dots: `#E0DED7` (dark `#3A3936`) = day has ≥1 timed item; `#5B5CE2` = day has an open proposal or pending plan approval; none = empty.
    - **AIInsightCard "TAKVİM ZEKÂSI"** (radial glow, r20, p16): the highest-priority open intelligence insight for the day (priority order by `kind` / `reason_code`: conflict > schedule_suggestion > prep_needed > back_to_back > leave_by).
    - **"TÜM GÜN" strip** (added): chips for all-day events, date-only tasks, and commitments due without a time.
    - **Timeline:** rows min-h 68, gutter 44 right-aligned 12/500, hairline `rgba(27,25,23,.07)`.
    - **TimelineBlock variants:**

      | Variant | Style / meta |
      |---|---|
      | `event` | `#fff` + hairline border |
      | `proposal` | `#F7F7FE` + `1px dashed #A9AAF5`, meta "Önerilen · {süre} · AI görev bloğu". Pending: "Onay bekliyor". Executing: spinner + "Ekleniyor…". Failed: coral meta "Takvime eklenemedi · Tekrar dene". |
      | `planned` | DA-created event with `da_approval_id`: `#EDEDFC` + `1px solid #5B5CE2`, meta "Dijital Asistan ekledi" |
      | `gap` | Transparent + `1px dashed rgba(27,25,23,.15)` |
      | `life` | `#FDF6EC` |
      | `deadline` | `#fff` block with `flag` icon + "SON TARİH" warning badge + source meta "{kaynak} · Mailden tespit edildi". **Deviation:** the design used the dashed AI style for a sourced deadline. Dashed is reserved for proposals (01 rule 1g). |
      | `task` | `task_alt`, meta "Görev · {Google Tasks|Microsoft To Do|Apple Anımsatıcılar}" |
      | `commitment` | `handshake`, meta "Söz · {kişi}" |

    - **Overlaps:** the second block is indented 24 with the coral 16×2 marker and a trailing text link "Çakışma" (→ M-PLAN-07).
    - **"Now" line** (today only): 1 px `#1A1917` (dark `#F2F0EB`) with a 6 px dot.
  - **Meta formats:** "{süre} · {konum|Online}" plus "· Hazırlık hazır" when `prep_status='ready'`, plus "· {takvim etiketi}" when >1 calendar is connected.
  - **Verbatim design copy:** "Plan", "Gün", "Hafta", "TAKVİM ZEKÂSI", "Planla", "Başka zaman", "{n} saat boşluk".
- **Primary CTA:** "Planla" (`event_available` 18) on the TAKVİM ZEKÂSI card when the card is a `schedule_suggestion`.
  - Calls `POST /plan/proposals {insight_id}` and receives `{approval}`, then `router.push('/plan/proposal/'+approval.id)` (M-PLAN-03).
  - For other signal kinds the primary action is that signal's first action (§0.10).
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):**
  - Segment "Hafta": switches to M-PLAN-02 in place (`view=week`, persisted).
  - Day cell tap: sets `date`, and the timeline loads from cache or fetches. Horizontal swipe on the strip moves ±1 week (the selected weekday is kept). "Bugün" pill returns to today.
  - Avatar: `settings/index`.
  - "Başka zaman": `POST /plan/proposals {insight_id, action:'next_slot'}`.
    - On `{insight}`: cross-fade the card to the new suggestion and toast "Yeni öneri: {Gün} {HH:MM}–{HH:MM}".
    - On `{none:true}`: collapse the card and toast "Bu hafta uygun başka boşluk bulamadım."
    - The server marks the previous insight `dismissed`, rejects its pending approval (if any) with `rejection_reason='superseded'`, and writes `ai_feedback{feature:'assistant_intent', target_type:'insight', target_id, rating:-1, reason_code:'other'}`. Schedule proposals are a T0 surface, so the feedback uses `assistant_intent` (registry decision on `ai_feedback.feature`).
  - "Böyle Kalsın" (conflict, back-to-back): `set_insight_status(id,'dismissed')` + `ai_feedback{feature:'assistant_intent', target_type:'insight', target_id:id, rating:-1, reason_code:'not_important'}`. Toast "Tamam, bunu bir daha göstermem" + "Geri al" (5 s → `set_insight_status(id,'open')`).
  - Insight card body tap: shared `SourceSheet` "Bu nereden çıktı?". It shows kind, reason, the source rows (each opens its real screen) and a "Neden önemli?" line (M§97, M§131).
  - **Timeline taps:**

    | Item | Opens |
    |---|---|
    | Meeting event (≥1 attendee other than self), Pro | M-MEET-01 |
    | Meeting event, Free | M-PLAN-09 (its prep row shows the Pro gate) |
    | Non-meeting event, or `planned` | M-PLAN-09 |
    | `proposal` | `plan/proposal/{approvalId}` |
    | `gap` | M-PLAN-05 |
    | `life` | `life/{id}` |
    | `deadline` | Its source (`mail/{messageId}` for email sources, M-PLAN-06 for tasks, `commitments/{id}` for commitments) |
    | `task` | M-PLAN-06 |
    | `commitment` | `commitments/{id}` |
    | Conflict "Çakışma" link | `plan/conflict/{insightId}` |

  - Pull-to-refresh: sync every calendar account (throttled) + refetch → ST-RECONNECT line and "Güncel · {HH:MM}".
- **Loading:** ST-SKELETON. Header, segment and strip render instantly from local date math. The intelligence card skeleton is 1 card; the timeline skeleton is 4 blocks (68 px) at real widths. After 10 s without data: "Takvimin hâlâ yükleniyor." (inline, no fake progress).
- **Empty:**
  - (a) **Today, no items, calendar connected:** 08 `empty/plan`. Icon `self_improvement` on `#EDEDFC` / `#4547C9`, "Bugün takvimin oldukça sakin.", sub "Yarın {HH:MM} {ilk etkinlik} ile başlıyorsun. Bugünü odak için kullanabilirsin." (next event within 7 days) or "Önümüzdeki 7 günde planlanmış etkinliğin yok. Bugünü odak için kullanabilirsin.", CTA "Odak bloğu öner" → `POST /plan/proposals {kind:'focus_block', date}` → M-PLAN-03 (Pro; Free sees the Pro gate).
  - (b) **Another date, no items:** "{Gün adı} takvimin boş." with the same CTA.
  - (c) **No calendar connected:** tile "Takvimini bağla." / "Plan, takvimin bağlandığında günlerini ve boşluklarını gösterir." / CTA "Takvim Bağla" → `settings/accounts` (connect flow, Part 4). Tasks and commitments still render in the TÜM GÜN strip.
  - (d) **No open intelligence insight:** the card is hidden (never an empty card).
- **Error:**
  - Timeline fetch fails with no cache: ST-ERROR-GENERIC "Plan yüklenemedi."
  - Account `needs_reauth`: ST-OAUTH-EXPIRED above the timeline (ST-PARTIAL).
  - Sync lag: ST-SYNC-DELAYED.
  - `POST /plan/proposals` fails (5xx or network): the card stays and toast "Şu an öneri hazırlayamıyorum. Birazdan tekrar dene." Proposals come from the deterministic T0 slot finder, so an AI outage never blocks them.
  - `no_free_slot` (`STATE_CONFLICT`): the card collapses and toast "Bu aralıkta boş zaman bulamadım."
  - `slot_unavailable`: the card refreshes and toast "Bu boşluk artık dolu."
  - `402 pro_required`: ProGateCard(advanced_planning) replaces the card.
- **Offline:** ST-OFFLINE-READ for the cached range today−1…today+7.
  - Dates outside the cache: "Bu gün çevrimdışı görüntülenemiyor." + "Bugüne Dön".
  - "Planla", "Başka zaman" and gap actions: ST-OFFLINE-WRITE.
  - "Böyle Kalsın": queued (idempotent RPC).
- **Permission edge case:**
  - Device calendar permission revoked (checked on focus): ST-CAL-PERMISSION card. Device-sourced blocks are hidden; other providers still render.
  - Provider account `partial` without calendar scope: ST-CAL-PERMISSION with "İzin Ver" → `/integrations/:accountId/upgrade`.
  - iOS 17 write-only access is never requested (reading needs full access).
- **Approval requirement:**
  - Viewing needs none.
  - Every calendar change ("Planla", focus block, prep block, shift) goes through a `calendar_create`/`calendar_update` approval (M§3.8, M§19, M§115).
  - Dismissals and feedback are internal (no approval, undo toast).
- **Analytics events:** `plan_viewed{view:'day', relative_day}` (clamped −7..30), `plan_date_changed{method:'strip_tap'|'swipe'|'today_button'}`, `plan_item_opened{item_type}`, `calendar_insight_action{signal, action}`, `plan_refreshed{result:'ok'|'error'}`, `pro_gate_viewed{feature:'advanced_planning'}`. No titles, names or times (ADR-13).
- **Accessibility notes:**
  - DayStrip is an `adjustable` group with `accessibilityActions` increment/decrement for week paging. Each cell has role `button` and a label like "Cuma 25 Eylül, 4 öğe, seçili".
  - Timeline row label: "{saat}, {başlık}, {süre}, {konum}, {durum}". Proposals announce "Önerilen, henüz takvimde değil".
  - Conflict marker plus the "Çakışma" text (colour is never the only cue).
  - Hit slop ≥44 pt / 48 dp on all text actions.
  - Dynamic Type up to 200%: the gutter becomes a stacked time line above the block when the scale is >1.3.
  - Reduce Motion: no cross-fades; instant swaps.
  - Focus returns to the tapped row after a sheet closes.
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://plan?view=day&date=2026-09-24&focus=event:{uuid}`; universal `https://<web-domain>/app/plan?...`. An invalid `date` or `focus` falls back to today and no focus.
- **Tests:**
  - vitest `packages/domain/src/plan/timeline.test.ts`: merge order; all-day strip; gaps ≥60 min within working hours only; the lunch meta rule; overlap grouping; DST fixtures (`America/New_York` 2026-03-08 and 2026-11-01); items spanning midnight.
  - vitest `calendar-signals.test.ts`: every §0.10 rule; the leave-by rule emits nothing without an evidence span; every emitted row uses a canonical `insight_kind` with its subtype in `reason_code` and a DB §1.5 `dedupe_key`.
  - jest-expo RNTL `apps/mobile/src/features/plan/__tests__/PlanDayScreen.test.tsx`: skeleton → data; empty variants a–d; Pro gate for Free; offline disables Planla; "Böyle Kalsın" undo; a11y labels present.
  - pgTAP `supabase/tests/rpc/plan_range.test.sql`: owner sees own rows only (including `life_event` and `deadline` rows); another user gets 0 rows; anon is denied.
  - Maestro `apps/mobile/e2e/plan/plan-day.yaml` (demo): open tab, page weeks, tap a meeting → prep, tap a gap → sheet, dark-mode assert.

### M-PLAN-02 · Plan · Hafta (Week, density + Calendar Intelligence)

- **Screen ID:** M-PLAN-02
- **Route:** `apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/plan/index.tsx?view=week&date={any date in week}`
- **Entry points:** the "Hafta" segment on M-PLAN-01; deep link; Today's weekly teaser card (Part 1) → `plan?view=week`.
- **Primary purpose:** Tell the week's load as a density story (not a grid), and list Calendar Intelligence insights with at most 2 actions each (M§20).
- **Data dependencies:**
  - `plan_week_density(p_week_start date)` RPC (RPC-18, accepted registry addition; `security invoker`). It returns 7 rows `{local_date, meeting_minutes, focus_minutes, event_count, is_hot, is_today}`.
    - `meeting_minutes` = non-all-day busy events with ≥1 other attendee or a conference URL.
    - `focus_minutes` = DA-created blocks + timed tasks.
    - `is_hot` = `meeting_minutes ≥ 300` (domain constant `HOT_DAY_MEETING_MINUTES`).
  - `insights` open, kind in (`conflict`,`meeting`,`schedule_suggestion`,`deadline`) within the week; `meeting` rows only with `reason_code` in (`back_to_back`,`prep_needed`,`leave_by`). Sorted by severity (conflict, deadline today, back_to_back, prep_needed, leave_by, schedule_suggestion), then time. Max 6 shown, then "{n} öneri daha" expands.
  - Entitlement.
- **API dependencies:**
  - PostgREST `rpc/plan_week_density`, `insights`.
  - `POST /plan/proposals` (prep block `{insight_id}`; "Zaman Ayır" `{kind:'task_block', task_id}`).
  - `POST /approvals` (back-to-back shift → `calendar_update`).
  - `POST /followups/:threadId/draft` is not used here. "Yeni Saat Öner" uses `POST /plan/conflicts/:insightId/resolve` semantics for back-to-back: `POST /plan/proposals {insight_id, action:'propose_new_time'}` returns an `email_send` approval (see proposed additions).
  - `set_insight_status`, `ai_feedback`.
- **State dependencies:** `usePlanUiStore.view='week'`; `['plan','week',weekStart]`; entitlement; online; reduce motion.
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY `05` 5.2 "Plan · Hafta + Takvim Zekâsı"; hub `isWeek`.
  - **Density card:** `#fff` r20 p16.
    - Kicker "{7–13} {EYLÜL} · YOĞUNLUK" and "{n} etkinlik".
    - Bars area h120, gap 8, bar r5, gap 3.
    - Scale: 120 px = 600 min, clamped. Minimum visible bar is 4 px when minutes >0.
    - Colours: normal `#D9D6F7` (Toplantı) / `#EDEDFC` (Odak); hot day `#F3B7AE` / `#E0553F`; today `#5B5CE2` / `#A9AAF5`.
    - Day labels 11/600: normal `#6B6860`, hot `#C7432F`, today `#5B5CE2`.
    - Legend "Toplantı", "Odak", "Yoğun".
    - **Added:** 44-pt chevron buttons "Önceki hafta" / "Sonraki hafta" in the card header (a swipe alternative).
  - Section kicker "TAKVİM ZEKÂSI".
  - **InsightRowCards:** `#fff` r16 p14/16; icon 20 in semantic text colour (amber `#9A6300` density, blue `#2262BE` travel, indigo `#5B5CE2` opportunity, coral `#C7432F` conflict); title 15/600; body 13/19; text actions 13/600 (`#4547C9` primary, `#6B6860` secondary).
  - Verbatim copy used as templates: "Yarın oldukça yoğun.", "{HH:MM} ve {HH:MM} toplantıların arka arkaya. Arada mola yok; …", "10:15'e Kaydır", "Böyle Kalsın", "{HH:MM} toplantısı öncesi 45 dakika boşluğun var.", "Hazırlığı Buraya Koy", "Seçenekleri Gör", "12:40'a Hatırlat".
  - **Rejected fixture:** "Kadıköy → Nişantaşı · 38 dk trafik tahmini" (no routing source; §0.10 leave-by rule).
  - The dark variant is derived from the 01 DARK tokens: card `#1F1E1B` + 6% ring; normal bars `rgba(133,134,242,.35)` / `rgba(133,134,242,.18)`; hot `rgba(240,139,120,.45)` / `#F08B78`; today `#8586F2` / `#A9AAF5`.
- **Primary CTA:** the first action of the top insight card (per §0.10). For a conflict: "Seçenekleri Gör" → `plan/conflict/{id}`.
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):**
  - Bar column or day label tap: `view=day&date={that day}`.
  - Chevrons or swipe: ±1 week.
  - "{HH:MM}'e Kaydır": `POST /approvals` with a `calendar_update` payload `{event_id, new_start, new_end}` (stored with `approval_actions.origin='plan_proposal'`, `origin_ref_id` = the insight id) → the approval preview opens in an in-screen sheet using M-PLAN-08 anatomy (side effect "Katılımcılara güncelleme gönderilir"), then approve.
  - "Yeni Saat Öner" (not organizer): returns an `email_send` approval with the draft to the organizer; the preview shows the draft; "Düzenle" → `mail/{messageId}/reply?draftId=`.
  - "Hazırlığı Buraya Koy": `POST /plan/proposals {insight_id}` → M-PLAN-03 (title "Hazırlık: {başlık}").
  - "Hazırlığı Aç": `meeting/{eventId}/prep`.
  - "{HH:MM}'e Hatırlat": `reminders/new?sourceType=insight&sourceId={id}&at={ISO}` (Smart Reminder sheet, confirm step, C-08).
  - "Kaynağı Aç": the source screen.
  - "Zaman Ayır": `POST /plan/proposals {kind:'task_block', task_id}` → M-PLAN-03.
  - "Planla" / "Başka zaman" / "Böyle Kalsın": as M-PLAN-01.
  - Card body tap: SourceSheet.
- **Loading:** ST-SKELETON. Density card with 7 grey columns at 40% height; 3 insight skeleton cards.
- **Empty:**
  - Week with no events: density card shows "0 etkinlik" with flat bars and the sub-line "Bu hafta takviminde etkinlik yok." (no CTA; it is plain text, not a button, SREQ-85).
  - No insights: neutral line "Bu hafta dengeli görünüyor." under the kicker.
  - No calendar: M-PLAN-01 empty (c).
- **Error:** ST-ERROR-GENERIC "Hafta yüklenemedi.", ST-PARTIAL, ST-OAUTH-EXPIRED, ST-SYNC-DELAYED. Action failures follow §0.4 codes (`not_organizer` → toast "Bu toplantıyı yalnızca düzenleyen taşıyabilir." and the card swaps to "Yeni Saat Öner").
- **Offline:** ST-OFFLINE-READ for the current and next week. Actions follow ST-OFFLINE-WRITE; "Böyle Kalsın" is queued.
- **Permission edge case:** as M-PLAN-01. A `calendar_update` on an account without `calendar_write` follows §0.4.5.
- **Approval requirement:** `calendar_update` (shift), `calendar_create` (prep/task/focus blocks), `email_send` (new-time proposal). In-app reminders use the reminder sheet's confirm step (C-08). Dismiss is internal.
- **Analytics events:** `plan_viewed{view:'week', week_offset}`, `plan_week_paged{direction}`, `calendar_insight_shown{signal}` (once per insight per local day), `calendar_insight_action{signal, action}`, `approval_created{type, origin:'plan_week'}`.
- **Accessibility notes:**
  - Each bar column is one accessible element, e.g. "Çarşamba 23 Eylül: 9 saat toplantı, 1 saat odak, yoğun gün. Gün görünümünü aç." with role `button`.
  - A visually hidden summary precedes the chart: "Bu hafta {n} etkinlik; en yoğun gün {gün}."
  - Legend swatches have text labels.
  - The insight icon carries meaning via the title text too.
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://plan?view=week&date=2026-09-21`.
- **Tests:**
  - vitest `plan/density.test.ts`: minutes classification, hot threshold, scale clamp.
  - RNTL `PlanWeekScreen.test.tsx`: chart a11y labels; ≤2 actions per card; the "Kaydır" vs "Yeni Saat Öner" switch on `organizer_is_self`; Pro gate.
  - Deno `supabase/functions/api/tests/plan_proposals_test.ts`: `not_organizer`, `slot_unavailable`, 402 for Free.
  - Maestro `plan/plan-week.yaml`.

### M-PLAN-03 · Önerilen zaman bloğu (Schedule proposal approval sheet)

- **Screen ID:** M-PLAN-03
- **Route:** `apps/mobile/app/plan/proposal/[id].tsx` (`id` = `approval_actions.id`, type `calendar_create`), `presentation:'formSheet'`, detents [0.62, 0.95].
- **Entry points:**
  - "Planla", "Hazırlığı Buraya Koy", "Zaman Ayır", "Odak bloğu öner" and gap actions (M-PLAN-01/02/05/06).
  - Proposal block tap on the timeline.
  - A Today schedule-suggestion card (Part 1).
  - Deep link.
  - Approval Center rows with `origin='plan_proposal'` open `approvals/[id]` (Part owning Approvals). This sheet is the Plan-context presentation of the same row.
- **Primary purpose:** Implement M§19 "Proposed block → User approval → Calendar update → Updated timeline" for one exact block, with the six-row approval contract (§0.4).
- **Data dependencies:**
  - `approval_actions` row (DB column names): `id, action_type, status, payload{calendar_id, account_id, title, start_at, end_at, description_marker, attendees:[], send_updates:'none', window_start, window_end}, payload_version, idempotency_key, approval_expires_at, last_error_code, source_type, source_id, origin, origin_ref_id`.
  - Source `tasks`/`commitments` row (title, due).
  - `calendars` + `connected_accounts` (destination label, capability).
  - `insights` (rationale).
- **API dependencies:**
  - PostgREST `approval_actions` (select by id; polling).
  - `PATCH /approvals/:id` (time change from M-PLAN-04; title edit).
  - `POST /approvals/:id/approve {idempotency_key}`.
  - `POST /approvals/:id/reject {reason:'user_cancel'}`.
  - `POST /integrations/:accountId/upgrade`.
  - `POST /approvals/:id/device-execution` (API-APR-05; device calendars).
  - `POST /plan/proposals {insight_id, action:'next_slot'}` (expired state).
- **State dependencies:** `useApproval(id)` with the polling policy from §0.4.4; the local step state `review | change_time | executing | done | failed | expired`; `useOnline()`; haptics preference (`user_preferences.haptics_enabled`).
- **Source design reference:**
  - SECONDARY `PlanScreen.tsx` "AI Öneri" sheet (SREQ-19), restyled to the PRIMARY sheet spec (`#fff`, r28 top, p10 20 44, grabber 36×5 `#E0DED7`).
  - PRIMARY "Planlandı" success tokens `#E4F5EA` / `#1E7A47` + `check`; 08 "Başarı" motion (ring 500 ms, icon 450 ms at a 100 ms delay).
  - **Content:**
    - Kicker `auto_awesome` "ÖNERİLEN ZAMAN BLOĞU" (`#5B5CE2` 12/600).
    - Time "14:00 – 15:00" 22/28/600 + date line "Yarın · 24 Eylül Perşembe".
    - Title "{Teklif hazırlama}" 17/600.
    - Approval grid (64 px label column, 13/19):
      - "Ne" = "Takvimine {60 dk}'lık bir blok eklenir"
      - "Neden" = "{Yarın 14:00–16:30} arasında {2,5 saat} boşluğun var. {Görev} son tarihi {26 Eylül}."
      - "Kaynak" = "Görev · Google Tasks · Son tarih 26 Eyl" (tappable)
      - "Hesap" = "Google Takvim · {calendar name}"
      - "Etkisi" = "Davetli yok · Kimseye bildirim gitmez"
    - Buttons (h48, r14): "Onayla" (primary), "Saati Değiştir" (tonal), "İptal" (ghost).
  - The secondary "Takvime eklendi" fake timer is **not** copied.
- **Primary CTA:** "Onayla" → §0.4.4.
  - On `executed`: the button morphs to "Planlandı" (success tokens), then the success view: ring + "Planlandı" / "{Yarın 14:00–15:00} “{Teklif hazırlama}” takvimine eklendi." + button "Plan'a Dön".
  - "Plan'a Dön" dismisses the sheet and routes to `plan?date={day}&focus=event:{created calendar_events.id}`.
  - Plan queries are invalidated. The worker upserts the created event from the provider response (F-10).
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):**
  - "Saati Değiştir": pushes M-PLAN-04 inside the sheet.
  - "İptal": `POST /approvals/:id/reject {reason:'user_cancel'}` → dismiss. The insight stays `open`, so "Planla" can be used again.
  - Swipe-down or scrim tap: dismiss **without** rejecting. The approval stays `pending`, visible in Approval Center, and expires at `approval_expires_at` (= block start).
  - Tap on "Kaynak": opens the source (`plan?focus=task:` or `commitments/{id}`) after dismissing the sheet.
  - Title tap (pencil `edit` 18 trailing): inline text edit (max 120 chars) → `PATCH /approvals/:id {payload:{title}}` → new version and key.
  - Failed "Tekrar Dene": re-approve with the same key.
  - Expired "Yeni saat bul": `POST /plan/proposals {insight_id, action:'next_slot'}` → replace the route with the new approval id.
- **Loading:** a 3-line skeleton while the approval loads. During `approved`/`executing` the button shows a spinner and "Takvime ekleniyor…"; the other buttons are disabled.
- **Empty:** not applicable (a missing row → ST-NOT-FOUND inside the sheet: "Bu öneri artık yok.").
- **Error:**
  - `failed`: coral line with the mapped reason:
    - `provider_reauth_required` → "{Google} Takvim bağlantısı yenilenmeli." plus "Yeniden Bağlan"
    - `slot_unavailable` → "Bu saat artık dolu." plus "Saati Değiştir"
    - `quota_exceeded` → "{Google} şu an yoğun. Birazdan tekrar dene."
    - default → "Takvime eklenemedi."
  - `expired`: "Bu öneri geçti." / "Önerilen saat geçtiği için eklenemez." + "Yeni saat bul".
  - `approval_version_mismatch`: silent refetch + toast "Öneri güncellendi, tekrar kontrol et."
- **Offline:** the sheet renders from cache. "Onayla", "Saati Değiştir" and "İptal" are disabled per ST-OFFLINE-WRITE with the hint "Onay için bağlantı gerekli."
- **Permission edge case:** `capability_missing` → §0.4.5 inline "Takvime yazmak için {Google}'dan ek izin gerekiyor." / "İzin Ver". Device calendar → §0.4.6; Android `WRITE_CALENDAR` denial → failed "Takvime yazma izni verilmedi." + "Ayarları Aç" (`Linking.openSettings()`).
- **Approval requirement:** **Yes.** `calendar_create`. The server executes with provider idempotency: Google deterministic event `id` (base32hex of the approval id; 409 means already done), Graph `transactionId`, `extendedProperties.private.da_approval_id`.
- **Analytics events:** `schedule_proposal_opened{origin}`, `schedule_proposal_time_changed`, `schedule_proposal_decided{decision:'approved'|'cancelled'|'dismissed'}`, `approval_decided{type:'calendar_create', decision, via:'inline_sheet'}`, `approval_executed{type, result}`.
- **Accessibility notes:**
  - The sheet has `accessibilityViewIsModal`. Initial focus is on the time heading.
  - The grid is read as label/value pairs.
  - Success is announced via `announceForAccessibility("Planlandı. {özet}")`.
  - Buttons are ≥48 pt. Under Reduce Motion the success ring is replaced by an instant icon.
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://plan/proposal/{approvalId}` (opens M-PLAN-01 underneath for the proposal's date).
- **Tests:**
  - RNTL `ProposalSheet.test.tsx`: renders all six rows; success only on `executed` (a mocked poll sequence `approved→executing→executed`); failed retry reuses the key; swipe-dismiss does not call reject.
  - Deno `approvals_execute_calendar_test.ts`: idempotent double execute (the second call is a no-op); 409 deterministic id → executed.
  - pgTAP `approval_transitions.test.sql` (illegal `pending → executed`).
  - Maestro `plan/plan-schedule-proposal.yaml` (Flow F-01).

### M-PLAN-04 · Saati Değiştir (free-slot picker)

- **Screen ID:** M-PLAN-04
- **Route:** in-sheet step pushed inside M-PLAN-03, M-PLAN-08 and the M-PLAN-09 "Saati Değiştir" sheet (no own URL). Parameters: `approvalId?`, `eventId?`, `durationMinutes`, `date`.
- **Entry points:** "Saati Değiştir" in M-PLAN-03, M-PLAN-08 (move option) and M-PLAN-09.
- **Primary purpose:** Let the user pick a new time **limited to real free slots** (SREQ-19) so a proposal can never double-book.
- **Data dependencies:** free slots for the selected day and the next 6 days; the current payload `start_at`/`end_at`; working hours.
- **API dependencies:**
  - `GET /plan/free-slots?from=&to=&min_minutes={duration}&exclude_approval_id={id}&exclude_event_id={id}`. The response is `{slots:[{start_at,end_at,minutes}]}`, computed server-side across all busy items incl. pending approvals, working hours and quiet hours.
  - `PATCH /approvals/:id {payload:{start_at,end_at}}`, or for M-PLAN-09 `POST /approvals {type:'calendar_update', …}`.
- **State dependencies:** local `selectedDay`, `selectedSlotStart`; `useQuery(['plan','free-slots',day,duration])` (not persisted).
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY sheet option-row spec (row min-h 52, icon 20, 15/500, meta 12).
  - A day chip row reuses FilterChip (h30, r999, selected `#1A1917` / `#fff`).
  - Each slot row:
    - Leading `schedule`.
    - Title "{14:00–15:00}".
    - Meta "{2,5 saat} boşluk içinde".
    - The recommended row (first slot closest to the original time) uses the "Önerilen" style (bg `#F7F7FE`, `auto_awesome`, meta `#4547C9`).
  - Header "Saati Değiştir" 19/600 / sub "Yalnızca takviminde boş olan saatler gösterilir."
  - No free-form time picker (prevents conflicts). **This picker is defined here; the design lacks it.**
- **Primary CTA:** tap a slot → "Bu saati kullan".
  - `PATCH /approvals/:id` returns the new `payload_version` and `idempotency_key`, then pops back to the parent sheet, which re-renders "Değişim".
  - For M-PLAN-09 it creates a `calendar_update` approval and shows the M-PLAN-08 anatomy.
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):** day chips (Bugün … +6 gün) refetch the slots; "Vazgeç" (header left) pops without changes.
- **Loading:** 4 skeleton rows.
- **Empty:** "Bu gün {süre} için boş zaman yok." + the day chips stay available; if no slot exists in 7 days: "Önümüzdeki 7 günde uygun boşluk bulamadım." + "Vazgeç".
- **Error:** ST-ERROR-GENERIC inline "Boş saatler yüklenemedi." + "Tekrar Dene". `slot_unavailable` on PATCH → refetch + toast "Bu saat az önce doldu."
- **Offline:** ST-OFFLINE-WRITE; the list shows "Boş saatleri görmek için bağlantı gerekli."
- **Permission edge case:** if any calendar is in ST-CAL-PERMISSION, the sub-line adds "{Hesap} takvimi görünmüyor; oradaki etkinlikler hesaba katılmadı." (honest partial data).
- **Approval requirement:** it edits a pending approval (new version and key per ADR state machine). It never executes.
- **Analytics events:** `free_slot_picker_opened{origin}`, `free_slot_selected{day_offset, recommended:boolean}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** the slot list is a radio group ("14:00–15:00, 2,5 saatlik boşlukta, önerilen"); the selected state is announced; Dynamic Type wraps meta below the title.
- **Deep links:** none (sheet step).
- **Tests:**
  - vitest `plan/free-slots.test.ts`: excludes pending approvals, quiet hours and declined events; the minimum duration; tz boundaries.
  - RNTL `FreeSlotPicker.test.tsx`.
  - Deno `plan_free_slots_test.ts` (RLS-scoped user, `exclude_approval_id`).

### M-PLAN-05 · Boşluk sheet (free gap actions)

- **Screen ID:** M-PLAN-05
- **Route:** in-screen `Sheet` on M-PLAN-01 (params: `start_at`, `end_at`).
- **Entry points:** tap on a `gap` timeline row.
- **Primary purpose:** Turn visible free time into a real plan without typing (M§19). "Boşluk da bilgidir."
- **Data dependencies:** the gap window; the top 3 open `tasks`/`commitments` (`user_owes`) due within 7 days without a DA block, ranked by due date (from the `plan_range` cache + `tasks`).
- **API dependencies:**
  - `POST /plan/proposals {kind:'focus_block', start_at, end_at}`.
  - `POST /plan/proposals {kind:'task_block', task_id|commitment_id, start_at, end_at}`.
  - Both return an approval → M-PLAN-03.
- **State dependencies:** entitlement; online.
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY bottom-sheet spec; option rows. The design audit lists "Odak bloğu öner / Görev yerleştir" for gaps.
  - Title "{12:00–14:30} · {2,5 saat} boşluk".
  - Rows:
    - `self_improvement` "Odak bloğu öner" / meta "Takvimine “Odak zamanı” bloğu eklenir"
    - per task: `task_alt` "“{Görev}” için zaman ayır" / meta "Son tarih {26 Eyl}"
    - `notifications` "Bu saatte hatırlat" / meta "Boşluk başlarken hatırlatırım"
- **Primary CTA:** "Odak bloğu öner" → proposal → M-PLAN-03.
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):**
  - A task row → `task_block` proposal → M-PLAN-03.
  - "Bu saatte hatırlat" → `reminders/new?sourceType=plan_gap&at={start_at}` (reminder sheet with confirm).
  - Scrim or swipe closes.
- **Loading:** a button spinner on the tapped row while `POST /plan/proposals` runs.
- **Empty:** no candidate tasks → the task rows are omitted (focus and reminder rows remain).
- **Error:** proposal errors as M-PLAN-01 (toast); `402` → ProGateCard(advanced_planning) inside the sheet.
- **Offline:** the rows are disabled per ST-OFFLINE-WRITE (the reminder row too, because the reminder is created server-side).
- **Permission edge case:** none beyond the M-PLAN-03 write-capability handling.
- **Approval requirement:** the resulting `calendar_create` is approved in M-PLAN-03; the reminder uses the confirm step.
- **Analytics events:** `plan_gap_opened{minutes_bucket}`, `plan_gap_action{action:'focus'|'task'|'remind'}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** rows are buttons with full labels; the sheet title is announced first.
- **Deep links:** none.
- **Tests:** RNTL `GapSheet.test.tsx` (Free gate, task list ordering); Maestro step inside `plan-day.yaml`.

### M-PLAN-06 · Görev sheet (task detail)

- **Screen ID:** M-PLAN-06
- **Route:** in-screen `Sheet` on M-PLAN-01/02 (param `taskId`), also reachable through `plan?focus=task:{id}` (auto-opens).
- **Entry points:** `task` timeline items and TÜM GÜN chips; task-sourced deadlines; search task results (M-SRCH-01).
- **Primary purpose:** Give every task on the Plan a real destination (M§99, "tasks" in M§19) without introducing unsupported provider task mutations.
- **Data dependencies:** `tasks` row (`title, due_at | due_date, list_name, provider, account_id, provider_web_url, source_type/source_id` for AI-derived tasks, `estimated_minutes`, `status`).
- **API dependencies:** `POST /plan/proposals {kind:'task_block', task_id}`; `reminders/new` route.
- **State dependencies:** entitlement; online.
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY sheet spec (defined here; no design artboard).
  - Title 19/600; meta "{Liste} · {Google Tasks}"; due line "Son tarih: {26 Eylül Cuma}" (Google Tasks is date-only, so no time is shown).
  - Provenance line for AI-derived tasks: "Kaynak: {Gmail · Ahmet Yılmaz · 08:42}".
- **Primary CTA:** "Takvime Yerleştir" → `task_block` proposal → M-PLAN-03 (Pro).
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):**
  - "Hatırlat" → `reminders/new?sourceType=task&sourceId={id}`.
  - "{Google Tasks}'ta Aç" → allowlisted external handoff (§0.5).
  - Provenance tap → source (`mail/{id}`).
  - Completion or editing of provider tasks is **not offered**: there is no approval type for it (M§33 enum); the provider app handoff covers it.
- **Loading:** the row data comes from the timeline cache (instant); the proposal button spinner.
- **Empty:** not applicable. A missing task → ST-NOT-FOUND in the sheet.
- **Error:** proposal errors → toast (as M-PLAN-01).
- **Offline:** "Takvime Yerleştir" and "Hatırlat" are disabled per ST-OFFLINE-WRITE; the external handoff remains.
- **Permission edge case:** a `tasks_read`-only account is fine (no write needed).
- **Approval requirement:** via M-PLAN-03 (`calendar_create`).
- **Analytics events:** `task_sheet_opened{provider}`, `task_sheet_action{action}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** the due date is announced in full; the external link has `accessibilityHint` "Uygulama dışında açılır".
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://plan?date={due}&focus=task:{id}`.
- **Tests:** RNTL `TaskSheet.test.tsx` (date-only rendering; the allowlist hides non-allowlisted URLs).

### M-PLAN-07 · Takvim Çakışması + "Nasıl çözelim?" (conflict screen and resolution sheet)

- **Screen ID:** M-PLAN-07
- **Route:** `apps/mobile/app/plan/conflict/[id].tsx` (`id` = `insights.id`, kind `conflict`). Stack push; the resolution sheet auto-opens at detent 0.55.
- **Entry points:**
  - Week insight "Seçenekleri Gör".
  - Day "Çakışma" link.
  - Today conflict card (Part 1).
  - Conflict push notification (§0.7).
  - SourceSheet from a conflict insight.
  - Deep link.
- **Primary purpose:** Explain one conflict and offer ranked, honest resolutions. **"Seçtiğin çözüm onayına sunulur, otomatik uygulanmaz."** (M§20, M§33, SREQ-20, C-36).
- **Data dependencies:**
  - `insights` row (`payload{item_a, item_b, overlap_start, overlap_end, local_date}`, provenance).
  - Both items via `calendar_events` / `life_events`: `organizer_is_self`, `can_modify`, `attendee_count`, `organizer_email`, `account_id`, `provider`, `source` for the life event.
  - The resolution options list.
- **API dependencies:**
  - `POST /plan/conflicts/:insightId/options`. It returns `{options:[{option_id, kind, title, meta, recommended, reason, approval_type|null, side_effect_text, requires_capability|null}]}` (computed deterministically; ranked).
  - `POST /plan/conflicts/:insightId/resolve {option_id}`. It returns `{approval}` or `{reminder_prefill}` or `{dismissed:true}`.
  - `/approvals/*`; `set_insight_status` (undo); `ai_feedback`.
- **State dependencies:** `useQuery(['plan','conflict',id])`, `useQuery(['plan','conflict-options',id])` (not persisted; recomputed on open); the sheet step `options | preview (M-PLAN-08) | done`; entitlement; online.
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY `05` 5.3 "Takvim Çakışması · Çözüm sayfası açık"; SECONDARY `CalendarConflict.tsx` (the "Beni hatırlat, kendim çözeyim" option, the source calendar label).
  - **Layout:**
    - Back button 36; kicker "{ÇARŞAMBA · 10 EYLÜL}".
    - Kicker `error` "TAKVİM ÇAKIŞMASI" `#C7432F`; headline "Bu iki etkinlik çakışıyor." 26/32.
    - ConflictPair: card A white; card B warm `#FDF6EC` when it is a life event, indented 24, with the coral 16×2 overlap marker. Each card shows time 14/600, title 15/600, meta "{60 dk} · {Mehmet Yılmaz} · {Ofis}" + a source/calendar label "{Google Takvim}" or "{Randevu maili}".
    - Explanation 14/21: "Toplantı {15:00}'te biter; {Doktor randevusu} {14:30}'da başlıyor." The travel clause is only included with leave-by evidence (§0.10).
  - **Sheet:** "Nasıl çözelim?" / "Seçtiğin çözüm onayına sunulur, otomatik uygulanmaz."
  - **Option catalogue** (server-computed; only applicable options are returned):

    | kind | Title template | Meta | Availability | Leads to |
    |---|---|---|---|---|
    | `move_own_event` | "{A}'yı {HH:MM}'e al" | "Katılımcılara güncelleme gönderilir" / "Yalnızca senin takvimin değişir" | The user organizes or can modify the item, and a same-day free slot of equal duration exists | `calendar_update` |
    | `shorten_own_event` | "{A}'yı {n} dk kısalt" | "{14:00–14:30} · Katılımcılara güncelleme gönderilir" | Organizer/can-modify, and the resulting duration is ≥15 min | `calendar_update` |
    | `propose_new_time` | "Toplantıyı {HH:MM}'e öner" | "{Mehmet}'e öneri maili taslağı hazırlanır" | The user is **not** the organizer and the organizer email is known. The proposed time is the user's own free slot. Attendee availability is **never** claimed (no free/busy scope). | `email_send` |
    | `contact_booking` | "Randevu sahibine yaz" | "Randevuyu değiştirmek için yanıt taslağı hazırlanır" | The item is a life event whose source email is reply-able | `email_send` |
    | `call_booking` | "Randevu yerini ara" | "{telefon}" | A grounded phone number exists in the source | `tel:` handoff (no approval) |
    | `remind_me` | "Beni hatırlat, kendim çözeyim" | "1 saat sonra hatırlatılır" | Always | Reminder confirm step |
    | `keep` | "Böyle kalsın" | "Bu çakışmayı bir daha gösterme" | Always, last | Dismiss (no approval) |

  - **Ranking:** own event with no attendees first; then shorten; then move with attendees; then propose/contact; then remind; then keep.
  - The first row uses the recommended style (`auto_awesome`, meta "Önerilen · {En az kişiyi etkiler}").
  - **Rejected design claims:** "Klinikte 15:45 boş görünüyor", "Doktora zamanında yetişirsin", "38 dakika yol" (no source; M§83).
- **Primary CTA:** the recommended option row → `resolve` → M-PLAN-08 preview inside the same sheet.
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):**
  - Other option rows: same flow with their own types.
  - `call_booking` → `tel:` (confirmation is the OS dialer).
  - `remind_me` → the server returns `reminder_prefill {at: now+60min}` → pushes `reminders/new?sourceType=insight&sourceId={id}&at=` (confirm).
  - `keep` → `resolve {option_id:'keep'}` → the insight is dismissed with its suppression key + `ai_feedback` → toast "Tamam, bu çakışmayı bir daha göstermem" + "Geri al" → pop to the origin.
  - Back: pop to the origin (Plan, Today or a notification-launched Plan).
  - Sheet swipe-down collapses to a peek (detent 0.12, "Nasıl çözelim?" handle). The screen stays.
  - Card tap: `event/{id}` or `life/{id}`.
- **Loading:** the conflict pair renders from cache; the sheet shows 4 skeleton option rows while `options` loads.
- **Empty:** no longer conflicting (either item moved or was deleted; the server returns `409 conflict_resolved`). Success tile `event_available` "Bu çakışma artık yok." / "Etkinliklerden biri değişti." + "Plan'a Dön". The insight is closed server-side.
- **Error:**
  - Options fetch failure → ST-ERROR-GENERIC in the sheet "Seçenekler yüklenemedi." + "Tekrar Dene".
  - `resolve` errors → toast + the row is re-enabled.
  - `402` → the sheet body becomes ProGateCard(advanced_planning). The conflict explanation stays visible (detection is free).
- **Offline:** the explanation comes from cache; the sheet shows ST-OFFLINE-WRITE "Çözüm seçmek için bağlantı gerekli." (`keep` is also disabled, because the options come from the server).
- **Permission edge case:** a move/shorten option on an account missing `calendar_write` still shows, with meta suffix "· Ek izin istenir". The approval triggers §0.4.5. Device-calendar items → §0.4.6.
- **Approval requirement:** **Yes** for every option except `keep`, `call_booking` (external handoff) and `remind_me` (in-app reminder confirm, C-08). Types: `calendar_update`, `email_send`.
- **Analytics events:** `conflict_opened{origin:'plan_day'|'plan_week'|'today'|'push'|'deeplink'}`, `conflict_options_shown{count}`, `conflict_option_selected{option_kind, recommended:boolean}`, `conflict_resolved{option_kind, outcome:'executed'|'dismissed'|'failed'}`.
- **Accessibility notes:**
  - The pair is read as "Çakışma: {A} {saat}, {B} {saat}, {n} dakika üst üste".
  - The sheet auto-open announces "Çözüm seçenekleri".
  - Each option reads title + meta + "önerilen".
  - Warning haptic on screen open (08 haptics "warning: çakışma").
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://plan/conflict/{insightId}`.
- **Tests:**
  - vitest `plan/conflict-options.test.ts`: organizer vs non-organizer; life-event booking options; shorten ≥15 min; ranking; never emits availability claims.
  - Deno `plan_conflicts_test.ts`: `conflict_resolved` 409; 402; `resolve keep` idempotent.
  - RNTL `ConflictScreen.test.tsx`.
  - Maestro `plan/plan-conflict-resolve.yaml` (Flow F-02).

### M-PLAN-08 · Çözüm onayı (conflict resolution approval preview)

- **Screen ID:** M-PLAN-08
- **Route:** step 2 inside the M-PLAN-07 sheet (param `approvalId`); the same anatomy is reused as the in-screen sheet for the M-PLAN-02 shift and M-PLAN-09 "Saati Değiştir".
- **Entry points:** the `resolve` response `{approval}`; M-PLAN-02 "{HH:MM}'e Kaydır" / "Yeni Saat Öner"; M-PLAN-09 after M-PLAN-04.
- **Primary purpose:** Show the exact change and its side effects before any calendar or email write (M§33).
- **Data dependencies:** the `approval_actions` row; for `email_send` also the `reply_drafts` row (`body_text`, `tone`, `to`, `subject`); the before/after event times.
- **API dependencies:** `/approvals/:id/approve|reject`; `PATCH /approvals/:id` (via M-PLAN-04); `PATCH /reply-drafts/:id` (via `mail/[id]/reply`); `POST /integrations/:accountId/upgrade`.
- **State dependencies:** `useApproval(id)` polling; online; step state.
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY 6.8 ApprovalCard contract rendered in-sheet (grid labels `#9B978E`, values 13/19).
  - Kicker per §0.4.2 ("ETKİNLİK TAŞI" / "MAİL GÖNDER").
  - Change row, e.g. "14:30 → 16:30 · 24 Eyl".
  - Side effect "Katılımcılara güncelleme gönderilir" (SREQ-20).
  - For `email_send`: a quoted 3-line draft preview (14/20 `#6B6860`) with recipient "Kime: Mehmet Yılmaz".
  - Buttons "Onayla" / "Düzenle" / "Vazgeç".
  - Done state: "Çözüldü" shown **only** after `executed` **and** a refreshed `insights.status='done'`; or, for email: "Öneri maili gönderildi." / "Çakışma, toplantı saati değişene kadar listede kalır."
- **Primary CTA:** "Onayla" (§0.4.4).
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):**
  - "Düzenle": `calendar_update` → M-PLAN-04; `email_send` → `mail/{messageId}/reply?draftId={id}` (AI Reply modal, Part 2), returning to this preview with the new payload version.
  - "Vazgeç": reject `user_cancel` → back to the option list.
  - "Kaynak" row → source.
- **Loading:** spinner states per §0.4.4 ("Takvim güncelleniyor…", "Gönderiliyor…").
- **Empty:** not applicable.
- **Error:** §0.4 failure mapping, plus `not_organizer` (organizer changed since the options were computed) → "Bu toplantıyı artık yalnızca düzenleyen taşıyabilir." + "Seçeneklere Dön" (refetch options).
- **Offline:** ST-OFFLINE-WRITE.
- **Permission edge case:** §0.4.5 and §0.4.6.
- **Approval requirement:** **Yes** — this *is* the approval surface (`calendar_update` / `email_send`). Gmail `Message-ID` idempotency; Google `events.patch` `sendUpdates='all'` when attendees >0, else `'none'`; Graph `PATCH /me/events/{id}`.
- **Analytics events:** `approval_decided{type, decision, via:'inline_sheet', origin:'conflict'}`, `approval_executed{type, result}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** the change row is read as "Değişim: 14:30'dan 16:30'a"; the side effect is read before the buttons; success is announced.
- **Deep links:** none (the sheet step); the approval itself is reachable via `approvals/{id}`.
- **Tests:** RNTL `ResolutionPreview.test.tsx` ("Çözüldü" not shown until executed + insight done); Deno `approvals_execute_calendar_update_test.ts` (sendUpdates mapping; idempotent retry).

### M-PLAN-09 · Etkinlik Detayı (Event detail)

- **Screen ID:** M-PLAN-09
- **Route:** `apps/mobile/app/event/[id].tsx` (`id` = `calendar_events.id`).
- **Entry points:** non-meeting event taps (M-PLAN-01); meeting taps for Free users; assistant calendar source cards (M-ASST-02); search event results; memory event sources; Person "Yaklaşan toplantılar" rows (Free); the Meeting Prep header overflow "Etkinlik ayrıntıları"; deep link.
- **Primary purpose:** An honest, complete view of one calendar event, with real handoffs (join, maps, provider) and approval-gated time change. This screen is needed by the design audit (missing screen list #30).
- **Data dependencies:**
  - `calendar_events`: `title, start_at, end_at, all_day, location, conference_url, conference_host, attendees jsonb [{name,email,response,is_self,contact_id}], organizer_is_self, can_modify, description_text` (sanitized plain text), `provider_web_link, account_id, calendar_id, provider, da_approval_id, self_response_status`.
  - `calendars` (label).
  - `sync_states.last_success_at`.
  - `meeting_notes` for the event (`kind='prep_note'|'post_meeting'`).
  - `meeting_preps.status`.
  - Entitlement.
- **API dependencies:** PostgREST `calendar_events`, `meeting_notes`, `meeting_preps`; `POST /approvals` (`calendar_update`, via M-PLAN-04); `POST /meetings/:eventId/notes` (M-MEET-02); `reminders/new` route.
- **State dependencies:** `useQuery(['event',id])` (persisted when in the plan cache range); entitlement; online; a minute tick (for "Başladı"/"Bitti" labels).
- **Source design reference:** composed from PRIMARY primitives (DetailHeader, GroupedListCard + IconRow, SectionKicker, StickyActionFooter).
  - Header: back + kicker "{PERŞEMBE · 24 EYLÜL}"; title 26/32/600; meta "{14:30–15:30} · {60 dk}".
  - Sections:
    - "KONUM" (only when a location exists) with row action "Haritada Aç".
    - "TOPLANTI BAĞLANTISI" (only for an allowlisted conference URL) with "{Google Meet}'e Katıl".
    - "KATILIMCILAR · {n}" with avatar rows + response icons (`check_circle` Katılıyor / `cancel` Katılmıyor / `help` Yanıt yok; text labels always present).
    - "AÇIKLAMA" (plain text, 4-line clamp + "Devamını gör").
    - "NOTLARIN".
  - Provenance footer `verified` "Kaynak: {Google Takvim} · {İş} · son eşitleme {09:41}".
  - DA-created events show "Dijital Asistan ekledi · Onay {22 Eyl 16:02}" → `approvals/{da_approval_id}`.
  - Sticky footer: primary "Toplantıya Hazırlan" (meetings) or "Hatırlat" (others); secondary "Takvimde Aç".
- **Primary CTA:** meetings → "Toplantıya Hazırlan" → `meeting/{id}/prep` (Pro; Free → ProGateCard(meeting_prep) as a bottom card). Non-meetings → "Hatırlat" → `reminders/new?sourceType=event&sourceId={id}`.
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):**
  - "Toplantıya Katıl", "Haritada Aç", "Takvimde Aç" → external handoffs (§0.5).
  - Attendee row with `contact_id` → `person/{contactId}`; without one → long-press "E-postayı kopyala".
  - "Saati Değiştir" (overflow `more_horiz` menu; only when `organizer_is_self || can_modify`) → M-PLAN-04 → M-PLAN-08 (`calendar_update`).
  - "Not Al" in NOTLARIN → M-MEET-02 (Pro).
  - A note row → expands inline.
  - After the event ends with attendees: a "Toplantı sonrası not al" row → `meeting/{id}/post` (Pro).
- **Loading:** ST-SKELETON (title and time from the list cache when available).
- **Empty:** sections without data are omitted (no empty headers). No description → omitted.
- **Error:** ST-NOT-FOUND (the event was deleted at the provider: "Bu etkinlik takviminden kaldırılmış."), ST-ERROR-GENERIC, ST-PARTIAL provenance showing a stale sync.
- **Offline:** ST-OFFLINE-READ. External handoffs remain enabled (the OS handles connectivity); "Saati Değiştir" and "Not Al" follow ST-OFFLINE-WRITE.
- **Permission edge case:** a device calendar event with the permission revoked → the cached snapshot with the provenance "Apple Takvim · son eşitleme {tarih}" + ST-CAL-PERMISSION banner.
- **Approval requirement:** "Saati Değiştir" → `calendar_update` approval. Everything else is read-only or an external handoff.
- **Analytics events:** `event_detail_opened{origin, is_meeting}`, `external_handoff{target:'meeting_link'|'maps'|'provider_calendar'}`, `event_time_change_started`.
- **Accessibility notes:** the response status is text + icon; external actions have the hint "Uygulama dışında açılır"; description links are not auto-linked (M§114); headings use `accessibilityRole="header"`.
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://event/{id}`.
- **Tests:**
  - vitest `handoff/allowlist.test.ts`: allows `https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij`, `https://us02web.zoom.us/j/1`; rejects `http:`, `https://evil.com/meet.google.com`, `javascript:`.
  - RNTL `EventDetail.test.tsx` (organizer gating of "Saati Değiştir"; Free gate on prep).
  - Maestro step in `plan-day.yaml`.

## 2. Meetings

### M-MEET-01 · Toplantıya Hazırlan (Meeting Prep — signature screen)

- **Screen ID:** M-MEET-01
- **Route:** `apps/mobile/app/meeting/[eventId]/prep.tsx` (`eventId` = `calendar_events.id`).
- **Entry points:** the meeting-prep push (§0.7); Today meeting card "Hazırlan" (Part 1); Flow meeting card (Part 2); Plan meeting tap (Pro); M-PLAN-02 "Hazırlığı Aç"; M-PLAN-09 primary CTA; Person "Yaklaşan" tile; widgets "Sıradaki" (Part 1); assistant calendar card for upcoming meetings; deep link.
- **Primary purpose:** A pre-meeting brief (M§21, REQ-PREP-01..05). It shows:
  - the person;
  - the meeting time and a live countdown;
  - the purpose;
  - previous communication;
  - recent mails;
  - open loops;
  - user commitments;
  - other-side commitments;
  - relevant files (only when real);
  - exactly 3 sourced talking points ("KONUŞMAN GEREKEN 3 ŞEY"; fewer only when the sources cannot support 3 — see Empty);
  - the "2 Dakikalık Özet";
  - a real meeting-link handoff;
  - notes.
- **Data dependencies:**
  - `meeting_preps`: `event_id, primary_contact_id, status (pending|generating|ready|failed|stale), talking_points jsonb [{title, body, source_refs[]}], sections jsonb {purpose{text, source_ref}, last_interaction{date, summary, source_ref}, recent_emails[{thread_id, message_id, subject_quote, from_label, at}], open_loops[{text, age_days, source_ref}], user_owes[{commitment_id|insight_id, text, due_at}], they_owe[{commitment_id|thread_id, text, waiting_days}], files[{name, url|null, capture_id|null, source}]}, summary jsonb, generated_at, prompt_version_id, confidence`.
  - `calendar_events` row.
  - `contacts` for attendees.
  - `meeting_notes` (`kind='prep_note'`).
  - Entitlement.
  - Every item carries `source_type/source_id/source_timestamp` (M§97).
  - Precompute policy (R-23): the `meeting_prep` job runs at T−60 only for meetings with an external attendee or a VIP. For every other meeting the prep is generated on the first open or "Hazırlan" tap through `POST /meetings/:eventId/prep`.
- **API dependencies:**
  - PostgREST `meeting_preps`, `calendar_events`, `meeting_notes`.
  - `POST /meetings/:eventId/prep {force?}`: returns 200 `{prep}` when fresh (generated <30 min ago and no newer source), otherwise 202 `{status:'generating'}` → poll `meeting_preps` every 2 s up to 60 s.
  - `POST /meetings/:eventId/notes` (M-MEET-02).
  - `POST /followups/:threadId/draft` (from a "Senin beklediklerin" row action).
- **State dependencies:** `useQuery(['meeting','prep',eventId])` persisted; `useCountdown(start_at,end_at)` (a minute tick + an `AppState` refresh); entitlement; online; reduce motion.
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY `05` 5.4 (light) and 5.5 (dark); SECONDARY `MeetingPrep.tsx` (meeting-platform line, "Toplantıyı Başlat" handoff → implemented as a direct `Linking.openURL`, SREQ-23).
  - **Layout:** padding `6 20 130`, gap 16.
    - Header: back 36 + kicker "TOPLANTIYA HAZIRLAN" + CountdownChip (`#FDF2DC` / `#9A6300`; dark `rgba(217,139,11,.18)` / `#F0B85A`) "18 dk".
    - PersonHeaderRow: avatar 56 (deterministic palette) + name 24/30 + meta "{Müşteri toplantısı} · {14:30} · {60 dk} · {Ofis}" + chevron.
    - Group meetings: an avatar stack + "{Mehmet Yılmaz} ve {2} kişi" → the attendee sheet listing each attendee → `person/{id}`.
    - **Added** under the person row (only with an allowlisted URL): tonal button `videocam` "{Google Meet}'e Katıl" (h44, r12).
    - TalkingPointsCard (light `#1A1917` r24 p20; dark gradient `160deg #2C2C7A → #4A4BC8`), kicker "KONUŞMAN GEREKEN 3 ŞEY", 3 numbered items (number circle 26).
    - Sections (GroupedListCard, icon tile 30): "TOPLANTININ AMACI" · "SON GÖRÜŞMENİZ" · "SON MAİLLER" · "AÇIK KONULAR" · "SENDEN BEKLENENLER" · "SENİN BEKLEDİKLERİN" · **added** "İLGİLİ DOSYALAR" (only if non-empty) · **added** "NOTLARIN" (only if notes exist).
    - Provenance footer `verified` "{3} mail, {1} not ve takvim davetinden hazırlandı · {14:02}" + text button "Yenile".
    - StickyActionFooter: primary "2 Dakikalık Özeti Oku", secondary "Not Al".
  - Verbatim design copy used as templates: "TOPLANTIYA HAZIRLAN", "KONUŞMAN GEREKEN 3 ŞEY", "TOPLANTININ AMACI", "Takvim davetinden çıkarıldı", "SON GÖRÜŞMENİZ", "SON MAİLLER", "AÇIK KONULAR", "SENDEN BEKLENENLER", "SENİN BEKLEDİKLERİN", "2 Dakikalık Özeti Oku", "Not Al".
  - **Rejected:** "Telefon görüşmesi · 12 dk" (no telephony source; notes are shown as "Not"), "Satın alma müdürü" unless `contacts.title` is sourced.
- **Primary CTA:** "2 Dakikalık Özeti Oku" → `meeting/{eventId}/summary` (M-MEET-03).
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):**
  - "Not Al" → M-MEET-02.
  - Person row → `person/{contactId}` (REQ-PREP-03).
  - "SON MAİLLER" row (with chevron + pressed state) → `mail/{messageId}` (REQ-PREP-04).
  - "SON GÖRÜŞMENİZ" → the source (`event/{id}` of the previous meeting with its notes section, or `mail/{id}`).
  - "AÇIK KONULAR" row → its source; a long-press menu offers "Taahhüde çevir" (`POST /approvals {type:'commitment_create', source_ref}` → M-ASST-03 anatomy sheet) and "Çözüldü" (`set_insight_status(done)` + undo).
  - "SENDEN BEKLENENLER" row → `commitments/{id}`, or `mail/{id}/reply` for a reply-needed thread. **Never auto-sends.**
  - "SENİN BEKLEDİKLERİN" row → `mail/{id}` with the follow-up action. Trailing text action "Takip hazırla" → `POST /followups/:threadId/draft` → `mail/{id}/reply?draftId=` (email_send approval downstream).
  - Talking point tap → SourceSheet listing its `source_refs` (each opens the real screen).
  - "İLGİLİ DOSYALAR" row → allowlisted handoff or `capture/{id}`; non-allowlisted → name only (not pressable).
  - "{Google Meet}'e Katıl" → `Linking.openURL` (§0.5).
  - "Yenile" → `POST /meetings/:eventId/prep {force:true}` (rate-limited 1/5 min per event).
  - Countdown after start reads "Başladı"; after the end the chip reads "Bitti" and the footer primary becomes "Toplantı sonrası not al" → `meeting/{eventId}/post`.
- **Loading:**
  - With no prep, or `status='generating'`: the header and person row render from `calendar_events`. The TalkingPointsCard shows ST-AI-WORKING with kicker "HAZIRLANIYOR…". Sections are skeletons.
  - >20 s → the line "Hazırlık birkaç saniye daha sürebilir." After 60 s → the Error state.
- **Empty (partial data):**
  - No mail history with the attendee: "SON MAİLLER" is replaced by "Bu kişiyle mail geçmişi bulunamadı."
  - No prior meeting: "SON GÖRÜŞMENİZ" becomes "İlk görüşmeniz."
  - No invite description: "TOPLANTININ AMACI" becomes "Davet açıklaması yok." (source "Takvim daveti").
  - Fewer than 3 groundable talking points: the kicker becomes "KONUŞMAN GEREKEN {n} ŞEY" (n≥1). With n=0 the card shows "Bu toplantı için kaynaklı bir konu bulamadım." + "Notlarını ekle" (→ M-MEET-02).
  - Empty lists are omitted.
- **Error:**
  - `status='failed'` or a timeout → ErrorCard "Hazırlık oluşturulamadı." / "Takvim bilgileri gösteriliyor; hazırlığı yeniden deneyebilirsin." + "Tekrar Dene" (`force:true`).
  - ST-AI-UNAVAILABLE (shows the cached prep if any); ST-AI-LIMIT.
  - Event cancelled → banner "Bu toplantı iptal edildi." + "Plan'a Dön".
  - Event moved → banner "Toplantı saati değişti: {yeni saat}." (the prep is marked `stale` and regenerated).
  - ST-NOT-FOUND.
- **Offline:** ST-OFFLINE-READ with the cached prep + "{14:02}'de hazırlandı". The countdown still ticks locally. "Not Al" follows ST-OFFLINE-WRITE. "2 Dakikalık Özeti Oku" works offline with the cached summary (native TTS works offline when the tr-TR voice is installed).
- **Permission edge case:** calendar permission or scope lost → the cached prep + ST-CAL-PERMISSION. Notification permission denied → no effect here (the in-app entry still works).
- **Approval requirement:** none to view. "Taahhüde çevir" → `commitment_create` approval. "Takip hazırla" → `email_send` approval downstream. "Çözüldü" is internal (undo).
- **Analytics events:** `meeting_prep_opened{origin:'push'|'today'|'flow'|'plan'|'person'|'widget'|'assistant'|'deeplink', minutes_to_start_bucket:'<15'|'15-30'|'30-120'|'>120'|'started'|'ended'}`, `meeting_prep_refreshed`, `meeting_prep_source_opened{section}`, `external_handoff{target:'meeting_link'|'file'}`, `pro_gate_viewed{feature:'meeting_prep'}`.
- **Accessibility notes:**
  - The countdown chip is a live region with `accessibilityLiveRegion="polite"`, announcing only at 15/5/0 min.
  - Talking points are read as "1. Fiyat: …".
  - Section kickers have role `header`.
  - The dark TalkingPointsCard text `rgba(255,255,255,.7)` on `#1A1917` measures ≥7:1 (verified in the token contrast test).
  - Sticky footer buttons are ≥52 pt.
  - Every source-bearing row exposes the `accessibilityHint` "Kaynağı açar".
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://meeting/{eventId}/prep`.
- **Tests:**
  - vitest `packages/validation/src/ai/meeting-prep.schema.test.ts`: exactly ≤3 talking points; each has ≥1 `source_ref`; summary ≤300 words.
  - Deno `meetings_prep_test.ts`: 402 for Free; fixture provider → grounded output; the grounding verifier drops unsourced points.
  - RNTL `MeetingPrep.test.tsx`: generating → ready; partial-data empties; the join button is hidden for a non-allowlisted URL; the countdown label transitions.
  - Maestro `meetings/meeting-prep-notification.yaml` (Flow F-03).

### M-MEET-02 · Not Al (meeting note composer)

- **Screen ID:** M-MEET-02
- **Route:** in-screen `Sheet` (keyboard-aware, detent 0.6 → 0.95 on focus) on M-MEET-01 and M-PLAN-09. Param `eventId`.
- **Entry points:** M-MEET-01 footer "Not Al"; M-PLAN-09 "NOTLARIN · Not Al"; M-MEET-01 "Notlarını ekle" (zero talking points).
- **Primary purpose:** Capture meeting notes by text or voice, bound to the event. Notes feed the prep, Post Meeting and AI Memory (SREQ-22). This is **not** Post Meeting, which only triggers after the end.
- **Data dependencies:** the `meeting_notes` draft (local until saved); `calendar_events.title` for the header.
- **API dependencies:** `POST /meetings/:eventId/notes {kind:'prep_note', input_mode:'text'|'voice', text, client_note_id}` (idempotent on `client_note_id`); `POST /assistant/transcribe` (server STT fallback).
- **State dependencies:** local draft (in-memory; a closed sheet with text prompts discard confirmation); the STT state machine shared with M-VOICE-01 (`useSpeechInput()` hook: `idle|requesting|listening|processing|error`); mic permission status.
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY Capture note input spec: min 52, pad 14/16, r16, input hint "Toplantı notlarını buraya yaz…" (from SECONDARY), grows on focus. The mic in the input = dictation (01 rule: "Mic = dictation, not voice mode"). The inline recording row (5.7): 26 bars ×3 px `#5B5CE2`/`#D9D6F7` + "0:07 · dinleniyor". Title "Not Al" 19/600, sub "{Müşteri toplantısı} · {14:30}". Buttons "Kaydet" (primary) / "Vazgeç".
- **Primary CTA:** "Kaydet" (disabled until text is non-empty) → POST notes → toast "Not kaydedildi" → close. The "NOTLARIN" section refetches and the `embedding` job is enqueued server-side (memory).
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):**
  - Mic → dictation. On-device STT appends to the text (§M-VOICE-01 engine rules); tap again to stop.
  - "Vazgeç" → with text: confirm alert "Not silinsin mi?" / "Sil" (destructive) / "Vazgeç"; empty: close.
- **Loading:** "Kaydet" spinner.
- **Empty:** not applicable (an input surface).
- **Error:** save failure → inline "Not kaydedilemedi." + "Tekrar Dene" (same `client_note_id`). STT errors → the inline hint "Ses tanınamadı. Yazarak devam edebilirsin."
- **Offline:** "Kaydet" follows ST-OFFLINE-WRITE. The draft text is kept in the sheet; if the app backgrounds, it is saved to encrypted MMKV `draft.meeting_note.{eventId}` and restored on reopen. Server STT is unavailable offline; on-device STT works.
- **Permission edge case:** mic denied → the mic button shows `mic_off` + hint "Mikrofon izni kapalı." + "Ayarları Aç" (`Linking.openSettings()`); typing still works. iOS speech-recognition permission denied → same, with "Konuşma tanıma izni kapalı."
- **Approval requirement:** none (a user-authored internal note, no external side effect).
- **Analytics events:** `meeting_note_saved{input_mode, origin:'prep'|'event'}`, `speech_input_used{engine:'on_device'|'server', success}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** the input has label "Toplantı notu"; the mic button toggles "Dikte başlat"/"Dikte durdur"; the recording state is announced; the text scales with Dynamic Type.
- **Deep links:** none.
- **Tests:** RNTL `MeetingNoteSheet.test.tsx` (discard confirm; idempotent retry; MMKV draft restore); Deno `meetings_notes_test.ts` (402; idempotency on `client_note_id`; RLS on `meeting_notes`).

### M-MEET-03 · 2 Dakikalık Özet (reading view + audio)

- **Screen ID:** M-MEET-03
- **Route:** `apps/mobile/app/meeting/[eventId]/summary.tsx`, `presentation:'modal'` (full screen; swipe-down to close).
- **Entry points:** M-MEET-01 primary CTA; the assistant source card "2 dakikalık özet" for upcoming meetings; deep link.
- **Primary purpose:** An editorial "Nerede kalmıştınız?" recap in the briefing voice, with sources and optional audio (M§21, REQ-PREP-02).
- **Data dependencies:** `meeting_preps.summary {title, paragraphs[{text, emphasis_spans[]}], sources_grouped[{type:'email'|'note'|'file'|'event', count, refs[]}], word_count, generated_at}`. `word_count ≤ 300` is enforced by zod, so "2 dakikalık" stays true at the default TTS rate.
- **API dependencies:** PostgREST `meeting_preps` (from the M-MEET-01 cache); optional `POST /meetings/:eventId/prep/audio` (added to API_CONTRACTS per R-24; only when the spine flag `voice.tts_premium` (R-10) is on and the TTS credential exists) → `{signed_url, expires_at, chapters[]}`.
- **State dependencies:** `useQuery(['meeting','prep',eventId])`; `useTts()` state `idle|speaking|paused` + `paragraphIndex`; `expo-speech` voice availability (`Speech.getAvailableVoicesAsync()` filtered to `tr-TR`); the audio session.
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY `05` 5.6 "2 Dakikalık Özet · Okuma görünümü".
  - Paper `#FBFAF7` (dark: `#141311` bg, paragraphs `#F2F0EB`, byline `#A39F96`; derived from 01 DARK).
  - Header: `close` 36 + kicker "2 DAKİKALIK ÖZET" + `headphones` 36.
  - Byline Lora italic 15 "{Mehmet Yılmaz} · {14:30}"; title Lora 30/36 "Nerede kalmıştınız?".
  - Paragraphs Lora 17/28 with bold date spans.
  - "KAYNAKLAR" SourceChips ("{3} mail", "{1} görüşme notu" → renamed "{1} not", "{Teklif v2.pdf}").
  - **Added** when audio is active: a mini control bar docked at the bottom (the PRIMARY mini-player anatomy: `#1E1E4C` r16) with play/pause 40, "Önceki bölüm"/"Sonraki bölüm" (paragraph skip; `expo-speech` has no seek), speed pill 1.0→1.25→1.5, progress "{2}/{3}".
- **Primary CTA:** `headphones` → speak paragraph by paragraph.
  - Default engine: `Speech.speak(text,{language:'tr-TR', rate})`.
  - With premium TTS: an `expo-audio` player with real seek ±15 s and chapters.
  - The active paragraph is highlighted (background `rgba(91,92,226,.06)`).
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):**
  - `close` / swipe-down → back to prep (stops audio).
  - "{n} mail" chip → a sheet listing those emails → `mail/{id}`.
  - Note chip → `event/{id}` (notes section).
  - File chip → allowlisted handoff or `capture/{id}`.
  - Long-press on a paragraph → "Kaynağı göster" → SourceSheet for the claims in that paragraph (M§131).
- **Loading:** if the summary is not ready → ST-AI-WORKING skeleton paragraphs (Lora line heights).
- **Empty:** summary missing because the prep failed → "Özet oluşturulamadı." + "Hazırlığa Dön".
- **Error:**
  - No tr-TR voice installed → a toast "Bu cihazda Türkçe ses bulunamadı." with the hint "Ayarlar > Erişilebilirlik > Sesli İçerik'ten Türkçe ses indirebilirsin." (iOS) / "Ayarlar > Metin okuma" (Android); the text view stays.
  - Premium audio fetch fails → silent fallback to native TTS + toast "Cihaz sesiyle okunuyor."
  - Audio interruption (call) → pause; resume button.
- **Offline:** the text is from cache. Native TTS works if the voice is local; premium audio is disabled ("İndirilmedi" pill disabled, as in 08 offline).
- **Permission edge case:** none (TTS needs no permission). Silent mode on iOS: audio category `playback` so speech plays with the ringer off.
- **Approval requirement:** none.
- **Analytics events:** `meeting_summary_opened`, `meeting_summary_audio_played{engine:'native'|'premium', speed}`, `meeting_summary_source_opened{type}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** Lora sizes respect Dynamic Type; when VoiceOver/TalkBack is running, the headphones button hint says "Metni sesli okur; ekran okuyucunla çakışabilir"; controls are ≥44 pt; paragraph highlight is not colour-only (a left 3 px bar).
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://meeting/{eventId}/summary`.
- **Tests:** RNTL `MeetingSummary.test.tsx` (paragraph TTS sequencing with a mocked `expo-speech`; no-voice fallback); vitest `validation` (300-word cap); Maestro step within `meeting-prep-notification.yaml`.

### M-MEET-04 · Toplantı Sonrası (Post Meeting capture)

- **Screen ID:** M-MEET-04
- **Route:** `apps/mobile/app/meeting/[eventId]/post.tsx` (stack push, tabs hidden).
- **Entry points:** the post-meeting push at end + 1 min (§0.7); M-MEET-01 footer after the end; M-PLAN-09 "Toplantı sonrası not al"; deep link.
- **Primary purpose:** "Toplantın bitti. Takip etmen gereken bir şey var mı?" Text or voice input → commitment proposals → user approval ("Kaydet") → save (M§22, M§18, REQ-POST-01..03, C-06).
- **Data dependencies:**
  - `calendar_events` (title, attendees, `end_at`).
  - The extraction result: `meeting_notes` (`kind='post_meeting'`) + pending `approval_actions` of type `commitment_create`: `{approval_id, payload{text, direction, contact_id|null, counterparty_label|null, due_at|null, due_precision:'datetime'|'date'|'none'}, confidence, evidence{quote}, idempotency_key}`.
  - `contacts` for pickers.
- **API dependencies:**
  - `POST /meetings/:eventId/post {input_mode:'text'|'voice', text, client_note_id}`. It returns 200 `{note_id, proposals[]}`. Synchronous up to 15 s; beyond that 202 → poll `approval_actions?source_id=eq.{note_id}`.
  - `POST /assistant/transcribe` (server STT fallback).
  - `PATCH /approvals/:id` (edits from M-MEET-05).
  - `POST /approvals/:id/approve` per selected item.
  - `POST /approvals/:id/reject {reason:'user_reject'|'user_cancel', learn:false}` (an unselected row uses `user_reject`; discard uses `user_cancel`).
  - PostgREST `DELETE meeting_notes?id=eq.{note_id}` (discard).
- **State dependencies:** the screen state machine `idle → listening → transcribed (editable) → extracting → proposals → saving → saved | none_found | error`; `useSpeechInput()`; per-proposal `selected` (default true when `confidence ≥ 0.7` and the direction is resolved, else false); entitlement; online.
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY `05` 5.7 "Toplantı Sonrası Yakalama · Ses girişi"; interactive-prototype chips "Yarın" / "Mehmet Yılmaz"; SECONDARY `PostMeeting.tsx` text-mode layout.
  - **Layout:** close 36 + kicker "TOPLANTI SONRASI"; meta "{Mehmet Yılmaz} · {14:30–15:30}"; H "Toplantın bitti." 28/34; sub "Takip etmen gereken bir şey var mı?".
  - **Idle state** (added; recording never auto-starts, a privacy decision): a large 64 mic button (primary) with "Konuşmak için dokun" + a keyboard toggle → text area with the input hint "“Mehmet'e yarın teklif göndereceğim.”"
  - **Listening:** TranscriptCard (italic 16/24 live transcript) + MiniWaveform driven by the real mic level + "{0:07} · dinleniyor"; tap to stop; end-pointing at 1.2 s silence.
  - **Transcribed:** the transcript is editable (tap to edit) + "Taahhütleri Çıkar" (primary).
  - **Proposals:** AI card kicker "{2} YENİ TAAHHÜT". DetectedItemRows (`handshake` 20 `#5B5CE2`) with title 15/600 and meta "{Yarın} · {Mehmet Yılmaz}". Direction marker in the meta: "Sen yapacaksın" / "{Kişi} yapacak". A trailing include toggle: `check_circle` FILL `#2FA062` = included (the 5.7 green check), `radio_button_unchecked` = excluded. Low-confidence rows are unchecked with the meta suffix "· Emin değilim, kontrol et".
  - **Footer:** "Kaydet" (flex, h52) + 52×52 keyboard/mic toggle.
- **Primary CTA:** "Kaydet" (enabled when ≥1 proposal is selected).
  - For each selected proposal: `POST /approvals/:id/approve {idempotency_key}`, sequential; the per-row spinner becomes a check. `commitment_create` executes server-side (internal) → a `commitments` row with `source_type='meeting_note'`, `source_id=note_id` and the dedupe key.
  - For each unselected proposal: reject with `{reason:'user_reject', learn:false}` (a default-unchecked low-confidence row is not a learning signal).
  - When all are executed: success ring + "{2} taahhüt kaydedildi." / "Son tarihlerinden önce Bugün'de görürsün." + buttons "Taahhütleri Gör" (→ `commitments`) and "Bugün'e Dön" (→ Today tab root).
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):**
  - Row tap → M-MEET-05 (edit).
  - Include toggle → local selection.
  - Keyboard toggle → text mode (same extraction on "Taahhütleri Çıkar").
  - Close X:
    - With pending proposals → alert "Kaydedilmemiş taahhütler silinsin mi?" / "Not ve öneriler silinir." / "Sil" (destructive) / "Vazgeç". "Sil" rejects all with `user_cancel` + deletes the note → pop.
    - With nothing extracted yet → pop.
  - "Tekrar kaydet" (visible in the transcribed state) → discards the transcript and returns to listening.
- **Loading:** extracting → ST-AI-WORKING over the AI card, with kicker "TAAHHÜTLER ÇIKARILIYOR…".
- **Empty:** `none_found` → "Takip edilecek bir şey bulamadım." / "Notun kaydedildi; istersen daha sonra düzenleyebilirsin." + "Tamam" (keeps the note) + "Notu Sil" (deletes it).
- **Error:**
  - Extraction failure → "Taahhütler çıkarılamadı." + "Tekrar Dene" (the same `client_note_id`, so the note is not duplicated).
  - ST-AI-UNAVAILABLE (the note is still saved); ST-AI-LIMIT.
  - An approve failure per row → coral "Kaydedilemedi · Tekrar dene".
  - Opened >24 h after the event end → the header meta adds "{dün} {14:30–15:30}"; proposals behave the same; relative dates are resolved against the **event end**, not now (the domain rule `resolveRelativeDate(text, anchor=end_at, tz)`).
  - Ambiguous date ("haftaya") → `due_precision='none'` + meta "Tarih belirsiz · seç" (forces edit before selection).
  - Unknown person ("Hukuk ekibi") → `counterparty_label` text + meta "Kişi listende yok".
- **Offline:**
  - On-device STT still works. Server extraction is not possible, so after the transcript: "Bağlantı gelince taahhütleri çıkarabilirim." The transcript is saved to encrypted MMKV `draft.post_meeting.{eventId}` and restored.
  - "Kaydet" follows ST-OFFLINE-WRITE.
  - No automatic replay (the user re-taps "Taahhütleri Çıkar").
- **Permission edge case:** mic or speech permission denied → the idle state switches to text mode with a banner "Mikrofon izni kapalı. Yazarak ekleyebilirsin." + "Ayarları Aç". Server STT credential missing and on-device unsupported → the mic is hidden; text only (and the Help doc explains; External credential required: STT provider).
- **Approval requirement:** **Yes.** Each proposal is a `commitment_create` approval. "Kaydet" is the explicit approval (C-06), recorded per item in `approval_actions` (`origin='post_meeting'`, `approved_via='in_place'`, R-03) and `approval_events`. Low-confidence items require explicit selection (M§18, M§115).
- **Analytics events:** `post_meeting_opened{origin:'push'|'prep'|'event'|'deeplink', hours_since_end_bucket}`, `post_meeting_input{mode:'voice'|'text', engine}`, `post_meeting_extracted{count_bucket:'0'|'1'|'2-3'|'4+', low_confidence_count}`, `post_meeting_commitments_saved{count, edited_count}`, `post_meeting_discarded`.
- **Accessibility notes:**
  - The mic button is 64 pt, labelled "Kaydı başlat"/"Kaydı durdur".
  - The live transcript region is `polite`.
  - The include toggles are checkboxes with label "{taahhüt}, {tarih}, {kişi}, dahil".
  - "Kaydet" is disabled with the reason hint "En az bir taahhüt seç".
  - Reduce Motion: static waveform bars (height = current level, no animation).
  - Success is announced.
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://meeting/{eventId}/post`.
- **Tests:**
  - vitest `packages/domain/src/datetime/tr-relative.test.ts`: "yarın", "Perşembe'ye kadar", "haftaya", "Cuma" anchored to the event end in `Europe/Istanbul`, incl. a Sunday 23:30 end.
  - vitest `domain/commitments/detect.test.ts`: direction detection "göndereceğim" → `user_owes`, "bana dönecek" → `they_owe`.
  - Deno `meetings_post_test.ts`: grounding (each proposal's evidence quote is present in the note text); 402; idempotent `client_note_id`.
  - RNTL `PostMeeting.test.tsx`: state machine; unchecked low-confidence rows; discard rejects and deletes.
  - Maestro `meetings/post-meeting-text.yaml` (text path) and `meetings/post-meeting-voice.yaml` (e2e build profile with the deterministic STT test double, Flow F-04).

### M-MEET-05 · Taahhüdü Düzenle (commitment proposal edit sheet)

- **Screen ID:** M-MEET-05
- **Route:** in-screen `Sheet` on M-MEET-04 (param `approvalId`). The same component is reused by the M-ASST-03 "Düzenle" for `commitment_create`.
- **Entry points:** proposal row tap in M-MEET-04; M-ASST-03 "Düzenle" for commitments; M-MEET-01 "Taahhüde çevir".
- **Primary purpose:** Correct the text, person, direction and due date before approval (M§18: confirmation for ambiguous inference).
- **Data dependencies:** the approval payload; `contacts` (event attendees first, then search results); the domain date presets.
- **API dependencies:** `PATCH /approvals/:id {payload}` → new version and key; PostgREST `contacts` search (`ilike` on `display_name_search` / `primary_email`, limit 20).
- **State dependencies:** a react-hook-form 7.88 form with the zod schema `CommitmentProposalEdit` (`packages/validation`); online.
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY sheet + inputs spec (text field 52h r16, focus 2 px indigo ring; FilterChip rows; SegmentedControl). Defined here (the design audit lists "Commitment edit sheet" as missing).
  - Title "Taahhüdü Düzenle".
  - Fields:
    - "Taahhüt" (text, max 120)
    - "Kişi" (attendee chips + "Başka biri…" search + free-text "Kişi listende yoksa adını yaz")
    - "Kim yapacak?" SegmentedControl "Ben" / "{Kişi}"
    - "Son tarih" chips "Bugün", "Yarın", "Bu hafta", "Tarih seç" (native date/time picker, SREQ-36), "Tarih yok"
  - Buttons "Kaydet" / "Vazgeç".
- **Primary CTA:** "Kaydet" → PATCH → close; the row updates and becomes `selected`.
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):** "Vazgeç" (discard edits); field interactions as listed.
- **Loading:** "Kaydet" spinner; contact search debounced 250 ms with an inline spinner.
- **Empty:** contact search with no results → "Kişi bulunamadı. Adını yazarak ekleyebilirsin."
- **Error:** validation messages under the fields (coral ring + `error` icon + 12 px text, e.g. "Taahhüt metni boş olamaz."); PATCH failure → inline "Kaydedilemedi." + retry.
- **Offline:** "Kaydet" follows ST-OFFLINE-WRITE.
- **Permission edge case:** none (device contacts are not used, SREQ-37).
- **Approval requirement:** edits a pending `commitment_create` approval (new payload version); it does not approve.
- **Analytics events:** `commitment_proposal_edited{fields_changed_count}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** each field has a visible label; the segmented control announces "Ben, seçili"; the date picker is native (fully accessible).
- **Deep links:** none.
- **Tests:** RNTL `CommitmentEditSheet.test.tsx` (zod errors; direction toggle); vitest schema tests.
