## 5. People

### M-PERS-01 · Kişi Zekâsı (Person Intelligence)

- **Screen ID:** M-PERS-01
- **Route:** `apps/mobile/app/person/[id].tsx` (`id` = `contacts.id`).
- **Entry points (SREQ-39):** the M-MEET-01 person row; email sender avatar/name (Part 2); meeting attendee rows (M-PLAN-09); VIP rows (M-VIP-01); search person results; assistant person cards; memory sources; deep link.
- **Primary purpose:** A relationship summary, not a mail thread (M§30, REQ-PERSON-02). It covers:
  - Last contact;
  - Upcoming meetings;
  - Open loops;
  - Recent topics;
  - User owes / They owe;
  - Commitments;
  - Related emails;
  - a person-scoped question box "{Ad} hakkında sor…".
- **Data dependencies:** `person_intelligence(p_contact_id)` RPC (API RPC-03, DB §6.9, `security invoker`) returning:
  - `{contact{id, display_name, primary_email, org (sourced or null), title (sourced or null), avatar_palette_key}`
  - `vip{relationship, always_notify, bypass_quiet_hours} | null`
  - `last_contact{at, channel:'email'|'meeting'|'note', ref}`
  - `upcoming_meetings[{event_id, title, start_at}]` (max 3, 14 days)
  - `open_loops[{insight_id, text, urgency, ref}]`
  - `recent_topics[{label, at, channel, ref}]` (max 5; from `email_threads.topic_label` and `meeting_notes`)
  - `user_owes[{commitment_id|thread_id, text, due_at}]`
  - `they_owe[{commitment_id|thread_id, text, waiting_days}]`
  - `commitments_count{open}`
  - `recent_communications[{type, ref, label, at}]` (max 3)
  - `related_email_count`
  - `locked_sections[]}` (Free: `open_loops`, `user_owes`, `they_owe` and `commitments` are omitted and named here, RPC-03)

  Every row carries provenance.
- **API dependencies:** PostgREST `rpc/person_intelligence` (RPC-03); `vip_people` (via M-VIP-03); `POST /followups/:threadId/draft`; `set_insight_status`; M-ASST-02 (`POST /assistant/threads {scope:{type:'person', contact_id}}`).
- **State dependencies:** `useQuery(['person',id])` persisted; entitlement; online.
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY `06` 6.7 "Kişi Zekâsı · Mehmet Yılmaz"; SECONDARY `PersonIntelligence.tsx` ("AÇIK KONULAR" with urgency dots restyled to critical `#E0553F` / warning `#E09A1C` + text).
  - **Layout** (padding `6 20 110`):
    - Header: back + status chip "VIP · {Müşteri}" (`#EDEDFC` / `#4547C9`, `star` FILL 15), or for non-VIP a tonal chip "VIP yap" (`star` outline).
    - Centered avatar 76, name 26/600, sub "{Yılmaz Endüstri} · {unvan}". The sub is shown only when sourced; else the primary email domain label "{yilmazendustri.com}".
    - StatTiles ×3: "Son iletişim" / "{Dün 18:20}"; "Yaklaşan" / "{Bugün 14:30}" or "—"; "Açık konu" / "{2}" (warning value colour when >0).
    - Sections (GroupedListCard):
      - **added** "YAKLAŞAN TOPLANTILAR"
      - **added** "AÇIK KONULAR" (6.7 lacks it, audit issue 23)
      - "SON KONUŞULAN KONULAR"
      - "SENDEN BEKLEDİKLERİ"
      - "SENİN BEKLEDİKLERİN"
      - **added** "TAAHHÜTLER" row "Tüm taahhütleri gör ({n})"
      - "SON İLETİŞİM" + **added** link "Tüm mailleri gör ({n})"
    - Sticky composer (gradient fade 40%): input hint "{Mehmet} hakkında sor…" + mic 40.
  - **Rejected:** "Telefon görüşmesi · 12 dk", "1 Eyl · Telefon" (no telephony). Channels are only "Mail", "Toplantı", "Not".
- **Primary CTA:** the composer → `chat/new?contactId={id}` with the typed text (a person-scoped thread; retrieval is filtered to this contact).
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):**
  - VIP chip → M-VIP-03 (Free within `vip_max`; at the limit → ProGateCard(vip) sheet).
  - The "Son iletişim" tile → the `last_contact.ref` screen.
  - The "Yaklaşan" tile → `meeting/{eventId}/prep` (Pro) or `event/{id}`.
  - The "Açık konu" tile → scrolls to AÇIK KONULAR.
  - An upcoming meeting row → prep/event.
  - An open loop row → its source; long-press "Çözüldü" → `set_insight_status(done)` + undo.
  - A topic row → its source (`mail/{id}` or `event/{id}`).
  - A SENDEN BEKLEDİKLERİ row → `commitments/{id}` or `mail/{id}/reply` for reply-needed threads.
  - A SENİN BEKLEDİKLERİN row → `mail/{id}`; trailing "Takip hazırla" → `POST /followups/:threadId/draft` → `mail/{id}/reply?draftId=`.
  - "Tüm taahhütleri gör" → `commitments?contactId={id}` (proposed param on the Part 2 list).
  - "Tüm mailleri gör" → `search?types=email&contactId={id}`.
  - Mic → `voice?contactId={id}`.
- **Loading:** ST-SKELETON (the name from the navigation param cache is shown instantly when available).
- **Empty:**
  - A sparse person (1 email): the sections without data are omitted; the stat tiles show "—" with the a11y label "bilgi yok".
  - No topics → the section is omitted.
  - Free user: the Pro sections render as one ProGateCard(post_meeting variant copy "Taahhüt ve takip takibi Pro'da.") in place of the sections named in `locked_sections` (AÇIK KONULAR / SENDEN BEKLEDİKLERİ / SENİN BEKLEDİKLERİN / TAAHHÜTLER).
- **Error:** ST-NOT-FOUND ("Bu kişi artık listende yok."); ST-ERROR-GENERIC; ST-PARTIAL (e.g. calendar unavailable → the upcoming meetings section shows "Takvim erişimi yok").
- **Offline:** ST-OFFLINE-READ from the persisted overview; the composer is disabled; "Takip hazırla" follows ST-OFFLINE-WRITE; the VIP chip toggle is queued (internal).
- **Permission edge case:** none device-level. Duplicate contacts with the same surname (Ahmet Yılmaz vs Mehmet Yılmaz) are **never merged**; identity is by email address (test fixture).
- **Approval requirement:** none to view. "Takip hazırla" → `email_send` downstream; VIP changes are internal (undo); "Çözüldü" is internal.
- **Analytics events:** `person_opened{origin:'prep'|'mail'|'event'|'vip'|'search'|'assistant'|'memory'|'deeplink', is_vip}`, `person_section_opened{section}`, `person_ask_submitted{input_mode}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** the stat tiles are read as "Son iletişim: dün 18:20"; urgency dots are paired with text ("acil"); the avatar initials are hidden from a11y (the name is read); sections are headers; the composer hint is read as the label.
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://person/{contactId}`.
- **Tests:**
  - pgTAP `person_intelligence.test.sql`: RLS (another user's contact → 0 rows); Free omits the Pro sections and lists them in `locked_sections`.
  - RNTL `PersonScreen.test.tsx` (sparse person; no telephony rows ever; gate rendering).
  - Maestro step in `people/vip-add-suggestion.yaml`.

### M-VIP-01 · Önemli Kişiler (VIP list + suggestions)

- **Screen ID:** M-VIP-01
- **Route:** `apps/mobile/app/vip.tsx`
- **Entry points:** `settings/index` row "Önemli Kişiler" (Part 4; replaces the prototype shortcut to one person, hub issue 14); the Today correction sheet "Bu kişiyi VIP yap" follow-up link (Part 1); the onboarding VIP step "Daha sonra düzenle" (Part 1); the M-PERS-01 VIP chip long-press "Tüm VIP'ler"; deep link.
- **Primary purpose:** Manage VIPs by relationship group. VIPs deterministically raise priority (priority engine `explicit_rule` tier, M§30, M§31, REQ-PERSON-03) and tighten wait tracking. Honest suggestions come from real communication frequency (SREQ-37).
- **Data dependencies:**
  - `vip_people` (`id, contact_id, relationship` (DB enum `vip_relationship`: `spouse`, `family`, `manager`, `key_client`, `friend`, `other`; default `other`), `always_notify`, `bypass_quiet_hours`, `origin:'user'|'suggestion'|'onboarding'`, `created_at`) joined to `contacts`.
  - Computed meta per VIP (from `person_intelligence`-lite: open loops count, "Revize teklif bekliyor" from the top open `reply_needed`/`follow_up` insight).
  - `vip_suggestions()` RPC (API RPC-13; Pro only, 0 rows for Free): `{contact_id, display_name, exchanged_30d}`. The screen shows the first row. Rules:
    - ≥8 messages exchanged in 30 days with ≥2 sent by the user;
    - excludes automated senders (List-Unsubscribe/Precedence/Auto-Submitted, no-reply patterns);
    - excludes existing VIPs;
    - excludes contacts with a negative `ai_feedback` (`target_type='contact'`, `rating=-1`) in the last 90 days.
- **API dependencies:** PostgREST `vip_people` (select/insert/update/delete under RLS; inserts limited by `vip_max` through `trg_vip_people_plan_limit`); `rpc/vip_suggestions`; `ai_feedback` insert. "Her zaman bildir" is the column `vip_people.always_notify`, so no `priority_rules` row is written.
- **State dependencies:** `useQuery(['vip','list'])` persisted; `useQuery(['vip','suggestions'])`; entitlement; online (mutations are queued offline, since they are internal and idempotent on `(user_id, contact_id)`).
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY `06` 6.6 "Önemli Kişiler · VIP"; SECONDARY `VIPPeople.tsx` (empty state copy; row toggle bubbling bug **not** copied).
  - Header: back + pill "Kişi Ekle" (`add` 18, `#5B5CE2` / `#fff`).
  - H1 "Önemli Kişiler" + sub "Bu kişilerden gelenleri her zaman öne alırım ve bekleme sürelerini daha sıkı izlerim."
  - Groups (kicker + GroupedListCard): "EŞ · AİLE" (spouse, family), "YÖNETİCİ" (manager), "MÜŞTERİ" (`key_client`), "ARKADAŞ" (friend), **added** "DİĞER" (`other`, the default).
  - Rows: avatar 38, name 15/600, meta 12 (computed facts only, e.g. "{Yılmaz Endüstri} · {2} açık konu", "{Kuzey Lojistik} · Revize teklif bekliyor", or the relationship label; + "· Her zaman bildir" when always-notify), trailing `star` FILL 20 `#5B5CE2`.
  - InlineSuggestionRow: `psychology` 18 + "Öneri: **{Selin Kaya}** ile son 30 günde {14} kez yazıştın. VIP yapayım mı?" + CTA "Evet" (`#4547C9`) + **added** "Şimdi değil" (`#6B6860`).
  - **Rejected meta:** "Mesaj ve takvim öncelikli", "Aramaları hatırlat" (these imply SMS/call access, M§91).
- **Primary CTA:** "Kişi Ekle" → M-VIP-02.
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):**
  - A row tap → `person/{contactId}`.
  - The star tap → remove: delete the `vip_people` row → toast "{Ad} VIP'lerden çıkarıldı" + "Geri al" (5 s re-insert with the same `relationship`, `always_notify` and `bypass_quiet_hours`).
  - Row long-press / `accessibilityActions` "Grubu değiştir", "VIP'lerden çıkar" → M-VIP-03.
  - Suggestion "Evet" → insert `vip_people{contact_id, origin:'suggestion'}` (optimistic) → toast "{Selin Kaya} VIP'lere eklendi" + "Geri al" → then M-VIP-03 opens for grouping (skippable).
  - Suggestion "Şimdi değil" → `ai_feedback{feature:'assistant_intent', target_type:'contact', target_id, rating:-1, reason_code:'other'}` (VIP suggestions are a T0 surface; the `contact` target type is proposed in A-28) → the row collapses (the next suggestion shows, if any).
- **Loading:** ST-SKELETON (4 rows).
- **Empty:** "Henüz VIP kişi yok." / "Önemli kişileri ekleyerek onlardan gelen mesajlara öncelik ver." / CTA "Kişi Ekle" (the 08 tile style, `star` on `#EDEDFC`). Suggestions still show above the tile if available.
- **Error:** ST-ERROR-GENERIC "Önemli kişiler yüklenemedi."; a mutation failure → toast "Kaydedilemedi. Tekrar dene." + rollback.
- **Offline:** ST-OFFLINE-READ; add/remove/suggestion actions are queued (ST-OFFLINE-WRITE queue semantics for internal writes) with a subtle pending badge on the row ("Bağlantı gelince kaydedilecek"); suggestions are not refreshed.
- **Permission edge case:** Free → the list stays usable up to `vip_max` (5; the onboarding VIP step also stores rows on Free) under the gate banner "VIP önceliği Pro'da; listen korunuyor." + "Pro'yu Gör". Suggestions are hidden (`vip_suggestions()` returns 0 rows), and the priority and notification engines ignore VIP effects while `private.is_pro` is false. A 6th VIP returns `PLAN_LIMIT:vip_max` → ProGateCard(vip). A lapsed Pro keeps every stored row; rows beyond the Free limit become read-only. Device contacts permission is never requested.
- **Approval requirement:** none (an internal preference; M§115 lists no approval for it). Undo is available for every change.
- **Analytics events:** `vip_list_viewed{count_bucket}`, `vip_added{origin:'manual'|'suggestion'|'person_page'|'correction'}`, `vip_removed`, `vip_suggestion_shown`, `vip_suggestion_dismissed`, `vip_updated{field:'relationship'|'always_notify'|'bypass_quiet_hours'}`, `pro_gate_viewed{feature:'vip'}`.
- **Accessibility notes:** the star is a toggle button "VIP, {Ad}, çıkarmak için dokun"; the suggestion row buttons are separate focusable elements; the groups are headers; the undo toast is announced.
- **Deep links:** `dijitalasistan://vip`.
- **Tests:**
  - pgTAP `vip_people.test.sql`: RLS; unique `(user_id, contact_id)`; a Free user's 6th insert is rejected by `trg_vip_people_plan_limit` (`PLAN_LIMIT:vip_max`); `relationship` accepts only `vip_relationship` values.
  - pgTAP `vip_suggestions.test.sql`: automated senders excluded; dismissed contacts (a negative `ai_feedback` on the contact) excluded for 90 days; Free → 0 rows.
  - vitest `priority-engine.test.ts` (a VIP sender raises the tier deterministically; the lapsed entitlement ignores it).
  - RNTL `VipScreen.test.tsx` (undo; no navigation on star tap).
  - Maestro `people/vip-add-suggestion.yaml` (Flow F-09).

### M-VIP-02 · Kişi Ekle (contact picker)

- **Screen ID:** M-VIP-02
- **Route:** in-screen `Sheet` (detent 0.95) on M-VIP-01.
- **Entry points:** "Kişi Ekle" pill; the empty-state CTA "Kişi Ekle".
- **Primary purpose:** Pick an existing correspondent (from `contacts` built from mail and calendar participants) or add one by email, without device contacts permission (SREQ-37).
- **Data dependencies:** `contacts` (excluding current VIPs), ordered by `last_contact_at desc`, filtered by the search term (name/email, TR casefold via `display_name_search` generated column); the manual email entry.
- **API dependencies:** PostgREST `contacts` select; `rpc/upsert_manual_contact(p_email, p_display_name)` (added to API_CONTRACTS §15 and DB §6.9 per R-24; `security invoker`: it lower-cases and validates the email, inserts `contacts{display_name, primary_email, emails:[email], origin:'manual'}` under the OWN-I policy, uses the email's local part as `display_name` when the optional name is empty, and on the `(user_id, primary_email)` conflict returns the existing contact id) → contact id; then the `vip_people` insert `{contact_id, relationship, origin:'user'}` (via M-VIP-03 save).
- **State dependencies:** search term (debounced 250 ms); the selected contact; online.
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY sheet + SearchFieldPill (input hint "Kişi ara…") + avatar rows (38). Defined here (design audit: "The picker screen is not designed").
  - Title "Kişi Ekle".
  - Sections "SON YAZIŞTIKLARIN" (top 10) and results.
  - When the term is a valid email not in contacts: a row `person_add` "“{email}” adresini ekle" with an optional name field "Ad (isteğe bağlı)".
- **Primary CTA:** a row tap → M-VIP-03 prefilled (Save inserts the VIP).
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):** the search field; "Vazgeç" (close); the manual email row → upsert contact → M-VIP-03.
- **Loading:** skeleton rows; an inline spinner during search.
- **Empty:** no contacts at all (no connected mail) → "Henüz yazıştığın kimse görünmüyor." / "Bir e-posta adresi yazarak ekleyebilirsin." Search with no match → "Kişi bulunamadı." + the email-entry hint.
- **Error:** an invalid email → inline "Geçerli bir e-posta adresi gir." (01 input error copy); RPC failure → toast + retry.
- **Offline:** existing contacts from cache (last 50) are searchable locally; manual email add follows ST-OFFLINE-WRITE (needs the server contact id).
- **Permission edge case:** none (device contacts are never used).
- **Approval requirement:** none.
- **Analytics events:** `vip_picker_opened`, `vip_picker_manual_email_used`.
- **Accessibility notes:** the search field is labelled "Kişi ara"; results are announced with a count; rows are buttons.
- **Deep links:** none.
- **Tests:** RNTL `ContactPickerSheet.test.tsx`; pgTAP `upsert_manual_contact.test.sql` (owner-scoped; the email is normalized lower-case; idempotent).

### M-VIP-03 · VIP Ayarı (VIP edit: relationship group, always notify, remove)

- **Screen ID:** M-VIP-03
- **Route:** in-screen `Sheet` on M-VIP-01 and M-PERS-01. Params `contactId`, `mode:'add'|'edit'`.
- **Entry points:** M-VIP-02 selection; a suggestion "Evet" (post-insert grouping); the M-PERS-01 VIP chip ("VIP yap" or "VIP · {grup}"); row long-press on M-VIP-01.
- **Primary purpose:** Set the relationship group, "VIP always notify" (M§31, `vip_people.always_notify`) and the per-VIP quiet-hours bypass (`vip_people.bypass_quiet_hours`, R-13), or remove the VIP.
- **Data dependencies:** `vip_people` row (if any: `relationship`, `always_notify`, `bypass_quiet_hours`); `notification_preferences.vip_bypass_quiet` (the global switch); entitlement; the contact display.
- **API dependencies:** PostgREST `vip_people` insert/update (`relationship`, `always_notify`, `bypass_quiet_hours` under the column grant)/delete. No `priority_rules` row is written. A DB trigger enqueues `insight_refresh` scoped to the contact on VIP changes (so Today/Flow re-rank deterministically).
- **State dependencies:** local form (`relationship`, `alwaysNotify`, `bypassQuietHours`); entitlement; online (queued internal writes).
- **Source design reference:** PRIMARY sheet + FilterChip grid + a 50×30 switch (01 selection controls).
  - Title "{Selin Kaya}" + sub "Önemli Kişi".
  - Kicker "İLİŞKİ": chips "Eş", "Aile", "Yönetici", "Müşteri", "Arkadaş", "Diğer" (→ `spouse`, `family`, `manager`, `key_client`, `friend`, `other`).
  - Switch row "Her zaman bildir" (`vip_people.always_notify`, default on) / meta "Bu kişiden gelen önemli mailler, bildirim sınırlarına takılmadan iletilir."
  - Switch row "Sessiz saatlerde bile" (`vip_people.bypass_quiet_hours`, default on; PRIMARY 07 "VIP kişilerden gelenler · Sessiz saatlerde bile") / meta "Acil önemli mailleri sessiz saatlerde de iletirim; en fazla 3 bildirim." Urgent important mail (`critical_email`) from this person passes quiet hours only when this per-VIP flag and the global `notification_preferences.vip_bypass_quiet` are both on (both default on; Pro only; still deduped and capped at 3 per quiet window, R-13). Other categories still wait for the quiet-hours end. When the global switch is off, this row is disabled with the hint "Bildirim ayarlarında kapalı." and a link to `settings/notifications`.
  - Buttons "Kaydet" (primary); "VIP'lerden çıkar" (destructive text button, edit mode only).
- **Primary CTA:** "Kaydet" → upsert `vip_people` (`relationship`, `always_notify`, `bypass_quiet_hours`) → toast "Kaydedildi" → close; invalidate `['vip']`, `['person',id]`, `['today']`.
- **Secondary actions (real behaviour each):** "VIP'lerden çıkar" → delete the row → toast with "Geri al"; "Vazgeç" (close; in `add` mode from a suggestion, the VIP stays with the default `relationship='other'` → grouped under "DİĞER").
- **Loading:** "Kaydet" spinner.
- **Empty:** not applicable.
- **Error:** save failure → inline "Kaydedilemedi." + retry; `PLAN_LIMIT:vip_max` from the trigger (a Free user's 6th VIP) → ProGateCard(vip) with the body "Ücretsiz planda en fazla 5 önemli kişi ekleyebilirsin."
- **Offline:** save is queued (internal, idempotent upsert on `(user_id, contact_id)`), with the toast "Bağlantı gelince kaydedilecek".
- **Permission edge case:** none at device level. Free: both switches are stored and show the hint "Pro'da etkin" (the effects apply only while `private.is_pro` is true).
- **Approval requirement:** none (internal preference; undo provided).
- **Analytics events:** `vip_updated{field}`, `vip_removed`.
- **Accessibility notes:** the chips are a radio group "İlişki"; the switch has label + meta as its hint; the destructive button is red-text + icon `person_remove` (not colour-only).
- **Deep links:** none.
- **Tests:** RNTL `VipEditSheet.test.tsx`; pgTAP (the VIP row is owner-scoped and only `relationship`, `always_notify`, `bypass_quiet_hours` and `note` are updatable; the trigger enqueues exactly one `insight_refresh` job per change with idempotency key `vip:{user}:{contact}:{updated_at}`).

---

## Flows

Each flow lists: trigger → steps (UI → state → API → backend → DB → provider/AI → approval → side effect → confirmation → refreshed state, M§98) → failure branches → test.

### F-01 · Schedule a task via proposal (M§19)

1. **Backend precondition.** After `tasks_sync`, `worker` runs `insight_refresh` for the Pro user:
   - `calendar-signals.ts` finds the open task "Teklif hazırlama" (due Friday) and a free window tomorrow 14:00–16:30 (all calendars + pending DA blocks + working hours).
   - The T0 slot finder (`packages/domain/src/slots/`, AI_PIPELINE §13.6) ranks the candidates deterministically (earliest due first, then the earliest valid slot) and fills the ICU rationale template. No LLM call is made.
   - It inserts `insights{kind:'schedule_suggestion', reason_code:'free_slot', dedupe_key:'schedule_suggestion:task:{task_id}:{window_start_epoch}', payload{task_id, window_start, window_end, block_start:14:00, block_end:15:00}}` with provenance `source_type='task'`.
2. **UI.** The user opens Plan (M-PLAN-01). `rpc/plan_range` and the insights query render the dashed proposal block at 14:00 tomorrow and the TAKVİM ZEKÂSI card: "Yarın 14:00–16:30 arasında 2,5 saat boşluğun var." / "Teklif hazırlama görevini buraya yerleştirebilirim." / "Planla" / "Başka zaman".
3. **Tap "Planla".** `POST /plan/proposals {insight_id}`. The `api` server:
   - checks entitlement;
   - re-checks the slot against fresh busy data;
   - resolves the destination (`user_preferences.default_write_calendar_id`, or the primary calendar of the calendar account);
   - builds the payload (`attendees:[]`, `send_updates:'none'`, description with the marker);
   - inserts `approval_actions{action_type:'calendar_create', status:'pending', idempotency_key, approval_expires_at:block_start, origin:'plan_proposal', origin_ref_id:insight_id}` + an `approval_events` row;
   - returns `{approval}`.

   It is idempotent: a repeat tap returns the same pending approval.
4. **Sheet.** The app pushes `plan/proposal/{id}` (M-PLAN-03) with the six rows. The timeline block meta changes to "Onay bekliyor".
5. **Optional "Saati Değiştir".** M-PLAN-04 → `GET /plan/free-slots?...&exclude_approval_id=` → the user picks 15:00–16:00 → `PATCH /approvals/:id` → new `payload_version` and key → the sheet updates "Değişim".
6. **Tap "Onayla".** `POST /approvals/:id/approve {idempotency_key, payload_version, approved_via:'inline_sheet'}` → `private.transition_approval` `pending→approved` → an `approval_execute` job is enqueued + the worker is poked → 202.
7. **Worker.** `approved→executing` → decrypt the token → Google `events.insert` with deterministic `id` = base32hex(approval id) and `extendedProperties.private.da_approval_id` (Graph: `transactionId`). On `409` → treated as success, fetch the existing event. Upsert `calendar_events` from the provider response → approval `executed`, `result_ref` = the event id → insight `done` → audit.
8. **Client.** Polling sees `executed` → "Planlandı" success ring + success haptic + the line "Yarın 15:00–16:00 “Teklif hazırlama” takvimine eklendi." → "Plan'a Dön" → `plan?date=…&focus=event:{id}`. The block renders solid indigo "Dijital Asistan ekledi".
9. **Failure branches:**
   - `capability_missing` → "İzin Ver" → `/integrations/:accountId/upgrade` → OAuth → re-approve with the same key.
   - `slot_unavailable` at execution → `failed` + "Bu saat artık dolu." + "Saati Değiştir".
   - Provider 5xx → job retry with backoff; the UI stays "Takvime ekleniyor…"; after `max_attempts` → `failed` + push (§0.7) + "Tekrar Dene" (same key; there is no duplicate thanks to the deterministic id).
   - Device calendar → §0.4.6.
   - "Başka zaman" at step 2 → `POST /plan/proposals {insight_id, action:'next_slot'}` → the next suggestion or "Bu hafta uygun başka boşluk bulamadım."
10. **Test:** Maestro `plan/plan-schedule-proposal.yaml` (demo adapter; asserts the "Planlandı" text only after the mocked executor completes); Deno `approvals_execute_calendar_test.ts` (double execution → one provider insert).

### F-02 · Resolve a conflict (M§20, SREQ-20)

1. **Detection.** After `calendar_sync`, `insight_refresh` finds "Müşteri toplantısı" (14:00–15:00, organizer Mehmet, the user is not the organizer, 2 attendees) overlapping "Doktor randevusu" (14:30, a `life_events` reservation grounded in the email "Randevu maili"). It inserts `insights{kind:'conflict'}` with the suppression dedupe key. Since the conflict is within 48 h, the notification engine (quiet hours, cap, detail mode `title_only`) sends "Takvim çakışması" / "Önümüzdeki iki gün içinde iki etkinliğin çakışıyor."
2. **Open.** The user taps the push → the router guard → `plan/conflict/{insightId}` (M-PLAN-07). The pair renders from cache, with a warning haptic. The sheet auto-opens → `POST /plan/conflicts/:insightId/options`.
3. **Options** (deterministic):
   - (1) "Toplantıyı 15:30'a öner" — "Mehmet'e öneri maili taslağı hazırlanır" (recommended: the user is not the organizer, so the meeting cannot be moved directly);
   - (2) "Randevu sahibine yaz" (the booking email is reply-able);
   - (3) "Randevu yerini ara" (only if a grounded phone number exists);
   - (4) "Beni hatırlat, kendim çözeyim";
   - (5) "Böyle kalsın".

   No availability claims are made.
4. **Pick (1).** `POST /plan/conflicts/:insightId/resolve {option_id}` → the server generates the reply draft (feature `reply_draft`, tone "Profesyonel", grounded on the meeting invite thread) → `reply_drafts` row → submit → `approval_actions{action_type:'email_send', origin:'conflict_resolution'}` → returns `{approval}`.
5. **M-PLAN-08 preview.** "Ne: Mehmet Yılmaz'a yeni saat önerisi" · "Neden: 14:30 doktor randevunla çakışıyor" · "Kaynak: Takvim daveti · Randevu maili" · "Değişim: 1 mail gönderilecek" · "Hesap: Gmail · yunus@…" · "Etkisi: 1 mail gönderilecek · Profesyonel ton · Ek yok". "Düzenle" → `mail/{id}/reply?draftId=` to adjust the text → back.
6. **"Onayla"** → approve → the worker sends through Gmail with `Message-ID: <approval-{id}@mail.dijitalasistan.app>` (checks `rfc822msgid:` before any retry) → `executed`.
7. **Confirmation.** The sheet shows "Öneri maili gönderildi." / "Çakışma, toplantı saati değişene kadar listede kalır." The thread becomes `awaiting_their_reply` (Part 2 follow-up). When Mehmet moves the event, the next `calendar_sync` → `insight_refresh` no longer detects the overlap → the insight is `done` → reopening the screen shows "Bu çakışma artık yok."
8. **Organizer variant.** Option "Müşteri toplantısını 13:00'e al" → `calendar_update` approval with "Katılımcılara güncelleme gönderilir" → Google `events.patch sendUpdates=all` / Graph PATCH → `executed` → "Çözüldü · {Müşteri toplantısı} {13:00}'e taşındı" (only after the insight becomes `done` post-sync).
9. **Failure branches:** `not_organizer` (changed meanwhile) → "Seçeneklere Dön"; `conflict_resolved` (409) → the success tile; Free → ProGateCard in the sheet (detection stays visible); offline → ST-OFFLINE-WRITE.
10. **Test:** Maestro `plan/plan-conflict-resolve.yaml` (demo: organizer and non-organizer fixtures); vitest `conflict-options.test.ts`.

### F-03 · Meeting prep from notification (M§21)

1. **Schedule.** `scheduler_tick` enqueues `meeting_prep` at T−60 for the Pro user's 14:30 meeting, because Mehmet is an external attendee (R-23: precompute only for external or VIP meetings), with the job key `meeting_prep:{event_id}:{start_at_epoch}` (DB §6.2).
2. **Generate.** The worker gathers the grounded context: invite description, the last 3 threads with the contact, open insights, commitments both directions, the previous meeting's `meeting_notes`, event attachments. It runs the prep model (feature `meeting_prep`) → zod-validates (≤3 talking points with `source_refs`, summary ≤300 words) → the grounding verifier drops unsourced claims → `meeting_preps{status:'ready'}`.
3. **Notify.** The notification decision engine checks relevance, quiet hours, frequency cap and detail mode. At T−20 it sends `title_only` "Toplantı hazırlığı" / "Bir sonraki toplantın 20 dakika sonra. Hazırlığın hazır." with the data `{type:'meeting_prep', entity_id:eventId, deeplink:'dijitalasistan://meeting/{eventId}/prep'}`.
4. **Open.** A tap → guard chain (session, onboarding, Pro, entity) → M-MEET-01 renders from `['meeting','prep',eventId]` (prefetched on notification receipt when the app is foregrounded) → the countdown chip reads "20 dk".
5. **Interactions:**
   - The person row → `person/{mehmet}`.
   - A "SON MAİLLER" row → `mail/{id}` (Email Detail).
   - "Google Meet'e Katıl" (the allowlisted `hangoutLink`) → `Linking.openURL` → the Meet app.
   - "2 Dakikalık Özeti Oku" → M-MEET-03 → headphones → `expo-speech` tr-TR reads the paragraphs.
   - "Not Al" → M-MEET-02 → `POST /meetings/:eventId/notes`.
6. **At start** the chip reads "Başladı". **At the end** it reads "Bitti" and the footer changes to "Toplantı sonrası not al" (F-04).
7. **Failure branches:**
   - Prep not ready at open (a race) → `POST /meetings/:eventId/prep` → 202 → the ST-AI-WORKING skeleton → poll.
   - Failed → "Hazırlık oluşturulamadı." + "Tekrar Dene".
   - Free user (a push is never sent; a deep link lands) → ProGateCard(meeting_prep).
   - Offline → the cached prep with "{14:02}'de hazırlandı".
8. **Test:** Maestro `meetings/meeting-prep-notification.yaml` (uses the e2e push-simulation deep link `dijitalasistan://meeting/{id}/prep?origin=push`); Deno `meetings_prep_test.ts`.

### F-04 · Post-meeting voice capture → commitments (M§22)

1. **Trigger.** At event end + 1 min, `scheduler_tick` enqueues the post-meeting prompt with the job key `post_meeting:{event_id}` (DB §6.2); the notification's dedupe key is `meeting:calendar_event:{event_id}:{local_date}`. It is sent silently: "Toplantın bitti." / "Takip etmen gereken bir şey var mı?" with the deeplink `meeting/{eventId}/post`.
2. **Open.** M-MEET-04 opens in the idle state. The user taps the mic (first use → permission prompts). `useSpeechInput` uses the on-device tr-TR engine if available, else `expo-audio` recording.
3. **Speak.** "Mehmet'e yarın teklif göndereceğim. Sözleşme için hukuktan Perşembe'ye kadar yorum isteyeceğim." The live transcript and waveform update. 1.2 s of silence stops recording. (Server fallback: upload to `POST /assistant/transcribe` → the text; the audio is discarded server-side.)
4. **Extract.** The user reviews or edits the transcript → "Taahhütleri Çıkar" → `POST /meetings/:eventId/post {input_mode:'voice', text, client_note_id}`. The server:
   - saves `meeting_notes{kind:'post_meeting'}`;
   - runs the post-meeting commitment parse (`ai_feature` `post_meeting_parse`, T1, no tools);
   - verifies the grounding: each proposal's evidence quote must be in the note;
   - resolves dates against the event end in the user's tz ("yarın" → D+1; "Perşembe'ye kadar" → the next Thursday 23:59 with `due_precision:'date'`);
   - resolves the contacts: Mehmet → the attendee contact; "hukuk" → `counterparty_label:'Hukuk ekibi'`;
   - sets the directions: both `user_owes`;
   - creates 2 pending `commitment_create` approvals;
   - returns the proposals.
5. **Review.** The UI shows "2 YENİ TAAHHÜT": "Mehmet'e teklif gönder · Yarın · Mehmet Yılmaz" ✓ and "Hukuktan sözleşme yorumu iste · Perşembe · Hukuk ekibi" ✓. A tap on a row → M-MEET-05 to edit (PATCH → new version).
6. **Save.** "Kaydet" → for each selected: `POST /approvals/:id/approve` → the internal executor inserts `commitments` (dedupe key) → `executed`. The per-row check animates.
7. **Confirmation.** "2 taahhüt kaydedildi." / "Son tarihlerinden önce Bugün'de görürsün." → "Taahhütleri Gör". Invalidation: `['commitments']`, `['person',mehmet]`, `['today']`, `['plan']`. The `embedding` job indexes the note for memory.
8. **Failure branches:** mic denied → text mode; none found → "Takip edilecek bir şey bulamadım."; an ambiguous date forces edit; discard → reject `user_cancel` + delete the note; offline after transcription → the MMKV draft + "Bağlantı gelince taahhütleri çıkarabilirim."
9. **Test:** Maestro `meetings/post-meeting-voice.yaml` (e2e STT test double injects the transcript); vitest `tr-relative.test.ts`; Deno `meetings_post_test.ts`.

### F-05 · Assistant question with citations (M§24)

1. **Ask.** The user taps "Mehmet ile en son ne konuştuk?" on M-ASST-01 → `chat/new?prompt=last_contact` → `POST /assistant/threads {}` → `{thread}` → `POST /assistant/threads/:id/messages {content, input_mode:'text', client_message_id}` (SSE).
2. **Server.** Checks the budget → retrieval tools (read-only, user-scoped): `find_contact("Mehmet")` → a single match `Mehmet Yılmaz` (if several → a `card` event `{type:'list', data:{kind:'person_choice'}}` and the answer stops there), `search_memory(contact_id, recent)`, `get_threads(contact_id, limit 3)`, `get_meeting_notes(contact_id)`. Items above the threshold exist, so the grounded answer model (`ai_feature` `assistant_qa`) streams.
3. **Client stream.** `meta` → `status{stage:'retrieving'}` → typing dots → the server buffers each sentence, checks it against the cited items (dates re-parsed) and emits only verified sentences as `delta` ("Kaynaklar kontrol ediliyor…" shows while `status.stage='verifying'`) → three `citation` events (mail "Re: Teklif · Gmail · dün 18:20", note "Toplantı notu · 1 Eyl", event "Tanışma toplantısı · 18 Ağu") → the source card rows appear → `done{grounded:true, finish_reason:'stop'}`. After `done` the client reads the stored message row (`followup_suggestions`: "Ona yanıt taslağı hazırla", "Açık konularımız neler?") and shows the chips. The `assistant_messages` rows are persisted with citations; `ai_requests` telemetry holds no content.
4. **Open a source.** The mail row → `mail/{id}` (Email Detail, Part 2); the note row → `event/{id}`; the person header card → `person/{id}`.
5. **No-data branch.** "Kerem ile ne konuştuk?" (no such contact or data) → the deterministic no-answer without an LLM call: "Maillerinde, takviminde ve notlarında bununla ilgili bir şey bulamadım." + chips "Hafızada ara" / "Soruyu değiştir".
6. **Partial branch.** The model claims an amount that is absent from the evidence → the verifier drops it → the final text ends with "Tutar kaynakta kesinleşmiyor."
7. **Failure branches:** a mid-stream error → "Yanıt yarıda kaldı." + "Tekrar Dene" (same `client_message_id`); ST-AI-LIMIT; offline composer disabled.
8. **Test:** Maestro `assistant/assistant-citations.yaml` (demo fixture provider; asserts the source card navigation to the Email Detail title); Deno `assistant_messages_test.ts` (zero LLM calls on no-hit; cross-user citation rejected).

### F-06 · Assistant write intent → approval (M§115)

1. **Ask.** In M-ASST-02 after F-05, the user taps the chip "Ona yanıt taslağı hazırla" (or types "Mehmet'e teklifi bu akşam göndereceğimi yaz").
2. **Server.** Intent classification (`AssistantIntentV1`: T0 grammar, then T1; R-04) detects a write → the server-internal action `create_reply_draft(thread_id, tone:'professional')` (not an LLM tool with side effects; it is the `api` domain service) → `reply_drafts` row (grounded on the thread) → `POST /reply-drafts/:id/submit` equivalent → `approval_actions{action_type:'email_send', origin:'assistant'}` → the stream emits `delta{text:"Hazırladım. Profesyonel tonda, bu akşam gönderimi teyit ediyor."}` + `action_proposal{approval}` + `done`.
3. **UI.** A DraftCard "TASLAK · MEHMET YILMAZ" (2-line preview) with "Göndermeyi Onayla" / "Düzenle". "Ayrıntılar" shows the six rows (Hesap: "Gmail · yunus@…", Etkisi: "1 mail gönderilecek · Profesyonel ton · Ek yok"). The Approval Center count increments (Today pill, Part 1).
4. **Edit (optional).** "Düzenle" → `mail/{messageId}/reply?draftId=` (AI Reply modal, tones Kısa/Profesyonel/Samimi/Detaylı) → `PATCH /reply-drafts/:id` → new approval payload version → back to the thread; the card shows the new preview.
5. **Approve.** "Göndermeyi Onayla" → `POST /approvals/:id/approve` → the worker sends via Gmail (or Graph `POST /messages/{id}/reply`) with provider idempotency → `executed` → the card morphs "Gönderiliyor…" → "Gönderildi" + success haptic.
6. **Refreshed state.** The thread becomes `awaiting_their_reply`; the Flow card updates (Part 2).
7. **Other intents:**
   - "Yarın 10:00'a Selin ile toplantı koy" → `calendar_create` card with "Selin Kaya'ya davet gönderilir".
   - "Yarın sabah hatırlat" → `reminder_create` card.
   - "Selin'i yarına ertele" → internal snooze + undo card (no approval).
8. **Failure branches:** `mail_send` capability missing → "İzin Ver" (Gmail `gmail.send` progressive consent) → re-approve with the same key; "Reddet" → `rejected` + learning signal toast "Reddedildi · Öğrendim".
9. **Test:** Maestro `assistant/assistant-write-intent.yaml`; Deno (the prompt-injection email fixture never yields an approval without an explicit user intent).

### F-07 · Voice "Mehmet'ten cevap geldi mi?" (M§25)

1. **Open.** The user long-presses the Today mic (or the Asistan mic) → `voice?origin=today` (M-VOICE-01) → permissions granted before → idle "Konuşmak için dokun" → tap.
2. **Listen.** On-device tr-TR recognition shows the interim "Mehmet'ten cevap…" → final "Mehmet'ten cevap geldi mi?" after 1.2 s of silence → "Anlıyorum…".
3. **Server.** `POST /assistant/threads` → messages `{input_mode:'voice'}`. Retrieval: contact Mehmet Yılmaz → the latest outbound thread "Teklif v2" sent 3 days ago, no inbound reply since → the grounded answer: "Henüz gelmedi. Teklifi 3 gün önce gönderdin. İstersen kısa bir takip mesajı hazırlayıp onayına sunabilirim." (the offer sentence only for Pro users, since Follow-Up is Pro) → verified `delta` sentences → `done` → TTS speaks it (`expo-speech` tr-TR); the answer text is shown.
4. **Follow-up.** The user taps the orb (barge-in) and says "Evet, hazırla." → the server runs `POST /followups/:threadId/draft` internally → `email_send` approval → `action_proposal` → the compact ApprovalCard "ONAY GEREKİYOR · MAİL GÖNDER" / "Mehmet Yılmaz'a takip mesajı" / the preview "Merhaba Mehmet, 2 Eylül'de ilettiğim teklif hakkında görüşünüzü alabilir miyim? …" / Hesap "Gmail · yunus@…" / hint "Onaylamak için Onayla'ya dokun."
5. **Approve.** The user says "Onayla" → nothing is executed; TTS answers "Onaylamak için ekrandaki Onayla'ya dokun." (C-07). The user taps "Onayla" → approve → `executing` "Gönderiliyor…" → `executed` → "Gönderildi" + success haptic + TTS "Gönderildi." The approve call carries `approved_via='voice_card'` (R-03), recorded on `approval_actions` and in `approval_events`.
6. **Persistence.** The thread (title "Mehmet'ten cevap geldi mi?") appears in "SON SOHBETLER"; "Metinle devam et" opens it in M-ASST-02.
7. **Failure branches:**
   - Two Mehmets → "Hangi Mehmet?" chips.
   - STT unavailable → "Sesli giriş bu cihazda kullanılamıyor." + "Metinle sor".
   - Mic denied → the permission state.
   - Offline → "Çevrimdışıyken soru yanıtlanamaz."
   - "İptal" → reject `user_cancel` (no learning).
8. **Test:** Maestro `voice/voice-mehmet-reply.yaml` (e2e STT test double + the fixture provider; asserts no execution before the tap); RNTL `VoiceMode.test.tsx`.

### F-08 · Memory search "Geçen ay aldığım uçak bileti neydi?" (M§26)

1. **Search.** The user opens Asistan → "Hafıza" → M-MEM-01 (Pro) → types or taps the example "Geçen ay aldığım uçak bileti neydi?" → submit.
2. **API.** `GET /search?q=…&mode=answer`. The server:
   - the TR date parser maps "geçen ay" on 2026-09-23 to 2026-08-01..2026-08-31 Europe/Istanbul;
   - embeds the query with Voyage `voyage-4-lite` (1024-d, R-01);
   - hybrid retrieval over `memory_chunks` (derived facts, never raw bodies) + `life_events{type:'flight'}` in the date range, filtered by `user_id` and `expires_at > now()`, RRF;
   - rerank;
   - the grounded answer model;
   - verification: the flight number, route and date must come from the evidence; the price only if stated.
3. **Response.** "CEVAP": "Geçen ay 1 uçuş bileti bulundu: **TK2412** İstanbul → Antalya, **14 Ağustos 09:15**." + "Ödenen tutar kaynakta kesinleşmiyor." if absent. Meta "2 kaynaktan · Güçlü eşleşme". Sources:
   - `flight` "Türk Hava Yolları · Uçuş" · "14 Ağu" · "TK2412 İstanbul → Antalya" → `life/{id}`;
   - `mail` "Gmail · Türk Hava Yolları" · "2 Ağu" · "Rezervasyon onayı" → `mail/{id}`.

   Related questions follow, then the retention footer "Hafıza, veri saklama ayarına bağlı: son 90 gün. Daha eski kayıtlar otomatik silinir."
4. **Open.** "Orijinali Aç" on the mail → Email Detail (the original mail body is fetched on demand via `GET /mail/:messageId/original`, not stored).
5. **Retention branch.** If the user's retention is `d30`, "geçen ay" partly or wholly falls outside it → `excluded_by_retention:true` → "Bu tarih, veri saklama süren (30 gün) dışında kalıyor." + "Saklama ayarı".
6. **Free branch.** ProGateCard(ai_memory) + "Arama her zaman ücretsiz" → `search?q=uçak bileti` (FTS results only).
7. **Test:** Maestro `memory/memory-flight-ticket.yaml` (demo fixtures with relative dates: the flight is dated to the previous calendar month); Deno `search_answer_test.ts`.

### F-09 · VIP add from suggestion (M§30)

1. **Precondition.** The Pro user has exchanged 14 messages with Selin Kaya in 30 days (6 sent by the user); she is not a VIP and has no negative feedback.
2. **Load.** The user opens Settings → "Önemli Kişiler" → M-VIP-01 → `rpc/vip_suggestions()` (RPC-13; the first row is shown) → the suggestion row "Öneri: **Selin Kaya** ile son 30 günde 14 kez yazıştın. VIP yapayım mı?" with "Evet" / "Şimdi değil".
3. **Accept.** Tap "Evet":
   - Optimistic insert `vip_people{contact_id, origin:'suggestion'}` via PostgREST (RLS + the `vip_max` trigger) → toast "Selin Kaya VIP'lere eklendi" + "Geri al".
   - The DB trigger enqueues `insight_refresh` (contact-scoped; key `vip:{user}:{contact}:{ts}`) → the priority engine applies the `explicit_rule` tier for Selin's open threads → Today and Flow re-rank on the next fetch.
4. **Group.** M-VIP-03 opens → the user picks "Müşteri", turns on "Her zaman bildir" → "Kaydet" → update `relationship='key_client'`, `always_notify=true` (the default; no `priority_rules` row) → toast "Kaydedildi" → Selin appears under "MÜŞTERİ" with the meta "Kuzey… · Sözleşme 4. madde bekliyor" (computed).
5. **Undo branch.** "Geri al" within 5 s → delete the VIP row → the list and the suggestion restore.
6. **Dismiss branch.** "Şimdi değil" → `ai_feedback{feature:'assistant_intent', target_type:'contact', target_id, rating:-1, reason_code:'other'}` → the suggestion is hidden for 90 days.
7. **Offline branch.** "Evet" is queued (pending badge) and replays on reconnect idempotently on `(user_id, contact_id)`.
8. **Test:** Maestro `people/vip-add-suggestion.yaml`; pgTAP `vip_suggestions.test.sql`; vitest `priority-engine.test.ts`.

# Screen & Flow Map, Part 4: Settings, Privacy, Notifications, Subscription, Referral, Widgets, Android Notification Intelligence, Global States

> Part 4 of `docs/SCREEN_AND_FLOW_MAP.md`. It follows the master plan (`ADR-01..15`, §5 canonical enums and tables, §5b `api` catalogue, §9 mobile route tree, §11 web routes). It also follows the master prompt (cited as **M§n**) and the audit resolutions: design-account-states-marketing, design-secondary-code, secondary-docs (SREQ-xx, C-xx, P-xx, F-xx) and integrations.
> Design precedence: **PRIMARY wins visually. The master prompt wins functionally.** Prototype fakes are never copied. The registry items used by §1–§9 (canonical, accepted in the cross-document reconciliation of plan §23b, or still proposed) are listed in §0.7 with the exact contract each screen uses. Anything else this part needs that the canonical registry does not contain is listed in the final section, "Proposed additions to the canonical registry".

---

The VIP list (`/vip`) and the Approval Center (`/approvals`) are reached from the hub but are specified in other parts.

### 0.2 Block format (M§145)
Every block has these 20 fields: **Screen ID · Route · Entry points · Primary purpose · Data dependencies · API dependencies · State dependencies · Source design reference · Primary CTA · Secondary actions · Loading · Empty · Error · Offline · Permission edge case · Approval requirement · Analytics events · Accessibility notes · Deep links · Tests.**

### 0.3 Navigation containers
- `app/settings/_layout.tsx` is a Stack. The root `_layout` registers `settings` with `presentation: 'modal'` (iOS pageSheet, Android full-screen slide).
  - The layout exports `unstable_settings = { initialRouteName: 'index' }`, so a deep link to any sub-page still has the hub underneath and Back returns to it.
  - The hub shows a 36 px `close` button (7.1). Sub-pages show `arrow_back`.
  - Android hardware or predictive back closes an open sheet first, then pops.
- `app/paywall` uses `presentation: 'modal'`. Its params are `source` (a `paywall_source` value), optional `feature` and `mode=change`. Close is visible from the first frame.
- Sheets use one custom Reanimated sheet host with the PRIMARY bottom-sheet spec: scrim `rgba(27,25,23,.35)` (dark `rgba(0,0,0,.5)`), radius 28 top, grabber 36×5, open 300 ms, close 240 ms, dim 250 ms, and a light haptic on open. Sheets are not routes unless listed.
- Deep links:
  - Custom scheme: `dijitalasistan://<route>`.
  - Universal / App Links: `https://<web-domain>/app/<route>`.
  - Analytics suffix: `?src=push|widget|web&w=<family>`.
  - Every deep link passes the root auth gate. A signed-out user is sent to `(auth)/sign-in` and the target is replayed after login.
- `app/settings/android-notifications` has a route guard. On iOS it `router.replace('/settings')`, and no row links to it on iOS (F-04, REQ-ANDNI-06).

### 0.4 UI kit components used (`packages/ui`, PRIMARY 07/08 anatomy)
`ScreenHeader`, `PageTitle`, `SectionKicker`, `GroupedList`/`ListCard`, `SettingsRow` (nav/toggle/radio/check/destructive/link-text/static/icon-tile), `Toggle`, `SegmentedControl` (3 and 4 segments), `Chip` (filter/selected/token/add/suggestion), `StatusBadge`, `Button` (primary/ink/destructive/tonal/text/neutral/disabled, sizes 52/48/44/40/38), `StickyFooterCTA`, `BottomSheet`, `ConfirmDialog`, `UndoToast`, `InkCallout`, `EmptyState`, `InlineErrorCard`, `OfflineBanner`, `Skeleton`, `AISpinner`, `PlanComparisonTable`, `PlanOptionCard`, `ProGateCard`, `ReferralLinkField`, `InviteRow`, `ThemePreviewTile`, `RulePreviewCard`, `NotificationPreviewCard` (2.12 style), `TimeChip`.

Ink surfaces (Approval card, promise card, offline banner, toast, 2×2 widget) use `#1F1E1B` plus a 1 px `rgba(255,255,255,.08)` ring in dark mode. The dark toast uses `#2A2926` plus a ring (design-system audit).

### 0.5 Rules common to every settings screen
1. **Auto-save.** Toggles, radios, segments and pickers save when changed.
   - The update is optimistic (TanStack `onMutate`) and reverts on error with the error toast "Kaydedilemedi. Tekrar dene." (coral icon).
   - The only screens with explicit Save buttons are the rule editor (M-SET-51), the learned-preference edit (M-SET-46), and the time pickers ("Tamam").
2. **Offline.** Settings screens render from the persisted cache (§14) with the `OfflineBanner`.
   - Controls whose write is classed *queued* (§14.2) stay enabled and show "Bağlantı gelince kaydedilecek" under the row.
   - Controls classed *blocked* are disabled (opacity .4) with the reason "Bu işlem için internet bağlantısı gerekiyor."
3. **Truthful copy.** Nothing claims more than the architecture does: no "uçtan uca şifreleme", no "Sınırsız", no hard-coded prices, no fake success (M§40, M§100, M§141).
4. **Non-interactive rows** (info rows, never-lists) have no chevron and no pressed state (SREQ-85).
5. **Typography and contrast.** Informational meta text uses `ink/tertiary-strong #726E66` (light) instead of `#9B978E`, which fails AA per plan §2. `#9B978E` is kept for decorative kickers ≥12 px and disabled text. Coral text on `#F5F4F0` at 15 px (4.47:1) is rendered at 15/600 on white card surfaces only.
6. **Accessibility baseline** for every row:
   - `accessibilityRole` of `button`, `switch`, `radio` or `header`.
   - A label that combines title, value and state, e.g. "Öğle nabzı, 13:00, Pro özelliği, kilitli".
   - Hit slop to 44 pt (iOS) or 48 dp (Android) on "Yönet", "Geri al", suggestion chips and "Satın alımı geri yükle".
   - `allowFontScaling` with `maxFontSizeMultiplier` 1.8 on rows and 1.4 on dense tables.
   - Focus moves to the sheet title when a sheet opens.
   - `AccessibilityInfo.announceForAccessibility` on toasts. Undo toasts last 10 s while a screen reader is running.
7. **i18n.** Every string is an ICU key in `packages/i18n` (`tr` default, `en` complete). Namespaces: `settings.*`, `privacy.*`, `notifications.*`, `subscription.*`, `referral.*`, `ani.*`, `widgets.*`, `state.*`, `push.*`. Turkish upper-casing uses `toLocaleUpperCase('tr-TR')`.
8. **Analytics.** Events go through `POST /analytics/events` with allow-listed names and typed, content-free props (§15). They never contain names, emails, subjects or free text.
9. **Kill switches.** When a feature flag disables a feature (M§63), its rows and screens show the honest state "Bu özellik şu anda kullanılamıyor." with no CTA. Nothing is hidden behind a dead control.

### 0.7 Registry items used by §1–§9

Names in this table are used verbatim in the blocks. "Accepted" items were decided in the cross-document reconciliation (plan §23b and the registry decisions); "proposed" items are additions that DATABASE_AND_RLS_PLAN or API_CONTRACTS must carry.

| Item | Kind · status | Contract used by this part | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /integrations/oauth/complete` (API-INT-07) | `api` route · accepted (R-07) | Body `{completion_code, device_nonce}` with the user JWT → 200 `{result, account_id, granted, resume}`. `result` is `success`, `partial`, `account_mismatch`, `already_linked` or `plan_limit`; `granted` is a `capability[]`; `resume` is `{approval_id}` or null. The server requires `oauth_states.user_id = auth.uid()`, `sha256(device_nonce) = device_nonce_hash`, `sha256(completion_code) = completion_code_hash`, `completed_at is null` and a state younger than 10 min. Another user or a wrong nonce → `403 FORBIDDEN`; a reused or expired state → `409 STATE_CONFLICT`. Until completion the account stays `connecting` and nothing is synced; an unbound account is revoked and purged after 10 min. | M-SET-11, M-SET-12, M-SET-14 |
| OAuth start binding and callback query | `api` fields · accepted (R-07) | `POST /integrations/:provider/start` and `POST /integrations/:accountId/upgrade` also carry `device_nonce_hash`: the hex SHA-256 of a 32-byte random `device_nonce` that the app keeps in SecureStore `da.oauth.pending` for 10 min. The `oauth` function redirects to `dijitalasistan://integrations/callback?state_id=&provider=&result=&error_code=&completion_code=` (or `https://<web-domain>/oauth/done?…` with the same parameters). `result` is `pending_confirmation`, `denied`, `error`, `expired_state` or `admin_consent_required`; `completion_code` is present only with `pending_confirmation`. | M-SET-11, M-SET-12, M-SET-14 |
| `app/integrations/callback` | mobile route · accepted | OAuth return handler | M-SET-14 |
| `POST /notifications/test` (API-DEV-04) | `api` route · accepted | Body `{category}` (a `notification_category`) → 202 `{decision, reason}`; `decision` is `sent` or `suppressed`, `reason` is `quiet_hours` or null. Rendered with the user's effective detail level and sent only to the calling installation's active token. It never bypasses quiet hours (R-13). No active token → `409 STATE_CONFLICT` (`details.reason='push_unavailable'`); more than 3 in 10 min → `429 RATE_LIMITED`. | M-SET-20 |
| `history_deletion_preview(p_older_than timestamptz default null)` (RPC-19) | PostgREST RPC, `security invoker` · accepted | → `{summaries, priority_decisions, memory_chunks, learned_preferences, assistant_threads, captures}`: counts of the caller's own rows older than `p_older_than` (`null` = all analysis history). Read-only. | M-SET-35, M-SET-36 |
| `POST /privacy/export/:id/download` | `api` route · accepted | → 200 `{url, expires_at}`: a 300 s signed URL for `exports/{uid}/{id}.zip`, minted per tap; sets `downloaded_at`; audit `export.downloaded`. A foreign id → `404 NOT_FOUND`; a request that is not `ready` → `409 STATE_CONFLICT`. | M-SET-38 |

### M-SET-02 · Çıkış onayı (Sign-out sheet)

| Field | Spec |
|---|---|
| Screen ID | M-SET-02 |
| Route | Sheet on `/settings` (not a route) |
| Entry points | "Çıkış Yap" on M-SET-01 |
| Primary purpose | Confirm and perform a real local sign-out with full local cleanup (M§87, ADR-06). |
| Data dependencies | Paused-mutation count (outbox, §14); connectivity |
| API dependencies | `POST /devices/unregister` (API-DEV-02) `{installation_id, reason:'logout'}` (best effort, 3 s timeout); Supabase `auth.signOut({scope:'local'})`; RevenueCat `Purchases.logOut()` |
| State dependencies | queryClient (clear), MMKV instances (wipe), SecureStore keys (delete), `da-widgets` snapshot (rewritten as `WidgetSnapshotV1` with `state:'signed_out'`, timelines reloaded), NI module (`disable()` + `clearBuffer()`), expo-notifications scheduled local reminders (`cancelAllScheduledNotificationsAsync`), share-intent pending files (delete) |
| Source design reference | No PRIMARY artboard; BottomSheet spec from 7.4; DESIGN_AUDIT §F-14 |
| Layout & copy | Icon tile `logout`. Title "Çıkış yapılsın mı?". Body "Bu cihazdaki önbellek, widget verileri ve kurulu hatırlatıcılar silinir. Bağlı hesapların ve ayarların hesabında kalır." When paused mutations exist: warning box "Gönderilmemiş {n} değişiklik var; çıkış yaparsan kaybolur." Buttons: ink "Çıkış Yap", text "Vazgeç". |
| Primary CTA | "Çıkış Yap". Order: unregister device → `Purchases.logOut()` (catch the anonymous error) → `signOut({scope:'local'})` → local wipe → `router.replace('/(auth)/sign-in')`. The button shows a spinner and the sheet is not dismissible while it runs. |
| Secondary actions | "Vazgeç" or drag down → dismiss |
| Loading | Button spinner; target under 2 s |
| Empty | n/a |
| Error | Unregister failure never blocks sign-out; the pending cleanup is recorded (see Offline). A local wipe failure is logged to Sentry and the wipe is retried at the next launch. |
| Offline | Allowed. Before the local sign-out, the refresh token is stored encrypted in SecureStore as `pending_session_cleanup`. The next time the app is online (even signed out), it refreshes the session, calls `POST /devices/unregister`, then `signOut({scope:'local'})` online (revokes that session) and deletes the key. The sheet adds the line "Çevrimdışısın. Bu cihazın bildirimleri internete bağlandığında durdurulur." |
| Permission edge case | n/a |
| Approval requirement | None; explicit confirmation |
| Analytics events | `sign_out{scope:'this', offline:boolean}` (sent before the wipe) |
| Accessibility notes | Focus on the title; destructive semantics announced; the sheet is modal (`accessibilityViewIsModal`) |
| Deep links | none |
| Tests | Unit `signOut.test.ts` asserts the order of calls and that every store is wiped. Maestro `auth/sign-out.yaml` ends on the sign-in screen, and relaunch does not restore the session. Offline variant stores `pending_session_cleanup`. Deno test: `devices/unregister` disables `push_tokens` for the installation. |

## 2. Connected accounts

**Provider rows by platform (C-35).**
- Mail: Gmail, Outlook.
- Calendar: Google Takvim, Microsoft Takvim, Apple Takvim (iOS only, EventKit, "iCloud · cihazdan okunur"), Cihaz Takvimi (Android only, CalendarContract).
- Tasks: Google Tasks, Microsoft To Do, Apple Hatırlatıcılar (iOS only).

Google and Microsoft rows are **account-level**: one `connected_accounts` row per provider identity, with capability chips "Mail · Takvim · Görevler".

**Free limits come from `plan_limits`** (key names per R-22; the server reads them through `check_plan_limit`):
- `max_mail_accounts` = 1
- `max_calendar_accounts` = 1
- `max_calendars` = 1 (one selected calendar across all sources: the primary calendar)

A second mail- or calendar-capable account, or an additional calendar inside an account, requires Pro (M§44). This is checked client-side for UX and **server-side** in `POST /integrations/:provider/start` and `PATCH /integrations/:accountId/data-sources` (`402 ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED`), in `POST /integrations/oauth/complete` (`result:'plan_limit'`) and by the `trg_connected_accounts_plan_limit` / `trg_calendars_plan_limit` triggers.

**Status mapping (`account_status` → UI):**

| Status | Pill / value | Row meta | Action |
|---|---|---|---|
| `connecting` | neutral "Bağlanıyor…" | — | spinner |
| `syncing` | neutral "Eşitleniyor…" | "İlk analiz sürüyor" | — |
| `healthy` | success "Bağlı" | "Son eşitleme {HH:mm}" | — |
| `partial` | warning "Eksik izin" | e.g. "Takvim izni verilmedi." | "İzin Ver" |
| `needs_reauth` | critical "Yeniden bağlan" | "{Provider} oturumu süresi doldu." | "Yeniden Bağlan" |
| `admin_consent_required` | warning "Yönetici onayı gerekli" | "Kurumunun yöneticisi bu uygulamaya onay vermeli." | "Nasıl yapılır?" |
| `error` | critical "Eşitleme hatası" | humanized `last_error_code` | "Şimdi Dene" |
| `disconnected` | row removed | — | — |

### M-SET-11 · Hesap ekle (Add-account chooser sheet)

| Field | Spec |
|---|---|
| Screen ID | M-SET-11 |

| API dependencies | `POST /integrations/:provider/start` (API-INT-01) body `{capabilities, account_id?, login_hint?, return_to, device_nonce_hash}` (`capabilities` is a subset of `mail_read`, `calendar_read`, `tasks_read`; `return_to` is `settings_accounts`, or `onboarding` when onboarding opened the sheet) → `{auth_url, state_expires_at, callback_url, requested_scopes}`. Before the call the app generates a 32-byte random `device_nonce`, stores `{device_nonce, provider, return_to, started_at}` in SecureStore `da.oauth.pending` (10 min) and sends only its SHA-256 (R-07). `WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(auth_url, 'dijitalasistan://integrations/callback')`; a redirect with `result=pending_confirmation` → `POST /integrations/oauth/complete {completion_code, device_nonce}` (API-INT-07, §0.7) → `{result, account_id, granted}` through the `completeOAuth()` function shared with M-SET-14; device calendars: `Calendar.requestCalendarPermissionsAsync()` (plus `requestRemindersPermissionsAsync()` for Apple Reminders) → `POST /integrations/device-calendar/snapshot` |
| State dependencies | local sheet state `step: 'choose' | 'explain' | 'waiting'`; `pendingIntent` persisted in MMKV (so a purchase round-trip from M-GATE-02 can resume) |
| Source design reference | 02 2.6 list + 2.7 / 2.7b / 2.7c permission explainers (reused components from the onboarding part); SECONDARY `Integrations.tsx` provider set |
| Layout & copy | Step "choose": provider rows as above.<br>Step "explain": the provider explainer (2.7 copy) with the capability checklist (Gmail: "Mailleri okuma" ✓ fixed; Google Takvim: "Takvim etkinliklerini okuma"; Google Tasks: "Görevleri okuma") and the note "Mail gönderme veya etkinlik oluşturma izni, ilk onayladığın işlemde ayrıca istenir." CTA "Google ile devam et" / "Microsoft ile devam et" / "Takvim erişimine izin ver".<br>Step "waiting": spinner "Google'da izin bekleniyor…" plus "Vazgeç". |
| Primary CTA | Continue → start OAuth or the OS prompt |
| Secondary actions | "Vazgeç" (dismiss; `WebBrowser.dismissAuthSession()` if open). Pro-locked provider → M-GATE-02. |
| Loading | Start call: button spinner. Auth session open: "waiting" step. |
| Empty | n/a |
| Error | `openAuthSessionAsync` result `cancel`/`dismiss` → back to "choose" silently.<br>Callback `result=denied` → `InlineErrorCard` "Erişim izni reddedildi." / "Google hesabında izin onaylanmadı. Tekrar denemek için aşağıya dokun." / "Tekrar Dene" / "İptal".<br>Complete `result=partial` → the account is connected; toast "Bağlandı · bazı izinler verilmedi"; the detail shows the missing scope.<br>Complete `result=account_mismatch` (a reconnect signed in with another provider account) → "Farklı bir hesapla giriş yapıldı. {email} hesabıyla tekrar dene."<br>Complete `result=already_linked` → toast "Bu hesap zaten bağlı." and its detail opens.<br>Complete `result=plan_limit` → M-GATE-02(`second_account`).<br>Callback `result=expired_state`, or a rejected completion (`403 FORBIDDEN`, `409 STATE_CONFLICT`) → "Bağlantı süresi doldu. Tekrar dene." + "Tekrar Dene" (a new start).<br>Callback `result=admin_consent_required` → card "Kurumunun yöneticisi bu uygulamaya onay vermeli." with the help article link.<br>Callback `result=error` → `InlineErrorCard` generic + "Tekrar Dene".<br>`402 ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED` from start → M-GATE-02(`second_account` or `extra_calendar`).<br>`503 EXTERNAL_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED` → "Bu bağlantı bu ortamda yapılandırılmamış (harici kimlik bilgisi gerekli)." |

| Field | Spec |

Yeniden bağlanana kadar yeni mailler analiz edilmez." / "Yeniden Bağlan" / "Sonra").<br>`SON EŞİTLEME` card: rows "Mail · 09:40", "Takvim · 09:38", "Görevler · 09:25" (+ "Şimdi eşitle").<br>`İZİNLER` card: each granted scope via `describeScopes()` (e.g. "Mailleri okuma", "Mail gönderme (her seferinde onayınla)"); ungranted progressive scopes as neutral "Henüz istenmedi · ilk onaylı işlemde istenir".<br>`VERİ KAYNAĞI KONTROLLERİ` card: toggles<br>– Mail: "Mailleri oku ve analiz et" (`mail_read`), "Ekleri analiz et" (`attachments_analyze`), "Son tarihleri tespit et" (`deadline_detect`), "Yanıt taslağı hazırla" (`draft_replies`)<br>– Calendar: "Etkinlikleri oku" (`calendar_read`), "Program öner" (`schedule_suggest`), "Onayınla etkinlik oluştur ve taşı" (`calendar_write_with_approval`)<br>– Tasks: "Görevleri oku" (`tasks_read`)<br>– The keys are the canonical `data_source_toggles` keys. Sending mail and creating tasks have no toggle here: every send and every task needs its own approval (M§33), and the write scope is requested at the first approved action (ADR-07).<br>– Note: "Kapatmak sağlayıcıya verdiğin izni geri almaz; yalnızca Dijital Asistan'ın bu işlemi yapmasını durdurur."<br>`TAKVİMLER` card (calendar-capable accounts): check rows per calendar; Free: primary only, others show "PRO".<br>Bottom: coral text button "Bağlantıyı kaldır". |
| Primary CTA | Context-dependent: "Yeniden Bağlan" (needs_reauth), "İzin Ver" (partial), "Şimdi eşitle" (healthy/error) |
| Secondary actions | "Sonra" on the status card → hides it until the next app launch (MMKV). Toggle → PATCH (optimistic): `mail_read` / `calendar_read` / `tasks_read` off pauses ingestion for that resource (the server stops watches and the cursors pause); `attachments_analyze` off stops downloading and parsing attachments; `deadline_detect` off skips deadline extraction; `draft_replies` off makes `POST /mail/:messageId/reply-drafts` return `403 DATA_SOURCE_DISABLED` (the AI Reply entry shows "Yanıt taslakları bu hesap için kapalı."); `schedule_suggest` off stops planning proposals for this account; `calendar_write_with_approval` off makes calendar proposals targeting this account fail with `403 DATA_SOURCE_DISABLED`. Turning `calendar_write_with_approval` **on** never requests a scope by itself; the write scope is requested at the first approved write (ADR-07). "İzin Ver" (status `partial`) → `upgrade` → OAuth consent → `oauth/complete`. Calendar check → PATCH `calendars` (beyond `max_calendars` → `402 ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED` → M-GATE-02(`extra_calendar`)) → a `calendar_sync` job for newly selected calendars. | Offline | Toggles are queued (last-write-wins, §14.2); sync, reconnect, upgrade and disconnect are blocked |
| Permission edge case | Microsoft `admin_consent_required` → explanation sheet with the text "Kurumsal hesapta yalnızca sana verilen izinler kullanılır; şirket politikaların geçerli kalır." and the help link. Device calendar: `İZİNLER` shows the OS state instead of scopes, with "Ayarları Aç". |
| Approval requirement | None (these toggles restrict the assistant; writes remain approval-gated elsewhere) |
| Analytics events | `account_detail_opened{provider,status}`, `data_source_toggled{key,enabled}`, `calendar_selection_changed{count}`, `account_reconnect_started{provider}`, `account_sync_requested{provider}` |
| Accessibility notes | Toggles have a label + meta; the scope list is a list with roles; the status card is a live region when the status changes |
| Deep links | `dijitalasistan://settings/accounts/{id}` |
| Tests | Deno `data-sources` PATCH (Pro check for extra calendars; unknown keys rejected by zod). Pipeline test: `attachments_analyze=false` → attachment fetch is not called; `draft_replies=false` → the reply-draft route returns `403 DATA_SOURCE_DISABLED`; turning `calendar_write_with_approval` on starts no OAuth flow. RNTL toggle revert on error. Maestro: reconnect with the demo provider forced to `needs_reauth`. |

### M-SET-13 · Bağlantıyı kaldır (Disconnect sheet)

| Field | Spec |
|---|---|
| Screen ID | M-SET-13 |
| Route | Sheet on `/settings/accounts/{id}` |
| Entry points | "Bağlantıyı kaldır" |
| Primary purpose | Real disconnect/revoke with honest consequences (ADR-07, M§76) |
| Data dependencies | provider; counts of derived items from this account (bootstrap-free RPC is not needed; shown qualitatively) |
| API dependencies | `POST /integrations/:accountId/disconnect` (API-INT-03) body `{confirm: true, purge_content: boolean}` → 200 `{account, revocation, manual_revoke_url, purge_request_id}` (`revocation` is `provider_revoked`, `local_only` or `revoke_failed`). Server order: stop watches/subscriptions → Google `/revoke` (Microsoft: local only) → delete `oauth_credentials` → status `disconnected` → with `purge_content`, a `data_deletion_requests` row (`kind='history'`, scoped to this account) and a `history_deletion` job; otherwise derived rows age out by retention → audit. With `purge_content=true` the request needs a sign-in within the last 10 min, like any history deletion (R-16). |
| State dependencies | invalidates `['accounts']`, `['me','bootstrap']`, Today queries |
| Source design reference | 7.4 BottomSheet destructive pattern |
| Layout & copy | Icon tile `link_off` (critical soft). Title "Gmail bağlantısı kaldırılsın mı?" Body "Yeni mailler artık analiz edilmez ve Google erişimi iptal edilir. Gmail'deki maillerin etkilenmez." Checkbox row "Bu hesaptan çıkarılan analizleri de şimdi sil" (default on); unchecked meta "İşaretlemezsen analizler saklama süren ({retention}) dolunca silinir." Microsoft adds a box: "Microsoft erişimi bizim tarafımızdan tamamen kaldırılamaz. Kaldırmak için: kişisel hesapta account.live.com/consent/Manage, iş veya okul hesabında myapps.microsoft.com." Buttons: destructive "Bağlantıyı Kaldır", "Vazgeç". |
| Primary CTA | "Bağlantıyı Kaldır" → 200 → sheet closes → pop to M-SET-10; the row disappears; toast "Gmail bağlantısı kaldırıldı". With `purge_request_id`, M-SET-10 shows the info row "Bu hesabın analizleri siliniyor…", polled every 5 s until the request completes (R-19, no Realtime). For Microsoft (`local_only`), the toast has the action "Microsoft'ta kaldır" → `Linking.openURL(manual_revoke_url)`. `revoke_failed` → toast "Bağlantı kaldırıldı; Google erişimi iptal edilemedi. Google Hesabı → Güvenlik → Üçüncü taraf bağlantıları bölümünden kaldırabilirsin." with the action "Google'da kaldır" → `https://myaccount.google.com/connections`. |
| Secondary actions | "Vazgeç"; the Microsoft links open the external browser |
| Loading | Button spinner until the response |
| Empty | n/a |

(nothing changed client-side). `401 REAUTH_REQUIRED` (only with `purge_content=true`, R-16) → M-SET-40, then the same request is resent with its `Idempotency-Key`. A failed purge request → the M-SET-10 info row reads "Analizler silinemedi · Tekrar dene", which re-sends `POST /privacy/delete-history {scope:{type:'connected_account', connected_account_id}, confirm:true}` (API-PRV-02). |

### M-SET-14 · OAuth dönüşü (OAuth return handler)

| Field | Spec |
|---|---|
| Screen ID | M-SET-14 |
| Route | `app/integrations/callback` → `/integrations/callback` (accepted route, §0.7) |
| Entry points | The redirect `dijitalasistan://integrations/callback?state_id=&provider=&result=&error_code=&completion_code=` or the universal link `https://<web-domain>/oauth/done?…` (same parameters) when the app was cold-started or Android delivered the redirect as an intent |
| Primary purpose | Perform the client-bound completion (R-07) when the auth session promise did not receive the redirect, then route to the right screen without a +not-found flash |
| Data dependencies | query params `state_id`, `provider`, `result` (`pending_confirmation`, `denied`, `error`, `expired_state` or `admin_consent_required`), `error_code`, `completion_code` (only with `pending_confirmation`); SecureStore `da.oauth.pending` (`device_nonce`, `return_to`) |
| API dependencies | On `pending_confirmation`: `POST /integrations/oauth/complete {completion_code, device_nonce}` (API-INT-07, §0.7) → `{result, account_id, granted, resume}`; then `da.oauth.pending` is deleted and `['accounts']` and `['me','bootstrap']` are invalidated. M-SET-11 and this handler share one `completeOAuth(state_id)` guarded by an in-memory lock, so the completion is sent once. Without a matching `da.oauth.pending` (the flow was started on another device or app instance) no completion is sent; the screen shows "Bağlantı bu cihazda başlatılmadı. Tekrar dene." and the server revokes and purges the unbound account after 10 min. |
| State dependencies | `pendingIntent` (MMKV) to resume onboarding or settings |
| Source design reference | none (system transition) |
| Layout & copy | The spinner "Bağlantı tamamlanıyor…" stays until the completion call returns, then `router.replace` to `pendingIntent.return_to` (default `/settings/accounts/{account_id}`) with the result toast or card as in M-SET-11; a `resume.approval_id` (progressive upgrade) → `/approvals/{approval_id}` |
| Primary CTA | none |
| Secondary actions | none |
| Loading | spinner |
| Empty | missing params → replace to `/settings/accounts` |
| Error | the `result` mapping as in M-SET-11; a rejected completion (`403 FORBIDDEN`, `409 STATE_CONFLICT`) → "Bağlantı tamamlanamadı." + "Tekrar Dene" (→ M-SET-11) |
| Offline | The completion call is retried when the connection returns while the 10-minute window lasts; after that "Bağlantı süresi doldu. Tekrar dene." + "Tekrar Dene" (→ M-SET-11) |
| Permission edge case | n/a |
| Approval requirement | none |
| Analytics events | `account_connected{provider,result}` (deduplicated with M-SET-11 by `state_id`) |
| Accessibility notes | the spinner has the label "Bağlantı tamamlanıyor" |
| Deep links | this is the deep-link target itself |
| Tests | Maestro opens the callback URL via `openLink` (demo provider, `pending_confirmation`) and lands on the account detail. RNTL: no completion call without `da.oauth.pending`; a double delivery (auth session + deep link) sends one completion. |

## 5. AI personalization & priority rules

**Precedence** (domain `priority-engine`, M§31, plan §5): `explicit_rule` → `learned_preference` → `deterministic_signal` → `ai_classification`.
- Among explicit rules, the most specific wins: `person` = `sender` > `domain` > `android_app` > `keyword` > `category`. VIP is not a rule type: `vip_people` feeds the deterministic tier (priority boost, always-notify, quiet-hours bypass per R-13).
- On equal specificity, the most recently updated rule wins.
- `always_notify` combines with any importance outcome, because it affects notification delivery, not ranking.

## 7. Subscription, paywall, Pro gates

**Common rules.**
- RevenueCat `react-native-purchases` 10.10.1.
- Configure after the Supabase session exists with `appUserID = user.id`. `Purchases.logIn` on account switch, `logOut` on sign-out.
- Offering `default` with packages `$rc_annual` → `da_pro_annual` and `$rc_monthly` → `da_pro_monthly`. Entitlement `pro`.
- Dev and demo builds use the RevenueCat **Test Store** key. When SDK keys are missing, the paywall shows "Satın alma bu ortamda yapılandırılmamış (harici kimlik bilgisi gerekli)." (**External credential required**: RevenueCat iOS/Android public SDK keys, store products, and App Store Connect / Play Console agreements, which are a **Manual external step**.)
- The central state is `GET /me/entitlements`, backed by `effective_entitlement(user_id)` = active store subscription OR active `entitlement_grants`.

## 8. Referral

The referral program (plan §16, M§45, SREQ-66):
- Each user has one `referral_codes` row: a 7-character code from the alphabet `23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ` (DB check `^[23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ]{7}$`). Link: `https://<web-domain>/r/{code}`.
- A referee applies a code within 7 days of sign-up.
- Qualification: the referee has completed onboarding, connected ≥ 1 account, received the first briefing, and the account is ≥ 48 h old.
- Reward: +14 days Pro for each side through `entitlement_grants` (`referral_referrer` / `referral_referee`, idempotency `referral:{id}:{side}`), stacked.
- Cap: at most 6 rewards per year for a referrer.
- Anti-abuse: `referral_evaluate` job.
- Store-policy note: Apple guideline 3.1.1 risk for non-IAP unlocks is recorded in STORE_CHECKLIST.

## 9. Android Notification Intelligence (Android only, Pro)

Local Kotlin module `modules/notification-intelligence` (ADR-12).

**Service.** `DANotificationListenerService` with `default_filter_types="conversations|alerting"`.

**JS API:**
- `isGranted()`, `openSettings()` (API 30+ uses `ACTION_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_DETAIL_SETTINGS` with our component, otherwise the list intent)
- `setEnabled(bool)`, `setMode('all'|'selected')`, `setAllowedPackages(string[])`
- `listCandidateApps()` → `{package, label, seen_count, last_seen_at, preset?, locked}`
- `getRecentSignals(limit)`, `deleteSignal(hash)`, `clearBuffer()`, `disable()` (`requestUnbind`)
- event `onGrantChanged`

**Extraction.** Rules run on the device and produce structured signals only: `{package, app_label, category: cargo|bank_payment|flight|reservation|other, amount?, currency?, due_date?, tracking_status?, flight_no?, gate?, posted_at, signal_hash}`.
- The raw title and text are never persisted or uploaded.
- The buffer is encrypted and cleared after 24 h or after upload.
- An OTP detector drops the whole notification. Notifications with `VISIBILITY_SECRET` or `CATEGORY_CALL` are dropped too.

**Uploads.** `POST /android-notifications/signals` (API-ANI-01; Pro-gated server-side, flag `feature.android_ni`). The app batches on foreground and on the `expo-background-task` tick.

**Locked exclusions** (bundled defaults, extended by the `denylist` field of the `feature.android_ni` flag payload, editable in the backoffice Feature Flags module; no other flag keys are used, R-10):
- authenticators: `com.google.android.apps.authenticator2`, `com.azure.authenticator`, `com.authy.authy`, `com.duosecurity.duomobile`, `com.okta.android.auth`, `com.twofasapp`, `com.beemdevelopment.aegis`
- password managers: `com.x8bit.bitwarden`, `com.agilebits.onepassword`, `com.lastpass.lpandroid`, `com.proton.pass`
- `com.google.android.gms`
- e-Devlet `tr.gov.turkiye.edevlet.kapisi`
- messaging and SMS: `com.whatsapp`, `org.telegram.messenger`, `com.turkcell.bip`, `com.google.android.apps.messaging`, `com.samsung.android.messaging`
- our own package

**Presets.** Kargo, Banka, Havayolu and Rezervasyon package lists come from the `presets` field of the `feature.android_ni` flag payload; the package IDs must be verified against Play before shipping.

# Screen & Flow Map — Part 4 (continued)

## 10. Help, feedback & about

**Single FAQ source.** Help content is the `faq.*` catalogue in `packages/i18n`. The web `/support` page renders the same catalogue (Part 5 W-SUP-01 §5.2), and the app bundles it, so Help works offline. Each item is `{key, category, featured, q, a}`. This part adds two optional metadata fields, listed under Proposed additions:
- `app_route`: an allow-listed in-app route, shown in the answer as an "Ayara git" button;
- `platforms`: `all | android | ios`.

ICU parameters come from bootstrap:
- `{mail}`, `{cal}` and `{n}` from `plan_limits` (`max_mail_accounts`, `max_calendars`, `ai_daily_budget_units`);
- `{days}`, `{cap}` and `{window}` from `config`.

The FAQ `storage` answer uses the R-15 canonical sentence.

**Sign out.** "Çıkış Yap" is M-SET-02 (§1) and closes the hub's `UYGULAMA` group. Its end-to-end flow is F4-09.
