## 11. Widgets

### 11.1 Shared rules (M§37, ADR-12, PRIMARY 08, C-25, SREQ-63)

**Targets.**
- iOS: WidgetKit (SwiftUI) in `apps/mobile/targets/widget`, via `@bacons/apple-targets` 5.0.0.
  - `DATodayWidget` (kind `da.today`) supports `.systemSmall`, `.systemMedium` and `.systemLarge`.
  - `DALockWidget` (kind `da.lock`) supports `.accessoryInline`, `.accessoryCircular` and `.accessoryRectangular`.
- Android: Jetpack Glance in `modules/da-widgets`, with `DaNextWidget` (2×2) and `DaTodayWidget` (4×2).
- Native names follow INTEGRATION_PLAN §12.2 / §12.3.

**Widgets are read-only.**
- There are no interactive buttons and no writes. The 08 caption: "Dokunuş ilgili ekranı açar; yazma işlemi widget'tan yapılmaz."
- Each widget answers one question (08 intent line).

**No network or tokens in the extension.** The app writes a privacy-filtered `WidgetSnapshotV1`:
- iOS: App Group `group.com.dijitalasistan.app`, UserDefaults key `da.widget.snapshot.v1`. The data is readable after the first unlock, which the lock-screen families require. It holds only fields allowed by the current level.
- Android: SharedPreferences `da_widget` key `snapshot_v1`.
- The write goes through `DaWidgets.setSnapshot(json)`. The JSON is zod-validated before it is written.

**Visuals.**
- Product surfaces from the tokens. Android uses the product palette rather than Material You (08 note) and `system_app_widget_background_radius` on API 31+.
- iOS 17+ uses `containerBackground(for: .widget)`. iOS 18 tinted/clear modes wrap accents in `widgetAccentable()`.
- Dark mode uses the ink-surface rule (`#1F1E1B` + a 1 px `rgba(255,255,255,.08)` ring).

**Times.** Time labels are rendered server-side in `user_preferences.timezone`, 24 h. ISO timestamps are used only for scheduling timeline entries.

**Free vs Pro.**
- Widgets are available to every plan.
- Pro-only elements (audio "Dinle", "Hazırlık hazır", the midday/evening kicker) are omitted for Free users, never shown locked.
- There is no upsell inside a widget.

### 11.2 `WidgetSnapshotV1` contract (`packages/validation/src/widget-snapshot.ts`)

The snapshot is produced by `GET /widgets/snapshot` (API-WDG-01). The server composes it from `today_overview`, `briefings`, `calendar_events` and follow-up insights, with no LLM call. It supports ETag / `If-None-Match` → 304 and is limited to 120 requests per hour per installation. Fields marked ➕ extend INTEGRATION_PLAN §12.2 (see Proposed additions).

```ts
WidgetSnapshotV1 = z.object({
  v: z.literal(1), etag: z.string(), generated_at: IsoDateTime, locale: z.enum(['tr','en']),
  state: z.enum(['ok','signed_out','no_sources','stale']),        // 'signed_out' is written by the app itself; 'stale' is derived in the widget
  detail_mode: z.enum(['full','title_only','generic']),             // = notification_preferences.detail_level
  lock_screen_private: z.boolean(), entitlement: z.enum(['free','pro']),
  counts: z.object({ important: z.int(), events_today: z.int(), follow_ups: z.int(), deadlines: z.int() }),
  briefing: z.object({ id: Uuid, kind: z.enum(['morning','midday','evening']), status: z.enum(['ready','scheduled','generating']),
    ready_at: IsoDateTime.nullable(), scheduled_for: IsoDateTime.nullable(), time_label: z.string().nullable(), item_count: z.int(),
    audio_minutes: z.int().nullable(), deeplink: z.string() }).nullable(),
  priorities: z.array(z.object({ id: Uuid, badge: z.enum(['ACİL','SON TARİH','TOPLANTI','TAKİP','KİŞİSEL','GÜVENLİK']),
    urgency: z.enum(['urgent','today','normal','low']),
    title_full: z.string().max(60).optional(),      // present only when detail_mode = 'full'
    chip_full: z.string().max(24).optional(),       // ➕ e.g. "Ahmet · 17:00"; full only
    title_private: z.string().max(40).optional(),   // no names/subjects/amounts; present when detail_mode ≥ title_only
    time_label: z.string().nullable(), source_label: z.string().optional(), // "Gmail · 08:42"; absent in generic
    deeplink: z.string() })).max(3),
  next_meeting: MeetingEntry.nullable(),
  later_meetings: z.array(MeetingEntry).max(2),     // ➕ lets timelines advance past a meeting without the app
  follow_up: z.object({ thread_id: Uuid, insight_id: Uuid, title_full: z.string().optional(), title_private: z.string().optional(),
    waiting_days: z.int(), deeplink: z.string() }).nullable(),
  last_analysis_at: IsoDateTime.nullable(),
});
MeetingEntry = z.object({ event_id: Uuid, start_at: IsoDateTime, end_at: IsoDateTime, time_label: z.string(), duration_min: z.int(),
  title_full: z.string().max(60).optional(), title_private: z.string().max(40).optional(),  // title_private e.g. "Toplantı · 45 dk"
  prep_ready: z.boolean(), prep_topic_count: z.int().nullable(), deeplink: z.string() });
```

**Minimisation is enforced by the server.** Title fields the current level does not allow are **omitted**, not blanked. The size is at most 8 KB.

**Offline level changes.** When the user lowers the detail level offline, the app immediately re-filters the cached snapshot (dropping `title_full` / `chip_full`, or all titles for `generic`). Raising the level needs the next online fetch.

### 11.3 Privacy by detail level (M§86, SECURITY CTL-3.12)

| Surface | `full` | `title_only` (default) | `generic` |
|---|---|---|---|
| iOS home families (S/M/L) | `title_full` / `chip_full`, wrapped in `.privacySensitive()`, so StandBy and locked contexts hide them | `title_private` + badge + time | counts only |
| iOS lock families (inline/circular/rectangular) | Effective level = `lock_screen_private ? title_only : full`. Names are always `.privacySensitive()`. | `title_private` + time (rectangular); counts (inline, circular) | counts only |
| Android 2×2 / 4×2 (home screen only) | `title_full` / `chip_full` | `title_private` + badge + time | counts only |

### 11.4 Refresh triggers and timelines

**When the app writes the snapshot.** The app calls `GET /widgets/snapshot` → `setSnapshot` and asks the OS to redraw the widgets on:
- foreground (when more than 5 min have passed since the last write);
- a successful Today refetch;
- a push received in the foreground;
- insight, approval or reminder mutations that change the counts;
- a change to `detail_level` or `lock_screen_private` (always, and this bypasses the 5-min floor);
- an entitlement change;
- sign-in;
- the `da-background-refresh` task (every 30 min, best effort; KNOWN_PLATFORM_LIMITATIONS).

**How the OS redraws.**
- iOS: `WidgetCenter.shared.reloadTimelines(ofKind:)` for both kinds.
- Android: `GlanceAppWidgetManager` → `updateAll`.

**Sign-out and account deletion.** `DaWidgets.clear()` writes `{v:1, state:'signed_out', …}` and redraws the widgets.

**iOS timeline.**
- Entries are created at `now` and at each start and end of `next_meeting` / `later_meetings` within 6 h. Entries are at least 5 min apart.
- Reload policy: `.after(min(nextBoundary, now + 30 min))`.
- Reloads while the app is in the foreground do not count against the 40–70 per day budget.
- The widget computes staleness from `generated_at` at render time.

**Android timeline.** A WorkManager one-time job runs at the next meeting boundary and re-renders from the stored snapshot. There is no network call.

**Staleness.**
- More than 6 h old: the meta line reads "Son güncelleme {HH:mm}".
- More than 24 h old: `state='stale'` with "Güncellemek için uygulamayı aç."

### 11.5 Deep links (`deepLinkForInsight()` in `packages/domain`)

Every widget URL gets the suffix `?src=widget&w=<family>` and passes through M-GL-07: allow-list, auth gate with replay after sign-in, entitlement guard, and the missing-entity fallback M-STATE-12.

| Target | Route |
|---|---|
| reply_needed | `mail/{messageId}` |
| follow_up | `followups?focus={insightId}` |
| meeting | `meeting/{eventId}/prep` (Pro with prep ready) or `event/{eventId}` |
| deadline | its source (`mail/{id}`, `capture/{id}` or `event/{id}`) |
| commitment | `commitments/{id}` |
| life_event / security | `life/{id}` |
| conflict | `plan/conflict/{insightId}` |
| schedule_suggestion | `plan/proposal/{approvalId}` |
| approval_pending | `approvals/{id}` |
| briefing | `briefing/{id}`; listen `briefing/{id}/listen` |
| empty, `signed_out` | `today` (the auth gate handles sign-in) |
| `no_sources` | `settings/accounts` |

## 12. Push notifications

Pushes are server-rendered by the `worker` job `notification` (API JOB-18):
- the decision engine is `packages/domain/notifications`;
- the templates are `packages/domain/notifications/templates.ts`;
- i18n keys follow `push.{category}.{template}.{level}.{title|body}`.

The payload is exactly `{v:1, type:<notification_category>, entity_id, deeplink, nid}`. `nid` is `notifications.id`; `entity_id` is null for digests and tests. It never contains content. M-GL-08 (Part 1) routes taps.

### 12.1 Android channels (ruling R-12)

**Creation.** All channels are created at first launch, **before** the permission prompt and before `getExpoPushTokenAsync` (Android 13 shows the prompt only when a channel exists).

**Visibility.** Every channel uses `lockscreenVisibility = PRIVATE`, including `account`.

**Names and importance.** Names are localised and are set again on a locale change. Importance cannot be raised after creation.

**Blocked channels.** When a user blocks a channel in Android settings, M-SET-20 detects it with `getNotificationChannelAsync(id)` (importance `NONE`). The row meta then reads "Android ayarlarında kapalı" with "Ayarları Aç".

| Channel ID | Name (tr / en) | Importance | Categories / templates |
|---|---|---|---|
| `briefings` | "Brifingler" / "Briefings" | DEFAULT | morning, midday, evening, weekly |
| `critical_email` | "Kritik mailler" / "Critical emails" | HIGH | critical_email |
| `meetings` | "Toplantılar" / "Meetings" | HIGH | meeting |
| `deadlines` | "Son tarihler" / "Deadlines" | HIGH | deadline |
| `follow_up` | "Takip hatırlatmaları" / "Follow-up reminders" | DEFAULT | follow_up |
| `life_intel` | "Yaşam zekâsı" / "Life intelligence" | DEFAULT | life_intel (except `phone_digest`) |
| `approvals` | "Onay bekleyenler" / "Pending approvals" | DEFAULT | approval |
| `reminders` | "Hatırlatıcılar" / "Reminders" | HIGH | device-local smart reminders |
| `account` | "Hesap ve bağlantılar" / "Account and connections" | LOW | account |
| `phone_digest` | "Telefon bildirimleri özeti" / "Phone notification digest" · description "Yalnızca Telefon Bildirimleri açıkken kullanılır." | LOW | `life_intel.phone_digest` (Android NI only) |

### 12.2 iOS categories and interruption levels

- One `UNNotificationCategory` per `notification_category`, plus `da_reminder`.
  - Each has the hidden-preview text "Dijital Asistan güncellemesi", shown when iOS hides previews.
  - Actions open the app only.
  - `da_reminder` actions follow INTEGRATION_PLAN §9.4 and Part 2 M-REM-01.
- **Time Sensitive** requires the entitlement `com.apple.developer.usernotifications.time-sensitive`. The user can turn it off in iOS Settings.
- `critical` is never used.
- Stored `notifications.interruption_level` values are `passive | active | time_sensitive`.
- `threadId` = category. The app icon badge is never set, so no count leaks on the home screen.

### 12.3 Decision, privacy and delivery rules (M§132, ADR-10, R-13, R-14)

1. **Evaluation order.**
   1. relevance
   2. urgency (the smart filter "Yalnızca gerçekten önemliyse bildir" lets only `urgent`/`today` through for critical_email, deadline, follow_up and life_intel; reason `smart_filter`)
   3. category preference (`category_disabled`)
   4. entitlement (`not_entitled`)
   5. quiet hours (`quiet_hours`)
   6. dedupe (`deduplicated`)
   7. frequency caps (`frequency_cap`)
   8. device and OS permission (`no_device`, `os_permission_denied`)
   9. detail level

   Every outcome is written to `notifications` with its reason and feeds backoffice suppression metrics (M§55).
2. **Effective detail** = `lock_screen_private ? min(detail_level, title_only) : detail_level`, ordered `generic < title_only < full`. This is SECURITY_AND_PRIVACY_PLAN R-05 and applies on both platforms. On Android, the PRIVATE channel additionally hides content on a secure lock screen.
   - Names, subjects and amounts appear **only** in `full` (C-14).
   - Briefing templates carry no personal data in any mode.
3. **Quiet hours (R-13).**
   - Evaluated in `user_preferences.timezone` on the `quiet_days` weekdays.
   - Window defaults: 22:30–07:30, start inclusive, end exclusive; a window crossing midnight belongs to its start day.
   - Nothing is delivered inside the window except:
     - (a) device-local smart reminders at the time the user chose;
     - (b) `critical_email` from a VIP, when `notification_preferences.vip_bypass_quiet` (default on) **and** `vip_people.bypass_quiet_hours` are true. These are still deduped and capped at **3 per window**.
   - Everything else is suppressed with `quiet_hours` and is **not** replayed when the window ends. The underlying item stays in Today, Flow and the next briefing.
   - A briefing whose slot falls inside the window is generated and shown in-app, but its push is suppressed (M-SET-23 warns about this).
4. **Frequency caps (R-14).**
   - `notification_preferences.daily_cap` (default **5**, rolling 24 h) counts meeting, deadline, follow_up, life_intel and `approval.pending` / `approval.expiring`.
   - Exempt from the daily cap:
     - user-scheduled briefings;
     - critical_email;
     - `always_notify` rule and VIP matches;
     - `life_intel.security`;
     - `approval.failed`;
     - account;
     - local reminders.
   - Per-category rolling caps: follow_up 2, life_intel 3 (security exempt), deadline 3 (TEST_PLAN UT-NTF-06).
5. **Delivery fields.**
   - `channelId` as in §12.1; `categoryId` = category.
   - `priority`: `high` for HIGH channels and time-sensitive pushes, otherwise `normal`.
   - `interruptionLevel` and `relevanceScore` per §12.4.
   - `collapseId` = sha1(`dedupe_key`).
   - `ttl`: meeting 1,800 s; briefings 21,600 s; others 86,400 s.
   - `sound: 'default'`, except `meeting.post`, which has no sound on iOS (`passive`). On Android the `meetings` channel sound applies; this is a platform limitation recorded in KNOWN_PLATFORM_LIMITATIONS.
6. **Receipts.** `push_receipts` runs every 5 min on tickets older than 15 min. `DeviceNotRegistered` disables the token (INTEGRATION_PLAN §9.6).
7. **Foreground.** No system banner is shown. M-GL-08 shows an in-app toast with "Aç" and invalidates the related queries.
8. **User test push** (`POST /notifications/test {category}`, API-DEV-04; default `critical_email`):
   - renders the template at the **current effective level** with demo parameters (PRIMARY names);
   - prefixes the title with "Test · " in `full` and `title_only`;
   - `generic` stays exactly "Dijital Asistan" / "Yeni bir güncellemen var.";
   - the deep link is `settings/notifications`;
   - limit: 3 per 10 min;
   - `409 STATE_CONFLICT` reasons:
     - `quiet_hours` → "Sessiz saatlerdesin; test bildirimi gönderilmedi. Sessiz saatler {HH:mm}'{de} bitiyor."
     - `no_active_device` or `os_permission_denied` → "Bu cihazda bildirim izni yok."
     - `category_disabled` → "Bu kategori kapalı."
9. **Admin test push** (`admin-api POST /notifications/test-push {user_id, installation_id?, reason, confirm}`, ADM-07; the device comes from `GET /users/:id/devices`): generic content, never bypasses quiet hours (R-13), category `account`.
10. **Missing `EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN`:** decisions are `failed` with `EXTERNAL_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED`. System Health shows Push as `not_configured`. The app surfaces M-STATE-10 on the test push.

### 12.4 Template catalogue (every `notification_category` × detail level)

**`generic` is identical for every template:** title "Dijital Asistan", body "Yeni bir güncellemen var." (M-SET-20 radio promise).

**Notation.**
- `{…}` values are server parameters truncated to 40 characters.
- `{HH:mm}'{de}` / `'{e}` are Turkish case suffixes from the `trSuffix` helper.
- Deep links are app routes (no scheme) validated by M-GL-07.
- Dedupe keys are unique per user (`notifications (user_id, dedupe_key)`).

**Category summary**

| Category | Android channel | iOS level (relevance) | Pro | Quiet hours (R-13) | Caps |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `morning` | `briefings` | active (0.6) | no | suppressed if the slot is inside the window | exempt; 1/day by key |
| `midday` | `briefings` | passive (0.3) | yes | suppressed | exempt; skipped when delta = 0 (R-05) |
| `evening` | `briefings` | passive (0.3) | yes | suppressed | exempt |
| `weekly` (proposed enum value) | `briefings` | passive (0.3) | no | suppressed | exempt |
| `critical_email` | `critical_email` | time-sensitive when `urgent` or VIP (0.9), else active (0.7) | `vip` template only | VIP bypass ≤3 per window; others suppressed | exempt |
| `meeting` | `meetings` | time-sensitive ≤10 min to start (0.8); `post` passive; else active | `prep_ready` and `post` | suppressed | daily cap |
| `deadline` | `deadlines` | time-sensitive ≤2 h (0.8), else active (0.6) | `commitment_due` | suppressed | daily cap; 3/24 h |
| `follow_up` | `follow_up` | passive (0.4) | yes | suppressed | daily cap; 2/24 h |
| `life_intel` | `life_intel`; `phone_digest` for NI | active for flight and security (0.7), else passive (0.4) | `phone_digest` | suppressed | daily cap; 3/24 h; security exempt |
| `approval` | `approvals` | active (0.6); `expiring` time-sensitive | no | suppressed | `pending`/`expiring` counted; `failed` exempt |
| `account` | `account` | active (0.5) | no | suppressed | exempt |
| local reminder | `reminders` | time-sensitive | per Part 2 | **delivered** (R-13 a) | exempt |

### 12.5 Device-local notifications (smart reminders)

- `reminders` rows are the source of truth.
- Every signed-in installation schedules its next 7 days of reminders with `identifier = reminder.id` on channel `reminders`, category `da_reminder` and `interruptionLevel: 'timeSensitive'` (INTEGRATION_PLAN §9.7).
- Content is composed on the device at the effective level:

  | Level | Title / body |
  |---|---|
  | `full` | "Hatırlatıcı" / "{hatırlatıcı_metni}" |
  | `title_only` | "Hatırlatıcı" / "Şimdi hatırlatmamı istediğin bir konu var." |
  | `generic` | "Dijital Asistan" / "Yeni bir güncellemen var." |

- A detail-level change reschedules every pending reminder so the content matches.
- Reminders fire during quiet hours (R-13 a).
- Sign-out and account deletion cancel them all.

### 12.6 Tests
- **Unit `render.test.ts`:** snapshots of every `template_key` × `full` / `title_only` / `generic` × tr/en (the M-SET-20 tests reference this catalogue).
- **Property test (UT-NTF-13, fast-check):** `title_only` and `generic` never contain a name, subject, amount or email; the data keys are exactly `{v, type, entity_id, deeplink, nid}`; the payload is under 1 KB.
- **Decision tests:**
  - a quiet-hours window across midnight and a DST day;
  - VIP bypass limited to 3 per window, with the per-VIP override;
  - no replay at the window end;
  - a briefing slot inside the window is suppressed;
  - daily cap 5 with the exemptions;
  - per-category caps;
  - the lock-screen cap;
  - an admin test during quiet hours is suppressed.
- **Channel test:** a map test asserts the R-12 IDs and `PRIVATE` for all channels (Android instrumentation in `mobile-native-android`).
- **Maestro `notifications/detail-and-test.yaml` (F4-05)** plus manual REL-10: the lock screen per level; iOS time-sensitive for a meeting ≤10 min.

## 13. Global states

### 13.1 Rules

- Every screen composes its Loading / Empty / Error / Offline / Reconnect / Partial / Permission states from the M-STATE components (M§93). i18n keys live under `states.*`.
- **Precedence** when several apply:
  1. offline without cache (M-STATE-03)
  2. not found (M-STATE-12)
  3. account-level blocks (M-STATE-11 variants)
  4. entitlement (M-STATE-09)
  5. reconnect (M-STATE-04)
  6. partial (M-STATE-06)
  7. sync delayed (M-STATE-05)
  8. AI unavailable (M-STATE-07)
  9. empty (M-STATE-02)
- At most **one** full-screen state is shown. Inline cards stack at most **2**, ordered critical → warning → neutral.
- Every error card carries the request's `correlation_id` in `testID` / `accessibilityHint` only; it is never shown as text.
- Dark variants come from tokens, with the ink-surface ring rule.
- The 08 motion rules apply: nothing exceeds 600 ms; Reduce Motion leaves a 120 ms fade.

**Concordance** (the same component; other parts keep their local IDs as aliases):

| M-STATE | Part 1 | Part 2 (`states.*`) | Part 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 01 Loading | M-GL-14 player loading, hero skeletons | skeletons | ST-SKELETON, ST-AI-WORKING |
| 02 Empty | Today empty | `empty.followups`, `empty.approvals`, `empty.noAccount` | Plan empty |
| 03 Offline | M-GL-09 | §0.7 offline | ST-OFFLINE-READ / -EMPTY / -WRITE, ST-RECONNECT |
| 04 Reconnect | — | `error.oauthExpired` | ST-OAUTH-EXPIRED |
| 05 Sync delayed | — | `error.syncDelayed` | ST-SYNC-DELAYED |
| 06 Partial | — | — | ST-PARTIAL |
| 07 AI unavailable | — | `error.aiUnavailable` | ST-AI-UNAVAILABLE |
| 08 Permission | M-ON-07D | `error.permissionDenied` | ST-CAL-PERMISSION |
| 09 Entitlement / limit | M-GL-13 | `error.aiBudget` | ST-AI-LIMIT |
| 10 External credential / disabled | — | — | — |
| 11 Error | M-GL-10, M-GL-12 | `error.generic`, `error.noInternet` | ST-ERROR-GENERIC |
| 12 Not found | M-GL-11 | deep-link missing entity | ST-NOT-FOUND |

## 14. Offline & resilience (M§94)

### 14.1 Cache (what survives offline)

**Persister.** TanStack persister over AES-256 MMKV `da-cache` (key in SecureStore), `maxAge` 7 days, buster = app version + user id. Only queries with `meta.persist === true` are persisted.

**This part persists:**
- `['me','bootstrap']`, `['me','entitlements']`
- `['integrations','accounts']` (§2 calls it `['accounts']`; execution uses the Part 1 key)
- `['sync_states', id]`, `['calendars', id]`
- `['prefs','notifications']`, `['prefs','user']`
- `['privacy','export']` status
- `['support','tickets']`
- `['referrals','me']`
- `['rules']`

**Never persisted:**
- original mail bodies;
- signed URLs, including export and audio URLs;
- deletion and export download links;
- the RevenueCat offerings cache (memory only; the paywall shows cached offerings only while the app is running).

**Survives offline outside TanStack:**
- the widget snapshot (App Group / SharedPreferences);
- scheduled local reminders;
- the Android NI signal buffer (encrypted; 24 h);
- the support draft;
- the pending referral code.

### 14.2 Write classes for this part

| Class | Writes | Transport | Duplicate protection | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Queued** (last-write-wins) | - Profile name, locale<br>- Theme, text size, reduce motion, haptics<br>- Briefing times, slots, silent days, weekend mode, timezone<br>- Notification categories, smart filter, detail level, lock-screen privacy, quiet hours<br>- AI access classes<br>- Retention **lengthening**<br>- Learned-preference toggles, edits and deletes<br>- Rule enable toggles, soft delete and undo<br>- Data-source toggles<br>- Gate dismissals<br>- Android NI local settings and server signal delete | PostgREST PATCH / RPC as a persisted paused mutation | `updated_at` compare on the server; scope `settings:{table}` serialises writes to one table | "Bağlantı gelince kaydedilecek." under the row |
| **Queued** (idempotent) | `POST /feedback`, `POST /analytics/events`, announcement dismissal | `api` with `Idempotency-Key` | Server idempotency store (24 h) | Queued state (M-SET-72) |
| **Blocked** | - Connect, reconnect, upgrade, disconnect, sync now<br>- Test push, `devices/register` side effects<br>- Retention **shortening**, history deletion, export request and download, account deletion, re-auth<br>- Purchase, restore, plan change<br>- Referral apply<br>- Support ticket<br>- Rule create/edit save (needs the preview)<br>- Global sign-out | — (`OFFLINE_BLOCKED` before the call) | n/a | Disabled with "Bu işlem için internet bağlantısı gerekiyor.", or the toast "Çevrimdışıyken bu işlem yapılamaz." |
| **Local-only, allowed** | - Sign out on this device (M-SET-02; `pending_session_cleanup`)<br>- Copy and share the referral link<br>- Help FAQ, licenses<br>- Widget re-filter on a level downgrade<br>- Rescheduling local reminders | Device | n/a | Normal |

### 14.3 Replay rules

1. **Order.** On reconnect (`onlineManager`), paused mutations resume FIFO within their scope. Different scopes run in parallel, at most 4.
2. **Session first.** Replay waits for a valid session. Refresh is attempted first. If the refresh token is dead (401 after refresh), the queue is kept encrypted and replayed after the same user signs in again. For a different user it is discarded.
3. **Terminal 4xx on replay** (422 constraint, 403 `DATA_SOURCE_DISABLED`, 402): the mutation is dropped, the optimistic value is reverted and the toast "Bir ayar kaydedilemedi: {ayar adı}." offers "Tekrar dene". 5xx and network errors keep it queued with back-off.
4. **Queue bounds.** At most 200 mutations or 7 days. Older ones are dropped with the same toast.
5. **Sign-out warning.** The paused count is shown in the M-SET-02 warning.
6. **Approvals and provider writes are never queued.** Nothing with an external side effect runs because connectivity came back (M§94 "Duplicate write oluşmamalı").

### 14.4 Showing the real sync state
- M-STATE-03 banner: "Son analiz {HH:mm}".
- Reconnect confirmation: "Güncel · {HH:mm}".
- Per-account freshness in M-SET-10/12 ("Son eşitleme {HH:mm}") and provenance lines (M-STATE-06).
- Cached business state carries "{saat} itibarıyla" (M-SUB-01, M-SET-36/38, M-SET-70 tickets).
- Widgets: "Son güncelleme {HH:mm}" / stale state (§11.4).

### 14.5 Server-side failure handling in the client (`packages/api-client`)
- **Idempotent GETs:** 3 retries with back-off 0.5 / 2 / 8 s plus jitter, then cache plus M-STATE-11 inline.
- **Mutations with an `Idempotency-Key`:** one automatic retry on a network error, then user-driven "Tekrar Dene" with the same key.
- **`RATE_LIMITED`:** honour `Retry-After`. **`IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY` `in_progress`:** retry after 1 s.
- **426:** → M-GL-12. **`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`:** → M-STATE-03 server variant.
- **`AI_UNAVAILABLE`:** → M-STATE-07; the circuit state is reflected in bootstrap `service_status`.
- **Polling instead of Realtime (R-19):**
  - account status: every 5 s while `connecting`/`syncing` and the screen is focused;
  - export: every 5 s while processing;
  - deletion: every 3 s, at most 60 s;
  - entitlement after purchase: every 1 s, at most 10 s;
  - First Analysis: 1–2 s.

### 14.6 Tests
- Unit: queue class map (a snapshot of every mutation key → class); replay ordering; terminal 4xx revert; queue bound; user switch discards the queue.
- Maestro `offline/settings-queue.yaml`: airplane mode → change theme, briefing time and detail level → blocked export CTA visible → reconnect → values persisted server-side (checked via the demo API) → "Güncel" shown.
- Maestro `offline/reconnect.yaml` (M§102 "offline/reconnect").

## 15. Analytics events of this part (R-21)

**Rules.**
- Events go to `POST /analytics/events`. Names are snake_case.
- Props are enums, booleans or small integers. There are no IDs, names, emails, subjects, codes or free text.
- Common props on every event: `screen` (Screen ID), `platform`, `is_pro`.
- SECURITY_AND_PRIVACY_PLAN defines the rules. This table is the catalogue input for `packages/domain/analytics/events.ts`.

|---|---|
| Hub & profile | `settings_opened{from}`, `settings_row_tapped{row}`, `sign_out{scope:'this'|'global',offline}`, `profile_name_changed` |

The columns follow the M§98 end-to-end standard. IDs are F4-xx. In §1–§9 of this part, the in-text references **F-01, F-05, F-06 and F-07** mean **F4-01, F4-05, F4-06 and F4-07**.

### F4-01 · Connect a second account (Free → Pro gate → paywall → purchase → connect)

| # | UI | State | API | Backend / job | DB | Provider / AI | Approval | Confirmation → refreshed state |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | M-SET-10: a Free user with Gmail taps "PRO" on the Outlook row | Client check: mail-capable accounts ≥ `plan_limits.max_mail_accounts` | — | — | — | — | — | M-GATE-02(`second_account`); MMKV `pendingIntent {type:'connect_account', provider:'microsoft', capabilities:['mail_read','calendar_read']}`, TTL 30 min |
| 2 | Trial CTA (only when eligible) or "Pro'yu Gör" | `['rc','offerings']` | RevenueCat `getOfferings()` | — | — | RevenueCat | — | M-PAY-01 `source=gate_second_account` |
| 3 | "Yıllık" → CTA → store sheet | `purchaseState='purchasing'` | `purchasePackage(pkg)` | `webhooks-revenuecat` INITIAL_PURCHASE (auth secret) → `billing_events` (unique `event_id`) → `billing_sync` | `billing_events`, `jobs` | App Store / Play → RevenueCat | Store sheet is the confirmation | — |
| 4 | Success ring | Poll `['me','entitlements']` every 1 s, up to 10 s | `POST /purchases/sync {reason:'purchase', rc_app_user_id}` → `GET /me/entitlements` | Re-fetch customer (REST v2), overwrite the mirror; `effective_entitlement` → pro | `subscriptions` | RevenueCat REST v2 | — | "Pro etkin" · "Tüm Pro özellikleri açıldı." → "Devam" consumes `pendingIntent` → M-SET-11 on the Microsoft explain step |
| 5 | "Microsoft ile devam et" | Generate `device_nonce`; SecureStore `da.oauth.nonce.{state_id}` | `POST /integrations/microsoft/start {capabilities, return_to:'settings_accounts', device_nonce_hash}` | Plan-limit check (now Pro); `oauth_states` (10 min, single use, `device_nonce_hash`) | `oauth_states` | — | — | `openAuthSessionAsync(auth_url)` |
| 6 | Microsoft consent page | "Microsoft'ta izin bekleniyor…" | — | `oauth` callback: PKCE code exchange, token encryption. The account stays `connecting` and is not bound (R-07). Returns a one-time `completion_code`. | `oauth_credentials` (ciphertext), `connected_accounts (connecting)` | Entra ID | User consent | Redirect `dijitalasistan://integrations/callback?state_id&provider=microsoft&result=pending_confirmation&completion_code` |
| 7 | M-SET-11 (or M-SET-14 on cold return) | Dedupe by `state_id` | `POST /integrations/oauth/complete {completion_code, device_nonce}` | Requires `oauth_states.user_id = auth.uid()`, a device nonce hash match and an unused code. Finalises the account (`syncing`), enqueues `initial_sync`, creates Graph subscriptions. | `connected_accounts`, `sync_states`, `jobs`; `oauth_states.completed_at` | Graph | — | `router.replace('/settings/accounts/{id}')`; toast "Bağlandı" |
| 8 | M-SET-12 "Eşitleniyor…" | Poll 5 s (R-19) | PostgREST `connected_accounts`, `sync_states` | `initial_sync` → `outlook_sync` → triage and analysis | Content tables, insights | Graph; AI tiers | — | "Bağlı · Son eşitleme {HH:mm}"; Today and Flow invalidated; the widget snapshot is refreshed |

**Branches**
- Purchase cancelled: back on the paywall; `pendingIntent` is kept until its TTL.
- Purchase pending: "Satın alma onay bekliyor…". The listener finishes it and step 4 resumes.
- Entitlement mirror late: `/start` → 402 → M-SET-11 retries after `POST /purchases/sync`.
- Complete rejected (nonce or code mismatch, expired): "Bağlantı tamamlanamadı. Tekrar dene." + "Tekrar Dene" (→ step 5). The unbound row is purged after 10 min.
- `already_linked` (the provider account belongs to another Dijital Asistan user): "Bu hesap başka bir Dijital Asistan hesabına bağlı."
- `admin_consent_required`: M-STATE-04 variant.

## Proposed additions to the canonical registry

Each item is needed by §10–§15 or the Flows and is missing, or incomplete, in the spine or the owning document. The owning document is named per R-20.

### `api` contracts (→ API_CONTRACTS)
1. **API-WDG-01 `GET /widgets/snapshot`** (accepted by the coverage critic). Contract per §11.2:
   - server-rendered and level-filtered (fields omitted, not blanked);
   - ETag / `If-None-Match` → 304;
   - 120 requests per hour per installation;
   - no LLM call;
   - errors: common, plus `ACCOUNT_DELETION_PENDING`.

## 0. Conventions

### 0.1 Page block format
Each web page has one block with these fields, in this order:

**Page ID · Route · Purpose · Sections (ordered, with copy) · Components · Data dependencies · CTAs (real behaviour) · SEO · Responsive notes · Accessibility notes · Analytics · Error/empty states · Tests.**

Page IDs use the `W-` prefix. Marketing assets use `MA-`. Shared web components use `W-CMP-`. Flows are `F5-nn`.

Copy tables have three columns: `Element | TR (default) | EN`. All copy uses the *sen* voice (the informal "you" register), per PRIMARY and SREQ-87. Every string is an i18n key under `@da/i18n`. Namespaces are listed in the registry section.

### 0.2 Application structure (`apps/web`)

- **Stack** (plan ADR-01/02, ADR-52, ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS §4.4):
  - Next **16.3.6** App Router with `cacheComponents: true` and `reactCompiler: true`;
  - Tailwind **4.3.3** with `@theme` from `@da/design-tokens/tokens.css`;
  - next-intl **4.14.6** (ICU catalogs from `@da/i18n`);
  - `@sentry/nextjs` 10.75.2 and `@t3-oss/env-nextjs` 0.13.11;
  - `next/font/google` Geist and Lora, `subsets: ['latin','latin-ext']` for Turkish glyphs;
  - no Supabase client library: every backend call is a plain `fetch` to `public-api` from `lib/public-api.ts` (§0.8, registry R-24).
- **No end-user login on the web** (C-24). The only identity check is the email OTP inside W-DEL-01, and `public-api` sends and verifies it server-side (PUB-02/PUB-03), so no auth session, token or auth cookie ever exists in the browser.

```
apps/web/
  app/
    [locale]/                         root layout A: <html lang>, fonts, SiteHeader, SiteFooter, NextIntlClientProvider
      layout.tsx  page.tsx            W-HOME-01
      pricing/page.tsx                W-PRICE-01
      privacy/page.tsx                W-LEGAL-01
      terms/page.tsx                  W-LEGAL-02
      support/page.tsx                W-SUP-01
      data-deletion/page.tsx          W-DEL-01
      opengraph-image.tsx (+ one per route folder)   W-SYS-05
      not-found.tsx  error.tsx        W-ERR-01 / W-ERR-02
    (links)/                          root layout B: locale-neutral link targets (Accept-Language / ?lang=)
      layout.tsx
      r/[code]/page.tsx               W-REF-01
      oauth/done/page.tsx             W-OAUTH-01
      app/[[...path]]/page.tsx        W-APP-01
    get/route.ts                      W-GET-01 (302 store router)
    well-known/apple-app-site-association/route.ts   W-SYS-01 (served at /.well-known/… via rewrite)
    well-known/assetlinks.json/route.ts              W-SYS-02
    well-known/security.txt/route.ts                 W-SYS-06
    well-known/microsoft-identity-association.json/route.ts   W-SYS-08
    sitemap.ts  robots.ts  manifest.ts  icon.png  apple-icon.png  favicon.ico   W-SYS-03/04/07
    global-error.tsx
  i18n/routing.ts  i18n/request.ts    next-intl: locales ['tr','en'], defaultLocale 'tr', localePrefix 'as-needed', localeDetection false
  proxy.ts                            next-intl routing for localized paths + security headers for every path + preview noindex
  content/legal/{privacy,terms}.{tr,en}.ts   typed LegalDocument sources (§3, §4)
  content/company.ts  content/subprocessors.ts   env-validated legal identity; sub-processor list
  lib/public-api.ts  lib/store-links.ts  lib/seo.ts  lib/json-ld.ts  lib/web-events.ts  lib/format.ts
  components/…                        W-CMP-* (§0.6)
  e2e/*.spec.ts  e2e/stub/public-api.ts  playwright.config.ts
  env.ts                              @t3-oss/env-nextjs schema (§17)
next.config.ts rewrites: /.well-known/:file → /well-known/:file   (no redirect; Apple forbids redirects for AASA)
```

**Locale routing**
- `/` and `/pricing` serve Turkish. `/en` and `/en/pricing` serve English.
- There is no cookie and no automatic redirect (`localeDetection: false`). This keeps the site cookieless (§0.11) and gives stable canonical URLs.
- Link-target routes in `(links)` stay unprefixed, because universal links always use unprefixed paths. They choose their locale per request:
  1. `?lang=tr|en`;
  2. otherwise `Accept-Language` (`tr*` → tr, else en);
  3. otherwise tr.

**Rendering modes**

| Route | Mode | Cache / revalidate | Indexable |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/`, `/en` | Static (`generateStaticParams` → tr, en; `setRequestLocale`). The `plans` fetch is inside `'use cache'` with `cacheLife({ revalidate: 3600 })` and `cacheTag('plans')` | 1 h | Yes, when `SITE_INDEXABLE=true` |
| `/pricing`, `/en/pricing` | Same as home | 1 h | Yes |
| `/privacy`, `/terms` (+ `/en`) | Static | Per deploy | Yes |
| `/support` (+ `/en`) | Static shell plus client `SupportForm` | Per deploy | Yes |
| `/data-deletion` (+ `/en`) | Dynamic. A nonce CSP needs a per-request render (§0.12). `await connection()` sits inside a `<Suspense>` shell | `no-store` | Yes |
| `/r/[code]` | Dynamic. `params` sits inside `<Suspense>`. Per-code resolve is cached 300 s with `cacheTag('ref:'+code)` | 300 s | No (`noindex, nofollow`) |
| `/oauth/done` | Dynamic (reads `searchParams`) | `no-store` | No |
| `/app/[[...path]]` | Static shell | Per deploy | No |
| `/get` | Route handler, 302 | `private, no-store`, `Vary: User-Agent, Accept-Language` | No |
| `/.well-known/*` | Route handlers, `dynamic = 'force-static'` | `public, max-age=3600` | n/a |

### 0.4 Visual language on the web (PRIMARY, adapted to web)

**Tokens.** The site imports `@da/design-tokens/tokens.css`. No hex value appears outside the token file (a lint rule enforces this).

| Role | Light | Dark (`prefers-color-scheme: dark`; no toggle, no cookie) |
|---|---|---|
| Page background | `bg #F5F4F0` | `#141311` |
| Card / surface | `surface #FFFFFF`, shadow `0 1px 2px rgba(27,25,23,.04), 0 6px 20px rgba(27,25,23,.05)` | `#1F1E1B` + 1px `rgba(255,255,255,.06)` hairline, no shadow |
| Editorial band | `editorial/paper #FBFAF7` | `#141311` |
| Ink band (meeting prep, promise card) | `#1A1917` | `#1F1E1B` + hairline (ink would vanish on `#141311`; design-account audit H-22) |
| Text | `#1A1917` / `#6B6860` / `ink/tertiary-strong` (meta text) / `#9B978E` only for decorative ≥12 px kickers | `#F2F0EB` / `#A39F96` / `#7A776F` |
| Primary action, links, AI marker | `brand/primary #5B5CE2` (pressed `#4B4CCB`) | `#8586F2` |
| Brand moments | `gradient/dawn` (hero device backdrop, final CTA, OG cards), `gradient/night` (memory band) | identical |
| Focus ring | `0 0 0 2px #5B5CE2`, offset 2 px | `#8586F2` |

**Colour rules carried from PRIMARY:**
- Indigo marks only AI markers, primary actions and links. It is never decoration.
- Coloured badges only for ACİL, SON TARİH, GÜVENLİK and ONAYLANDI, plus the PRIMARY `PRO` brand-soft pill (`#EDEDFC`/`#4547C9`, 11/700/+5%, radius 999).
- Integration tiles are neutral (`surface-2` tile, `#6B6860` icon). Semantic colours are never used as brand stand-ins.

**Web type scale.** This is a **proposed** addition of web-only tokens. Geist is used for UI; Lora for editorial quotes and briefing excerpts.

| Token | ≥1200 | 768–1199 | <768 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `web/display` (H1) | 56/60 600 −2.5% | 44/50 | 34/40 |
| `web/h2` | 40/46 600 −2% | 32/38 | 28/34 |
| `web/h3` | 22/28 600 −1% | 20/26 | 18/24 |
| `web/lead` | 20/30 400 | 18/28 | 17/26 |
| `web/body` | 16/26 400 | 16/26 | 16/24 |
| `kicker` | 12/16 600 +8% caps | same | same |
| `web/editorial` (Lora) | 22/34 400 | 20/31 | 18/29 |
| `micro` | 12/16 500 | same | same |

- Times, counts and prices use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.
- Uppercase copy is uppercased in the catalog with `toLocaleUpperCase('tr-TR')`, never with CSS `text-transform`, because CSS casing is not Turkish-aware for "i".

**Breakpoints, SREQ-94.** Tailwind v4: `@theme { --breakpoint-*: initial; --breakpoint-md: 48rem; --breakpoint-xl: 75rem; }`.
- **Mobile < 768:** 4-column grid, 20 px gutters, section padding 64 px.
- **Tablet 768–1199:** 8 columns, 32 px gutters, section padding 88 px.
- **Desktop ≥ 1200:** 12 columns, container `max-width: 1200px`, 40 px gutters, section padding 120 px.
- **No horizontal scroll at any width from 320 to 1920** (a test asserts this).

**Motion** (PRIMARY 08 contract):
- Easing `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`; `ease-out` for exits. No animation exceeds 600 ms.
- Section reveal: fade plus 8 px rise, 280 ms, once per page view (IntersectionObserver).
- Hero entrance: kicker, H1 and supporting line fade in 240 ms, staggered by 60 ms.
- FAQ expand: height 280 ms, chevron rotation 200 ms.
- Dialog: opens 300 ms, closes 240 ms, 35 % ink scrim over 250 ms.
- **`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`:** every transform, stagger, count and scroll-linked effect is disabled. Only a 120 ms opacity transition remains.
- No autoplaying video, parallax or carousel exists anywhere.

**Section backgrounds on the home page, in order:**
1. Hero: onboarding tint `linear-gradient(180deg,#EDEDFC 0%,#F5F4F0 32%)`.
2. Integrations: `surface` band.
3. How it works: `bg`.
4. Morning Briefing: `editorial/paper`.
5. Mail Intelligence: `bg`.
6. Meeting Prep: ink band.
7. Smart Planning: `bg`.
8. AI Memory: `gradient/night`.
9. Security: `bg` with an ink promise card.
10. Pricing: `bg`.
11. FAQ: `bg`.
12. Final CTA: `gradient/dawn`.

### 0.5 Truthfulness rules (M§74, M§141, M§40, C-27, C-09, C-10, P-01)

**Banned claims.** A web-specific list extends `scripts/quality-gate/banned-markers.txt` (ADR-14). A CI grep runs over `@da/i18n` `web.*`/`faq.*`/`plans.*` catalogs, `apps/web/content/**` and the rendered HTML of every page (Playwright). The following never appear, in TR or EN:

| Banned | Why / replacement |
|---|---|
| "Kredi kartı gerekmez" / "no credit card required" | Store trials need a store account with a payment method (C-27) |
| Any "N gün ücretsiz" / "free trial" wording outside the trial-conditional template (§2) | Trial copy only if a store intro offer is configured (C-09, M§43) |
| "Sınırsız" / "unlimited" | Pro means "Yüksek (adil kullanım)" (C-10, plan §8). The web avoids the word even in negated fair-use sentences, so `apps/web` needs no `quality-gate.allow` entry (plan R-17) |
| "uçtan uca şifreleme", "Uçtan uca TLS", "end-to-end encrypted" | Not true (M§40, P-01) |
| "KVKK ve GDPR uyumlu", "GDPR compliant" | Unverified legal claim (P-01). Use rights-oriented copy instead |
| "Gerisini siler" / "deletes the rest" | The product never deletes or moves mail |
| "Şu an ücretsiz erişim açık", "ŞU ANDA BAĞLI HESAPLAR" | Fake scarcity or social proof |
| "Zoom", "Microsoft Teams" listed as integrations | Not providers (M§75) |
| "60 saniyelik brifing" / fixed audio durations | Duration is dynamic from TTS length |
| "Unutulan mail kalmaz" and other absolute guarantees | Softened (§15) |
| Traffic or travel-time ETAs | Travel time only when the source provides it (plan §20) |

**Social proof.**
- No testimonials, star ratings, user counts, press logos or "as seen in" blocks ship.
- A quotation is only ever shown if it is real, written consent is on file and it is dated. None exist at launch, so the site has no testimonial component at all.
- PRIMARY ad/03's named quote is replaced (§15.7).

**Single source of truth.** Every factual number on the site renders from the same source the product enforces:

| Fact on the site | Source | Test |
|---|---|---|
| Free limits (1 mail account, 1 calendar, 50 AI analyses/day) | `public-api GET /plans` (PUB-05) → `plan_limits` keys `max_mail_accounts`, `max_calendars`, `ai_daily_budget_units` (plan R-22) | Playwright against the stub; Deno test that `/plans` mirrors `plan_limits` |
| Store prices, intro-offer days | `app_settings['web.pricing_display']` via `GET /plans` (PUB-05). It is a system setting, not a feature flag, because plan R-10 fixes the flag keys. Rendered only when `verified=true` and `as_of` ≤ 90 days old | unit test `pricingView()` |
| Retention table in /privacy | `@da/domain` `RETENTION_SCHEDULE` (also drives the `retention` job) | vitest: the renderer output equals the constants |
| "Neler silinir" table in /data-deletion | `@da/domain` `ACCOUNT_DELETION_SCOPE` / `HISTORY_DELETION_SCOPE` (also drive the `account_deletion` / `history_deletion` jobs) | vitest equality, plus a Deno job test that deletes exactly this scope |
| Referral reward days, window, cap | `GET /referrals/:code` (PUB-04) → `reward_days`. The apply window and the yearly cap render from `REFERRAL_DEFAULTS` (registry R-12), which a Deno test pins to the server `app_settings` `referral.*` values | Playwright; Deno |
| Data region, AI processing location | `env.DATA_REGION_LABEL`, `content/subprocessors.ts` | snapshot test |
| Marketing numbers (83/4, 5 şey, …) | The marketing demo scenario (§15.2), always captioned as a sample | Maestro assertions before capture |

**Every visual is real UI.**
- Device imagery and feature visuals are captured from the real app in demo mode (M§89, S-03, SREQ-96).
- Hand-drawn product UI is not allowed. Composition frames (text, backgrounds, bezels) are generated from HTML templates.

**No dead actions (M§99).**
- Every button or link performs navigation, a store handoff, a dialog, a copy or a submit.
- Non-interactive chips (integrations) never look pressable (SREQ-85).

### 0.7 Store links, QR, deep links, universal links

**`lib/store-links.ts`** builds every store URL. There are no inline store URLs anywhere else.
- App Store: `https://apps.apple.com/{tr|us}/app/id{IOS_APP_STORE_ID}?pt={APP_STORE_PROVIDER_TOKEN}&ct={campaign}&mt=8`. These are App Store Connect campaign tokens: aggregated, with no user identifiers. Omit `pt`/`ct` if no provider token is configured.
- Google Play: `https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dijitalasistan.app&hl={tr|en}&referrer={urlencoded}`.
  - Marketing placements use `utm_source=web&utm_medium={placement}`.
  - The referral landing uses `code={CODE}`, the same Install Referrer value that PUB-04 returns in `store_urls.android` (read by the Play Install Referrer API in the app; Part 4 M-REF-02).
- `campaign` / `placement` enum: `header | hero | pricing | final | menu | referral | app_link | oauth_done | qr_hero | qr_final | qr_pricing`.

**Header CTA and QR codes** point to `/get?src=…` (W-GET-01):
- iOS user agents → App Store;
- Android → Play;
- everything else → `/#download` (or `/en#download`).

This works without JavaScript and with no client-side user-agent sniffing.

**iOS Smart App Banner**
- Home and every `(links)` page emit `<meta name="apple-itunes-app" content="app-id={IOS_APP_STORE_ID}[, app-argument={canonical URL}]">`.
- `app-argument` is set only on `/r/[code]`, `/app/*` and `/oauth/done`, so an installed app opens at the right place.
- It is omitted when `IOS_APP_STORE_ID` is unset.

**Universal / App Links.** Paths and app IDs, M§108:
- Paths: `/app/*`, `/r/*`, `/oauth/done`.
- App IDs: `com.dijitalasistan.app`, scheme `dijitalasistan`.
- The mobile config (Part 1 / MOBILE) must declare:
  - `ios.associatedDomains: ['applinks:dijitalasistan.app']`;
  - Android intent filters with `autoVerify: true` for host `dijitalasistan.app`, path prefixes `/app/` and `/r/`, and path `/oauth/done`.

**Explicit "open in app" links on web pages:**
- Android: `intent://{path}?{query}#Intent;scheme=dijitalasistan;package=com.dijitalasistan.app;S.browser_fallback_url={urlencoded Play URL};end`. This falls back gracefully when the app is absent.
- iOS: the Smart App Banner is the open path. No bare `dijitalasistan://` button is shown on iOS for pages where the app may be absent, because Safari would show an error. The exception is W-OAUTH-01: there the user has just come from the app, so a custom-scheme button is safe.

### 0.8 Data sources: `public-api` routes used by the web (API_CONTRACTS §13, PUB-01…PUB-06)

`lib/public-api.ts` is the only caller. The browser uses `{NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/public-api`, and server-side fetches (`/plans` at build and revalidation) use `{API_PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/functions/v1/public-api`. Both resolve to `https://api.dijitalasistan.app/functions/v1/public-api` (INTEGRATION_PLAN §15).

**Function rules** (API_CONTRACTS §2 and the §13 common rules):
- `verify_jwt = false`, auth tier `none+ratelimit`. No web call sends or needs a bearer token, and `public-api` rejects admin identities (plan R-08).
- CORS: the `Origin` must equal `PUBLIC_WEB_URL` (production `https://dijitalasistan.app`). The staging project sets `PUBLIC_WEB_URL` to the staging web host, and Vercel previews of `da-web` call the staging project. Methods `GET, POST, OPTIONS`; request headers `content-type`, `apikey` (the publishable key) and `x-client-info`.
- Envelope: success `{ data, meta }`; error `{ error: { code, message, message_key, retryable, correlation_id, field_errors? } }`. The web maps `error.code` and `field_errors[].path` to its own `web.*` copy and never renders `message`.
- Rate limits use `private.rate_limit_hit()`, keyed by the hashed first `x-forwarded-for` hop and, where relevant, the email hash. Raw IPs are never stored. A 429 carries `Retry-After`.
- Honeypot field `website`: it must be empty. The check runs before schema validation, and a filled field gets a silent 202 with nothing stored or sent.
- Optional Cloudflare Turnstile `captcha_token`, verified when `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` is set. The web renders W-CMP-23 only when `NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` is set; without it, the honeypot and rate limits still apply.
- Responses never reveal whether an account exists.
- Schemas are in `@da/validation` (zod 4), shared by web and Deno.

| ID · Route | Request | Response | Limits | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PUB-05 · `GET /plans` | — | 200 `PublicPlans` `{ free: {mail_accounts, calendars, ai_analyses_per_day}, pro: {mail_accounts: 'multiple', calendars: 'multiple', ai_policy: 'fair_use'}, pricing: PricingDisplay \| null, updated_at }` with `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`. `free.*` come from the `plan_limits` keys `max_mail_accounts`, `max_calendars` and `ai_daily_budget_units` of plan `free` (plan R-22). `pricing` is `app_settings['web.pricing_display']` when it passes the `PricingDisplay` schema | IP hash 120/min | W-HOME-01, W-PRICE-01, `faq.*` params |
| PUB-04 · `GET /referrals/:code` | path `code` (normalised server-side) | 200 `{ valid, reward_days, store_urls: {ios, android}, deep_link, message_key }`; an unknown code is 200 with `valid: false`. **Never** returns referrer identity. The web reads only `valid` and `reward_days` | IP hash 60/min; cacheable 5 min | W-REF-01 |
| PUB-01 · `POST /support` | `PublicSupportBody` (strict) `{ name? (≤120), email, category: ticket_category, message (10–5000, trimmed), locale: 'tr' \| 'en', website?: '', captcha_token? }` | 202 `{ reference }` (the ticket's `public_ref`, e.g. `DA-2026-000123`) · 422 `VALIDATION_FAILED` with `field_errors` · 429 `RATE_LIMITED` | IP hash 5/h, email hash 3/h. The same email and message within 10 min returns the same reference | W-SUP-01 |
| PUB-02 · `POST /data-deletion/start` | `{ email, locale, captcha_token?, website?: '' }` | Always 202 `{ status: 'code_sent_if_account_exists' }`, padded to at least 400 ms · 422 `VALIDATION_FAILED` · 429 `RATE_LIMITED` | IP hash 10/h, email hash 3/h | W-DEL-01 |
| PUB-03 · `POST /data-deletion/verify` | `{ email, code }` (`code` = 6 digits) | 202 `{ reference, status: 'queued', subscription_notice: { active } }`; an already active request returns the same body · 422 `OTP_INVALID` (generic, identical for unknown emails) · 429 `OTP_LOCKED` (after 5 failures in 15 min, for 1 h) · 429 `RATE_LIMITED` | email hash 5 per 15 min | W-DEL-01 |
| PUB-06 · `POST /web-events` | `WebEventInput` (§0.11) | 202 `{ accepted: true }` | IP hash 120/min | all pages |

**Honeypot and bot handling.** People never see or fill `website`: it is visually hidden and removed from the accessibility tree. The silent 202 for a filled honeypot therefore never shows a person a fake success. For PUB-01 that 202 carries a reference-shaped value that matches no ticket; for PUB-02 it is the usual generic body, and no code is sent.

### 0.9 SEO conventions (M§73)

**Metadata.** Every indexable page sets:
- a unique `title` and `description` from `web.seo.*`;
- `alternates.canonical`;
- `alternates.languages` `{ tr: '/…', en: '/en/…', 'x-default': '/…' }`;
- `openGraph` (`type: website`, `siteName: 'Dijital Asistan'`, `locale: tr_TR|en_US`, `alternateLocale`, image 1200×630);
- `twitter: { card: 'summary_large_image' }`.

**Structured data** (`JsonLd`):

| Page | Types |
|---|---|
| Home | `Organization` (name = `COMPANY_LEGAL_NAME`, `brand` "Dijital Asistan", url, logo `/icon-512.png`, email `destek@dijitalasistan.app`, `sameAs` = store URLs) · `WebSite` (`inLanguage` `['tr-TR','en']`) · `MobileApplication` (`operatingSystem` "iOS, Android", `applicationCategory` "BusinessApplication", `offers` Free `price "0"` `priceCurrency "TRY"`) |
| Pricing | `MobileApplication` with `offers`: Free, plus Pro monthly and annual as `Offer` + `UnitPriceSpecification` (`billingDuration` `P1M`/`P1Y`). Pro offers are included **only** when `pricing.verified` |
| Support | `FAQPage` generated from the same FAQ catalog |
| Legal pages | `WebPage` with `dateModified` = effective date |

`aggregateRating` and `review` are **never** emitted (§0.5). There are no ratings to cite, so Google's app rich result will simply not show. This is accepted.

**Indexing switch.**
- `SITE_INDEXABLE` is a boolean env (**proposed**).
- `false` → `robots.txt` `Disallow: /`, `<meta name="robots" content="noindex">` on every page, and `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` from `proxy.ts`.
- Preview deployments (`VERCEL_ENV !== 'production'`) are always non-indexable.
- Production launch requires Google OAuth verification plus CASA (§17), so the switch is flipped as a Manual external step at public launch.

### 0.10 Accessibility conventions (M§92, WCAG 2.2 AA)

**Document structure.**
- One `<h1>` per page; no skipped heading levels.
- `lang` on `<html>`. Any EN words inside TR copy are wrapped in `lang="en"` spans, and the reverse.
- Landmarks: `header`, `nav[aria-label="Ana menü"|"Main"]`, `main#main`, `footer`.

**Focus.**
- Visible focus ring on every interactive element (§0.4).
- Focus is never trapped except inside open dialogs.
- `Esc` closes dialogs and focus returns to the trigger.
- Tab order follows visual order.

**Targets.** Hit targets are at least 44×44 CSS px. Inline links in text are exempt under WCAG 2.5.8, but get 4 px vertical padding anyway.

**Contrast.**
- Text is 4.5:1 or better (large text 3:1).
- Meta text uses `ink/tertiary-strong`, never `#9B978E`.
- White text on `gradient/dawn` sits only over the `#1E1E4C → #3B3CA8` portion, or over a `rgba(21,21,58,.35)` scrim where it crosses `#7071EA` (3.6:1 would fail for body text).
- The PRO pill (`#4547C9` on `#EDEDFC`) passes at 6.9:1.

**Images.**
- Informative images have `alt` text describing the content, including the key numbers.
- Decorative icons are `aria-hidden="true"`.
- The QR code has `alt` "Uygulamayı indirmek için QR kod" / "QR code to download the app" plus a visible text alternative (the store badges next to it).

**Forms.**
- Every input has a visible `<label>` and helper text via `aria-describedby`. There is no in-field hint text.
- Errors appear inline with `aria-invalid="true"`, and a summary appears at the top on submit, focused, with `role="alert"`.
- Status changes are announced through `aria-live="polite"`.
- Correct `autocomplete` values: `email`, `name`, `one-time-code`.

**Reduced motion.** See §0.4. Playwright checks it with `page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })` and asserts every `document.getAnimations()` duration is ≤ 120 ms.

**Zoom and reflow.** The layout reflows at 400 % zoom (1280 → 320 CSS px) with no loss of content or function (WCAG 1.4.10).

**No-JS.** All content, navigation, FAQ expansion (`<details>`) and store links work without JavaScript. The support form and the deletion flow need JS; their `<noscript>` text points to `destek@dijitalasistan.app` and to the in-app path.

### 0.11 Privacy-safe web analytics (M§42, ADR-13/38 adapted to an anonymous website)

**No third-party analytics.** There is no analytics SDK, no cookie, no `localStorage` identifier, no fingerprinting, no IP or user-agent storage and no referral codes, emails or query strings in events. This is why the site needs **no cookie banner**: it sets no non-essential cookies (the policy says so in `#cerezler`).

**Transport.** `lib/web-events.ts` posts JSON to `POST /web-events` (PUB-06) with `fetch(url, { method: 'POST', keepalive: true, credentials: 'omit' })`, so an event survives a page unload and never carries cookies. Nothing is sent when `navigator.globalPrivacyControl === true` or `navigator.doNotTrack === '1'`.

**Payload** (`WebEventInput`): `{ event, page, locale, device_class: 'mobile'|'tablet'|'desktop' (from the §0.4 breakpoints), theme: 'light'|'dark', props }`. `props` is validated against an allow-list per event.

**Storage.** PUB-06 increments `web_analytics_daily (day, event, dims_hash, dims jsonb, count)` (accepted system table: no user id, RLS enabled with no client policies). No row exists per visit.

| Event | Props (enums/booleans only) |
|---|---|
| `web_page_view` | — (dims carry page, locale, device_class, theme) |
| `web_cta_click` | `cta: app_store \| play_store \| get_started \| pricing \| faq_all \| privacy \| support \| open_in_app`, `placement` (§0.7 enum) |
| `web_qr_shown` | `placement` |
| `web_nav_click` | `target: how_it_works \| features \| security \| pricing \| faq` |
| `web_locale_switch` | `to: tr \| en` |
| `web_faq_toggle` | `faq_id` (catalog key enum), `open: boolean` |
| `web_pricing_period` | `period: monthly \| annual` |
| `web_support_submit` | `category` (`ticket_category`), `result: ok \| invalid \| rate_limited \| error` |
| `web_deletion_step` | `step: email_submitted \| code_sent \| request_submitted \| request_created \| otp_invalid \| otp_locked \| rate_limited \| error` (account deletion only, so there is no `kind`) |
| `web_referral_view` | `valid: boolean` |
| `web_oauth_done_view` | `provider: google \| microsoft \| demo \| unknown`, `result: pending_confirmation \| denied \| error \| expired_state \| admin_consent_required \| unknown` |
| `web_app_link_view` | — |
| `web_get_redirect` | `target: app_store \| play_store \| web`, `src` (§0.7 enum). Sent server-side from W-GET-01 |

### 0.12 Security headers and CSP (`proxy.ts`; ADR-52)

**All paths:**
- `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload`
- `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`
- `X-Frame-Options: DENY`
- `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin`
- `Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()`
- `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, except `no-referrer` on `/data-deletion`, `/oauth/done`, `/r/*` and `/app/*`.

**Static pages:**
```
default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline';
img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://api.dijitalasistan.app {SENTRY_INGEST_ORIGIN};
frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
```
Static pages reflect no user input and hold no session.

**`/data-deletion` and `/support`** (they accept personal data) are rendered per request with a nonce:
```
script-src 'self' 'nonce-{n}' 'strict-dynamic'; connect-src 'self' https://api.dijitalasistan.app {SENTRY_INGEST_ORIGIN}
```
Everything else is as for static pages. When `NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` is set, these two routes also add `https://challenges.cloudflare.com` to `script-src` and `frame-src` for W-CMP-23; no other route loads it.

**Link and redirect routes.** `/oauth/done` and `/get` also send `Cache-Control: no-store`.

**Sentry (web).**
- `sendDefaultPii: false`; no Session Replay; `tracesSampleRate: 0.05`.
- `beforeSend` scrubs `email`, `code`, `completion_code`, `token`, `authorization` and query strings.
- The ingest origin is the DSN region; the EU region is chosen as a Manual external step.

### 0.13 Performance budgets (M§125; plan §11 "Lighthouse ≥90")

- Lighthouse CI (`@lhci/cli` 0.15.1) runs on `next start` for `/`, `/pricing`, `/privacy`, `/support` and `/data-deletion` in both locales, with mobile emulation. Every category must score **≥ 90**. Accessibility and SEO must score **≥ 95**.
- Core Web Vitals targets (lab): LCP < 2.5 s, CLS < 0.1, TBT < 200 ms.
- First-load JS: home ≤ 130 KB gzip; legal pages ≤ 110 KB.
- The hero image is `priority`, AVIF, ≤ 120 KB at 2x. Feature images are lazy, ≤ 90 KB each.
- Fonts are self-hosted by `next/font` (no runtime requests to Google, which is also a privacy win), `display: swap`, subsets `latin` and `latin-ext`, with preloaded weights 400/500/600 and Lora 400/500.

## 1. W-HOME-01 · Ana sayfa (Home)

| Field | Spec |
|---|---|
| Page ID | W-HOME-01 |
| Route | `/` (tr), `/en` (en) |
| Purpose | Explain the product in one screen: a personal command center, not a chatbot (M§2, M§3.1). Show every M§73 section with truthful, capability-accurate copy, and hand the visitor to the right store (M§137 "app CTA"). Also satisfy Google OAuth brand verification: a public homepage that describes the app and links the privacy policy (integrations audit) |

### 1.2 Remaining fields

| Field | Spec |
|---|---|
| Components | W-CMP-01..15, W-CMP-21, W-CMP-22 |
| Data dependencies | `@da/i18n` `web.home.*`, `web.nav.*`, `web.footer.*`, `faq.*`, `plans.*`, `briefing.sections.*` (EN labels), `mail.categories.*` · `GET /plans` (PUB-05, cached 1 h) · generated images `public/marketing/{tr,en}/{light,dark}/{feat-00..06}.{avif,webp,png}` (§15.6) · env `IOS_APP_STORE_ID`, `APP_STORE_PROVIDER_TOKEN`, `DATA_REGION_LABEL`, `COMPANY_LEGAL_NAME` |
| CTAs (real behaviour) | **Header "Ücretsiz Başla":** `/get?src=header` (302 to the right store or `/#download`). **Store badges:** direct store URLs (§0.7), same tab. **QR:** scanning opens `/get?src=qr_*`. On 768–1199 the "QR ile indir" button opens a `<dialog>` containing the QR. **Nav anchors:** smooth scroll (instant under reduced motion). The target heading receives focus (`tabIndex=-1`) and the URL hash updates. **Locale switch:** navigates to `/en` (or `/`) at the same anchor. **Pricing link and FAQ link:** navigation. **Google "Ayrıntılar":** `/privacy#google`. **Footer mailto** opens the mail client. **iOS Smart App Banner:** "Aç/Open" when installed, "Görüntüle/View" otherwise (OS-native) |
| SEO | Title TR "Dijital Asistan — Bugün bilmen gerekenleri, sen sormadan söyler." / EN "Dijital Asistan — What you need to know today, before you ask". Description TR "Dijital Asistan mailini, takvimini ve açık işlerini anlayıp her gün sana kısa bir brifing hazırlar. iPhone ve Android için." / EN "Dijital Asistan understands your email, calendar and open tasks and prepares a short daily briefing. For iPhone and Android." Canonical `https://dijitalasistan.app/` and `/en`. OG image W-SYS-05 `home`. JSON-LD `Organization`, `WebSite`, `MobileApplication` (§0.9) |
| Responsive notes | **≥1200:** hero 6/6 grid (text left, device right, device 440 px wide). S4–S8 alternate image right/left, 6/6, image max 560 px. Integrations chips in 3 labelled rows. Steps in 3 columns. Pricing cards side by side (max 1000 px). FAQ max 760 px. Inline QR in hero and final CTA. **768–1199:** hero 7/5 (device 340 px). Features 1:1. Nav shows Özellikler, Güvenlik, Fiyatlar; "Nasıl çalışır" and "SSS" move into the menu. QR behind the dialog button. **<768:** single column. Hero order: kicker → H1 → supporting → badges (stacked full-width, 48 px) → trust line → device (300 px, centered, bottom-cropped by the section edge). Features stack text then image. Menu button opens a full-height `<dialog>`. QR hidden. Minimum supported width 320 px |
| Accessibility notes | Landmarks and one H1 (§0.10). Each section has `aria-labelledby` pointing at its H2. Chips are a `<ul>` with non-interactive `<li>` elements (no hover or pointer styles). `ProTag` has text "PRO" plus a visually hidden "Pro özelliği". Store badge links have accessible names "App Store'dan indir" / "Google Play'den al" (EN "Download on the App Store" / "Get it on Google Play"). The QR dialog is a native `<dialog>` with `aria-labelledby`: it traps focus, `Esc` closes it and focus returns. Menu dialog: first link focused on open. Dark and light variants of device images have equivalent alt text. White text on the night and dawn bands is checked by axe per band |
| Analytics | `web_page_view`, `web_nav_click`, `web_cta_click` (every badge, header CTA and link button), `web_qr_shown`, `web_locale_switch`, `web_faq_toggle` |
| Error/empty states | **`/plans` unavailable at revalidation:** the last cached version is served (ISR). At first build it is fatal in production: the env schema requires `API_PUBLIC_BASE_URL`, and the build fails with "plans fetch failed". In non-production builds, numeric Free values render as "Sınırlı" wording and the Pro price line is omitted. **`pricing` null or unverified:** no Pro price line; the note stays. **An image fails to load:** alt text renders in a `surface-2` box of the same aspect ratio, so there is no CLS. **`IOS_APP_STORE_ID` unset** (non-production): App Store badge, QR and Smart App Banner are not rendered, and a dev-only notice appears (`APP_ENV !== 'production'`): "Harici kimlik bilgisi gerekli: IOS_APP_STORE_ID". **JS disabled:** fully usable; the QR is inline at every width ≥768 |
| Tests | See §16: `landing.spec.ts`, `seo.spec.ts`, `responsive.spec.ts`, `a11y.spec.ts`, `privacy-network.spec.ts`, `truthfulness.spec.ts` |

### 2.2 Remaining fields

| Field | Spec |
|---|---|
| Components | W-CMP-02..08, W-CMP-11, W-CMP-14, W-CMP-15, W-CMP-21, W-CMP-22 |
| Data dependencies | `GET /plans` (PUB-05) → `free.*`, `pricing: PricingDisplay \| null`. `PricingDisplay` (zod, part of PUB-05) = `{ storefront: 'TR', currency: 'TRY', as_of: ISODate, verified: boolean, monthly: {app_store: number\|null, play: number\|null}, annual: {…}, intro_offer: {days: number, stores: ('app_store'\|'play')[]} \| null }`. Stored as the `app_settings` key `web.pricing_display` (a system setting, not a feature flag, because plan R-10 fixes the flag keys) and edited in backoffice Settings › Sistem (`admin_api.settings_update`, permission `settings.system.write`, step-up, audit `settings.system_updated` with before/after). **Manual external step:** after prices and offers are set in App Store Connect and Play Console, finance supplies the values and a `settings.system.write` holder saves them with `verified=true`. Formatting: `Intl.NumberFormat(locale==='tr'?'tr-TR':'en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'TRY',maximumFractionDigits:2,minimumFractionDigits: n%1?2:0})`. When the two stores differ the price renders as a range `min–max` ("₺199–₺209"); this is the plan's "mağaza fiyatı ranges". Savings: `round((1 − annual/(monthly×12))×100)`, computed per store, shown only if both stores give the same value (else the min–max percent range) and ≥1. `as_of` older than 90 days → treated as unverified |
| CTAs (real behaviour) | Period toggle switches the displayed Pro price client-side (no navigation) and emits `web_pricing_period`. "Ücretsiz Başla" / "Uygulamada Pro'ya geç" work as described in P2. Store badges and QR are direct handoffs. FAQ `<details>` toggles. There is no web checkout, no RevenueCat on the web and no pricing form |
| SEO | Title "Fiyatlar — Dijital Asistan" / "Pricing — Dijital Asistan". Description TR "Ücretsiz planla başla; öğle ve akşam brifingleri, toplantı hazırlığı, akıllı takip ve AI hafıza için Pro'ya geç. Fiyatlar App Store ve Google Play mağaza fiyatlarıdır." / EN equivalent. OG `pricing`. JSON-LD `MobileApplication` + offers (Pro offers only when verified) |
| Responsive notes | ≥768: cards 2-up (max 1000 px). The comparison table is a full-width 3-column grid (`1fr 120px 120px`) with a sticky header row. <768: cards stacked (Pro first when the annual toggle is selected? **No**: order is always Free then Pro, for predictability). The table keeps 3 columns with `1fr 72px 72px` and 14 px labels, with no horizontal scroll: long labels wrap and the ✓ and — cells stay centered |
| Accessibility notes | The toggle is a native `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>` "Ödeme dönemi" and radio inputs (arrow keys work). The price region is `aria-live="polite"`, so a period change is announced. The table is a real `<table>` with `<th scope="col">` and `<th scope="row">`, and its `<caption>` is "Ücretsiz ve Pro karşılaştırması" |
| Analytics | `web_page_view`, `web_pricing_period`, `web_cta_click` (placement `pricing`), `web_faq_toggle`, `web_qr_shown` |
| Error/empty states | **`/plans` down:** Free numeric cells show "Sınırlı" / "Limited", the Pro price block is omitted and a line appears: "Güncel fiyatı uygulamada, satın almadan önce görürsün." / "You'll see the current price in the app before you buy." **`pricing.verified=false` or stale:** same line, no numbers. **`intro_offer` null:** no trial line and no trial wording anywhere (enforced by `truthfulness.spec.ts`) |
| Tests | `pricing.spec.ts` (§16) |
