## 3. W-LEGAL-01 · Gizlilik Politikası ve KVKK Aydınlatma Metni (Privacy Policy)

| Field | Spec |
|---|---|
| Page ID | W-LEGAL-01 |
| Route | `/privacy`, `/en/privacy`. It is the target of every "Gizlilik Politikası" link in the app (paywall, onboarding explainers, Privacy Center) and of App Store Connect "Privacy Policy URL", the Play Console privacy field and the Google OAuth consent-screen privacy URL |
| Purpose | One document that serves as the KVKK m.10 *aydınlatma metni* (information notice) and a GDPR Art. 13 notice. It includes the Google API Services User Data Policy Limited Use statement, AI sub-processors, the no-training statement, retention, deletion, rights and contact. Content must be **real and consistent** with the architecture (M§73, M§40, M§141). **Manual external step:** Turkish counsel reviews and signs off the final TR text before `SITE_INDEXABLE=true`; the EN text is a translation |

### 3.1 Document model

`content/legal/privacy.{tr,en}.ts` export a `LegalDocument`:
```ts
{ id: 'privacy', version: string, effectiveDate: ISODate, sections: { id: string, heading: string, blocks: Block[] }[] }
```
`Block` is one of: `p`, `ul`, `table`, `callout`, `retentionTable`, `subprocessorTable` or `definition`.

- Section IDs are **identical across locales**, because the app deep-links to anchors.
- A vitest parity test asserts that tr and en have the same section IDs and order.
- Dynamic values come from `content/company.ts`, the env-validated `COMPANY_*` values, `RETENTION_SCHEDULE`, `SUBPROCESSORS` and `DATA_REGION_LABEL`.
- The page header shows "Sürüm {version} · Yürürlük tarihi: {effectiveDate}" / "Version … · Effective …".
- The precedence note: "Türkçe ve İngilizce metinler arasında fark olursa Türkçe metin esas alınır." / "If the Turkish and English texts differ, the Turkish text prevails."

### 3.2 Section outline (anchor · heading TR / EN · required content)

1. **`#ozet`** · "Kısaca" / "In short". Bullets:
   - the seven PromiseCard statements (W-HOME-01 S9);
   - "Hesabını ve verilerini istediğin an silebilirsin: uygulamada Profil › Gizlilik ya da /data-deletion."
2. **`#veri-sorumlusu`** · "Veri sorumlusu" / "Data controller". Content:
   - `COMPANY_LEGAL_NAME`, `COMPANY_ADDRESS`, `COMPANY_MERSIS_NO`, `COMPANY_KEP_ADDRESS`;
   - privacy contact `gizlilik@dijitalasistan.app`;
   - statement that this text is the notice under KVKK m.10.
   - **Manual external step:** the owner supplies legal entity values (production build fails without them) and decides the VERBİS registration obligation. The EU representative (GDPR Art. 27) is named here once appointed by the owner. It is a required launch item for `/en` marketing to EU residents (§17).
3. **`#kapsam`** · "Bu politika neyi kapsar?" / "Scope". Covers the Dijital Asistan iOS and Android apps, this website and support channels. The internal administration panel is used only by authorised staff and has no end-user data entry.
4. **`#islenen-veriler`** · "Hangi verileri işliyoruz?" / "Data we process". Table with columns category / examples / source / when:

   | Category | Contents (must match the architecture) |
   |---|---|
   | Hesap | Ad, e-posta, giriş yöntemi (Apple, Google, Microsoft, e-posta kodu). Apple gizli e-posta adresi (…@privaterelay.appleid.com) kullanabilirsin |
   | Bağlı mail hesapları | Başlık bilgileri (gönderen, alıcılar, konu, tarih, ileti kimlikleri), en fazla 200 karakterlik önizleme, AI özetleri, anahtar noktalar, kategoriler, kaynaktan doğrulanmış en fazla 300 karakterlik kısa alıntılar. **Mail gövdesi saklanmaz**; "Orijinal Mail" açıldığında hesabından anlık getirilir, kaydedilmez ve kayıt dosyalarına yazılmaz. Ekler yalnızca "Ekler" veri kaynağı açıksa ve analiz için okunur |
   | Takvim | Etkinlik başlığı, zamanı, katılımcılar, konum metni, toplantı bağlantısı, düzenleyen |
   | Görevler | Google Tasks / Microsoft To Do görev başlığı, son tarihi, durumu |
   | Cihaz takvimi ve anımsatıcılar | iPhone'da Apple Takvim ve Anımsatıcılar, Android'de cihaz takvimi: yalnızca sen "Bağla"ya dokunduğunda, uygulama açıkken okunur ve özet olarak yüklenir |
   | Telefon bildirimleri (yalnızca Android, açıkça etkinleştirirsen) | Bildirim içerikleri cihazında işlenir; yalnızca çıkarılan bilgiler (ör. kargo durumu, tutar, tarih) hesabına kaydedilir. Doğrulama kodları ve güvenlik uygulamaları her zaman hariç tutulur. Bildirim metinleri **sunucuya gönderilmez** |
   | Yakalamalar | Paylaştığın veya yüklediğin fotoğraf, ekran görüntüsü, PDF, dosya, bağlantı ve metinler; dosyalar analizden sonra silinir (§`#saklama`) |
   | Ses | Sesli komutlar cihazda yazıya çevrilir. Cihazın desteklemiyorsa Apple veya Google'ın konuşma tanıma hizmeti ya da sunucu tarafı ses tanıma sağlayıcımız kullanılır; ses kaydı saklanmaz |
   | Asistan konuşmaları | Sorduğun sorular ve yanıtlar, kaynak bağlantılarıyla |
   | Tercihler ve kurallar | Brifing saatleri, bildirim ayarları, öncelik kuralları, VIP kişiler, öğrenilen tercihler, saklama süresi |
   | Onaylı işlemler | Önerilen ve onayladığın/reddettiğin işlemler (ne, neden, nereye, sonuç) |
   | Bildirimler | Cihaz bildirim anahtarı, gönderilen bildirimlerin türü ve zamanı; bildirim metni seçtiğin ayrıntı düzeyinde oluşturulur |
   | Abonelik | Uygulama kullanıcı kimliği, abonelik durumu, ürün, yenileme/bitiş tarihi. **Kart bilgilerin bize gelmez**; ödemeyi Apple/Google alır |
   | Davet | Davet kodun, davet durumları; kötüye kullanımı önlemek için geri döndürülemez özete çevrilmiş cihaz ve e-posta sinyalleri |
   | Destek | E-posta, ad (isteğe bağlı), konu, mesaj ve dil; uygulamadan yazdığında ayrıca platform ve uygulama sürümü |
   | Ürün analitiği | İçerik içermeyen olaylar (ör. "brifing açıldı"); mail, konuşma veya kişi bilgisi içermez |
   | Hata kayıtları | Hata izi, cihaz modeli, işletim sistemi ve uygulama sürümü; kişisel veriler gönderilmeden önce temizlenir |
   | Web sitesi | Çerez yok; yalnızca günlük toplam sayımlar (§`#cerezler`). Barındırma sağlayıcımız güvenlik için kısa süreli erişim kaydı tutar |

   Closing sentence: "Cihaz konumunu toplamayız; takvim etkinliğinde yazan konum metni etkinlik verisinin parçası olarak işlenir." (see registry note R-19).
5. **`#amaclar`** · "Neden işliyoruz ve hukuki sebepler" / "Purposes and legal bases". Table columns: purpose / data / KVKK m.5 basis / GDPR Art. 6 basis:
   - brifing, sınıflandırma, öneriler, asistan → m.5/2(c) sözleşmenin ifası / 6(1)(b);
   - onayladığın işlemleri yürütmek (mail gönderme, takvim/görev oluşturma) → (c) / (b);
   - bildirimler → (c) / (b);
   - abonelik ve davet yönetimi, kötüye kullanım önleme → (c) + (f) meşru menfaat / (b) + (f);
   - güvenlik, hata ayıklama, sistem sağlığı → (f) / (f);
   - destek → (c) + (f);
   - yasal yükümlülükler ve talepler → (ç) + (e) / (c) + (f);
   - içeriksiz ürün analitiği ile ürün iyileştirme → (f) / (f).

   The section states that no explicit consent is relied on for core processing and that optional features (Android notifications, "Etkileşimlerimden öğren") are opt-in and can be turned off at any time.
6. **`#yapay-zeka`** · "Yapay zekâ ile işleme" / "How AI processing works". Content:
   - Deterministic filters and your rules run first. Only the content needed for a feature goes to AI providers.
   - Content is treated as untrusted data (prompt-injection defences).
   - Outputs must be grounded in the source; an unverifiable date or amount is shown as "Kaynakta kesinleşmiyor."
   - Every AI inference has a "Bu nereden çıktı?" source link.
   - Doğrulama kodları, şifreler, kart ve IBAN numaraları, AI'a gönderilmeden önce otomatik maskelenir (registry R-18).
   - **No automated decision with legal or similarly significant effect** (KVKK m.11(1)(g), GDPR Art. 22). Every write needs your approval.
   - You can correct AI decisions; corrections feed only your own preferences.
   - **Mail içeriklerin ve diğer verilerin yapay zekâ modellerini eğitmek için kullanılmaz.** Neither we nor our AI providers train models on them.
7. **`#google`** · "Google kullanıcı verileri (Sınırlı Kullanım)" / "Google user data (Limited Use)". The statement, verbatim, in a callout:
   - TR: "Dijital Asistan'ın Google API'lerinden aldığı bilgileri kullanması ve başka bir uygulamaya aktarması, Sınırlı Kullanım şartları dahil Google API Hizmetleri Kullanıcı Verileri Politikası'na uygun olacaktır."
   - EN: "Dijital Asistan's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements."

   Links: `https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy` and `https://developers.google.com/workspace/workspace-api-user-data-developer-policy`. Then a scope table with scope / why / when requested:
   - `gmail.readonly` (analyse mail, at connect);
   - `gmail.send` (only to send a reply you approved; requested at your first approved send);
   - `calendar.events.readonly`, `calendar.calendarlist.readonly`, `calendar.settings.readonly` (at connect);
   - `calendar.events.owned` (only for events you approve; at first approved write);
   - `tasks.readonly` (at connect);
   - `tasks` (only for tasks you approve).

   Then the rules:
   - Google data is used only to provide user-facing features in the app.
   - It is never used for advertising, never sold, and never used to develop, improve or train generalised or non-personalised AI/ML models.
   - It is transferred to third parties only to provide those features (the AI sub-processors in `#alt-isleyiciler`, acting on our instructions), for security, to comply with law, or in a merger/acquisition with notice.
   - **Humans do not read it** except with your affirmative agreement for specific messages (e.g., you ask support to check a mail), for security investigations, to comply with law, or in aggregated, anonymised form for internal operations.

   Revocation:
   - in the app: Profil › Bağlı Hesaplar › Bağlantıyı kaldır (we revoke Google access automatically);
   - at Google: `https://myaccount.google.com/connections`.
8. **`#microsoft`** · "Microsoft hesap verileri" / "Microsoft account data". Permissions:
   - `openid profile email offline_access User.Read Mail.Read` at connect;
   - `Calendars.Read` and `Tasks.Read` when you connect calendar or tasks;
   - `Mail.Send`, `Calendars.ReadWrite` and `Tasks.ReadWrite` only when you approve your first write of that kind.

   The same use rules as Google apply. Revocation: Microsoft does not allow apps to revoke their own access. When you disconnect, we delete the stored access keys and stop synchronisation. Remove the permission at `https://account.live.com/consent/Manage` (personal account) or `https://myapps.microsoft.com` (work or school account).
9. **`#apple-ve-cihaz`** · "Apple ile giriş ve cihaz verileri" / "Sign in with Apple and device data". Content:
   - Apple private relay addresses are supported.
   - At account deletion we revoke the Sign in with Apple token.
   - EventKit and Android CalendarContract are read only after you tap "Bağla" and only while the app runs; freshness is shown as "son cihaz senkronu".
   - Widget content stays on the device (App Group) and never includes mail content beyond what you see on the lock screen setting.
   - iOS has no notification-reading feature, because iOS does not allow it.
10. **`#alt-isleyiciler`** · "Aktarımlar ve alt işleyiciler" / "Recipients and sub-processors". Lead: "Verilerini satmayız, reklam için paylaşmayız. Aşağıdaki hizmet sağlayıcılar yalnızca bizim adımıza ve talimatımızla işler." `SubprocessorTable` (from `content/subprocessors.ts`) with columns sağlayıcı / amaç / işlenen veri / konum / güvence / koşul:

    | Provider | Purpose | Data | Location | Condition |
    |---|---|---|---|---|
    | Supabase | Veritabanı, kimlik doğrulama, dosya depolama, sunucu işlevleri | Tüm hizmet verileri | AB (Frankfurt, `eu-central-1`) | Her zaman |
    | Vercel | Web sitesinin barındırılması | Site istekleri | AB işlev bölgesi (fra1) + küresel CDN | Her zaman |
    | Anthropic | AI analizi (Claude) | Analiz için gereken mail/takvim/görev/yakalama bölümleri, soruların | ABD | Her zaman |
    | OpenAI | Yedek AI analizi; sunucu tarafı ses tanıma yedeği | Aynı kapsam; ses kaydı (saklanmaz) | ABD | Birincil sağlayıcı yanıt vermediğinde; cihaz ses tanıması yoksa |
    | Voyage AI | Anlam dizini (embedding) | Türetilmiş kısa metinler | ABD | AI hafıza ve arama |
    | Expo (650 Industries) | Bildirim iletimi | Cihaz bildirim anahtarı, bildirim metni | ABD | Bildirim izni verdiysen |
    | Apple (APNs) / Google (FCM) | Bildirimin cihaza ulaştırılması | Bildirim anahtarı, bildirim metni | Küresel | Bildirim izni verdiysen |
    | RevenueCat | Abonelik yönetimi | Uygulama kullanıcı kimliği, abonelik durumu | ABD | Her zaman |
    | Sentry | Hata izleme | Temizlenmiş hata kayıtları | Configured Sentry region | Her zaman |
    | E-posta sağlayıcısı (`EMAIL_PROVIDER` değerine göre Resend, Postmark veya Amazon SES) | Doğrulama kodu, silme bildirimi ve destek yanıtı e-postaları | E-posta adresi, e-posta içeriği | Configured | Her zaman |
    | Google Cloud Pub/Sub | Gmail değişiklik bildirimleri | Posta adresi ve değişiklik numarası (içerik yok) | Küresel | Gmail bağladıysan |
    | Premium ses sağlayıcısı (Azure AI Speech, OpenAI veya ElevenLabs'ten yapılandırılan) | Brifing metnini sese çevirme | Brifing metni | Configured | Yalnızca premium ses etkinse |
    | Cloudflare (Turnstile) | Destek ve veri silme formlarında bot koruması | Tarayıcı ve etkileşim sinyalleri, IP adresi | Küresel | Yalnızca bot koruması etkinse |

    Every row that states a location depends on the provider's configured region, which is a Manual external step (§17). The last paragraph covers legal and authority requests (disclosed only when legally required) and mergers (users are notified in advance).
11. **`#yurt-disi-aktarim`** · "Yurt dışına aktarım" / "International transfers". AI processing happens in the US. The section states that transfers from Türkiye follow KVKK m.9 (standard contracts announced by the Board, notified to the Authority within 5 business days), and that transfers from the EU/EEA follow Standard Contractual Clauses or an adequacy decision where the provider is certified. **Manual external step:** sign the standard contracts or DPAs with every provider in `#alt-isleyiciler` and file the KVKK notifications before launch.
12. **`#saklama`** · "Saklama süreleri" / "Retention". `RetentionTable` rendered from `RETENTION_SCHEDULE` (registry R-10):

    | Veri | Süre |
    |---|---|
    | Analiz sonuçları ve senkronize içerik özetleri (brifingler, içgörüler, mail başlıkları ve önizlemeleri, takvim/görev kopyaları, taahhütler, yaşam kartları, toplantı notları, asistan konuşmaları, AI hafıza dizini, sesli brifing dosyaları) | Senin seçimin: 30 gün, **90 gün (varsayılan)**, 1 yıl ya da sen silene kadar |
    | Mail gövdeleri | Saklanmaz |
    | Yakalama dosyaları | Analizden sonra en geç 24 saat |
    | Dışa aktarım dosyaları | 24 saat (indirme bağlantısıyla birlikte silinir) |
    | Şifreli erişim anahtarları | Bağlantıyı kaldırana ya da hesabını silene kadar |
    | Cihaz bildirim anahtarları | Çıkış yapana, uygulama kaldırılana ya da hesabını silene kadar |
    | İçeriksiz ürün analitiği | 400 gün; kimliksiz günlük toplamlar sonrasında saklanır |
    | Hata kayıtları | 90 gün |
    | Sunucu kayıtları | En fazla 30 gün |
    | Destek talepleri | Kapatıldıktan sonra 2 yıl |
    | Güvenlik denetim kayıtları | 2 yıl; hesap silinince kimliğin geri döndürülemez özete çevrilir |
    | Silme talebi kaydı | Tamamlandıktan sonra 3 yıl (yalnızca referans, tarihler ve e-postanın geri döndürülemez özeti) |
    | Davet kötüye kullanım sinyalleri (geri döndürülemez özet) | 400 gün |
    | Yedekler | En fazla `BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS` gün; yalnızca felaket kurtarma için |
    | AI sağlayıcı tarafı | Toplu işlem sonuçları alındıktan hemen sonra sağlayıcıdan silinir; diğer içerikler sağlayıcı sözleşmesinde yazan kısa güvenlik denetimi süreleri dışında tutulmaz |

    Durations not fixed by the spine are proposed constants. Counsel confirms them (Manual external step), and the constants drive both the `retention` job and this table.
13. **`#silme`** · "Dışa aktarma ve silme" / "Export and deletion". Content:
    - Export: Profil › Gizlilik › Verilerimi dışa aktar. The export is prepared asynchronously and the link is valid for 24 h (M§128).
    - The history and account deletion scopes are summarised and link to `/data-deletion#neler-silinir`.
    - What happens: provider revocation (Google automatic; Apple automatic; Microsoft needs the user-side link), subscription records deleted at RevenueCat, and the store subscription **must be cancelled separately**.
    - Timelines: usually within 24 h; the legal maximum is 30 days; backups rotate within the configured days.
    - "Silme tamamlanmadan tamamlandı demeyiz." (M§129)
14. **`#guvenlik`** · "Güvenlik önlemleri" / "Security". Content:
    - TLS in transit; encryption at rest.
    - OAuth access keys are separately encrypted with AES-256-GCM and are never sent to the device.
    - Per-user row-level access isolation in the database.
    - Staff access requires multi-factor authentication, role-based permissions and audit logs. Viewing personal data needs a reason and time-limited access, and the reveal is logged.
    - No full mail bodies are stored.
    - Every write needs approval.
    - Minimal, PII-scrubbed logs.
    - **No "end-to-end encryption" claim.**
    - Report vulnerabilities to `guvenlik@dijitalasistan.app` (security.txt).
15. **`#bildirimler`** · "Bildirimler ve kilit ekranı" / "Notifications". The default detail level shows no sensitive content: "Yalnızca başlık". Full detail is your choice. Quiet hours apply.
16. **`#cerezler`** · "Çerezler ve web sitesi" / "Cookies and this website". Content:
    - "Bu site reklam, izleme veya analitik çerezi kullanmaz ve seni tanımlayan bir kimlik saklamaz."
    - Page views and button clicks are counted only as anonymous daily totals, with no IP or device identifier.
    - When your browser sends a "Global Privacy Control" or "Do Not Track" signal, nothing is counted.
    - The data-deletion verification runs on our server (PUB-02/PUB-03); no session, token or cookie is created in your browser.
    - When bot protection is enabled, Cloudflare Turnstile runs only on the support and data-deletion forms, only to tell people from automated abuse. It is listed in `#alt-isleyiciler`.
17. **`#cocuklar`** · "Çocuklar" / "Children". The service is not intended for people under 18. The section explains how to report an account that belongs to a child.
18. **`#haklarin`** · "Hakların" / "Your rights".
    - KVKK m.11 list, verbatim in substance:
      - öğrenme;
      - bilgi talep etme;
      - amacını ve amaca uygun kullanımını öğrenme;
      - aktarılan üçüncü kişileri bilme;
      - düzeltme;
      - m.7 kapsamında silme/yok etme;
      - bu işlemlerin aktarılan üçüncü kişilere bildirilmesini isteme;
      - münhasıran otomatik analizle aleyhe sonuca itiraz;
      - zararın giderilmesini talep.
    - GDPR Art. 15–22 and the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
    - How to apply:
      - in-app Privacy Center;
      - `/data-deletion`;
      - a registered email address to `gizlilik@dijitalasistan.app`;
      - in writing to `COMPANY_ADDRESS`;
      - KEP to `COMPANY_KEP_ADDRESS`.
    - Answered within 30 days, free of charge except the costs set by the Board tariff.
    - Complaint to the KVKK Board after applying to us (KVKK m.14 timelines).
19. **`#degisiklikler`** · "Değişiklikler" / "Changes". Version history. Material changes are announced in the app (Announcements) at least 15 days before they take effect.
20. **`#iletisim`** · "İletişim" / "Contact". Privacy, support and security mailboxes, postal address and KEP.

### 3.3 Remaining fields

| Field | Spec |
|---|---|
| Components | W-CMP-16 (`LegalDocument`, `LegalToc`, `RetentionTable`, `SubprocessorTable`, `EffectiveDate`), W-CMP-02..04, W-CMP-21 |
| Data dependencies | `content/legal/privacy.{tr,en}.ts`; `content/company.ts` (env `COMPANY_LEGAL_NAME`, `COMPANY_ADDRESS`, `COMPANY_MERSIS_NO`, `COMPANY_KEP_ADDRESS`, `PRIVACY_CONTACT_EMAIL`, `EU_REPRESENTATIVE`); `@da/domain` `RETENTION_SCHEDULE`; `content/subprocessors.ts` (+ `EMAIL_PROVIDER` mapped to its display name, whether `NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` is set, `SENTRY_REGION_LABEL`, `DATA_REGION_LABEL`, `BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS`) |
| CTAs (real behaviour) | TOC links jump to anchors and move focus to the heading. External policy links open in the same tab with `rel="noopener"`. Mailto links. "Veri silme sayfasına git" → `/data-deletion`. The in-page "Başa dön" link goes to `#top` |
| SEO | Title "Gizlilik Politikası ve KVKK Aydınlatma Metni — Dijital Asistan" / "Privacy Policy — Dijital Asistan". Description "Hangi verileri neden işlediğimizi, yapay zekâ alt işleyicilerimizi, saklama sürelerini ve haklarını açıklar." / EN. OG `privacy` (promise variant). JSON-LD `WebPage` with `dateModified` |
| Responsive notes | ≥1200: 3/9 grid with a sticky TOC (top 88 px) and body max 720 px. 768–1199: TOC collapsed at the top as a `<details>` "İçindekiler". <768: the same `<details>`. Tables with more than 3 columns become stacked definition lists under 768 (no horizontal scroll) |
| Accessibility notes | The TOC is a `nav[aria-label="İçindekiler"]` with `aria-current="true"` on the active section (IntersectionObserver). Real `<table>` elements with captions on ≥768 and `<dl>` on mobile. A print stylesheet hides header and footer and expands the TOC |
| Analytics | `web_page_view` only |
| Error/empty states | Missing `COMPANY_*` or empty `SUBPROCESSORS` → production build fails (env schema + content test); a legal page never renders with gaps. No runtime data fetch |
| Tests | `legal.spec.ts` (§16) plus vitest `legal-parity.test.ts`, `retention-table.test.ts`, `subprocessors.test.ts` |

## 4. W-LEGAL-02 · Kullanım Koşulları (Terms of Use)

| Field | Spec |
|---|---|
| Page ID | W-LEGAL-02 |
| Route | `/terms`, `/en/terms`. Linked from the paywall (Apple 3.1.2 EULA link), onboarding and the App Store description. **Manual external step:** keep Apple's Standard EULA in App Store Connect and add a "Kullanım Koşulları (EULA)" link to the App Store description, or upload these Terms as a custom EULA that includes Apple's minimum terms. Either way counsel confirms |
| Purpose | Real, consistent terms for a Turkey-based consumer subscription app sold through app stores, matching product behaviour (approvals, AI limits, referral rules, store billing) |

**Section outline** (same `LegalDocument` model, same `version` / `effectiveDate` handling):

1. **`#taraflar`** "Taraflar ve kabul". `COMPANY_LEGAL_NAME` and you. Acceptance happens by creating an account.
2. **`#hizmet`** "Hizmetin tanımı". Dijital Asistan analyses the email, calendar and tasks you connect and prepares briefings, priorities, drafts and suggestions. It is not a chatbot-first product. It does not replace professional (legal, financial, medical) advice.
3. **`#uygunluk`** "Hesap ve uygunluk". You must be 18 or older, use one account per person, keep your sign-in methods secure and tell us about unauthorised use.
4. **`#baglantilar`** "Bağlı hesaplar ve izinler". You authorise read access per connected account. Write permissions are requested only when you first approve a write. Third-party terms (Google, Microsoft, Apple) also apply. You can disconnect at any time.
5. **`#onay`** "Onaylı işlemler". Nothing is sent, created or changed without your approval (M§3.6–8). We execute exactly what the approval screen shows, once (idempotency). If execution fails, you are told and can retry; we never report success that didn't happen. You are responsible for content you approve.
6. **`#yapay-zeka`** "Yapay zekâ çıktıları". AI output may be incomplete or wrong. Check the source through "Bu nereden çıktı?". Unverifiable details are marked "Kaynakta kesinleşmiyor." You can correct classifications.
7. **`#kabul-edilebilir-kullanim`** "Kabul edilebilir kullanım". No unlawful use, spam or abuse, no attempts to bypass limits, security or other users' isolation, no reverse engineering beyond what the law allows, no automated scraping, and no referral fraud or multiple-account abuse.
8. **`#planlar`** "Ücretsiz plan ve Pro". Free limits are published on `/pricing` (live values). Pro AI usage is fair use with high daily limits for personal use and may be slowed temporarily under abnormal automated load (plan §8 graceful degradation). TR wording: "Pro'da AI kullanımı adil kullanım ilkesine tabidir; kişisel kullanım için yüksek günlük limitler sunar ve olağan dışı otomatik yükte geçici olarak yavaşlatılabilir." Neither language uses the banned fair-use wording of §0.5.
9. **`#abonelik`** "Abonelik, faturalandırma, iptal ve iade". Content:
   - Purchases are processed by Apple or Google under their terms.
   - Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends.
   - Cancel paths: iPhone Ayarlar › [adın] › Abonelikler; Google Play › Profil › Ödemeler ve abonelikler.
   - A trial is offered only when shown in the store purchase sheet and follows the store's conditions.
   - Price changes follow store rules and notices.
   - Refunds are handled through Apple (`reportaproblem.apple.com`) or Google Play.
   - Deleting your account does not cancel a store subscription.
   - Statutory consumer rights (Law No. 6502 and related regulations) are reserved. Counsel confirms the withdrawal-right wording for instantly performed digital services.
10. **`#davet`** "Davet programı". Content:
    - Each side gets `reward_days` (14) days of Pro after the invitee applies the code within `apply_window_days` (7) of sign-up, connects at least one account, receives the first briefing and the account is at least 48 h old (plan §16, Part 4 §8).
    - At most `max_rewards_per_year` (6) rewards per referrer per year.
    - Rewards are stacked grants, have no cash value and are not transferable.
    - Abusive referrals (self-referral, duplicate accounts, loops) are rejected, and rewards obtained this way may be revoked.
    - Changes to the programme apply only to future invitations; rewards already earned are honoured.
11. **`#fikri-mulkiyet`** "Fikri mülkiyet ve lisans". You receive a personal, non-exclusive licence to use the app. Your content stays yours. You grant us a limited licence to process it only to provide the service. "Dijital Asistan" name and marks.
12. **`#ucuncu-taraf`** "Üçüncü taraf hizmetleri ve mağazalar". Apple and Google are not parties to these Terms and have no support obligation. Apple and its subsidiaries are third-party beneficiaries of these Terms for App Store users (Apple minimum terms). Google, Microsoft and Apple services have their own terms.
13. **`#hizmet-degisiklikleri`** "Hizmetin sürekliliği ve değişiklikler". We may change features. Material changes are announced in the app at least 15 days ahead. Maintenance notices appear through in-app announcements.
14. **`#fesih`** "Fesih". You may delete your account at any time (`/data-deletion`, in-app). We may suspend accounts for serious violations, with notice where lawful.
15. **`#sorumluluk`** "Sorumluluğun sınırlandırılması". Limitation to the extent permitted by law. Liability for intent and gross negligence is not excluded, and consumer rights are unaffected.
16. **`#uygulanacak-hukuk`** "Uygulanacak hukuk ve uyuşmazlıklar". Laws of the Republic of Türkiye. Consumer arbitration committees and consumer courts apply per the statutory monetary thresholds. Mandatory protections of the user's country of residence are unaffected.
17. **`#degisiklikler`** "Koşullardaki değişiklikler". Versioning and advance notice, as in W-LEGAL-01 `#degisiklikler`.
18. **`#iletisim`** "İletişim".

| Field | Spec |
|---|---|
| Components | Same as W-LEGAL-01 |
| Data dependencies | `content/legal/terms.{tr,en}.ts`; `content/company.ts`; referral config values (`reward_days`, `apply_window_days`, `max_rewards_per_year`) injected at build time from `@da/domain` `REFERRAL_DEFAULTS`. The server config (`referral.*`) must equal these defaults; a Deno test asserts the seeded config equals `REFERRAL_DEFAULTS`, and changing either requires changing both |
| CTAs (real behaviour) | TOC anchors; links to `/pricing`, `/privacy`, `/data-deletion`; store subscription management URLs (`https://apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions`, `https://play.google.com/store/account/subscriptions`) |
| SEO | Title "Kullanım Koşulları — Dijital Asistan" / "Terms of Use — Dijital Asistan". OG `terms`. JSON-LD `WebPage` |
| Responsive / Accessibility / Analytics / Error states | Identical to W-LEGAL-01 |
| Tests | `legal.spec.ts` (anchors `#abonelik`, `#davet`, `#onay` present in both locales; referral numbers equal `REFERRAL_DEFAULTS`; no "Sınırsız") |

The web form has no device or app-version fields, because PUB-01 is a strict schema; the message helper asks for them instead. Tickets written in the app (`api` API-SUP-01) carry them as columns.

**Server side** (API_CONTRACTS PUB-01):
- The honeypot check runs first. A filled `website` gets 202 with a reference-shaped value that matches no ticket, and nothing is stored.
- The function then verifies the Turnstile token when `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` is set, validates the body and applies the IP-hash (5/h) and email-hash (3/h) limits.
- It inserts a `support_tickets` row: `origin='web'`, `platform='web'`, `user_id=null` (never linked by email, to prevent spoofing), `status='open'`, `category`, `contact_email`, `message`, `subject` filled from the localised category name, and `locale` (registry R-07).
- The same email and message within 10 minutes returns the same reference, so a double submit creates one ticket.
- The 202 carries `reference` = the ticket's `public_ref` (for example `DA-2026-000123`).

Backoffice agents (M§62, BACKOFFICE_PLAN):
- see the email masked;
- reveal it only through the audited reveal;
- must not disclose account data to an unverified web requester. They ask the requester to write from the app, or to use the `/data-deletion` OTP flow for deletion requests.

Replies go out from the support mailbox (**Manual external step:** create `destek@`).

### 6.2 `DeletionFlow`: state machine and copy

**Identity and request** (API_CONTRACTS PUB-02 and PUB-03; account deletion only):
- The browser never talks to Supabase Auth. `EmailStep` calls `POST /data-deletion/start {email, locale, captcha_token?, website: ''}`. For an existing account, the function sends the 6-digit code server-side (`signInWithOtp` with `shouldCreateUser: false`) through the shared neutral OTP template (registry R-15). The answer is always the same 202, padded to at least 400 ms, so the page never reveals whether an account exists. Admin identities (plan R-08) never receive a code and get the same answer.
- `CodeConfirmStep` calls `POST /data-deletion/verify {email, code}` only after the user has seen the consequences and typed the confirmation word. The server-side code check is the re-authentication for this path (plan R-16). The function creates or returns the user's single active request and answers `{reference, status: 'queued', subscription_notice: {active}}`.
- The email and the code live only in React state. "Vazgeç", "E-posta adresini değiştir" and leaving the page discard them. The flow uses no cookie, `localStorage` or `sessionStorage`.
- Deleting only the analysis history needs the signed-in app (M-SET-36). The page therefore shows its in-app path (§6.1 row 3) and offers no history option.

| State | UI (TR / EN) | Transitions |
|---|---|---|
| `email` | Label "Hesabındaki e-posta adresi" / "Email address on your account"; helper = the Apple relay tip; W-CMP-23 when configured; button "Kod gönder" / "Send code" | submit → `sending` |
| `sending` | Button spinner "Gönderiliyor…" / "Sending…" | 202 → `code` · 422 `VALIDATION_FAILED` → `email` + "Geçerli bir e-posta adresi yaz." / "Enter a valid email address." · 429 `RATE_LIMITED` → `email` + "Çok fazla deneme yapıldı. {minutes} dakika sonra tekrar dene." / "Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes." (`{minutes}` from `Retry-After`) · network error or 5xx → `email` + "Bağlantı kurulamadı. Tekrar dene." / "Couldn't connect. Try again." |
| `code` | Info "Bu adrese bağlı bir Dijital Asistan hesabı varsa 6 haneli bir kod gönderdik. Kod 10 dakika geçerlidir." / "If an account exists for this address, we sent a 6-digit code. It's valid for 10 minutes."<br>Input "6 haneli kod" / "6-digit code" (`inputMode="numeric"`, `autoComplete="one-time-code"`, `maxLength=6`)<br>H3 "Hesabın kalıcı olarak silinecek." / "Your account will be permanently deleted.", followed by the summary list from `ACCOUNT_DELETION_SCOPE` (the deleted rows of §6.3) and two reminders, each with the §6.1 row 6 links: "App Store veya Google Play aboneliğin hesap silmeyle iptal olmaz." / "Deleting your account doesn't cancel an App Store or Google Play subscription." and "Microsoft hesabı bağladıysan izni Microsoft'tan da kaldır." / "If you connected a Microsoft account, also remove the permission at Microsoft."<br>Input "Onaylamak için SİL yaz" / "Type DELETE to confirm"<br>Destructive button "Hesabımı sil" / "Delete my account". It is enabled only when the code has 6 digits and the confirmation matches (`toLocaleUpperCase('tr-TR')` ∈ {`SİL`, `SIL`} on tr, `DELETE` on en)<br>Link "Kodu tekrar gönder" / "Resend code" (disabled for 60 s, with "{s} sn sonra tekrar gönderebilirsin" / "You can resend in {s} s")<br>Links "E-posta adresini değiştir" / "Change email address" and "Vazgeç" / "Cancel" | submit → `submitting` · resend → `sending` · change or cancel → `email` (inputs cleared) |
| `submitting` | Button spinner; inputs disabled | 202 → `done` · 422 `OTP_INVALID` → `code` + "Kod doğrulanamadı. Kodu kontrol et ya da yeni kod iste." / "The code couldn't be verified. Check it or request a new one." · 429 `OTP_LOCKED` → `locked` · 429 `RATE_LIMITED` → `code` + the `sending` rate-limit copy · network error or 5xx → `code` + "Talebin gönderilemedi. Tekrar dene." / "Your request couldn't be sent. Try again." (retrying is safe: a user has at most one active request) |
| `locked` | "Çok fazla hatalı deneme yapıldı. Güvenliğin için bu adresle 1 saat boyunca doğrulama yapılamaz." / "Too many incorrect attempts. For your security, this address can't be verified for 1 hour." + links "Uygulamadan sil" / "Delete in the app" (`#uygulamadan`) and "Destek ekibine yaz" / "Write to support" (`/support?category=privacy#contact`) | terminal until the page is reloaded |
| `done` | Title "Silme talebin alındı." / "Your deletion request was received."<br>"Referans: {reference}" / "Reference: {reference}"<br>"Hesabın ve verilerin sırayla siliniyor; bu genellikle 24 saat içinde tamamlanır. Tamamlandığında {email_masked} adresine e-posta göndereceğiz. Telefonundaki uygulamada oturumun kapanır." / "Your account and data are being deleted; this usually completes within 24 hours. We'll email {email_masked} when it's done. The app on your phone is signed out."<br>When `subscription_notice.active`: a warning callout "Aktif bir App Store veya Google Play aboneliğin var. Hesabını silmek aboneliği iptal etmez; ücretlendirilmemek için aboneliğini iptal et." / "You have an active App Store or Google Play subscription. Deleting your account doesn't cancel it; cancel it to avoid charges." + both store links<br>"Bu sayfadan ayrılabilirsin." / "You can leave this page." | terminal; the email and code are cleared from memory |

`{email_masked}` is computed in the browser from the entered address (for example `yu***@gmail.com`); nothing about the account is fetched.

**Honest status.**
- The page shows only what the server confirmed: the 202 with `status: 'queued'`. Nothing on the web can look the request up afterwards, because the account and its sessions are gone.
- The result is therefore reported by email: `email.deletion.received` when the request is created, and `email.deletion.completed` only after JOB-23 has really finished (job `transactional_email`, registry R-14; M§129).
- A failed job retries with back-off. A dead-lettered job appears in backoffice Data Requests (M§65) for a retry that needs a permission and a reason and is audited. The user is never told "deleted" before completion.

**Server behaviour** (authoritative: API_CONTRACTS PUB-02, PUB-03 and JOB-23; the in-app `api POST /privacy/delete-account` uses the same deletion service):
1. PUB-02 applies the IP-hash and email-hash limits, silently ignores a filled honeypot, verifies `captcha_token` when `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` is set, and calls `signInWithOtp` only for an existing non-admin user.
2. PUB-03 verifies the code with `verifyOtp` (type `email`). Five failures in 15 minutes lock the address for 1 hour (`OTP_LOCKED`).
3. It inserts `data_deletion_requests` `{user_id, subject_hash, subject_email_hash, kind: 'account', origin: 'web_otp', confirmation_method: 'email_otp', status: 'queued', reference, locale, expected_by: now() + 24 h}`, or returns the existing active row (unique `(user_id, kind)` while active).
4. It sets `profiles.state = 'deletion_pending'`, enqueues `account_deletion` (JOB-23) and pokes the worker, enqueues `email.deletion.received`, and writes the PUB-03 audit event `user.privacy.account_deletion_requested`.
5. It revokes the verification session and every other session of the user, so no session survives and the phone app is signed out.
6. It returns 202.

When JOB-23 finally deletes `auth.users`, the FK `on delete set null` (registry R-06) nulls `data_deletion_requests.user_id`, and the row keeps `subject_hash` as proof (F5-01).

## 8. W-OAUTH-01 · Bağlantı sonucu (`/oauth/done`)

| Field | Spec |
|---|---|
| Page ID | W-OAUTH-01 |
| Route | `/oauth/done?provider={google\|microsoft\|demo}&result={pending_confirmation\|denied\|error\|expired_state\|admin_consent_required}[&completion_code=…][&error_code=…][&lang={tr\|en}]` (locale-neutral). The `oauth` Edge Function redirects to `oauth_states.return_to`: normally the app's custom-scheme `OAUTH_RESULT_REDIRECT_URI` (`dijitalasistan://integrations/callback?…`), and this page when the flow ran outside the in-app auth session (INTEGRATION_PLAN §3.2, ADR-35). The path is also a universal / App Link, so with the app installed the OS usually opens the app's `integrations/callback` handler directly. The page renders only when that does not happen (e.g., a link opened on desktop, older iOS auth-session behaviour, or the app removed mid-flow) |
| Purpose | Tell the user the true state and hand the flow back to the app. After the provider callback **nothing is connected yet**: the account is bound only when the app that started the flow calls `POST /integrations/oauth/complete {completion_code, device_nonce}` with its own session (plan R-07). The page therefore never says "connected", never shows or accepts tokens, and never echoes unvalidated input |

**Sections**

| Element | TR | EN |
|---|---|---|
| Icon tile (52, radius 16) | `pending_confirmation` `phonelink` (info tone) · `denied` `block` (neutral) · `error` `error` (critical tone) · `expired_state` `timer_off` (neutral) · `admin_consent_required` `admin_panel_settings` (warning tone) | same |
| `pending_confirmation` | "Bir adım kaldı." / "{Google \| Microsoft} izni alındı. Bağlantıyı tamamlamak için Dijital Asistan uygulamasına dön; hesabın, uygulama onayladığında bağlanır." | "One step left." / "{Google \| Microsoft} permission was received. Return to the Dijital Asistan app to finish; your account is connected once the app confirms it." |
| `denied` | "Bağlantı iptal edildi." / "İzin vermediğin için hesap bağlanmadı. İstediğin zaman uygulamadan yeniden deneyebilirsin." | "Connection cancelled." / "You didn't grant permission, so nothing was connected. Try again from the app any time." |
| `error` with `error_code=account_mismatch` | "Farklı bir hesap seçildi." / "Hiçbir şey değişmedi. Uygulamaya dönüp doğru hesapla yeniden dene." | "A different account was chosen." / "Nothing was changed. Return to the app and try again with the right account." |
| `error` with `error_code=scope_missing` | "Gerekli izinler verilmedi." / "Hiçbir hesap bağlanmadı. Uygulamadan yeniden deneyip istenen izinleri onaylayabilirsin." | "Required permissions weren't granted." / "Nothing was connected. Try again from the app and approve the requested permissions." |
| `error` with any other code, or unknown params | "Bağlantı tamamlanamadı." / "Bir sorun oluştu. Uygulamaya dönüp tekrar dene." | "Connection couldn't be completed." / "Something went wrong. Return to the app and try again." |
| `expired_state` | "Bağlantı isteğinin süresi doldu." / "Güvenliğin için bir bağlantı isteği 10 dakika geçerlidir. Uygulamadan yeniden başlat." | "The connection request expired." / "For your security, a connection request is valid for 10 minutes. Start again from the app." |
| `admin_consent_required` | "Kurum yöneticisinin onayı gerekiyor." / "İş veya okul hesabın için kuruluşunun BT yöneticisinin Dijital Asistan'a izin vermesi gerekiyor." + link "Yöneticin için bilgi" → `/support#faq-admin-consent` | "Your organisation's admin must approve." / "For a work or school account, your organisation's IT admin needs to approve Dijital Asistan." + "Information for your admin" |
| Primary button (mobile UAs) | "Uygulamaya Dön": iOS → `dijitalasistan://integrations/callback?{allow-listed params}`; Android → the intent URL (scheme `dijitalasistan`, path `integrations/callback`, same params) with a Play fallback | "Return to the app" |
| Desktop line (no mobile UA) | "Bu işlem telefonundaki Dijital Asistan uygulamasında tamamlanır. Telefonunda uygulamaya geri dönebilirsin." | "This finishes in the Dijital Asistan app on your phone. Return to the app there." |

- The button opens the same app route as the `https://dijitalasistan.app/app/integrations/callback?…` universal link in INTEGRATION_PLAN §3.2. On iOS the page uses the custom scheme, because Safari keeps a tap on a same-domain universal link inside the browser. The user has just come from the app, so the scheme is safe (§0.7).
- A `completion_code` is useless without the initiating user's session and device nonce (plan R-07), so forwarding it to the app is safe. The page still never renders, logs or reports it.

| Field | Spec |
|---|---|
| Components | W-CMP-20 |
| Data dependencies | `searchParams` only. Zod allow-list: `provider` enum (`google`, `microsoft`, `demo`); `result` enum (above); `completion_code` (43 base64url characters, i.e. 32 bytes); `error_code` (lowercase letters and `_`, at most 40; only `account_mismatch` and `scope_missing` select specific copy); `lang` enum. `pending_confirmation` without a valid `completion_code` renders the generic error variant. Any other key (including `code`, `state`, `error_description`) is ignored and never rendered or logged. The status text comes from `result` and `error_code` alone, never from provider error strings. `demo` renders as "Demo" and occurs only while `DEMO_MODE=true` |
| CTAs (real behaviour) | The button rebuilds the callback URL only from validated params (`URLSearchParams`) and navigates. The app completes the flow (plan R-07) and shows the final result, for example `partial` with the missing capabilities. The Smart App Banner `app-argument` is the canonical URL with the same validated params. "Yöneticin için bilgi" is a same-site link |
| SEO | `noindex, nofollow`; `Cache-Control: no-store`; `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`; excluded from the sitemap; title "Bağlantı — Dijital Asistan" |
| Responsive notes | Centered card, max 480 px |
| Accessibility notes | The heading receives focus on load. The icon is decorative; the result is in the heading text |
| Analytics | `web_oauth_done_view{provider,result}`. The completion code and the error code are never sent |
| Error/empty states | Missing or invalid params → the error variant. JS disabled → works (links are plain anchors) |
| Tests | `oauth-done.spec.ts` (§16) |

## 10. W-GET-01 · Mağaza yönlendirici (`/get`)

| Field | Spec |
|---|---|
| Page ID | W-GET-01 |
| Route | `GET /get?src={enum}` (route handler, not a page) |
| Purpose | One URL for the header CTA and every QR code that sends a phone to its store, and a desktop to the download section |
| Behaviour | UA contains `iPhone\|iPad\|iPod` (and not `Windows Phone`) → 302 to the App Store URL (`ct=src`). UA contains `Android` → 302 to the Play URL (`utm_medium=src`). Otherwise → 302 to `/#download`, or `/en#download` when `Accept-Language` prefers non-Turkish. `src` must be in the §0.7 enum, else `web`. If `IOS_APP_STORE_ID` is unset, iOS goes to `/#download`. Headers: `Cache-Control: private, no-store`, `Vary: User-Agent, Accept-Language`. The handler fires `web_get_redirect{target,src}` server-side (non-blocking `fetch` to `/web-events`, 300 ms timeout) |
| SEO | `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`; disallowed in robots |
| Tests | vitest `resolveStoreTarget(ua, lang, src)` table; Playwright requests with iPhone, Pixel and desktop UAs assert `Location` |

## 11. System routes

### W-SYS-01 · `/.well-known/apple-app-site-association`

- Served by a route handler behind a rewrite. **No redirect**, `Content-Type: application/json`, no file extension, HTTP 200 on the apex domain.
- Body:
  ```json
  { "applinks": { "details": [ { "appIDs": ["{APPLE_TEAM_ID}.com.dijitalasistan.app"],
      "components": [ { "/": "/app/*" }, { "/": "/r/*" }, { "/": "/oauth/done", "comment": "integration OAuth fallback" } ] } ] } }
  ```
- `APPLE_TEAM_ID` is **External credential required**. The production build fails without it; preview builds return 404 with a build warning.
- Apple fetches the file via its CDN. A post-deploy check uses Apple's CDN endpoint (`https://app-site-association.cdn-apple.com/a/v1/dijitalasistan.app`) from CI; this is a Manual external step when the network is blocked.

### W-SYS-02 · `/.well-known/assetlinks.json`

- Body:
  ```json
  [ { "relation": ["delegate_permission/common.handle_all_urls"],
      "target": { "namespace": "android_app", "package_name": "com.dijitalasistan.app",
                  "sha256_cert_fingerprints": ["{PLAY_APP_SIGNING_SHA256}", "{UPLOAD_KEY_SHA256}"] } } ]
  ```
- Values come from `ANDROID_SHA256_CERT_FINGERPRINTS` (comma-separated), **External credential required**. They are copied from Play Console › App integrity and from the EAS credentials.
- Production build fails without them.

### W-SYS-03 · `/sitemap.xml` (`app/sitemap.ts`)

- Entries: `/`, `/pricing`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/support`, `/data-deletion`, each with `alternates.languages` `{ tr, en }` → `/en/...`.
- `lastModified` comes from the content version dates (legal `effectiveDate`, `content/meta.ts` for others).
- Excluded: `/r/*`, `/oauth/*`, `/app/*` and `/get`.
- When `SITE_INDEXABLE=false`, the sitemap still renders but robots disallows everything.

### W-SYS-04 · `/robots.txt` (`app/robots.ts`)

Production with `SITE_INDEXABLE=true`:
```
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /r/
Disallow: /oauth/
Disallow: /app/
Disallow: /get
Sitemap: https://dijitalasistan.app/sitemap.xml
```
Otherwise `User-agent: * / Disallow: /`.

### W-SYS-05 · Open Graph images (`opengraph-image.tsx` per route, `next/og` `ImageResponse`, 1200×630 PNG, generated at build per locale)

**Fonts** are read as files from `@expo-google-fonts/geist/600SemiBold/Geist_600SemiBold.ttf`, `…/500Medium/Geist_500Medium.ttf` and `@expo-google-fonts/lora/500Medium/Lora_500Medium.ttf`. These are TTF files with Turkish glyphs; Satori cannot read woff2.

**Composition** (PRIMARY language, light only):
- Canvas `#F5F4F0`.
- Left column at x = 72, width 600:

  - "Dijital Asistan" 32/600 `#1A1917` at 16 px from the tile;
  - headline 56/62 600 −2.5 % `#1A1917` (≤ 3 lines);
  - sub 26/36 `#6B6860` (≤ 2 lines).
- Right card at x 708, y 80, 420×470, radius 40:
  - **`brief` variant:** `gradient/dawn`. Kicker "BRİFİNG HAZIR · 07:58" 22/600 +8 % `rgba(255,255,255,.75)`; "Bugün bilmen gereken 5 şey var." 40/46 600 white; meta "4 önemli mail · 4 etkinlik · 2 takip" 22 `rgba(255,255,255,.78)`. These are the §15.2 demo numbers.
  - **`promise` variant:** ink `#1A1917`. Three `verified_user` rows (26/36 white; icons `#6FCF97`) with M§40 statements 1–3.

### W-SYS-06 · `/.well-known/security.txt` (RFC 9116)

```
Contact: mailto:guvenlik@dijitalasistan.app
Expires: {build date + 365 days, ISO 8601}
Preferred-Languages: tr, en
Canonical: https://dijitalasistan.app/.well-known/security.txt
Policy: https://dijitalasistan.app/support#faq-security-report
```
`Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8`. A CI check fails if `Expires` is less than 30 days away at deploy.

### W-SYS-07 · Manifest and icons

- `app/manifest.ts`: `{ name: 'Dijital Asistan', short_name: 'Dijital Asistan', start_url: '/', display: 'browser', background_color: '#F5F4F0', theme_color: '#F5F4F0', icons: [192, 512, 512 maskable] }`.
- `<meta name="theme-color">` is light `#F5F4F0` and dark `#141311`, with `media` attributes.
- `icon.png` (512), `apple-icon.png` (180) and `favicon.ico` (32/16) are derived from the app icon master (§15.5).

### W-SYS-08 · `/.well-known/microsoft-identity-association.json`

- **Purpose:** Microsoft Entra publisher-domain verification for the integration app registration (INTEGRATION_PLAN M4). With a verified publisher domain, the Microsoft consent screen shows `dijitalasistan.app` as the publisher.
- Served by a route handler behind the `/.well-known/:file` rewrite (`dynamic = 'force-static'`): HTTP 200 on the apex domain, `Content-Type: application/json`, **no redirect**, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600`.
- Body:
  ```json
  { "associatedApplications": [ { "applicationId": "{MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID}" } ] }
  ```
- `MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID` (INTEGRATION_PLAN §15) is the public application (client) ID of the Entra integration app. Only the route handler reads it, at build time on the server; no client bundle references it. **External credential required:** the production build fails without it, and preview builds return 404.
- **Manual external step:** after deploy, verify the domain in Entra › App registrations › Branding & properties › Publisher domain (INTEGRATION_PLAN M4).
- Tests: `wellknown.spec.ts` (§16).

## 13. `/en` locale conventions

- Every localized route has a complete EN rendition. Catalog key parity is a CI test (ADR-14), and the pseudo-locale (+40 %) Playwright run catches truncation.
- EN pages keep the brand name "Dijital Asistan" untranslated. App terms (briefing section names, mail categories, button labels) come from the app's own EN catalog so they match the EN app exactly.
- Prices on EN pages are still Turkey storefront prices, in `TRY`, with the note: "Prices shown are Turkey App Store and Google Play prices including VAT. Prices in your country are shown in the store before you buy."
- Legal EN texts carry the Turkish-prevails note (W-LEGAL-01 §3.1).
- Link-target pages choose their locale by `?lang` → `Accept-Language` → tr, and their footers offer "Türkçe" / "English" links that set `?lang=`.
- `hreflang`: `tr`, `en`, `x-default` → tr. `og:locale` `tr_TR` / `en_US`.

## 14. Flows

**F5-01 · Web account deletion (M§129, C-24).**

1. The user opens `/data-deletion` and reads the in-app steps, the scope table and the reminders.
2. The user enters an email and taps "Kod gönder". `POST /data-deletion/start` (PUB-02) answers 202 `code_sent_if_account_exists` in constant time. For an existing non-admin account, the function sends the 6-digit code through the Supabase Auth custom SMTP template.
3. The user enters the code, reads the consequence summary, types "SİL" and taps "Hesabımı sil".
4. `POST /data-deletion/verify` (PUB-03):
   1. verifies the code server-side;
   2. creates or returns the active `data_deletion_requests` row (`origin='web_otp'`, `status='queued'`);
   3. sets `profiles.state='deletion_pending'`, enqueues `account_deletion` (JOB-23) and the "received" email, and writes the audit event;
   4. revokes every session of the user;
   5. returns 202 `{reference, status:'queued', subscription_notice}`.
5. The page shows the reference and, when `subscription_notice.active`, the cancel-subscription warning. It clears the email and the code; the browser never held a session.
6. The worker job (JOB-23):
   1. stops watches and subscriptions;
   2. revokes Google tokens; revokes SIWA via `appleid.apple.com/auth/revoke`; purges Microsoft tokens locally;
   3. deletes the RevenueCat customer;
   4. purges DB rows, storage objects and embeddings per `ACCOUNT_DELETION_SCOPE`, recording each step in `data_deletion_requests.steps`;
   5. hashes audit identifiers;
   6. sets `status=completed` and `completed_at`;
   7. sends the "Hesabın silindi" email;
   8. deletes `auth.users`, which sets the request's `user_id` to null (`on delete set null`) while `subject_hash` stays.
7. The phone app's next API call is refused (`ACCOUNT_DELETION_PENDING`, then 401 once the user is gone). The app signs out and wipes the encrypted cache (ADR-06).

Failure path: job retries with backoff → `dead_letter` → the request shows `failed` in backoffice Data Requests (M§65) → retry with permission, reason and audit → completion email. No "deleted" message is sent before JOB-23 finishes.

**F5-02 · Referral install.**
1. The referrer shares `https://dijitalasistan.app/r/7K2M4QX` from `app/settings/referral`.
2. **Invitee on Android without the app:** the page loads → Google Play badge with `referrer=code%3D7K2M4QX` → install → first launch reads the Install Referrer and stores `pending_referral_code` in MMKV → after sign-up, M-REF-02 opens prefilled → "Kodu Uygula" → `POST /referrals/apply`.
3. **Invitee on iPhone without the app:** page → copy code → App Store → install → sign up → "Davet kodun var mı?" → paste.
4. **App installed:** the OS opens the app on the link → M-REF-02 prefilled.
5. The reward follows plan §16 qualification (not a web concern).

**F5-03 · OAuth fallback (plan R-07).**
1. The app creates a random `device_nonce`, keeps it in SecureStore, calls `POST /integrations/google/start` with its hash and opens the auth session.
2. Google redirects to the `oauth` function. It exchanges the code, holds the encrypted token set in `oauth_states`, creates no account yet and issues a one-time `completion_code`.
3. The function redirects to `oauth_states.return_to` with `completion_code=…&provider=google&result=pending_confirmation`: normally `dijitalasistan://integrations/callback`, or `https://dijitalasistan.app/oauth/done` when the flow ran outside the in-app auth session.
4. If the app receives the redirect, it calls `POST /integrations/oauth/complete {completion_code, device_nonce}` with its own session. The server checks `oauth_states.user_id = auth.uid()` and the device-nonce hash, binds the account and returns, for example, `partial` with the missing capabilities when the user unticked a scope.
5. Otherwise W-OAUTH-01 renders "Bir adım kaldı." → "Uygulamaya Dön" → `dijitalasistan://integrations/callback?completion_code=…&provider=google&result=pending_confirmation` → the app makes the same `complete` call and refreshes the account status. A code opened by another user or on another device is rejected by `complete`, so nothing is connected there.

**F5-04 · Support ticket.**
1. The user reads the FAQ, then fills in the form.
2. `POST /support` (PUB-01) passes the honeypot check, the optional Turnstile check, the zod schema and the rate limits, and inserts `support_tickets` (`origin='web'`, `platform='web'`, `user_id` null).
3. The user sees the 202 reference (`public_ref`). The backoffice support queue shows the new ticket; the agent replies from the support mailbox.

**F5-05 · Desktop to phone download.**
1. A desktop visitor sees the hero QR.
2. The phone camera opens `/get?src=qr_hero`, which redirects to the App Store or Play by UA.
3. `web_get_redirect` and `web_qr_shown` counts feed backoffice web funnel metrics (`web_analytics_daily`).

## 15. Marketing assets (M§74)

### 15.1 Principles

- **Final visual language.** PRIMARY 09 compositions, tokens and fonts (Geist and Lora); Material Symbols Rounded; dawn, night and ink backgrounds.
- **Real UI only.** Every in-device image is a real screenshot of the app running in **demo mode** (M§89: `DEMO_MODE`, deterministic demo adapters and fixture AI provider), captured on simulators or emulators with a **pinned demo clock**. The same dataset produces every screen, so **every number in every asset is consistent** (S-03, SREQ-96). Frames, captions and backgrounds are composited from HTML templates; the product UI is never redrawn.
- **Truthful copy.**
  - Captions are the M§74 messages. Supporting lines are softened where they were absolute (§15.4).
  - Numbers are demo samples. Store listings don't need a caption for this, but the web shows "Görsellerdeki kişiler ve veriler kurgusaldır."
  - Screens that feature Pro-only capabilities carry a visible `PRO` pill next to the kicker (App Store Guideline 2.3.2; Play misleading-claims policy).
  - No testimonials, prices, trial claims (unless configured), ratings or third-party logos appear in any asset.
- **Localisation.** Every asset exists in `tr` (primary listing tr-TR) and `en` (en-US), and light only unless noted.

### 15.2 Canonical marketing demo scenario (`@da/domain/demo/marketingScenario.ts`, also seeds `supabase/seed/demo`)

**Clocks and people.**
- The demo clock is pinned per capture. The base day is **Wednesday 23 Sep 2026** (M§8's example date), Europe/Istanbul. A Wednesday is also a realistic weekday for client meetings, replacing PRIMARY's Saturday "5 EYLÜL CUMARTESİ".

**Consistency gate.** Each Maestro capture flow asserts the key texts before taking the screenshot (for example `assertVisible: "83"`, `"4 tanesi dikkat gerektiriyor."`, `"Bugün bilmen gereken"`, `"5"`). A vitest asserts that `marketingScenario` constants equal the seed's aggregates.

### 15.3 Generation pipeline

**Capture** (GitHub Actions workflow `marketing-assets.yml`, `workflow_dispatch`, **proposed**):
- **iOS job:** `macos` runner; EAS `e2e` profile simulator build downloaded with `EXPO_TOKEN` (External credential required); the current 6.9-inch iPhone simulator (native 1320×2868); `xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --dataNetwork wifi --wifiBars 3 --cellularBars 4 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100` (the time is set per shot from the pinned clock).
- **Android job:** `ubuntu` runner with KVM and an emulator (Pixel-class, 1080×2400); SystemUI demo mode via `adb shell settings put global sysui_demo_allowed 1` plus the demo broadcasts.
- **Flows:** Maestro flows in `apps/mobile/.maestro/marketing/{store-01-today,store-02-mail,store-03-prep,store-04-waiting,store-05-plan,store-06-assistant,feat-01-briefing,feat-04-approval,ad-02-followup,ad-03-brief,week-share}.yaml`. Each flow:
  1. runs `openLink: dijitalasistan://demo/setup?scenario=marketing&clock={ISO}&locale={tr|en}&theme={light|dark}`. This is a demo-build-only route, registry R-21. It resets the demo data, pins the clock and sets the language and theme;
  2. navigates;
  3. asserts the §15.2 texts;
  4. runs `takeScreenshot`.
- Raw PNGs are uploaded as workflow artifacts.

**Compose** (`tools/marketing/`, Node 24 + Playwright 1.63 Chromium + `sharp` 0.35.4, **proposed**):
- HTML templates `templates/{store,play,feature,social,pricing,week,feature-graphic}.html` import `@da/design-tokens/tokens.css` and bundle the Geist and Lora TTFs.
- The script injects the raw screenshot, sets `page.setViewportSize` to the exact output size, runs `page.screenshot({ type: 'png' })`, then uses `sharp` to flatten onto opaque RGB (App Store and Play reject alpha), strip metadata and check dimensions and file size.
- Output: `tools/marketing/out/{locale}/{appstore|play|web|social}/{id}.png`.
- Web copies are converted to AVIF and WebP into `apps/web/public/marketing/{locale}/{light|dark}/`.

**QA** (`tools/marketing/validate.ts`):
- exact pixel sizes;
- RGB without alpha;
- ≤ 8 MB (Play) and ≤ 10 MB (App Store);
- the text-safe area is empty of device overlap;
- a banned-claim grep over the template strings (§0.5).

**Upload.** **Manual external step:** App Store Connect media manager and Play Console store listing (or fastlane `deliver`/`supply` with the owner's API keys).

Projects:

- **tier A (CI):** `supabase start` + `supabase functions serve public-api` + the local mail catcher (Mailpit/Inbucket on `:54324`) to read OTP codes.

| Spec | Key assertions |
|---|---|
| `landing.spec.ts` | H1 and supporting line are exactly the M§73 strings (tr and en). `[data-section]` order = hero, integrations, how-it-works, briefing, mail, meeting-prep, planning, memory, security, pricing, faq, download. Every nav anchor scrolls, focuses its heading and updates the hash. Header CTA `href="/get?src=header"`. Store badge hrefs equal `store-links.ts` output (App Store id, `ct`, Play `referrer`). QR visible inline ≥1200, behind a dialog button 768–1199 (open, `Esc` closes, focus returns), absent <768. Chips are not focusable. Image captions present. Footer links resolve (200) |
| `pricing.spec.ts` | With stub `plans`: Free values render ({1},{1},{50}). `verified=false` → no price text and the fallback line is present. `verified=true` → formatted "₺199" / "₺1.490". Savings "%38" computed. A store range renders when prices differ. `intro_offer=null` → no trial wording anywhere on the page. `intro_offer={days:7}` → only the conditional template text. Comparison table has 17 rows with the Android-only label. "Sınırsız" absent. The toggle is keyboard-operable and announces through a live region. JSON-LD parses; Pro offers only when verified |
| `legal.spec.ts` | Every §3.2 and §4 anchor exists in tr and en in the same order. The Limited Use sentence matches exactly (tr and en) with both Google policy links. `#saklama` table equals `RETENTION_SCHEDULE` (a rendered-text comparison against the constant). `#alt-isleyiciler` rows equal `SUBPROCESSORS`. Effective date and version are shown. No "uçtan uca", "uyumlu" or "Sınırsız". Terms referral numbers equal `REFERRAL_DEFAULTS` |
| `support.spec.ts` | FAQ item count equals the `faq.*` catalog. `#faq-delete-account` and `#kurum-yoneticileri` deep links open and focus their items. Categories navigate. Form: empty submit gives an error summary with focus and per-field errors. An invalid email and a 9-character message are rejected client-side, and a stub 422 with `field_errors` maps to the right fields. The request body has exactly the PUB-01 keys. The honeypot is filled programmatically → the stub answers 202 and records no ticket. 429 → rate-limit copy. Network abort → retry works. Success shows the `DA-2026-…` reference and the masked email. Category "Gizlilik" shows the deletion hint. With a Turnstile test site key the widget renders and its token is sent; without one, no Cloudflare request is made |
| `data-deletion.spec.ts` | Full path in tier A: email → PUB-02 202 → code from Mailpit → type "sil" (normalised) → "Hesabımı sil" → PUB-03 202 → done view with the `DS-` reference. A seeded user with an active App Store subscription gets the subscription warning. Cookies, `localStorage` and `sessionStorage` stay empty, and the browser sends no request to `/auth/v1/*`. Unknown email → the same 202 body, no mail in Mailpit and a response time within the padding tolerance. Admin identity → the same 202 and no mail. Wrong code → `OTP_INVALID` copy; after five failures the next attempt shows the locked view. Resend is disabled for 60 s. The destructive button stays disabled until the code has 6 digits and the confirmation matches. A second verify for the same user → 202 with the same reference. After success the user's seeded app session no longer refreshes. Keyboard-only completion of the whole flow. The page offers no history option and links to the in-app path |
| `referral.spec.ts` | `/r/7k2m4qx` → 308 to `/r/7K2M4QX`. Valid: code shown, reward days from API, Play link contains `code%3D7K2M4QX`, QR encodes the `/r/` URL, `noindex` meta, Smart App Banner `app-argument`. Invalid shape → invalid page with no API call. API down → no reward promise |
| `oauth-done.spec.ts` | Each `result` variant, plus the `account_mismatch` and `scope_missing` copy. `pending_confirmation` never claims a finished connection. The `completion_code` never appears in DOM text or in any web-event payload; the button href carries it only as a query parameter rebuilt from the allow-list. `pending_confirmation` without a valid code → error variant. Unknown params → error variant. `?provider=google&result=<script>` → error variant with no script text in the DOM. `noindex` and `Cache-Control: no-store`. Desktop UA → no button |
| `app-link.spec.ts` | `/app/briefing/abc` shows no "abc" anywhere. Android UA → intent URL correct. `/app/integrations/callback?…` renders the W-OAUTH-01 copy, forwards only the allow-listed parameters and shows no QR. `noindex` |
| `wellknown.spec.ts` | AASA: 200, `application/json`, no redirect (`maxRedirects: 0`), `appIDs` = `${TEAM}.com.dijitalasistan.app`, components include `/r/*`, `/app/*`, `/oauth/done`. assetlinks: valid JSON, package name, fingerprints from env. security.txt fields present and `Expires` in the future. microsoft-identity-association.json: 200, `application/json`, no redirect, `associatedApplications[0].applicationId` equals `MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID`. `/get` with iPhone, Pixel and desktop UAs → correct `Location`. Robots: production indexable vs `SITE_INDEXABLE=false` vs preview. Sitemap: 12 URLs with `xhtml:link` alternates; no `/r/`, `/oauth/`, `/app/` |

| `responsive.spec.ts` | At 320, 390, 767, 768, 1199, 1200 and 1440: `scrollWidth ≤ innerWidth`. Nav mode per breakpoint (§1.2). Hero order on mobile. Comparison table without horizontal scroll. Visual snapshots (`toHaveScreenshot`, 0.2 % tolerance) of home, pricing and data-deletion in light and dark (`colorScheme` emulation) |
| `a11y.spec.ts` | `@axe-core/playwright` 4.13.0: zero serious or critical violations on every route × locale × theme. Tab order starts with the skip link and reaches `main`. Every interactive element shows a visible focus ring (screenshot diff of `:focus-visible`). `Esc` closes both dialogs. 400 % zoom (320 px viewport) keeps all content reachable. Reduced motion: `document.getAnimations()` durations ≤ 120 ms after hero load and FAQ toggle |
| `privacy-network.spec.ts` | Crawl every route: `context.cookies()` is empty and no `localStorage`/`sessionStorage` keys exist on any route, the deletion flow included. Every request host is in {site, `api.dijitalasistan.app`, Sentry ingest} (this run has no Turnstile site key; a second run with a Turnstile test key allows `challenges.cloudflare.com` on `/support` and `/data-deletion` only). With `globalPrivacyControl` stubbed true, no `/web-events` request. Web-event payloads contain only allow-listed keys (zod) and never an email, code, completion code or reference |
| `truthfulness.spec.ts` | Rendered text of every route × locale contains none of the §0.5 banned claims or the `banned-markers.txt` tokens. No element with a testimonial role or star rating. Trial wording only when the stub `intro_offer` is set |
| `i18n.spec.ts` | Pseudo-locale run: no clipped text in headers, cards or buttons (overflow detection). EN pages have no untranslated TR catalog values (key-parity report) |

**Unit (vitest 4.1.11, `apps/web` and `@da/domain`):**
- `pricingView()`: ranges, savings, staleness and verification;
- `formatTry()` for tr-TR and en-US;
- `normalizeReferralCode()`;
- `resolveStoreTarget()`;
- `buildStoreLinks()`;
- `oauthDoneModel()` allow-list;
- the JSON-LD builders;
- the legal tr/en parity;
- `RETENTION_SCHEDULE` → table rows;
- `ACCOUNT_DELETION_SCOPE` / `HISTORY_DELETION_SCOPE` → table rows;
- `faq` catalog completeness (8 featured);
- the web-events allow-list;
- the env schema (production requires `APPLE_TEAM_ID`, `ANDROID_SHA256_CERT_FINGERPRINTS`, `MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID`, `IOS_APP_STORE_ID`, `COMPANY_*`, `API_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` when `SITE_INDEXABLE=true`).

**Deno (`supabase/functions/public-api`):**
- PUB-05 `/plans` mirrors `plan_limits` (`max_mail_accounts`, `max_calendars`, `ai_daily_budget_units`) and `app_settings['web.pricing_display']` (zod-valid; `verified` and the 90-day `as_of` rule respected);
- PUB-04 `/referrals/:code` returns no referrer PII, answers 200 `valid: false` for unknown codes and enforces its rate limit; the seeded `app_settings` `referral.*` values equal `REFERRAL_DEFAULTS`;
- PUB-01 `/support`: strict schema; honeypot checked before validation; Turnstile verification when `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` is set; per-IP-hash and per-email-hash limits; a 10-minute duplicate returns the same reference; stored `origin='web'`, `platform='web'`, `user_id` null and a non-empty `subject`;
- PUB-02 `/data-deletion/start`: identical body and padded timing for known, unknown and admin emails; no code sent for unknown or admin identities; rate limits;
- PUB-03 `/data-deletion/verify`: a wrong code gives `OTP_INVALID` for existing and unknown emails alike; lockout after 5 failures; one active request per user (a repeat returns the same reference); `origin='web_otp'` and `confirmation_method='email_otp'`; JOB-23 and the `transactional_email` job enqueued; audit row; every session of the user revoked; CORS allow-list = `PUBLIC_WEB_URL`; 202 body;
- PUB-06 `/web-events` rejects unknown events and props and increments `web_analytics_daily`.

**pgTAP:**
- `data_deletion_requests` (owner select, no client insert, `user_id` set-null on auth delete, `subject_hash` retained);
- web tickets (`origin='web'`, `user_id` null) invisible to `anon` and to every authenticated user; `web_analytics_daily` invisible to `anon` and `authenticated`.

**Lighthouse CI:** §0.13 thresholds as a required CI job (`e2e-web` stage).

**Maestro (marketing):** the `apps/mobile/.maestro/marketing/*.yaml` assertions (§15.2) run in `marketing-assets.yml`. They are not in the PR gate.
